bibl.note: Kannada text only (the English translation pages are not in the PDF). Source file: MCLI12_Shivakotyacharya_Proof4US Jun 5_kannada.pdf, 259 pp., book pp. 2-518 (even pages). Editor, translator, publisher and date to be filled in.

projectDesc.p: The text is the machine-readable text of the PDF (exact glyph-level decoding of the typeface MCLIKannada; no OCR). Transliteration is ISO-15919 with ṟ (ಱ) and ḻ (ೞ) kept apart from r and ḷ, and e/o short, ē/ō long. Anusvāra before a stop is written with the nasal of the stop's class (ṅ ñ ṇ n m), as in the other texts of this project; elsewhere ṁ.

Structure: div type="pīṭhike" (the prologue) and div type="kathā" n="1"-"19" (the stories, numbered in the print). Paragraphs carry the number printed in the margin as n; verses (lg) the number printed as story:verse (n = verse number within the story); their type is the label printed before the verse (gāhā: Prakrit; śloka, vr̥tta: Sanskrit). A bracketed paragraph after a verse is the gloss printed in the edition (ab type="gloss"; the brackets are not kept). Letters in square brackets inside the text are supplied. pb n is the page number printed in the book. lb marks the beginning of each printed line in prose, headings and trailers, and lb break="no" a word that continues on the next line; there are no lb in verses, where each l is a printed line (a short continuation line is joined to the line before it with lb).

body.head: vaḍḍārādhane

div.head: pīṭhike
div.p:
śrī vīravardhamāna bhaṭṭārakarge namaskāraṁ
geydu dēvōpasarga manuṣyōpasarga
tirikōpasargamacētanōpasargamendintu caturvidha
mappupasargamumaṁ pasivuṁ nīraḻke modalāgoḍeya
ippatteraḍu parīṣahaṅgaḷumaṁ sairisi aydumindriyaṅgaḷaṁ
geldu bāhyābhyantara parigrahaṅgaḷaṁ toṟedu dvādaśavidhamappa
tapadoḷ negaḻdu prāyōpagamanadiṁ saṁnyasanaṁ geydu
karmakṣayaṁ geydu mōkṣakke vōda mattaṁ sarvārthasiddhiyoḷ
puṭṭida mahāpuruṣarkaḷa kathegaḷaṁ pēḻvalli munnaṁ
sukumārasvāmiya katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ

div.head: sukumāra svāmiya kathe
div.ab:
bhallukkiyēṇa – munnina janmāntaradattigeyappa peṇṇariyindaṁ,
ṇiccaṁ khajjantō – mūṟudivasaṁ nirantaramiruḷuṁ
pagaluṁ tinepaḍutirdonāgiyuṁ, ghōra vēdaṇaṭhṭhōpi
– kaḍidappa vēdaneyindaṁ baḻdidonāgiyuṁ, ārādhaṇaṁ
– samyagdarśana cāritrātmakamappārādhaneyaṁ, jhāṇēṇa –
uttamadhyānadindaṁ, avanti sukumārō –avantiya
sukumārasvāmi, pavaṇṇō – porddidoṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharata kṣētradoḷ vatseyembudu nāḍalli
kausambiyembudu poḻaladanāḷvonatibaḷanembarasanātana
mahādēvi manōhariyemboḷ pesarge takkante
nōḍidarellargaḷa kaṇṇālige sogayisuvaḷ satya
śaucācāraṅgaḷiṁ kūḍidoḷ atyanta rūpalāvaṇya saubhāgya
kānti hāva bhāva vilāsa vibhramaṅgaḷanoḍeyaḷantavargaḷiṣṭa
viṣaya kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttire mattā arasana
mantri sōmaśarmanembonātana bhārye kāśyapiyemboḷ
irvarggaṁ makkaḷagnibhūti vāyubhūtiyembavargaḷ tāy
tandevira kēḷpiyaṁ geyyadā vēdaṁ modalāgoḍeya
śāstraṅgaḷanōdade tande paḍeda kasavaramaṁ biyaṅgeyyuttuṁ
saptavyasanābhibhūtarāgi negaḻuttireyire

palakāladiṁ tande kaḻidoḍe sōmaśarmmaṅge
makkaḷoḷarillendarasaṁ besagoṇḍoḍoḷarendu pēḻdoḍavargge
baḻiyaṭṭivarisi majjanadoḷ misisi uḍisi tuḍisiyūḍi
tambulaṅgoṭṭubbegambaḍadirimendu nuḍidavarggaḷa
duḥkhamanāṟisi bīḍiṅge pōgalvēḻdu kelavu divasadiṁ
baḻiyaṭṭi varisi nīvāvōdugaḷaṁ ballirendirvarumaṁ
besagoṇḍoḍavarggaḷ taleyaṁ bāgi maṟumātuguḍade
kaṇṇanīraṁ tīvi nelanaṁ bareyuttire sabheyoḷirddavarggaḷellaṁ
ivar mūrkharēnumōdugaḷanaṟiyar
saptavyasanābhibhūtarendarasaṅge pēḻdoḍarasanavargaḷanaṭṭi
kaḷedavara dāyigaṁ śāstraṅgaḷaṁ balloṅgaṁ mantri padaviyaṁ
bāḻumaṁ pratipattiyumaṁ koṭṭudaṁ kēḷdu

irvarumubbegambaṭṭu vairāgyaparāyaṇarāgi kappaḍamuṭṭu
baikandiridinnappoḍamōduvamendu tāyge nuḍidoḍaṁ
tappoḍe makkaḷirā magadheyembudu nāḍalli rājagr̥hamembudu
poḻaladanāḷvoṁ subalanembarasanātana mahādēvi
suprabheyemboḷavargge mantriyemmaṇṇaṁ sūryamitranemboṁ
ellā ōdugaḷumaṁ ballonātaṁ nimmanōdisi yōgyaraṁ
māḍuvantire nirūpisi kalpisiyōleyaṁ bareyisi
nimma kayyoḷaṭṭidapeṁ nīmuṁ pōgi nimma māvana
pakkadoḷōdimendōleyaṁ bareyisi koṭṭoḍavarggaḷuṁ
tāyaṁ bīḻkoṇḍu

katipaya divasaṅgaḷiṁ rājagr̥hamaneydi sūryamitrana
maneyaṁ besagoṇḍu pōgi kaṇḍōleyanikkidoḍe
sūryamitranelliṁ bandirārōleyendu
besagoṇḍoḍe kausambiyiṁ bandevu nimma taṅgeyappa
kāśyapiyaṭṭidōleyendoḍōleyaṁ bājisi nōḍi
sōmaśarmaṁ kaḻidudumaṁ mantripadavi peṟarggādudumaṁ
makkaḷ saptavyasanābhibhūtarāgi bāḻiṁ keṭṭudumaṁ
śāstrajñaruṁ buddhiyoḍeyaruṁ yōgyarumappantu māḍi
mendu makkaḷaṁ tanaginitoppisiyaṭṭidudumanintivellamaṁ
bājisi nōḍi ivandirgge pasaraṅgoṭṭenappoḍe munninanturkki
kiḍuvarendu manade bagedagnibhūti vāyubhūtigaḷgintendaṁ
kāśyapiyemboḷenage taṅgeyilla sōmaśarmmanemboṁ
maydunanumilla sūryamitranemba pesarenaguṇṭu
nimma māvanappa sūryamitranallenendavargge nuḍiduṁ
mattamintendaṁ nīmārggārādoḍamēṁ vidyārthi
gaḷāgiyōdaṁ kalvemembaḻtiyoḷ bandirappoḍe
baikandiridu kappaḍamuṭṭiruḷuṁ pagalumalasade
nirbandhadindōdalārpoḍe nimmanōdisalakkumendoḍa
varggaḷumiṁ dayegeyyiṁ mahāprasādamendu
poḍemaṭṭu harṣacittarāgi oḷḷitappa divasa vāra
vidyānakṣatradandu tammanukūladoḷōjarggeṟagi poḍevaṭṭu
vidyāprārambhaṅgeydar

sūryamitranumavaraniruḷuṁ pagaluṁ nirantaraṁ
nirbandhadindōdisi ēḻeṇṭu varuṣadindoḷage
nālkuvēdamumāṟaṅgamuṁ padineṇṭu dharma
śāstraṅgaḷuṁ mīmāṁsā nyāyavistaraṁ vyākaraṇaṁ
pramāṇaṁ chandamalaṅkāraṁ nighaṇṭu kāvya nāṭakaṅgaḷuṁ
cāṇakyaṁ sāmudrikaṁ śālihōtraṁ pāḷakāpyaṁ hānitaṁ
carakamaśvinīmataṁ bāhalaṁ susrutaṁ kṣārapānīyaṁ
modalāgoḍeya naravaidyaṅgaḷuṁ jyōtiṣyaṁ mantravādaṁ
modalāgoḍeya śāstraṅgaḷellamaṁ neṟeye kalpisi yōgyar
māḍidoḍe

avar nimma prasādadindellā śāstramaṁ kaltu
paṇḍitaremādemendādamānumoseduminnemma
nāḍge pōdapemendōjarggeṟagi poḍevaṭṭu
bīḻkoṇḍāgaḷōjarendar nīmemma taṅgeya makkaḷir
sōdaraḷiyandirappir nimagāṁ pasaraṅgoṭṭenillēkendoḍe
munninante tandeyalliyurkki keṭṭantirilliyumettānumurkki
kiḍuvirendāṁ nimmaṁ yōgyaraṁ māḍuva kāraṇamāgi nimage
pasaraṅgoṭṭenillidarkke muḷiyadiriṁ kṣamiyisimenduḍaluṁ
tuḍaluṁ sambaḷamumaṁ koṭṭu kaḻipidāgaḷ

piriyātanagnibhūtiyemboṁ māvanemage
pasaraṅguḍadirvarumaṁ yōgyaraṁ
māḍidarendupakāramaṁ manade bagedādamānuṁ
santōṣaṁ baṭṭaṁ kiṟiyātaṁ vāyubhūti sūryamitraṁ
geydudellamapakāramendu bagedendappoḍamemma
māvaṁ baikandiridu tanda kūḻge nerameṇṇeyanakkuppanakke
kaḻiyanakkendappoḍamikkiyumeṟeyisiyumaṟiyaṁ
keṟege vōgi mīvāgaḷ taleyaṁ
pūsaleṇṇeyanappoḍameṟeyisiyaṟiyaṁ tāṁ
divyamappāhāraṅgaḷaṁ devasadevasakkaṁ palambar
naṇṭarkkaḷuṁ āḷgaḷuṁ berasuṇguṁ parvadivasa
doḷappoḍamendānumivargguṇalikkimendaṟiyaṁ
pañcamahāpātakanemma nēḻeṇṭu varuṣambaraṁ pagevaraṁ
bagevante daṇḍisidanendu manadoḷ muḷisaṁ bhāvisi
poṟamaṭṭu pōdan

antirvaruṁ pōgi katipaya divasaṅgaḷiṁ kauśambiyaneydi
tamma maneyaṁ pokku tāyaṁ kaṇḍu tuḻilgeydu paṇḍitarāgi
bandudaṁ pēḻdu minduṇḍu viśramisiyoḷḷitappa divasa vāra
nakṣatra muhūrtadoḷatibala mahārājanaṁ kaṇḍirvaruṁ
bēṟebēṟupaślōkisi kriyākāraka sambandhadindaṁ vakhkhāṇisi
tamma paṇḍitikkeyanaṟipidoḍe sabheyoḷirdda paṇḍitajanamellaṁ
mecci biccaḷisi pogaḻdo ḍarasaṁ santuṣṭacittanāgi osedu nimma
tandeya mantripadamaṁ bāḻumaṁ kaikoḷḷimendu koṭṭoḍe
mahāprasādamendeṟagi poḍevaṭṭu kaikoṇḍu sukhadoḷ
bāḻuttaṁ palambar paṇḍitarkkaḷgōdugaḷaṁ vakhkhāṇisuttaṁ
lōkadoḷaramaneyoḷaṁ pūjyarāgi sukhasaṅkathā
vinōdadiṁ kālaṁ sale

mattitta rājagr̥hadoḷ sūryamitraṁ subala mahārājana
toṭṭanarghyamappa māṇikyaduṅguramaṁ kaḷedu tanage
tuḍalkendu koṭṭoḍondu divasaṁ sañjevārisalendu
pōdalli ādityaṅgidiraṁ nīraṁ sūsuvāgaḷ beralindamurcci
nīrverasu sūsi tāmareyoḷuṅguraṁ biḻdattu tānuṁ
nōḍade bageyade kemmane kiṟidantaramaṁ pōgi
kaiyaṁ nōḍi beraluṅguramaṁ kāṇadelli keṭṭittendu
pramāṇamaṟiyade malmalaṁ maṟuguttañji desegaḷaṁ
nōḻpannegaṁ dūrāntaradoḷirdda sudharmarembācāryaraṁ
divya jñānigaḷaṁ kaṇḍivarēnānumaṁ ballorappoḍe
besagoṇḍu nōḻpenendu pōgi bhaṭṭāraraṁ kaṇḍu
pakkadoḷirddāgaḷ ītaṁ bhavyanendaṟidu ēnayya arasara
vārakada māṇikaduṅguramaṁ kiḍisi bandire endāgaḷeṟagi
poḍevaṭṭintaṟivaroḷare endu pogaḻdirddintu besagoṇḍaṁ
bhaṭṭārā besasimāvuṅguramaṁ kāṇalakkume endaṅge
bhaṭārar kāṇalakkumendar ninne nīnādityaṅge nīraṁ sūsi
poḍemaḍuvāgaḷā nīrverasu sūsi tāmaregeṟeyoḷage
muḻugirda muguḷamēge taguḷdirdudu nāḷe nēsaṟ
mūḍuvāgaḷ nīrindaṁ mēge negedirdduṅguramaṁ
kāṇalakkumendoḍe santōṣambaṭṭu poḍemaṭṭu pōgi
koḷakke mānasaraṁ kāpiṭṭu maṟudivasaṁ sañjeyoḷ bandu
nōḻpanannegaṁ tāmareya muguḷa mēle taguḷdirdduṅguramaṁ
kaṇḍu koṇḍarasaṅgoppisi turipadindaramaneyaṁ poṟamaṭṭu
pōgi manadoḷintendu bagedanī lōkadoḷirda
sūkṣmāntarita dūra padārtha vastugaḷellamanaṟivantappī
savaṇana jōyisamanentappoḍaṁ kṣapaṇakanaṁ
mithyāvinayadindiḷisi kalvenembudondu buddhiyindaṁ manege
bandu sudēviyemba tanna pārvantige svābhiprāyamellamaṁ
pēḻdu

jyōtiṣa nimittaṁ maneyaṁ poṟamaṭṭu
sudharmācāryarallige pōgi poḍevaṭṭu bhaṭṭārā nimma
pakkade jyōtiṣamaṁ kalvenembudondaḻtiyiṁ bandenennaṁ
jyōtiṣamaṁ kalpippudendoḍe bhaṭārarendar tammā
emma jōyisamemmantappa rūpina r̥ṣiyarggallade
pēḻaluṁ kalalumāgadendoḍe antappa dīkṣeyaṁ
dayageyyimendu bēḍidoḍoḷḷitappa muhūrtadoḷ
dīkṣeyaṁ koṭṭu pañcamahāvrataṅgaḷanēṟisi
paḍikamaṇaṁ pēḻda tadanantaramin kalpisimendoḍe
namaskāraṅgaḷumāḷōcanegaḷaṁ niyamumanōdidoḍallade
pēḻalāgadendoḍellamaṁ bēgavēgaṁ pāṭhaṅgoṇḍu bhaṭṭārā
in pēḻimene bhaṭṭārarendar triṣaṣṭiśalākāpuruṣarkaḷa
caritaṅgaḷumanācāramārādhane modalāgoḍeya caraṇa
granthaṅgaḷumaṁ lōgāṇi saṅgāṇi modalāgoḍeya
karaṇagranthaṅgaḷumanivellamaṁ kaltoḍallade pēḻalāgadendoḍe
sūryamitraṁ paṇḍitanappudaṟindavellamaṁ kiṟide
kāladindōdi kaltu bhaṭṭārā nimma pēḻdōdugaḷellamaṁ
granthārtha svarūpadindōdi kalteṁ in jyōtiṣamaṁ
vakhkhāṇisimendoṅge bhaṭṭārarendar innondadhikāramuṇṭu
dravyānuyōgamembudaṁ kēḷdabaḻikke jyōtiṣa
śāstramaṁ vakhkhāṇisuvenendoḍe manadoḷā
damānumosedondadhikāramembudenagēmuṭṭīgaḷe
kalvenendu bagedu

oḷḷitappa divasa vāra nakṣatra muhūrtadoḷ siddhāntamaṁ
toḍagise entante kēḷgumantante mithyātvaminisinisu
piṅge bandhaṁ bandhakāraṇaṁ mōkṣaṁ mōkṣakāraṇamā
eraḍaṟa phalamumendintu siddhāntadoḷ pēḻda
vastugaḷellamaṁ kēḷdu jīvājīva puṇyapāpāsrava saṁvara
nirjarabandhamōkṣamendintu navapadārthaṅgaḷuṁ
pañcāstikāya ṣaḍdravyaṅgaḷumembivaṟoḷādamānu
maṟitamuṁ kuśalikeyuṁ nambugeyumāgi
arhadbhaṭṭārakara siddhasvarūpamaṁ guṇaṅgaḷumanaṟidu
śaṅkādyaṣṭamalaṅgaḷumeṇṭu madaṅgaḷuṁ mūṟu
mūḍhamumāṟanāyatana sēvegaḷumendintu
ippattaieduṁ dōṣaṅgaḷindagalda samyaktvamanoḍeyanāgi
saṁsāra bhōga vairāgya parāyaṇanumāgi emmukkeva
tapadindamananta sukhakke kāraṇamappa sanmārggamaṁ
pettenendatyanta harṣacittanāgi gurugaḷge tammukkevadiṁ
tapambaṭṭudanāḷōcisi prāyaścittaṅgoṇḍu
paḍikamaṇaṅgeydu paramārthayativararāgi panneraḍu
varṣambaraṁ gurugaḷanagalade tapaṅgeydācāryarāgi
gurugaḷanumatadindēkavihāriyāgi grāmē’karātraṁ nagarē
pañcarātramaṭavyāṁ daśarātramembī teṟadindaṁ grāma
nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba pattana drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ

kauśambige vandudayāvata parvatadoḷ siddhakṣētraṅgaḷellamaṁ
bandisi tīrthōpavāsaṅgeydu bhaikṣakkendu kauśambinagaramaṁ
pokku kiṟumane permaneyennaduṇaltakka manegaḷaṁ
carigedoḻaluttamagnibhūti brāhmaṇana maneyaṁ pokko
ḍātanuṁ kaṇḍidiraṁ paritandādamānuṁ bhaktiyindaṁ niṟisi
kālaṅkarci paḍigahamuccaṁ ṭhāṇamendīvombattu teṟadindaṁ
puṇyamaṁ kaikoṇḍu śraddhe modalāgoḍeya ēḻuṁ guṇaṅgaḷiṁ
kūḍi prāsukamappāhāramanādamānuṁ bhaktiyindaṁ
baḍḍiseyuṇḍin baḻikkakṣayadānamendu parasi pōpāgaḷ

bhaṭṭārā nimma kiṟiya guḍḍanaṁ parasi pōgalvēḻkumendu
vāyubhūtiya manegoḍagoṇḍu pōdoḍātanuṁ piriya
lōhāsanamēṟi palambar pārvargge vakhkhāṇisuttirda
mānagarvadindidiraṁ bandu bandisadirddonaṁ agnibhūti
pōgi vāyubhūtiya kaiyaṁ piḍidenguṁ bhaṭṭārar
namage svāmigaḷ bhaṭṭārara prasādadindaṁ namaginiviridu
śrīyuṁ sampattuṁ vibhavamumādudaṟindameḻdu pōgi
bhaṭṭāraraṁ vandisendoḍavanintendaṁ idēnoḷḷidarggennaṁ
poḍevaḍisidappai pēḻendumaśucigaḷ malagrastarendappoḍaṁ
mindaṟiyadavarivara kālgeṟaguveṁ gaḍamendu pārvara
sabheya naḍuvirddu kaniṣṭha niṣṭhura vacanaṅgaḷiṁ nānā prakāradiṁ
nirākarisi nuḍidu polladaṁ pēḻdaṭṭi kaḷeye agnibhūtiyendaṁ
koy taleyadhamā nīcā svāmiyanintembā endavanaṁ
baydoḍe bhaṭṭārarenguṁ

lg.l: ṇindantaṁ siḷahantaṁ sattuṁ mittuṁ tahēva sukha dukkhaṁ

jō samabhāvai peccai sō samaṇō sōya
pavvayiō
prāṇā hr̥tāḥ mama parairnatu mē samādhiḥ

div.p:
endintu kṣameyaṁ bhāvisidar agnibhūtiyuṁ
bhaṭṭāraroḍanudayāvata parvatakke pōgi intendaṁ bhaṭṭārā
nimmaṁ pañcamahāpātakana manegoḍagoṇḍu pōgi
baysidenadanātaṁ baydonallanāṁ baydenīyaparādhakkenage
kṣamiyisuvudī baysida pāpamintallade piṅgadenage dīkṣeyaṁ
dayageyyimendu kīṟi bēḍidoḍe bhaṭṭāraroḷḷitappa
muhūrtadoḷ dīkṣeyaṁ koṭṭoḍātanuṁ tapambaṭṭu
kriyegaḷellamaṁ kaltu āgamaṅgaḷanōduttaṁ tamma gurugaḷoḍane
vihārisuttirddaṁ

ittalagnibhūtiya pārvanti sōmadatteyemboḷ tannondu
salgeyindamaḻalindaṁ vāyubhūtiyanintendaḷ
sūryamitrabhaṭṭārakar mun brāhmaṇar nimma
sōdaramāvaṅgaḷīgaḷ mahātapōdhanar guṇavantarappar
nimma manege vandoḍe maṇeyinderddidiraṁ pōgi
poḍevaṭṭirillī bāḻuṁ sampattuṁ śrīyumembudavara
prasādadindamādudantappa mahār̥ṣiyaraṁ nimage
paḻiyaluṁ bayyaluṁ tiraskarisi nuḍiyalumakkume
adhamara pollamānasara durjanara jārajātara vijātigaḷge
yōgyamappayōgyamaṁ geydirendu pārvara sabheya
naḍuve nuḍidoḍe vāyubhūtiyuṁ muḷidu baydu
jaḍidu kālindaṁ taleyanodedu maneyoḷuḷḷudellamaṁ
kavardukoṇḍu nimma savaṇanāgirddāṇmana pōdallige
pōgendaṭṭi kaḷedoḍākeyuṁ muḷidu krōdhāgni perce
durātmā ennanodeda ninna kālgaḷaṁ janmāntaradoḷaṁ nāyuṁ
nariyumāgiyappoḍaṁ kondu makkaḷverasu timbenakkendu
nidānaṅgeydu maneyindaṁ makkaḷverasu poṟamaṭṭupōgi
kelavu kāladiṁ baḻikke sattu tānuṁ makkaḷuṁ saṁsāradoḷ
tiriyuttirddar

itta vāyubhūtiyumatimāna garvadindaṁ r̥ṣiyaraṁ
paribhavisi baydu nuḍidu jinadharmamaṁ paḻida pāpada
phaladindamēḻuṁ divasadindoḷagaudumbara kuṣṭhamāgi
puḻitu namedu sattu kausambiyemba poḻaloḷ miḷiya
bidira mēgēṟiyākāśadoḷāḍuva vidyādhara laṅgigara
maneyoḷ peṇgatteyāgi puṭṭi piriyavappa poṟegaḷaṁ pottu
pōgi bennoḷ nāḷi birddu kaṟimeyāgi puḻitu namedu
sattu mattamā poḻaloḷ pēpandiyāgi puṭṭi sattu mattā
magadheyembudu nāḍalli campānagaramembudu poḻalalli
peṇṇāyāgi mādegara maneyoḷ puṭṭi sattu mattamā
poḻaloḷ mādegargge pradhānanappa nīḷanemba mādegaṅgaṁ
kēśiyemba mādegigaṁ magaḷ durūpe durvvarṇe durgandhe
dussvare puṭṭuṅguruḍi polatiyāgi puṭṭi vyādhipīḍite
kṣudhāgniyiṁ baḻdidoḷ

ondu divasamudyānavanakke pōgi nēṟila paṇgaḷaṁ
taḍavarisiyāydāydu tinnuttirpaḷ annegamitta
sūryamitrācāryarumagnibhūtimuniyuṁ grāma
nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba pattana drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ campānagaramaneydi vāsupūjya
bhaṭṭārara nisiddhige sanda tīrthasthānamanādamānuṁ śuddha
pariṇāmadindaṁ vandisuttirdda sūryamitrācāryarggavadhi
jñānaṁ puṭṭittu matte bahirudyānadoḷ
sambaranāgaṭhāṇadoḷ bandirdarandina divasaṁ
sūryamitrācāryarupavāsaṁ geydirddaragnibhūtimuniyuṁ
bhaikṣānimittaṁ carigevoguttaveḍeyoḷudyānavanadoḷ
nēṟila marada keḻage nēṟila paṇgaḷaṁ taḍavarisi āydu tinba
jātyandheyappa poleyara kūsaṁ kaṇḍatyanta snēhamāgi
paravasadindaṁ kaṇṇīrgaḷaṁ sūsiyeytandu manyumikku
karuṇadinde kuñcada kōloḷ paredirda paṇgaḷaṁ kūsina
munde sārccuttaṁ nīḍuṁ bēgamirddidēṁ pāpada phalamo
endu saṁsāra nirvēgamāge

andina divasamalābhaṁ māḍi tammāvāsakke
pōdoḍe bhaṭṭārarendar ēnalābhamādude
endu besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭṭārarggintendu pēḻdar
carigevuguttamondeḍeyoḷudyānadoḷ nēṟila marada
keḻage taḍavarisi nēṟila paṇgaḷaṁ tinba jātyandheyappa poleyara
kūsaṁ kaṇḍādamānuṁ snēhamāgi karuṇadindaṁ manyu
mikku paravasadindaṁ kaṇṇīrgaḷ bandu nīḍuṁ bēgamirddu
nōḍi ahō vidhātrā saṁsāramendalābhaṁ māḍi
bandenene bhaṭṭārarendar ā kūsembudu nimma tammanappa
vāyubhūtiya jīvamene adentu bhaṭṭārā endu
besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭṭārarintendu pēḻdar vāyubhūti
tannondu mānagarvadindemmaṁ paḻidu baydu nuḍida
pāpada phaladindēḻu divasadindoḷagaudumbara kuṣṭhamāgi
puḻitu namedu sattā poḻaloḷe laṅgigara maneyoḷ
peṇgatteyāgi puṭṭi namedu sattu pēpandiyāgi puṭṭi sattu
peṇṇāyāgi puṭṭi sattīgaḷ jātyandhe poleyara magaḷāgi
puṭṭidaḷadaṟiṁ munnina snēhaṁ kāraṇamāgi kūsina mēge
nimage kūrmeyādudene bhaṭṭārā adēṁ bhavyajīvano
abhavyajīvano endu besagoṇḍoḍe bhavyajīvaṁ nimma pēḻe
brataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoḷgumendoḍe

bhaṭṭāraranumatadindagnibhūti r̥ṣiyar pōgi tamma
munnina janmāntara sambandhamumaṁ r̥ṣiyaraṁ ēḷidu
nuḍida pāpada phaladindeydida bhavaṅgaḷa duḥkhaṅgaḷumanā
kūsiṅgaṟivantu tiḷiye pēḻdu mattamintendar munne nīnī
bhavadiṁ toṭṭaydaneya bhavadoḷ vāyubhūtiyappandu
mānagarvadiṁ r̥ṣiyaraṁ bayda pāpada phaladindintappa
duḥkhaṅgaḷaneydide in mattaṁ madhu madyamāṁsaṅgaḷaṁ
bhakṣisi naraka tirika manuṣyabhavaṅgaḷoḷappa duḥkhaṅgaḷanantananta
kālamanubhavisi nīḍaṟindettānumallade manuṣyabhavamaṁ
peṟadu pettoḍamintāgi puṭṭuguṁ

lg.l:
vairūpyaṁ durbhagatvaṁ kumati kujanatāṁ kutsitatvaṁ
kujātiṁ
pāpātkila jāyantē vāmana paṅgvandha kubjakhañja karāḷāḥ
jaḍa badhira mūka kr̥śarōmaśa vakra nibiḍāḷistē
vasanta tilakaṁ॥uddanta kubja kuṇikuṇḍa karāḷa kāṇāḥ

kulahīnaṁ dīnamānaṁ paribhava vibhavaṁ duṣkr̥taṁ
pāpakarmaṁ

malinaṁ durgandha gandhaṁ jaḍamati kivuḍaṁ paṅgu
mūkaṁ…taṁ nā

ṇili pāṇbaṁ pande lōbhaṁ khaḷanaḷika manaṁ vañcakaṁ
nityarōgā

kuḷanembī nāma nāmāvaḷige niḷayanakkuṁ vratavrāta
hīnaṁ

div.p:
intu pūrvakr̥ta pāpada phaladindaṁ vrataṅgaḷaṁ
kaikoṇḍaḻidudaṟindaṁ manuṣya janmadoḷ puṭṭiyuṁ
duḥkhagaḷaneyduguṁ jīvaṁ matte dharmada phaladindaṁ

lg.l:
śrī vakṣaścāru rūpaṁ kula bala vinayaṁ khyāti
dīrghāyuṣatvaṁ

svarggē martyē labhantē dyutimatipaṭutāṁ rājarājaśriyaṁ
ca

saubhāgyaṁ pūjyavākyaṁ jagati madhusurā māṁsa
sēvānivr̥ttāḥ

dyuti mati dhr̥ti kānti śrī hrī rūpārōgya satvabala
sampannāḥ
ājñā yaśō dhr̥ti mati dyuti kānti lakṣmī

varayuvati bhavana vāhana nāṭaka dhana kanaka rajatamaṇi
surathāḥ
ati lalita turaga mada daḷita nāga bhr̥tyā bhavanti dharmēṇa

div.p:
intu dharmada phaladindaṁ dēvalōkada manuṣya lōkada
sukhaṅgaḷananubhavisi baḻikke nirvāṇa sukhamaneyduguṁ
jīvaminnā dharmamembudentendoḍe

lg.l:
sō dhammō jattha dayā sōvi taō visayaṇiggahō
jattha
dasa aṭṭha dōsarahiō sō dēvō ṇatthi sandēhō

div.p:
endintu padineṇṭu dōṣaṅgaḷanilladoṁ dēvanantappa
dēvana pēḻdudāgamamembudakkumā āgamaṁ pēḻdantu
bāhyābhyantara parigrahaṅgaḷellamaṁ toṟedu dvādaśavidhamappa
tapadoḷnegaḻdu aydumindriyaṅgaḷaṁ geldu pasivuṁ nīraḻke
modalāgoḍeya ippatteraḍu parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ sairisi yama
niyama svādhyāya dhyānānuṣṭhāna niratarāgi tapaṅgeyva
r̥ṣiyarkaḷ tapōdhanar kolladude dharmamendintu nambi
vrataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu negaḻvudu dharmamembudakkum

endagnibhūti risiyar tiḷiye dharmamaṁ pēḻdoḍerdeyoḷ
mellidaḷāgi tanna bhavāntaraṅgaḷaṁ dharmamumaṁ kēḷdaṟidu
saṁsāra śarīra vairāgyamādamānuṁ perce tannaṁ tāne
paḻidu nindisi pāpakkañji aṇuvrataṁ modalāgoḍeya
śrāvaka brataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍāgaḷ bhaṭṭāraruṁ dr̥ḍhavrateyāgu
karmakṣayamakkendu parasi tammāvāsakke pōdaritta
jātyandheyappa kūsumahiṁsādi vrataṅgaḷaṁ mēlkoṇḍu tanna
manege pōpāgaḷ

annegaṁ eḍeyoḷarasana purōhitaṁ sōmaśarmanemboṁ
tanna parivāraṁ berasu mahāvibhūti vistāradindaṁ
piridu pūjeyaṁ koṇḍu makkaḷaṁ bēḍi
sambaranāgaṭhāṇakke parakeguḍal pōpudaṁ tannoḍa
vōpa poleyara kūsugaḷ kaṇḍu tanage vyāvarṇisi
pēḻe kēḷdadaṟoḷ manamiṭṭumavargge sattu
puṭṭuvenakkendu bhōgāsakteyāgi nidānaṅgeydu manege
vōgi irppannegamāyiruḷoḷe pāvu koḷe sattu
campānagaramanāḷvoṁ candravāhananembonarasanātana
mahādēvi candramatiyemboḷavara purōhitaṁ
sōmaśarmanemboṁ bhaṭṭanātana pārvanti
trivēdiyemboḷāyirvarggaṁ nāgaśrīyemboḷ magaḷāgi
puṭṭidoḷatyanta rūpalāvaṇya saubhāgya kāntiyanoḍeyaḷ
janaṅgaḷgellamādamānuṁ sogayisuvaḷ nāgarge parasi
pettarappudaṟiṁ nāgaśrīyendu pesaraniṭṭar mattitta
sūryamitrācāryar agnibhūtiruṣiyarumantirvaruṁ
campānagaramaṁ poṟamaṭṭu grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa
maḍamba pattana drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ
ēḻeṇṭu varṣadiṁ maguḻdu campānagarakke vandu
poṟavoḻaloḷudyānavanadoḷ kambaḷanāgaṁ śambharanāgaṁ
pāṇḍukanāgamendī nāgara pesaranoḍeya munnirdda
nāgaṭhāṇadoḷ bandirddar

annegaṁ nāgaśrīyuṁ pañcamiyandu mantriyarkkaḷa
pergaḍegaḷa rājaśrēṣṭhiyara pradhānarappa niyōgigaḷa palambaruṁ
peṇgūsugaḷverasu piridumarcaneyaṁ koṇḍu nāgaṭhāṇakke
pōgi nāgaranarcisi poḍevaṭṭu sūryamitrācāryaru
magnibhūti ruṣiyaraṁ kaṇḍu jātismareyāgi tanna munnina
polatiyāgi puṭṭida bhavamanaṟidu bhaṭṭārara kālgeṟagi
poḍevaṭṭu kuḷḷirdāgaḷā kūsaṁ kaṇḍu agnibhūti ruṣiyargati
snēhamāgi tamma gurugaḷaṁ sūryamitrācāryaranintendu
besagoṇḍar bhaṭṭārā ī kūsina mēgemagādamānuṁ
mōhamādudarke kāraṇamēnendu besagoṇḍoḍe
bhaṭṭāraravadhijñānamaṁ prayōgisi intendu pēḻdar
ī kūsembudu nimma tammanappa vāyubhūtiya jīvaṁ
abhimānaṁ kāraṇamāgemmanuṟade paribhavisi bāyge
vandudane pollameya bayguḷaṁ baydumā pāpada
phaladindamēḻudivasadindoḷagaudumbara kuṣṭhamāgi puḻitu
sattu kausambiyoḷe laṅgigara maneyoḷ peṇgatteyāgi piriya
poṟegaḷaṁ pottu pōgi bennoḷ kaṟumeyāgi nāḷi birdu
puḻitu namedu sattu pēpandiyāgi puṭṭi sattu peṇṇāyāgi
puṭṭi sattu mattī campānagaradoḷ mādegarge pradhānanappa
nīḷanemba mādegaṅgaṁ kēśiyemba mādegigaṁ durūpe
durgandhe dusvare jātyandhe poleyarge magaḷāgi puṭṭi nīvu
pratibōdhise vrataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu nidānaṅgeydu pāvu
koḷe sattu purōhitaṁ sōmaśarmaṅgaṁ trivēdigaṁ puṭṭida
nāgaśrīyemboḷ magaḷādaḷadaṟiṁ nimagī kūsina mēgati
snēhamādudu

endu pēḻdudellamaṁ nāgaśrī kēḷdu kaḻidaydu bhavaṅgaḷuṁ
tanage pratyakṣamādantaṟidu bhaṭṭārara kālgeṟagi poḍevaṭṭu
dharmamaṁ besagoṇḍu kēḷdaṇuvrataṁ modalāgoḍeya
śrāvaka vrataṅgaḷaṁ samyaktva pūrvakaṁ kaikoṇḍu vandisi manege
pōpāgaḷ bhaṭṭārar magaḷe emma koṭṭa brataṅgaḷaṁ nimmammaṁ
bisuḍalvēḻdanappoḍe peṟavuḻivisuḍadiremmallige vandemma
koṭṭa brataṅgaḷanemagoppisuvudene kēḷdantegeyvenendu
manege vōdoḍoḍaneya kūsugaḷ sōmaśarma bhaṭṭaṅge
nimma magaḷ risiyara pakkade śrāvaka brataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu
bandaḷene bhaṭṭaṁ kēḷdu magaḷe nāgaśrī nāmuṁ pārvaremuṁ
lōkakkellamaggaḷaṁ lōkadindaṁ pūjitaremumemmindaggaḷaṁ
peṟarilladaṟindaṁ savaṇara dharmamaṁ namage koḷalāga
bisuḍu ene nāgaśrīyendaḷ ammā vrataṅgaḷaṁ koṭṭa
risiyarge pōgiyoppisi bisuḻpeneneyante geyyendu magaḷa
kaiyaṁ piḍidirvaruṁ risiyarallige vrataṅgaḷanoppisalkendu
pōpannegaṁ

āveḍeyoḷ baṭṭeyoḷorvanaṁ peḍaṅgayyuḍiye kaṭṭi
ondevaṟeguṭṭi poḻala janaṅgaḷ musuṟikoṇḍu
nōḍuttamoḍavare nūṅkuttuṁ kolaluyva puruṣanaṁ
yavvananaṁ tējasviyaṁ kaṇḍu nāgaśrī tammammanaṁ
besagoḷgumītananēke kolaluydapporammā besagoḷḷimene
sōmaśarmanuṁ kolaluyva taḷāṟanaṁ besagoṇḍu
tadvr̥ttāntamellamanaṟidu nāgaśrīgintendu pēḻguṁ

ī poḻala pradhānanappa śrēṣṭhi indradattanemboṁ padināṟuṁ
kōṭi kasavaramanoḍeyonātana maganītaṁ varasēnanemboṁ
jūdāḍiyakṣadhūrtanemboṅge sāsira dīnāramaṁ sōltu
sōlamaṁ kuḍalāṟade arasanāṇeyaṁ mikku pōpan
mundaḍḍamāgirddonananaparādhiyanakṣadhūrtanaṁ konda
nadaṟindarasanītanaṁ kolalvēḻdanadaṟiṁ kolulaydapar
magaḷe endu pēḻdoḍe nāgaśrīyendaḷ antappoḍamānuṁ
risiyara pakkade bratamaṁ sāviṅgañji jīvaṅgaḷaṁ kollenemba
bratamaṁ koṇḍenā bratamanavargoppisidoḍānuma
mōghaṁ jīvaṅgaḷaṁ kolalvēḻkumā jīvaṅgaḷaṁ
kondoḍennumanītanante peḍaṅgayyuḍiye
kaṭṭiyondevaṟeguṭṭi nīmella naṇṭar nōḍe śmaśānakkuydu
sūladoḷikki kolvarene antappoḍe īyondu kollada
vrataṁ ninagirke magaḷe uḻida brataṅgaḷellamaṁ pōgiyā
kṣapaṇaṅgoppisuvam

endu kiṟidantaramaṁ pōpannegaṁ mattorvanaṁ munninante
kolalkoṇḍu pōpa puruṣanaṁ kaṇḍu nāgaśrī tammammanaṁ
besagoḷalvēḻdoḍātanuṁ besagoṇḍellamanaṟidu
magaḷgintendu pēḻguṁ kēḷ magaḷe vainayikanembo
norvapuruṣaṁ kanneya baṇṭana vr̥ddhastrīya mūvara
citrakathegaḷaṁ paṭadoḷ tōṟi pēḻdu lōgaraṁ ḍambisi
māṟugoḷva battamaṁ kaḷvonā mūṟuṁ kathegaḷoḷage kanneya
katheyaṁ pēḻvenadentendoḍe

kauśambiyemba poḻaloḷ sumitranemboṁ śrēṣṭhi kōṭi
kasavaramanoḍeyanātana magaṁ vasumitranemboṅge
sarpadaṣṭamādoḍe sattanendu śmaśānakke koṇḍu pōgi
iḻipidoḍalli garuḍanābhiyemba mantravādi pōgi nōḍi
ītananāṁ nāḷeyabhimantrisi bāḻisuvenañjadirimilliye
iruḷī dāṣṭikaṅge jāvamirimendu pēḻdu pōdaṁ
sumitraseṭṭiyuṁ nālvaroḷḷidarappa subhaṭaraṁ jāvamirisi
pōdanā nālvaruṁ jāvamirda bhaṭaroḷagorvaniruḷ
kuṟiyaṁ kaḷdu taral pōdaṁ mattorvaṁ puḷḷiyaṁ taral
pōdaṁ mattorvaṁ kiccaṁ taral pōdaṁ mattorvaṁ
dāṣṭikanā pakkade kāpirdanantā nālvaruṁ kuṟiyaṁ kondu
suṭṭu tindaremba katheyumaṁ poḻtaṟine nēsarmūḍe
garuḍanābhiyemba mantravādi bandu paṟeguṭṭi mantrisi
dāṣṭikananettidaṁ sumitraseṭṭiyumiruḷ jāvamirda
nālvar subhaṭarggōrorvarge sāsira dīnārada
poṭṭaḷigegaḷaṁ prāsādada mēgirdu janasaṅkīrṇada
naḍuve nālku poṭṭaḷigeyanīḍāḍidoḍā poṭṭaḷigeyaṁ
koṇḍukoḷḷenendu pusidoḍā śrēṣṭhiyumarasarge
pōgi binnapaṅgeydan enna sāsirada dīnārada poṭṭaḷige
keṭṭudadaṁ dēvarāraivudendu pēḻdoḍe taḷāṟanaṁ karedu
bēgaṁ kaḷḷananārayyalladāgaḷ kaḷḷaṅge takka nigrahamaṁ ninage
māḻpenendarasanātanaṁ baggisi nuḍidoḍātanumaṟasi
kaḷḷananārayyalāṟade nālvar subhaṭarumaṁ manegoḍagoṇḍu
bandu bhītanāgi binnane mogaṁ bāḍi cintisutirddoḍātana
magaḷ sumatiyembaḷintēke binnanāgi cintisuttirddeyammā
endu tandeyaṁ besagoṇḍoḍātanuṁ tadvr̥ttāntamellamaṁ
magaḷgaṟiye pēḻdoḍañjalvēḍidanellamanānāraydu
kaḷḷanumaṁ kasavaramumaṁ nāḷe nimagoppisuveṁ nīmuṁ
niścintamirimendu tandeyanēkāntadoḷ nuḍidu tandeyaṁ
santavisidāgaḷ sumatiyumiruḷ kaḷḷaraṁ parīkṣisalvēḍiyā
nālvaruṁ subhaṭara pakkadirddēnendavargge katheyaṁ pēḻguṁ

pāṭaḷīputramemba puramalli śrēṣṭhi sudattanembonātana
magaḷ sudāmeyemba kanneyondu divasaṁ gaṅgeyaṁ
mīyalpōgi mīvalli negaḻ piḍidoḍādamānumañji
taḍiyoḷirda dhanadattanemboṁ sōdaramaydunanaṁ kaṇḍennaṁ
bēgaṁ biḍisendoḍātanintendanenna bēḍidudanīvoḍe ninnaṁ
kāvenendoḍākeyumīvenendu pūṇdoḍe bēgaṁ nīraṁ
pokku negaḻaṁ biḍisida baḻikka pēḻēnaṁ bēḍuvay ninna
bēḍidudellamanīvenendu kanne nuḍidoḍātanintendaṁ ninna
maduveyandu prathama divasada pasadanamanenage vandu
tōṟalvēḻkumendu bēḍidoḍākeyumante geyvenendu
pūṇdaḷ

intu kālaṁ sale mattā kannege yauvanaṁ neṟedandu
maduveyādoḍe tanna pūṇkeyaṁ nenedu
sarvālaṅkāra bhūṣiteyāgiyādamānuṁ kaigeydu
celveyāgi naṭṭanaḍuviruḷ maneyindaṁ poṟamaṭṭu
maidunanirdāpaṇakke pōpannegaveḍeyoḷ kaḷḷanorvaṁ
kaṇḍu ninna toṭṭābharaṇamellamaṁ koṭṭu pōgalladāṁ
pōgalīyenendoḍīgaḷe pōgi bandu ninagenna
tuḍugeyellamaṁ kuḍuvenannegamilli enna barpannegamettaṁ
pōgadirendu nambe nuḍidu santaisi kiṟidantaramaṁ
pōdoḍe taḷāṟaṁ kaṇḍī poḻtetta pōdappay
pollamānasiye endātaṁ piḍidu kāḍe piridondu
manevāḻteyuṇṭennaṁ kāḍade pōgalīyānīgaḷe pōgi
ninnallige bandappeṁ bandoḍe ninna meccugeyvenendu nambe
nuḍidu nannigoṭṭu kiṟidantaramaṁ pōpannegameḍeyoḷ
brahmarākṣasaṁ kaṇḍu tannaṁ tinnal bagedoḍe
brahmarākṣasaṅgendaḷ piriyadondu manevāḻteyuṇṭīgaḷe
pōgi bandappeṁ banda baḻikkennaṁ meccidante māḍendu
nannigoṭṭu nambisi pōdoḍā kaḷḷanuṁ taḷāṟanuṁ
brahmarākṣasanumantumīkeyī poḻtu turipadindaḻkaṟindetta
pōdappaḷendu baḻivaḻiyane nōḍuttaṁ pōpar

annegaṁ maydunaṁ paṭṭirddāpaṇakke pōgi bāgilaṁ
teṟeyiṁmendāgaḷavarārendu besagoṇḍāgaḷānalte
sudāmeyenendoḍe bāgilaṁ teṟedāpaṇadoḷagaṁ
pokkaḷanī poḻtēke bandeyendu besagoṇḍoḍe nīnalte
enna nannigoṇḍay enna maduveyandu prathama divasada
pasadanamanenage tōṟalvēḻkumendu bēḍidoḍāṁ pratijñeyaṁ
neṟapal bandenendu tannaṁ tōṟidoḍātanumākeya rūpaṁ
nōḍi mecci vidyādhariya dēvagaṇikeya rūpane pōlve endu
pogaḻdu mattamintendaṁ pratijñeyaṁ neṟapide oḷḷittāytī
poḻtu polladu vande naṭṭanaḍuviruḷ kaḷḷaruṁ taḷāṟaruṁ
kāḍuvar bēgaṁ pōgendu nuḍidu pōgalvēḻdoḍe

adellamanā mūvaruṁ poṟage kēḷdu mattaṁ bēgavēgaṁ
pōgi tammirdeḍegaḷoḷirdarannegamā madevaḷ
rakkasanallige bandēnennaṁ nīṁ meccidantaṁ māḍendu tannaṁ
tōṟidoḍā brahmarākṣasanintendaṁ nīṁ satyavādiyay
ādamānuṁ rūpu lāvaṇya saubhāgya kānti hāvabhāva
vilāsa vibhramaṅgaḷanoḍeyaḷay ninnaṁ tindānāva gatige
pōpeṁ ninna rūpanaḻiyalāṟenadaṟinañjade pōgendu
pōgalvēḻdoḍe barpaḷannegaṁ taḷāṟanaṁ kaṇḍinnennaṁ nīṁ
meccugeyyendu nuḍidoḍātanintendaṁ nīṁ pollamānasiye
endu manadoḷe bagedeṁ ninnantoḷḷidarārumilla nuḍida
nanniyaṁ tappade bande satyavādiyay pōgabbā endu
pōgalvēḻdoḍe barpaḷannegaṁ kaḷḷanaṁ kaṇḍu tanna toṭṭābharaṇa
manellamaṁ kaḷedoppiseyātanintendanenagēnonde
bhavame ninna kaiyadaṁ koṇḍānēnācandrārkatārambaraṁ
barddappene eṇikoṇḍa kasavaraṁ tavanidhiyante tavadi
rddappude ninna kaiyindaṁ koḷḷe pōgabbā endu
pōgalvēḻdanantā mūvaruṁ madevaḷaṁ pōgalvēḻdu pūjisi
kaḻipidoḍākeyuṁ tanna manege pōdaḷ

intavaroḷagoḷḷidarāraṇṇaṅgaḷirā pēḻimendu
sumatiyemba kanne besagoṇḍāgaḷā subhaṭaroḷorvaniruḷ
kuṟiyaṁ kondavaṁ bommarākṣasanākeyaṁ tinnade
kaḻipidoḍātanoḷḷidanendaṁ sarpadaṣṭanaṁ kādirdātaṁ
taḷāṟaṁ kāḍade kaḻipidanātanoḷḷidanendaṁ kiccaṁ taral
pōdātanintendaṁ madevaḷaṁ sōdaramaydunanatyanta
rūpalāvaṇya saubhāgya kānti hāva bhāva vilāsa
vibhramaṅgaḷanoḍeyoḷaṁ sōdaramāvana magaḷaṁ tannallige
vandoḷanēkāntaṁ samanisidoḍākegaḷipade pōgavēḻda
dhanadattanoḷḷidanendaṁ puḷḷiyaṁ taral pōdātaṁ sāsira
dīnārada poṭṭaḷigeyaṁ kaḷdātanintendaṁ madevaḷ toṭṭā
bharaṇamellamaṁ koḷḷade kaḻipida kaḷḷanoḷḷidanendoḍe

ātan kaḷḷanappudanaṟidu kiṟidu bēgamirdā nuḍigaḷellamaṁ
maṟeyisi ellarumaṁ maṟalundisida baḻikkamā kaḷḷananeḻbi
ēkāntadoḷintendu nuḍiguṁ ninagānāṭisidenenage
neṟeye tuḍugeyaṁ māḍisal bhāgasamuḷḷoḍe ninagāṁ
peṇḍatiyenāgi ninnoḍavarpenendavananurkevadindaṁ
manaṅgoḷe nambe nuḍidoḍātanuṁ meyyaṟiyade dīnārada
sahasrada poṭṭaḷigeyaṁ tegedu koṭṭānidaṟoḷage ninage
tuḍugeyaṁ māḍisuveṁ bā pōpamirvarumendoḍante
geyvenendu ponna poṭṭaḷigeyaṁ tandeya maṟalundidallige
vōgi baruṇṭi eḻbi poṭṭaḷigeyaṁ tandege koṭṭaḷ
koṭṭoḍātanuṁ kaḷḷanumaṁ dīnārada sahasrada
poṭṭaḷigeyumaṁ koṇḍu pōgiyarasaṅgoppisidanembī
citrakathegaḷumaṁ janaṅgaḷge pēḻdu battamaṁ kaḷdoṁ
vainayikanemboṁ kaḷḷan

innumātana pēḻda kathegaḷumaṁ pēḻveṁ kēḷ magaḷe
endu sōmaśarmabhaṭṭaṁ nāgaśrīgintendu pēḻguṁ
dharmapuramembudu poḻalalli nāgadattanemboṁ
śrēṣṭhiyātana baṇṭaṁ vainākanembonātanondu divasaṁ
karbbina keyyanuḻvoṁ nidānamaṁ kaṇḍadaṁ maṟasalvēḍi
tanna peṇḍatiya manamaṁ parīkṣisalvēḍi kr̥taka garbhamaṁ
tāḷdire peṇḍati kaṇḍidēn basiṟoḷirdudendoḍātanā
mātinoḷēno kemmagirendoḍāke nirbandhadiṁ kīṟi
besagoḷeyārgaṁ pēḻeyappoḍe ninage pēḻvenendintendaṁ
puruṣarkkaḷgāgadudenagādudendu pēḻdoḍadaṁ kēḷdu
sairisalāṟade poḻala janaṅgaḷellamaṟivantu pēḻdaḷeṁ
beraḍaneya katheyumaṁ pēḻdu

mūṟaneya vr̥ddhastrīya katheyanintendu pēḻal toḍaṅgidaṁ
haripuriyemba poḻaloḷ gambhīreyemboḷorvaḷ
birddiyākeya magaḷ hariṇiyemboḷākeyaṁ
jayantamemba poḻaloḷ vasudattanemba paradaṅge
koṭṭoḍākege garbhamāgi mōdageya mēge
bayakeyādoḍe tāy palavuṁ teṟada laḍḍugegaḷ
maṇḍagegaḷuṁ modalāgoḍeya palavuṁ bhakṣya
rūpaṅgaḷumaṁ koṇḍu gambhīreyemba birddi haripuradiṁ
poṟamaṭṭu magaḷiddūrgge pōpaḷannegaveḍeyoḷeṇbar
kaḷḷaraṁ kaṇḍavaroḷagorvanaṁ piḍidaḻtenna magaṁ ninnane
pōlkuṁ panneraḻbarisaṁ pōdonetta pōdanendaṟiyenātanaṁ
kāṇadiruḷuṁ pagaluṁ nenedaḻtu kaṇgaḷ bātirpuvindenage
ātaṁ bandantire ninnaṁ kaṇḍu santasamāytu magane nīmellaṁ
banniṁ pōpaṁ sāreyūraṁ minduṇḍuṭṭu viśramisi nāḷe
pōpirendoḍagoṇḍu pōgi magaḷa maneyaneydi avargellaṁ
nīraniḍisi taleyaṁ pūsisiyollaṇigeyanuḍisi taleyoḷ
kaḻiyaṁ poydāgaḷ birddi maneya mēgēṟi kaḷḷarendu
puyyaliṭṭāgaḷanibaruṁ trastābhibhūtarāgi paṭṭane pāṟiyōḍi
keṭṭoḷḷittemmaṁ birddi chidrisidaḷendu pagesāṟirddar

itta birddiyuṁ neṭṭanindiruḷ kaḷḷar barparendaṟidu
kūritappa bāḷaṁ piḍidirdaḷannegamiruḷ kaḷḷar
vandākeya lundida maneyoḷ kannamikkidoḍe kannada
bāgiloḷā bāḷanaḍḍamiṭṭu piḍidirdu puguva kaḷḷana
mūganaridoḍavaṁ poṟamaṭṭu tanage pugal pāṅgilla
nīṁ pugendu peṟanorvanaṁ pugisidoḍātana mūgumaṁ
koṟedoḍātanuṁ peṟanorvanaṁ pugise sūḻu sūḻoḷe
pokkoḍanibara mūgumaṁ koṟedikkidoḍanibaruṁ
mūgariyepaṭṭu poṟamaṭṭu pōgi

orvanindrajāligana maneyoḷ kannamikki puḍukeyaṁ
tegedu pottupōgi poṟavoḻaloḷ śmaśānadoḷiḻipi
kuṟiyaṁ kaḷdu tandaṟuvar kaḷḷaruṁ maṟalundidarorvanā
kuṟiyaṁ kondu jāvamirdu masaṇada kiccinoḷ
piśitamaṁ māḍuttirddu puḍukeyaṁ teṟedu
nōḻpanannegamadaṟoḷagirda indrajāligara pāpegaḷuṁ
sīregaḷuṁ jhaṇambamumaṁ koṇḍondu pratimukhamaṁ
koṇḍu tanna mukhadoḷiṭṭu puliya jhaṇambamumaṁ
toṭṭu śmaśānadoḷuriva kiccina pakkade nindirdanannegameḻcattu
kaṇḍaṟuvaruṁ kaḷḷaruṁ bētāḷanendañji prāṇabhayadindōḍi
keṭṭarātanumavarōḍuvudaṁ kaṇḍu piśitamaṁ koṇḍu
baḻiyaṁ taguḷe enitenitātanaṁ kāṇbaranitanitane bētāḷaṁ
baḻiyaṁ taguḷdanendōḍe pratimukhamuṁ jhaṇambamumaṁ
kaḷedīḍāḍi tanna pesaraṁ pēḻdavaraṁ māṇisiyoḍagūḍi tanna
māḍida piśitamanavarggellaṁ perccigoṭṭumanibarumondāgi
pōpannegaṁ

itta gambhīreyemba birddi baigiruḷinondu jāvamuṇṭene
eḻdu poḻalaṁ poṟamaṭṭu tannūrggevōpaḷ neraṁ beṟadañji
vandāladamarananēṟirdaḷannegamā kaḷḷarākeyēṟirdda marakke
vandavaroḷorvaṁ baṭṭeyoḷ barpa janamaṁ nōḍalvēḍi
marada tuttatudiyanēṟi nōḻpannegaṁ marada mēgirda
vr̥ddhastrīyaṁ kaṇḍu nīnārggendātaṁ besagoṇḍoḍākeyānī
maradoḷirppa yakṣadēvateyenendoḍātanenage peṇḍatiyappā
endu besagoṇḍoḍondu pāṅginoḷappenī piśitada
khaṇḍamaṁ nālageyiṁ piḍidenna bāyoḷiḍuvoḍe ninagāṁ
peṇḍatiyappenendu nuḍidoḍātanuṁ nālageyindaṁ
piśitada khaṇḍamaṁ bāyoḷiḍe nālageyaṁ paṟiye
kaccidoḍavaṁ puyyaliṭṭañji bīḻe anibaruṁ bhayadindōḍe
vr̥ddhastrīyendaḷ enage nimma kaḷvalliyellameṇṭaneya
bhāgamaṁ tandī poḻaloḷiṭṭu pōpoḍe
bāḻviralladāgaḷ sattir nimmellarumaṁ tindappenendoḍañji
kaḷḷarantegeyvemendoḍambaṭṭu kaḷvalliyellameṇṭaneya
bhāgamaṁ marada poḻaloḷiṭṭu divasakkaṁ pōparā
vr̥ddhastrīyuṁ tannūrindaṁ bandu kasavaramaṁ koṇḍu
pōkum

intā eṇbar kaḷḷaranā vr̥ddhastrī piḍidāḷdaḷemba
kathegaḷumaṁ intivu modalāgoḍeya citrakathegaḷaṁ
paṭadoḷ baredu janaṅgaḷge tōṟi pēḻdu battamaṁ
kaḷdonītanorvaṁ vainayikanemboṁ kaḷḷaṁ mattorvaṁ
vainayikanemboṅgāsaktarāgi kēḷva janaṅgaḷa dhānyamanaṟuvattu
baḷḷamanirppattu baḷḷamendaḷegumītanorvaṁ vaikanemboṁ
kaḷḷaṁ mattorvaṁ vyōmakanemboṁ vainaikana kaḷda
dhānyamanellamanalliye nelamaneyoḷagirdu kiṟidānumondu
chidradvāradoḷagaṇge battamaṁ barekoḷvaṁ poṟagaṇaḷeda battamaṁ
nōṭakke kiṟidappantire intu mūvarumondāgi battamaṁ
māṟuvarā battaṅgaḷaṁ kaḷdu koḷvarī prakāradiṁ mūvargaṁ
kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ kauśaḷamembūra gāmuṇḍaṁ
jagadgr̥hanemboṁ tanna battamaṁ campānagarakke māṟalendu
koṇḍu pōgi battamanaḷevalliyā mūvara dōṣaṅgaḷuṁ
prakaṭamāgarasuvaregamādoḍe arasanivara kaḷavina pusiya
dōṣaṁ kāraṇamāgi mūvarumaṁ kolal pēḻdoḍe
kolaluydappar magaḷe endu pēḻdoḍe nāgaśrīyumī
teṟadappa duḥkhakkañji pusiyuṁ kaḷavumaṁ nivr̥ttigeydenammā
endoḍantappoḍā eraḍuṁ brataṅgaḷ ninagirke magaḷe
endoḍantegeyvenene

mattaṁ kiṟidantaramaṁ pōpannegaṁ gaṇḍanumaṁ
peṇḍatiyanoḍagūḍi irvarumaṁ peḍaṅgayyuḍiye
kaṭṭikoṇḍu pōparaṁ kaṇḍē dōṣaṅgeydaravaraṁ
besagoḷḷimendu tandege pēḻdoḍātanumadellamaṁ
besagoṇḍu magaḷgintendu pēḻguṁ campānagarada sāre
śvētapuramemba poḻalalli matsyanemba paradanātana
peṇḍati jaiseyemboḷ irvarggaṁ makkaḷ nandanuṁ
bōdanembavargaḷ mattamā poḻaloḷ sūradattanemba
paradaṅgaṁ vasudatteyemba paradigaṁ magaḷ
mōdāḷiyemboḷākeyaṁ basiṟoḷirdante sōdaramāvana
magaṁ nandanemboṅge kuḍuvamendu nuḍidarintu kālaṁ sale
nandanondu divasaṁ dravyambaḍevudu kāraṇamāgi suvarṇa
dvīpakke vōguttaṁ māmaṅgendaṁ panneraḍu varuṣakkāṁ
bāradāgaḷ emma kiṟiya tammaṁ bōdaṅge kūsaṁ
kuḍimendu pēḻdu pōdaṁ intu kālaṁ sale panneraḍuvaruṣaṁ
neṟedandu nandaṁ bandanillendu kūsaṁ bōdaṅge
kainīreṟedu kuḍuva prastāvakkāgaḷ nandaṁ bandoḍātaṅge
kuḍal taguḷdoḍe tammana peṇḍatiyanemage koḷalakkume
endu koṇḍanilla bōdanumaṇṇana peṇḍatiyanentu
koḷvenendātanuṁ koṇḍanillintirvaruṁ bisuṭṭoḍe
mōdāḷi tanna tavarmaneyoḷirdaḷ mattamā poḻaloḷ
nāgadattanemboṁ paradanātana bhārye gaṅgeyemboḷā
irvargaṁ magaṁ nāgasūranembonātaṅgeṇbar peṇḍir
tanna peṇḍiroḷ santōsambaḍeyade mōdāḷiyoḷ
maṟevāḻuttirkkuṁ intu kālaṁ sale mattondu divasaṁ
nāgasūraṁ mōdāḷiyanoḍagoṇḍu campānagarakke
vandoḍe taḷāṟaṁ kaṇḍāyirvarumaṁ piḍidu koṇḍupōgi
arasaṅge tōṟidoḍarasanumirvarumaneraḍu kāyda
karbbonna pratimegaḷanappavēḻimendu taḷāṟaṅge besavēḻdoḍa
varirvarumaṁ kolal koṇḍu pōpar magaḷe endu
pēḻdoḍānumintappa bhayakkañji parapuruṣa prasaṅgamaṁ
toṟedenendoḍantappoḍā bratamuṁ ninagirkke magaḷe
endoḍuḻida brataṅgaḷaṁ bisuḻvudendu pēḻdu

kiṟidantaramirvar pōparannegaṁ mattorvanaṁ kolal
koṇḍu pōpa puruṣanaṁ kaṇḍītanēdōṣaṅgeydanāgi
kolal koṇḍupōdapparendu besagoḷḷiyammā endu
tandege pēḻdoḍātanumadellamaṁ besagoṇḍu magaḷgintendu
pēḻguṁ ī kolepaḍuvātanarasara gōmaṇḍaḷamaṁ kāvoṁ
vīrapūrṇanembonarasanondu divasamātaṅgosedu
tanna gōmaṇḍaḷadoḷagoḷḷiduvappa pattu payanumaṁ
mūsāsiragaṇḍuga battamumaṁ pramāṇaṁ māḍi
koṭṭoḍā pasaradoḷarasaṁ dāyaṅgoṭṭanendu sāmantara
niyōgigaḷa arasiyara gōvugaḷoḷoḷḷiduvappa
emmeyuṁ pasugaḷumanāydukoṇḍarasara maṇḍaladoḷage
pugisiyuṇuttamirkkuṁ mattaṁ lōbhābhibhūtaṁ poḻala
pasugaḷanarasara gōmaṇḍaḷamaṁ pokkavellamaṁ baṇḍāraṁ
pokkavenduṁ poṟamaḍavenduṁ jaḍidu baggisikoṇḍuṇe
mattondu divasaṁ mahādēviya gōmaṇḍaḷadoḷa
gaggaḷamappa kāmadhēnuvanāydondu divasaṁ vīrapūrṇaṁ
mūdalise mahādēviyarasaṅgenna kāmadhēnuvaṁ
vīrapūrṇaṁ koṇḍoydanendoḍarasaṁ sāmantaru
marasiyaruṁ niyōgigaḷuṁ poḻala janaṅgaḷumellamemmemma
paśugaḷellamaṁ koṇḍanendanibaruṁ pēḻeyarasaṁ
muḷidavanenna koṭṭudaṟoḷ santōṣambaṭṭanilla lōgara
paśugaḷaṁ koḷaltaguḷdon mahālōbhābhibhūtana
santuṣṭacittanivanaṁ kollimendu taḷāṟaṅge besavēḻdoḍe
sūladoḷikkaloydappar magaḷe endu pēḻdoḍe

nāgaśrīyendaḷ kollada pusiyada kaḷḷada svadāra
santōṣaṁ parimita parigrahamintaydumaṇuvrataṅgaḷaṁ
koṇḍenī brataṅgaḷaṁ risiyarggoppisidoḍānu
mīyayduṁ pāpaṅgaḷoḷappa sēdeyaṁ kaṭṭupaḍuvuduṁ
koleyumanivaranteydal vēḻkumendoḍe
sōmaśarmanendanīyaydumaṇubratamaṁ
kaikoṇḍu dr̥ḍhabrateyāgu suvrateyāgu magaḷe
avarggoppisalvēḍentumā nirllajjaṁ battaliganappa
savaṇanalligevōgi kaṇḍu nuḍidu kāḍi barpaṁ bā magaḷe
endu

magaḷanoḍagoṇḍu risiyarallige pōgi kaṇḍu
geṇṭaṟoḷirddintenguṁ ele tapasvi enna magaḷge nimma
brataṅgaḷanēke koṭṭirene sūryamitra bhaṭārarendar nimma
magaḷgēkakkumemma magaḷiṅgemma brataṅgaḷanāmuṁ koṭṭoḍe
ninage bēne mūḍitte endu nuḍidu itta bā nāgaśrī endu
karedoḍākeyuṁ pōgi irvar bhaṭṭārakara kālgaḷaṁ
piḍedeṟagi poḍevaṭṭavara keladoḷirdoḍe sōmaśarmabhaṭṭaṁ
beṟagāgi kīlisidantirdonaṁ bhaṭṭārarendar ī
eḍeyindaṁ bēgaṁ pōgu duṣṭa brāhmaṇā arasarge pēḻdu
nīnaḻkāḍadannegamendoḍallindameḻdu pōgi sōmaśarma
bhaṭṭaṁ piridondu tovalaṁ piḍidabrahmaṇyaṁ bhō abrahmaṇyaṁ
bhō endaḻuttamaṅgaḍiya janaṅgaḷge puyyaliḍutum

aramanege pōgi candravāhananembarasanaṁ kaṇḍintendu
binnapaṅgeyguṁ mahārājā āṁ battale savaṇarindaṁ
kōḷpaṭṭenenna magaḷ nāgaśrīyaṁ tanna magaḷendu
kaikoṇḍirdar mattavar kūsaṁ koṇḍōḍadannegaṁ pōpaṁ
bannimendarasananoḍagoṇḍu pōge sāmanta mahāsāmanta
śrēṣṭhi sēnāpati taḷāṟa daṇḍanāyaka prabhr̥ti campānagarada
sabāḷavr̥ddhajanamellarumarasanoḍane nāgaratāṇakke pōgi
sūryamitrācāryaragnibhūtirisiyaranarasaṁ kaṇḍavara
pakkade kuḷḷirddidēn sambandhaṁ pēḻimendu munīndranaṁ
besagoṇḍoḍe sūryamitra bhaṭṭārakarī kūsembudu namma
magaḷendoḍe sōmaśarmabhaṭṭan nāgaśrī enna magaḷ
nāgarittarendoḍe

bhaṭṭārarintendar ninna magaḷappoḍe
nālkuvēdamumāṟaṅgamuṁ padineṇṭu dharmaśāstraṅgaḷuṁ
mīmāṁsā nyāyaśāstraṁ vyākaraṇaṁ pramāṇaṁ kābyaṁ
nāṭakaṁ chandamalaṅkāraṁ abhidhānaṁ sāmudrikaṁ
śāḷihōtraṁ pāḷakāpyaṁ hānitaṁ carakamaśvinīmataṁ
bāhaṭaṁ śuśrutamumendivu modalāda
naravaidyamumaṁ cāṇakyaṁ jyōtiṣaṁ mantravādaṁ
modalāgoḍeya śāstraṅgaḷellamanēnī kūsanōdisidā
endoḍātanillōdisidenendaṁ mattinitumanā
kūsanāvōdisidemadaṟindemma kūsendoḍe arasanōdisi
tōṟimendoḍe vāyubhūti emmōdisida vēdamanī
poḻala nereda neraviya naḍuve ōdi tōṟu magaḷe endoḍā
nāgaśrīyumantegeyvenendu praṇamavanuccarisi svara varṇa
bhēdadindaṁ prathamaṁ catuḥṣaṣṭi saṁhatigaḷaṁ pada krama
bhēdadiṁ brāhmaṇa āraṇa sūtraṁ modalāgoḍeyavanōdi
r̥gyajussāmātharvaṇa vēdaṅgaḷaṁ svaravarṇabhēdadindaṁ
mantra sahita pāḷi padakrama jaṭe bhēdadindaṁ śatasūtraṁ
modalāgellamaṁ yathākramadinduccarisi padineṇṭu
purāṇaṅgaḷuṁ padineṇṭu dharma saṁhatigaḷuṁ mīmāṁsā
nyāyasūtramivellamanōdi kriyākāraka sambandhadindellamaṁ
vakkhāṇisi tōṟidoḍarasaṁ modalāgi nereda neraviyuṁ
paṇḍitarkkaḷellaṁ vismayambaṭṭu pogaḻdu mattamarasanintendanī
kūsinitu śāstraṅgaḷanentu kaltaḷendu bhaṭārā idanaṟiye
besasimene

sūryamitra bhaṭṭārarintendar īyirdda risiyara
sahōdaraṁ vāyubhūtiyembonānāmōdisidememmoḷappa
mānakaṣāyaṁ kāraṇamāgi sattu beḷgatteyuṁ pēpandiyuṁ
nāyuṁ poleyara kūsumāgi risiyara prabōdhaneyindaṁ
brataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍīgaḷ nāgaśrīyādaḷendu munnina
bhavada sambandhamellamaṁ savistaraṁ pēḻdu mattamintendar
mithyātva saṁyama kaṣāya yōgaṁ kāraṇamāgi jīvaṅgaḷ
saṁsāra samudradoḷ toḻalgumendu savistaraṁ dharmamaṁ
pēḻe kēḷdu candravāhananembarasaṅge vairāgyaṁ puṭṭi magaṁ
garasugoṭṭu palambararasu makkaḷverasu bhaṭṭārara pakkade
tapambaṭṭaṁ kelar śrāvaka vrataṅgaḷaṁ kelambar samyaktvamaṁ
kaikoṇḍarāgaḷā sōmaśarmabhaṭṭaṁ risiyaroḷāda
mānagarvada dōṣadindeydida duḥkhaṅgaḷaṁ kēḷdaṟidā
bhaṭṭārara pakkade tapambaṭṭaṁ nāgaśrīyuṁ nāgaśrīya tāy
trivēdiyuṁ brahmileyemba kantiyara pakkade tapambaṭṭar matte
sūryamitra bhaṭṭāraragnibhūti bhaṭṭārarumirvaruṁ palakālaṁ
tapaṅgeydu agramandiravemba parvatadoḷ mōkṣavaneydidar
mattaṁ sōmaśarmarisiyarumugrōgra tapaścaraṇaṅgeydu
saṁnyasana vidhiyindaṁ muḍipi acyuta kalpadoḷirppatteraḍu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyoṁ sāmānika dēvanāgi
puṭṭidoṁ matte nāgaśrīyuṁ bhuktapratyākhyānavidhiyiṁ
ratnatrayamaṁ sādhisi acyuta kalpadoḷ dēvanāgi
puṭṭidoḷ mattā svargadoḷ trivēdiyuṁ nāgaśrī
enage janmāntaradoḷappoḍaṁ maganakkendu nidānaṅgeydu
muḍipi dēvanādoḷintāyirvaruṁ irppatteraḍu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyorāgi dēvarāgi puṭṭidar

mattaṁ sōmaśarmanappa dēvaṁ palakālaṁ dēvalōkada
bhōgamananubhavisi bandilli ī jambūdvīpada dakṣiṇa
bharatadoḷavantiyembudu nāḍujjēniyembudu poḻalalli
indradattanemboṁ paradanātana bhārye guṇamati
yemboḷāyirvarggaṁ sūradattanemboṁ maganāgi
puṭṭidoṁ mattamā poḻaloḷ mūvatteraḍu kōṭi
kasavaramanoḍeyoṁ subhadranemboṁ seṭṭiyātana bhārye
sarvayaśiyemboḷāyirvarggaṁ trivēdiyappa dēvaṁ
bandu yaśōbhadreyemboḷ magaḷāgi puṭṭidoḷā
trivēdi tapaścaraṇada phaladindaṁ dēvatvamaneydiyuṁ
nidānaṁ kāraṇamāgi mithyātvakke sandu strītvamaneydidaḷā
yaśōbhadreyaṁ sūradattaṅge koṭṭorāyirvarggaṁ
nāgaśrīyappa dēvaṁ bandu sukumārasvāmiyemboṁ
maganāgi puṭṭidanātana puṭṭidande vairāgyaṁ kāraṇamāgi
sūradattaseṭṭi sukumārasvāmige seṭṭivaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi tapambaṭṭaṁ
sukumāra svāmiyuṁ yauvananāgi atyanta rūpalāvaṇya
saubhāgya kāntiyindaṁ kūḍidonātaṅge mūvatteraḍu
baḷḷi māḍaṅgaḷatyanta rūpalāvaṇ saubhāgya kānti hāva
bhāva vilāsa vibhramaṅgaḷanoḍeya dēvagaṇikeyarane pōlva
mūvattirvar divyastrīyarkaḷ mūvatteraḍu nāṭakaṅgaḷ
mūvatteraḍu kōṭi kasavaramuṁ pañcaratnaṅgaḷembinitaṟoḷaṁ
kūḍi bhōgōpabhōga sukhaṅgaḷananubhavisuttumireyire

mattondu divasamorva naimittikanintendādēśaṅgeydanī
sukumārasvāmi āvudondu kāladoḷ risiyara rūpaṁ
kāṇgumandītanuṁ tapambaḍugumendoḍā mātaṁ
tāy kēḷdu tanna maneyaṁ risiyaraṁ pugalīyadantu
bāgila kāpinavaraṁ kalpisidoḷantu kālaṁ sale mattondu
divasaṁ ratnadvīpadindorva paradaṁ sarva ratna kambaḷaṅgaḷaṁ
lakṣa dīnāraṅgaḷ beleyappavanujjēnige māṟalkoṇḍu
bandonā poḻalanāḷvoṁ vr̥ṣabhāṅkanembonarasaṅgaṁ
jyōtirmāleyemba mahādēvigamintirvarggaṁ
tōṟidoḍe avaṟa beleyaṁ besagoṇḍoḍe lakṣa
dīnāraṅgaḷ beleyendu pēḻdoḍe koḷalāṟadarasaṁ
pōgalvēḻdanantu poḻaloḷagellaṁ tōṟiyāruṁ
koḷalāṟadirddoḍe ratnaṁ kambaḷaṅgaḷaṁ koṇḍupōgi
yaśōbhadrege tōṟidoḍe lakṣa dīnāraṅgaḷaṁ koṭṭu
ratnakambaḷaṅgaḷaṁ koṇḍōrondaṟoḷaṁ nālku khaṇḍamāge
mūvatteraḍu khaṇḍaṅgaḷaṁ māḍi mūvattirvar sosevirkaḷge
paccugoṭṭoḍavaruṁ tantamma kerpugaḷoḷ taguḷcidaremba
mātanarasaṁ kēḷdu cōdyambaṭṭavara vibhūtiyaṁ
nōḻpenendu manege varpudaṁ yaśōbhadre kēḷdarasar barpa
baṭṭeyoḷellaṁ pañcaratnaṅgaḷiṁ raṅgavalliyanikki nētravaṭṭu
dukūla cīnādi divyavastraṅgaḷaṁ pāsi maṇibhadramappa
hēmamuktāhāraṅgaḷiṁ tōraṇaṅgaṭṭisiyarasara baravaṁ
pāruttire nr̥patiyuṁ bandu surēndra bhavanōpamamappa
prāsādamaṁ pokku vismayacittanāgi suralōkambokka
puṇyavantambolāgaḷ mahā vibhūtiyiṁ
śayyātaḷadoḷirdu sukumāranellidanendu besagoṇḍoḍe

svāmi ātaṁ karaṁ sādu nimma baramanaṟiyaṁ prāsādada
mēgaṇa neleyoḷirdanendoḍarasaṁ baḻiyanaṭṭimene
tāy pōgi magane arasar vandar bā pōpamene
arasaremborārene tāyendaḷ nammanāḷvorendoḍe
nammanāḷvarumoḷare endu vismayambaṭṭu tāya
vacanamaṁ mārkkoḷalāṟade barponaṁ narēśvaraṁ
kaṇḍu kaṇbetta phalamanindu pettenendu pratyakṣa
kāmadēvananappikoḷvantappikoṇḍu divyaśayyātaḷada
mēgoḍanirisidāgaḷ svajana parijanaṅgaḷ siddārthaṅgaḷaṁ
māṅgalyamendirvarggaṁ sēseyanikkalāgaḷā
siddārthaṅgaḷ sukumārasvāmiyāsanamanotte
kaṭivamanalugisuvudumaṁ soḍaraṁ nōḍidāgaḷ
kaṇṇīrgaḷ surivudumaṁ kaṇḍīgaḷītaṅge byādigaḷendu
bagedirppinaṁ majjanakkeḻtannimendoḍantegeyvemendu
majjanaṅgoṇḍamara sannibha maṇikuṭṭimamappa
bāviyaṁ pokku mindalliyanarghyamappa tanna berala
māṇikaduṅguraṁ biḻdudanaṟasalvēḍi chidrakadvārada
tūntanurci nīraṁ kaḷedāgaḷindrana bhaṇḍāraṁ
teṟedantappa lēsappa nānā maṇiya vicitra
bhūṣaṇaṅgaḷaṁ palavumaṁ kaṇḍu mahāścaryabhūtanāgi
nōḍuttirpannegamārōgisaleḻtannimendāgaḷ
pariyaṇada modaloḷ sukumāraṁ berasu
nānāprakāradiniyavappuṇisugaḷanuṇuttaṁ sukumārasvāmi
ardhāhāramaṁ nuṅgugumardhāhāramanuguḻgumadaṁ
nōḍi iduvumondu kuttao āhārada mēgaruciyendu
bageduṇisu sameda baḻikke gandha tāmbūla mālya
vastrābharaṇaṅgaḷaṁ tandu koṭṭāgavaṁ toṭṭuṭṭu
pasadanaṅgoṇḍu sukhasaṅkathā vinōdadindirdoḍe

yaśōbhadreyanarasanintendu besagoṇḍanabbā emma
tammana kaṭipradēśa bhāgakkaṁ kaṇṇa nīr barpudarkaṁ
arucigamēke mardaṁ māḍisidirillene dēvā ātaṅgivu
kuttamallavu sēseyikkida sarusapaṅgaḷotte sairisalāṟaṁ
matte āva kālamuṁ māṇikada beḷaginoḷirpudaṟindaṁ
soḍara beḷagiṅge sairisade kaṇṇa nīr barkuṁ mattaṁ
kamaḷanīḷōtpaḷadoḷ vāsisidakkiyoḷ peṟavakkiyaṁ nīvuṁ
bandoḍe berasiyaṭṭudu kūḻumappudaṟiṁ vāsisidakkiya
kūḻaṁ nuṅgugumuḻida kūḻanuguḻgumadaṟindītaṅgī
yavasthegaḷāduvene kēḷdu vismayaṁ baṭṭu ītana kṣaṇamātrada
bhōgakkaṁ sukhakkaṁ emmellā kālamarasutanaṅgeyvalliyoḷappa
bhōgōpabhōgaṅgaḷ doreyallavadaṟindī
lōkadoḷītane paramārthaṁ sukhiyendosedarasanavanti
sukumāranendu pesaraniṭṭaṁ yaśōbhadreyumarasanananēka
vastuvāhanaṅgaḷindaṁ pūjisi kaḻipidoḷ

intu sukumāra svāmige sukhadindaṁ kālaṁ sale mattondu
divasaṁ yaśōbhadreya bhrātararappa dayābhadraremba
risiyar munnamavara pakkade sūradattaṁ dharmaṅgēḷdu
vairāgyamāgi putramukhaṅgaṇḍu tapambaṭṭonātana
maganuṁ risiyaraṁ kaṇḍāgaḷe tapambaḍugumembudaṁ
munne naimittikarādēśaṅgeydirdar mattaṁ dayābhadraremba
risiyar grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba pattana
drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ barpa divyajñānigaḷ
sukumārasvāmige nālkutiṅgaḷumaidudivasamāyuṣyapra
māṇamanaṟidupakārārthamujjēnige vandu sukumāra
svāmiya māḍada peṟagaṇa nandanavanadoḷagaṇa jinālaya
doḷāṣāḍha māsada caturdaśiya divasadandu paṟevoḻtu
bandu jōgugoṇḍirdarannegaṁ vanapālakar pōgi
yaśōbhadrege risiyara baravaṁ pēḻdoḍe

ākeyuṁ bandu dēvarumaṁ risiyarumaṁ bandisi
bhaṭṭārā nīmilligēke bandirillindaṁ poṟavoḻaloḷ
peṟavuḻi basadiyillā endoḍe bhaṭṭārarendarabbā
niḍuvayaṇaṁ bandu sēdegeṭṭentānumilligeyāsattu
jōgina poḻtaṟoḷeydi bandu jōgugoṇḍirdemettaluṁ
pōgalāgadene antappoḍe bhaṭārā nimmanondaṁ
bēḍidappeṁ nālku tiṅgaḷumēnumanōdade mōnaṅgoṇḍu
basadiyaṅgaṇadoḷ naḍapāḍadoḷagaṇaḍaṅgirdu jōgu
neṟedandu bijayaṅgeyyimendoḍantegeyvemendu
bhaṭārarirdar

mattittal sukumārasvāmiyuṁ sarvatōbhadramembuttuṅga
vicitramāgirda prāsādada mēgēḻaneya neleyoḷ kārtika
māsada puṇṇamiyandu sukhadinde lundirdanannegamitta
dayābhadra bhaṭārarge jōgu neṟedu yaśōbhadreya
bēḍida mōnada divasada pramāṇāvasānadoḷ
baigiruḷina pañcamahāśabdada poḻtaṟoḷ trilōka
prajñaptiyembudaṁ mr̥du madhura gambhīra svaradiṁ bhaṭārar
parivaḍigeydāgaḷ adhōlōka tiryaglōkaṅgaḷirda
svarūpamaṁ pramāṇamumanōdi ūrdhvalōka
vyāvarṇaneyaṁ pēḻdāgaḷacyutakalpada padmagulma
vimānamaṁ vyāvarṇisuvudaṁ sukumārasvāmi kēḷdu
jātismaranāgiyānilli puṭṭirddenembudanaṟidu ahō
suralōkasukhamembamr̥ta samudrada nīrellamaṁ kuḍidu
taṇiyadanī manuṣya bhavada sukhamemba pulvaniyoḷ silki
śivasukhamaneydisuva saccāritradiṁ baḻcidenendu tannaṁ tāṁ
nindisuttaṁ mañcadindiḻidu māḍadoḷagirda vastraṅgaḷaṁ
tegedukoṇḍu prāsādada peṟagaṇa gavākṣa jāḷadoḷ
kaṭṭikoṇḍondondaṟa tudiyoḷondondu vastramaṁ taguḷci
piḍidiḻidu jinālayamaneydi dēvarge namaskāraṅgeydu
dayābhadra bhaṭārargeṟagi poḍevaṭṭu dīkṣeyaṁ
prasādaṅgeydennaṁ saṁsārārṇavadattaṇindettimendoṅge
bhaṭārar mūṟudivasaṁ ninagāyuṣyamendoḍīgaḷī
nissāramappadēhadiṁ sāramappa tapamaṁ kaikoṇḍu palakālaṁ
negaḻal pettenilla nissāramappa bhōgadoḷ silki amēdhyadoḷ
krīḍisuva bāḷakambol kālamaṁ baṟide kaḷedenendu
tannanādamānuṁ nindisi

tatpāda mūladoḷ tapambaṭṭu
pañcamahābrataṅgaḷanēṟisikoṇḍu paḍikamaṇaṅgēḷda
tadanantaraṁ niścaya samyaktvamaṁ kaikoṇḍimbaḻikke mahākāḷa
memba śmaśānakke pōgi yāvajjīvamāhārakke nivr̥ttigeydu
prāyōpagamana vidhānadiṁ pracchannamappeḍeyoḷ
mr̥takasejjeyoḷirdu saṁnyasanaṅgeydu dharmadhyāna
śukladhyānaṅgaḷaṁ dhyānisuttirpannegaṁ

itta vāyubhūtiyappa bhavadandinattigeyappa
sōmadatteyemboḷ nidānaṅgeydu tanna nālvar makkaḷuṁ
tānuṁ saṁsārasamudradoḷ nīḍuṁ tiṟṟane tiridu bandu
peṇṇariyāgi puṭṭi tanna nālkumaṟigaḷverasāhāramanaṟasi
toḻaluttaṁ barpudannegaṁ sukumārasvāmiyuṁ mahākāḷakke
pōpanellā kālamuṁ maṇikuṭṭimabhūmiyoḷ pāsida
nētrapaḻiya mēge naḍeda mr̥du lalitamappa caraṇadvayadoḷ
munnendu nelanaṁ kiṭṭayaṟiyadoṁ kaṭhinabhūmiyoḷ
naḍedoḍe kiṟugalgaḷuṁ peṭṭegaḷu maguḻdu puguḷoḍedu
poṟamaṭṭu karagada dārevoleḍevaṟiyade mahākāḷa
śmaśānambaregamokka nettara dāreya gandadindaṁ narigaḷ
bandu kaṇḍu rāgisi maṟigaḷverasaḍiyindaṁ toṭṭeraḍuṁ
kālgaḷaṁ moḻakālvaregamondu divasaṁ tindatteraḍaneya
divasaṁ moḻakālintoṭṭu kaṭivaregaṁ tindattu mūṟaneya
divasaṁ basiṟaṁ pōḻdu karuḷaṁ tōḍi tine pr̥thaktvavitarka
vīcāramemba prathama śukladhyānadoḷ kūḍiyupaśānta
guṇasthānadoḷirdu ratnatrayamaṁ sādisi sayasattamadēvanāgi
puṭṭidoṁ

mattitta tāyuṁ peṇḍiruṁ parivāramumellā desegaḷoḷaṁ
parivaridu pōgi sukumārasvāmiyaneraḻdivasamiruḷuṁ
pagalumaṟasiyuṁ kāṇade mūṟaneya divasadandu baigina
poḻtaṟoḷ dēvarkkaḷ bandu sukumārasvāmiyanaho
sūrā aho mahāpuruṣa aho dhairyavanta aho
saṁsārabhīru ninnantupasargamanārappoḍaṁ sairisi
ratnatrayamaṁ sādhisidorillendu dēvategaḷ pogaḻva
kaḷakaḷadhvaniyumaṁ dēvadundubhiya ravamumaṁ
yaśōbhadre nōḍi dēvasaṅghātamaṁ kaṇḍu magana
sāvanaṟidu baygiruḷādāgaḷ mūvattirvar sosevirkaḷgaṁ
pēḻdaṭṭi sukumārasvāmi nimagellarge muḷidu pōgi
yaḍaṅgirdonanānaṟiveṁ nīvellaṁ neṟeye toṭṭuṭṭu
pasadanaṅgoṇḍu celveyarāgi banniṁ pōpaṁ tiḷipikoṇḍu
barpaṁ nimma svāmiyanendoḍe

avargaḷanibaruṁ rāgisi kaigeydatteyoḍane parivārasahitaṁ
mahākāḷakke pōgi nōḻparannegaṁ namēru mandāra santānaka
pāriyātramemba dēvarkaḷ surida puṣpavr̥ṣṭiyindaṁ
muccepaṭṭanāgi kampiṅgeṟagida tumbiya samūhamaṁ mēge
suḻivudaṁ kaṇḍillirddanendu yaśōbhadre tōṟidoḍe pōgi
teṟedu nōḻparannegaṁ mr̥takamaṁ kaṇḍanibaruṁ mūrchevōgi
nīḍaṟindeḻcarttu tamma basiṟumaṁ taleyumaṁ baḍidukoṇḍu
sukumārasvāmiya rūpamaṁ tējamumaṁ yauvanamaṁ
lāvaṇyamaṁ saubhāgyamaṁ yaśamaṁ melpaṁ nuḍiya balmeyaṁ
śucitvamaṁ śaucamaṁ śrīyaṁ sampattaṁ sobagaṁ olmeyaṁ
dhairyamuṁ endivu modalāgoḍeyavātanoḷ nelasirda
guṇaṅgaḷaṁ nenenenedanibaruṁ pralāpaṅgeyyuttaṁ sairisalāṟade
nirantaraṁ mūrchevōguttaṁ nīḍuṁ bēgaṁ duḥkhaṅgeydaḻtu
nīriḻideṇbar basiṟa peṇḍiruḻiye irppattunālvar peṇḍiruṁ
mattaṁ peṟar naṇṭarkaḷuṁ parivāramuṁ yaśōbhadreyoḍane
dayābhadrar gurugaḷāge kamaḷaśrī kantiyar kantiyarāge
tapambaṭṭugrōgra tapaṅgeydanibaruṁ saudharma kalpaṁ
modalāgoḍeya kalpaṅgaḷoḷ puṭṭidar

mattintappudaṁ cintisalu sairisalumāgada
tirikōpasargamanavanti sukumārasvāmi
mūṟudivasamiruḷuṁ pagaluṁ sairisi ratnatrayamanentu
sādisidanante saṁnyasanaṅgeydirdārādhakarappa
mahāpuruṣarumavanti sukumārasvāmiya
paramasukhiyappupasargamaṁ vijaya vidhānamaṁ manadoḷa
navarataṁ cintisuttāptāgamapadārthardhigaḷoḷatīva sthirarāgi
parama sahaja nijaratnatrayadoḷ kūḍi abhēdavāgeydekūḍi
śarīraṁ modalāgoḍeya samasta bāhyābhyantara parigrahaṅgaḷaṁ
neṟe toṟedu apūrvāpavarga sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

mattujjēniya teṅkaṇadeseyoḷavanti sukumārasvāmiya
kālaṅgeydeḍe īgaḷuṁ puṇyamuṁ pavitramumādudu mattaṁ
mahāpuruṣana śarīramaṁ caturnikāyāmaratatigaḷ
bhaktiyindagaru kāḷāgaru gōśīrṣa candanaṁ
modalāgoḍeya anēka sugandha dravyaṅgaḷindaṁ
pūjisida vastugaḷ kālāntaradiṁ karagi biḻdudā sthānakkaṁ
gandhavatiyemba toṟeyādudu dēvarkaḷ pogaḻda
kaḷakaḷadhvaniyiṁ peṇḍirkaḷa praḷāpaṅgeydaḻta kaḷakaḷadhvaniyindaṁ
kaḷakaḷāyatamendu siddhāyatanamādudu

div.head: sukauśaḷa svāmiya kathe
div.p: sukauśaḷa svāmiya katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ

lg.l:
moggaḷa girimhiya sukausaḷō vi siddattha dayidagō
bhagavaṁ
vagghīye khayidaṁ padidō paḍivaṇṇō uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ

div.ab:
moggaḷa girimhiya – moggaḷamemba parvatadoḷ ,
sukausaḷōpi – sukauśaḷa svāmiyuṁ, siddatthadayidagō
– siddhārthanemba paradana kādalise paḍuva magaṁ, bhagavaṁ –
permeyanoḍeyoṁ, vaghghīye khayidampadidō – munnina
bhavada tāyappa peṇbuliyindaṁ tine bardidonāgiyuṁ,
paḍivaṇṇo – pordidoṁ, uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ – mikka darśana jñāna
cāritrārādhaneyaṁ.
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada dakṣiṇa bharata kṣētradoḷaṅgamembudu
nāḍalli campānagaramembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
gandhabhājananembarasanindranoḷōrantappa
bhōgaiśvaryavibhavamanoḍeyoṁ
nyāyadindaṁ prajegaḷaṁ pratipāḷisuvonadhigama
samyak dr̥ṣṭiyappanēḻu guṇaṅgaḷindaṁ
kūḍidonāyēḻuṅguṇaṅgaḷembuvāvuvendoḍe
endu

ēḻuṁ guṇaṅgaḷindaṁ kūḍidonantapparasaṁ śaratkālada
mugiloḷōrantappudanādamānuṁ vicitramappudaṁ
sahasrakūṭamemba jinālayamaṁ māḍisi adarkkanavarataṁ
mahāpūjeyumaṁ mahimeyumabhiṣēkaṅgaḷumaṁ
salisutirpoṁ mattā poḻaloḷorvaṁ sāgaradattanemboṁ
seṭṭiyātana bhārye subhadreyemboḷāyirvargaṁ magaḷ
surūpeyemboḷ mattā poḻaloḷ peṟanorvaṁ seṭṭi
nāgadattanembonātaṅge surūpeyaṁ koṭṭoḍāyirvargaṁ
sukēśiniyemba magaḷādaḷāke baḷedatyanta rūpalāvaṇya
saubhāgya kānti hāva bhāvavilāsavibhramaṅgaḷanoḍeyoḷ
palavuṁ teṟada śubhalakṣaṇaṅgaḷinda kūḍida meyyanoḍe
yoḷ navayauvane dēvagaṇikeyane pōlvaḷondu divasaṁ
aṣṭamiyaṁ nōntu dēvaranarcisalendu sahasrakūṭa
caityālayakkarcaneyaṁ koṇḍu pōdaḷannegamarasanumāgaḷe
dēvaraṁ bandisal bandoḍarasaṅge nāṇci basadiyoḷagaṇa
kambada maṟeyoḷ kēraṁ sārdu ponna beḷaguva gaḷantige
yanādamānumopputtirdudaṁ piḍidu nindirdoḷanarasaṁ
kaṇḍilliya citrada leppada kāṣṭhakarmada rūpugaḷoḷellamī
strīya jīvaviddhamintuṭatiśayamendarasanākeya
rūpiṅgaccarivaṭṭu pogaḻe keladoḷirda kaściddēvadattanīke
kanneyirdoḷendu pēḻdoḍāra magaḷendu besagoṇḍoḍī
poḻalge pradhānaṁ nāgadatta seṭṭiya magaḷendu pēḻdoḍarasaṁ
kēḷdu kemmagirdu dēvarge namaskāraṅgeydu r̥ṣiyaraṁ
bandisi tanna manege vōdan

itta sukēśiniyuṁ dēvaranarcisi bandisi gurupariviḍiyindaṁ
risiyaraṁ bandisi vrataṅgaḷanēṟisikoṇḍu siddhasēseyaṁ
tāygaṁ tandegaṁ pōgi koṭṭoḍavargaḷuṁ
taleyoḷiṭṭukoṇḍu yauvanaṁ neṟeda kūsina
rūpaṁ nōḍuttirdārge kuḍuvamendu tammoḷ
nuḍiyuttirpinamarasaṁ kanneya rūpaṁ kaṇḍāṭisi kūsina
tāyappa surūpege baḻiyanaṭṭi barisi kūsanārge
koṭṭapirendu besagoṇḍoḍenna tammaṁ varāṅganembonātana
magaṁ jitaraṅganembonenna sōdaraḷiyanātaṅge koṭṭapenendu
pēḻdoḍe

arasaṁ madhusēnaṁ madhusūdanarembirvar
pradhānavergaḍegaḷaṁ nāgadattaseṭṭiyallige kūsaṁ
bēḍiyaṭṭiyuttavaḷanāgiyavara baḻiyane tānuṁ nāgadattana
manege pōgi kūsaṁ bēḍi pettaṁ nāgadattanumaṣṭāhnika
mahāmahimeyaneṇṭu divasaṁ māḍi praśasta dina vāra
nakṣatra muhūrta hōrālagnadoḷ kūsinanukūladoḷ
pāṇigrahaṇa purassaraṁ sukēśiniyaṁ gandhabhājananembarasaṅge
koṭṭanintu mahāvibhūtiyindaṁ maduve nindu gandhabhājana
nr̥patiyuṁ sukēśiniyoḷiṣṭa viṣayakāmabhōgaṅgaḷaṁ
palakālamanubhavisuttire

mattondu divasaṁ kauśalādhipatiyappatibaḷanembarasaṅgaṁ
kaḷiṅgādhipatiyappa kaḷiṅganembarasaṁ tammoḷ
vigrahamādoḍe gandhabhājana nr̥pati tanna matiśrutanemba
mantriyanaṭṭi irvvarggaṁ sandhimāḍidoḍe kaḷiṅganembarasaṁ
madhusūdananemba perggaḍeya keyyoḷ madāndha
gandhahastiyaṁ gandhabhājana nr̥patige pāguḍamaṭṭidoḍadaṁ
sorkkinindaṁ masagidudaṁ gandhahastiyaṁ sukēśini
kaṇḍu jātismareyāgi mūrchevōgirddoḷaṁ dādi
modalāgi keladoḷirddorellaṁ candanada nīrgaḷaṁ
taḷidu bīse nīḍaṟindeḻcattaḷannegamarasanuttavaḷanāgi
paritandidēnīkegēkintāytendu besagoḷe dādiyendaḷ
sorkkāneyaṁ kaṇḍu mūrchevōdaḷendu pēḻdoḍā
mātanarasaṁ kēḷdu maṟusūḻanāneyaṁ kaṇḍañjadantire
sukēśiniya māḍada kērggaḷellāyeḍegaḷoḷaṁ vyāḷaṅgaḷappāne
gaḷaṁ tanna cittārigarindaṁ bareyisidaṁ matte sukēśiniyuṁ
tanna munnina janmadoḷ negaḻdudellamaṁ paṭadoḷ tāne
baredārumaṟiyadantirēkāntadoḷ nōḍuttirkkumintu
kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ munnina gandhahastiyoḍane
bāriyoḷ mūvatteraḍu gajakrīḍegaḷindaṁ nīḍuṁ
bēgaṁ krīḍisiyāneyaṁ sēdegeḍisi tanna basakke māḍi
yēṟiyaṅkusamaṁ poḷeyisuttamarasiyallige vandu
nindintakkume maccidā endu tanna sāhasamaṁ pēḻdu meṟeye
sukēśiniyendoḷidēnembāne tagaroḷōrantappudu
candanamalayamemba piriya parvatadoḷ
indranīla māṇikadoḷōrantappa baṇṇamanoḍeyadu
malayasundaranembāneyuṇṭu hastiyūdhakkeṟeyanappudu
ellā kālamuṁ madadindaṁ percuttirdudu
kendāvareya vaṇṇadoḷōrantappa baṇṇamanoḍeya
padmāvatiyemba piḍiyoḍane krīḍisuttirppāneyaṁ ninna
vasakke māḍi piḍidēṟikoṇḍu vandoḍe ninna gaja
priyateyumēṟiyāḍal balmeyuṁ kalitanamuṁ
sāhasamuṁ gaṇḍaguṇamumanaṟiyalakkumāyāneyaṁ
tandandu gaṇḍar ninnannarī bhuvanadoḷārumillendosedu
macci pogaḻvenendoḍarasanintendaṁ nīnappoḍilli puṭṭide
āyāneyanelli kaṇḍeyentaṟiveyendu besagoḷe
sukēśiniyintendaḷ
āṁ munnina janmadoḷ manōvēgeyenemba vidyādhari
ennandina bhartāraṁ maṇicūḷanemboṁ vidyādharanātanoḍane
bhaumavihārārthaṁ toḻalvalli candanamalayamemba
parvatadoḷ kariṇīvr̥ndaṁ berasāḍuva karipatiyanairāvaṇa
sannibhamaṁ kaṇḍenendurkkevadindaṁ pēḻdoḍā mātanarasaṁ
kēḷdu pūrva janmāntaradoḷ kaṭṭepaṭṭa muḷisanoḍeyoṁ
tannuḷḷa samasta balamberasu pōgi malayaparvatamellamaṁ
baḷasi suttimuttidāgaḷindranīlamāṇikada tējadoḷōrantappa
meyyanoḍeya gajapatiyuṁ mugila dhvaniya
melgambhīramappa garjjaneyanoḍeyaduṁ bandu paḍeyellamaṁ
hatavitatakōḷāhaḷameḻedu kolvudanādamānuṁ
kaliyappudanarasaṁ kaṇḍu piḍiyalāṟadāneyaṁ
konderaḍuṁ niḍiya tōramappa kombugaḷumaṁ
kumbhasthaḷada muttugaḷumaṁ koṇḍosageyindaṁ bēgaṁ
campāpurakke vandaramaneyaṁ pokkarasiyaṁ kaṇḍu ninna
naccuva malayasundarana kombugaḷumaṁ muttu
gaḷumaṁ koḷḷendavaṁ sukēśiniya munde tandiṭṭoḍe
sukēśiniyuṁ hā malayasundarā hā enna nallane hā enna
malayasundaranappa svāmiyendu praḷāpaṅgeydu eraḍu
kombugaḷumaṁ taḻkaisiyādamānuṁ bigidappikoṇḍu
sattaḷ sukēśini sattudarkkarasaṁ modalāgi parivāramellamuṁ
beṟagāgi vismayambaṭṭu duḥkhaṅgeydar

kelavu divasadiṁ yaśōdhararemba kēvalajñānigaḷ
vihārisuttamā campānagarakke vandu
pramadōdyānavanadoḷirddaremba mātanarasaṁ risi
nivēdakanindaṟidu saparivāraṁ berasu bandarcisi
yathōcitasthānadoḷirdaṁ mattaṁ nāgadatta seṭṭiyuṁ
surūpeyuṁ varāṅganuṁ priyaṅguvuṁ modalāgoḍeya
śrāvaka janaṅgaḷ bandarcisi namaskāraṅgeydar
tammaḍigaḷoḷirdu dharmamaṁ kēḷdu tadanantarame
vairāgyamāgi sukēśiniya duḥkhamaṁ sairisalāṟade
sukēśiniya tandeyappa nāgadattaseṭṭiyuṁ tāy
surūpeyuṁ māvanappa varāṅganuṁ varāṅgana
bhāryeyappa priyaṅguvumantu nālvarumeḻdabhimukharāgi
dīkṣāprasādaṅgeyyiṁ bhaṭārā endu bēḍi tapambaṭṭar mattaṁ
sukēśiniyā malayasundaranembāneya kombugaḷanappi
sattaḷemba mātaṁ varāṅganuṁ kēḷdu janmānubandhiyappa
snēhaṁ kāraṇamāgi duḥkhamaṁ sairisalāṟade tapambaṭṭu
nidānasahitaṁ tapaṅgeydanitta gandhabhājana nr̥pati yaśōdhara
kēvaligaḷanintendu besagoṇḍaṁ bhaṭārā sukēśini
malayasundaranembāneya kombugaḷanappikoṇḍu sattudarkke
kāraṇamēnendu besagoṇḍoḍe kēvalajñānigaḷintendu
pēḻdar

dakṣiṇāpathadoḷ draviḷa viṣayadoḷ
dakṣiṇa madhureyembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
sundarapāṇḍyanembonarasanātanarasiyamr̥tamahādēvi
yemboḷantavarggaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāmabhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttire
mattamā poḻaloḷāryanandiyemboṁ
seṭṭiyātana paradiyavidhiyemboḷā irvvarggaṁ
sukīrtiyemboḷ magaḷādaḷ mattorvanā
poḻaloḷ sudarśananemboṁ paradanātana paradi
vīraśrīyemboḷāyirvarggaṁ magaṁ priyadarśananembo
nātaṅgā sukīrtiyaṁ koṭṭar sukīrtiya keḷadi
mālegārti priyasēneyemboḷantavarggaḷiṣṭa viṣaya
kāmabhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttire mattondu divasaṁ sukīrti
tanna bhartārananintendaḷaḍaviyoḷaṁ parvataṅgaḷoḷaṁ puḷina
sthaḷaṅgaḷoḷamenage krīḍisalaḻtiyādudene

ninnaḻtiyaṁ neṟapalakkumendu priyadarśananuṁ sukīrtiyuṁ
priyasēneyumantu mūvaruṁ parivārasahitamaḍavige
pōgiyalli kānana vana saritsarōvara pradēśaṅgaḷoḷ
parijanamberasu tadīpsita pradēśaṅgaḷoḷ vihārisi
ramyamappa girinadiya puṣpa pallavalatākīrṇamappa puḷina
sthaḷaṅgaḷoḷ krīḍisurttippannegaṁ hastiyūthaṁ barppudaṁ
kaṇḍāgaḷondu madāndhagandhasindhuraṁ kariṇīvr̥ndaṁ
gaḷiṁ parivēṣṭitanāgi kariṇīgaṇaṅgaḷā kāśapuṣpaṅgaḷiṁ
cāmaramikke mr̥du pallavaṅgaḷaṁ kabaḷaṅgoḷuttuṁ
līleyiṁ bandu svaccha vicchaḷākāramappa maḍuvaṁ pokku
manōhārigaḷappa kariṇīgaṇadoḍane krīḍisuvudaṁ
mūvaruṁ kaṇḍu hastibhōgaṅgaḷoḷappa kāṅkṣeyindaṁ
nidānaṅgeydu tiryagāyuṣyamaṁ kaṭṭidarintu kālaṁ
sale mattondu divasaṁ baṟasiḍil poḍedu priyasēne
sattaḷ priyadarśananondu divasaṁ tanna bhāryeverasu
kadaḷīvanadoḷ maṟalundidallige kāḷiṅganāgaṁ
bandoḍadaṟa mēge kālaṁ nīḍidoḍe karccittātanumāgaḷe
paravaśanāgi prāṇaparityāgaṅgeydanaṁ kaṇḍu sukīrtiyuṁ
kādalana viyōgaṁ kāraṇamāge prāṇavallabhana surigeyaṁ
koṇḍu tannaṁ tāniṟidu sattaḷ

antā mūvaruṁ sattu teṅkaṇa paḍuvaṇa samudrada
taḍiyoḷ candanamalayamembādamānuṁ ramyamappa
parvatadoḷ priyadarśananindranīla māṇikadoḷōrantappa
meyyanoḍeyadāgi subhadrajātiyappānege malaya
sundaranembāneyāgi puṭṭidoṁ sukīrtiyuṁ
dhavaḷavarṇamappa malayāvatiyemba piḍiyāgi puṭṭidaḷ
priyasēneyuṁ kendāvareya vaṇṇadoḷōrantappa
meyyanoḍeya padmāvatiyemba piḍiyāgi
puṭṭidaḷāyeraḍuṁ piḍigaḷuṁ subhadrajātiyappānege
puṭṭidavantā mūṟarkamāraṇyanivāsigaḷappa janaṅgaḷuṁ
tāpasādigaḷumavaṁ kaṇḍorggaḷellamosedu mecci
taddēhānusārigaḷappa pesaraniṭṭudaṟindā nāḍoḷ prasiddhige
sanduvantavarke kālaṁ sale mattamalli yūdhādhipati
bhadrajātiyappa sundaranembāne cāraṇarisiyarkkaḷa
pādayugaḷaṅgaḷaṁ vidyādharanarcisi poḍevaṭṭu pōpudaṁ
kaṇḍu tānuṁ niccamā sthitiyoḷe tāmareya pūgaḷaṁ
tandarccisi pūjisi poḍevaṭṭu pōkumintu puṇyamaṁ
neraputtaṁ kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ prabhaṅkariyemba sarōvaradoḷ
malayasundaraṁ pūrvabhavada prāṇavallabheyarkaḷaṁ
kaṇḍatisnēhadindaṁ pordalāṭisuvudaṁ kaṇḍu
sundaranembāne sāralīyadudaṟiṁ tadviraha paritapta
manadindaṁ salvudaṁ navayauvanamaneydi ātmabalamanadaṟa
baladoḷ vr̥kṣabhañjana sāmarthyadiṁ parīkṣisi maṟiyānegaḷiṁ
paribhavamanadarke kaṇḍu vr̥ddhanappā sundaranoḷ
yuddhaṅgeydu kondā yūdhakkellamadhipatiyāgi
malayāvatiyuṁ padmāvatiyumanoḍagoṇḍiṣṭa viṣaya
kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttamāyeraḍuṁ piḍigaḷ
tammoḷanyōnya snēhadoḷ kūḍiduvu malayasundaran
balada deseyoḷ malayāvatige pōpa dāyamaneḍada
deseyoḷ padmāvatige pōpa dāyamanittantu
prabhaṅkariyemba sarōvaradoḷ svēccheyiṁ krīḍisi
poṟamaḍuvāgaḷ malayāvatiya mastakadoḷ vikasita
sahasrapatra kusumavaniḍuva dāyamaṁ koṭṭu salisuttaṁ
uḻida piḍigaḷellamaṁ toṟedāyeraḍaṟoḷamāsaktanāgi
kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttamintu sukhadoḷirppa
kāladoḷ

mattondu divasaṁ prabhaṅkariyemba koḷadoḷ svēccheyiṁ
nīḍuṁ krīḍisuttaṁ taḍambandu manaḥpūrvakamallade
poṟamaḍuvāgaḷ padmāvati balada deseyoḷāgi
malayāvatiyeḍada deseyoḷāgi poṟamaṭṭu bare
madāndha gandhasindhuraṁ madadiṁ meyyaṟiyade balada
deseyoḷirda padmāvatiyaṁ malayāvatigettu padmāvatiya
mastakadoḷ vikasita sahasrapatra kusumamaniṭṭoḍe
malayāvati nōḍi tannaṁ paribhavisidanendu
padmāvatiyoḷappa puruḍuṁ kāraṇamāgi muḷisinindaṁ
candanamalayaparvatada tuttatudiyaṁ bēgaṁ
paridaḍardantallindaṁ tannanikki malayāvati śatakhaṇḍamāgi
biḻdu sattattadaṟa sattudaṁ malayasundaraṁ kaṇḍu
malayāvatiya viyōgadoḷādamānuṁ duḥkhaṅgaidu
padmāvatiyanoḍagoṇḍu pōytu mattā malayāvatiyemba
piḍi sattu sukēśiniyemboḷādaḷā padmāvatiyemba
piḍiyumāyuṣyāntadoḷ sattu sukēśiniya tāy
surūpeya sōdara tammaṁ varāṅganādoṁ mattā
malayasundaranindaṁ kolesatta sundaranembāne
suvēganemba vidyādharanindaṁ pūjise paṭṭa cāraṇariṣiyara
pādapadmayugaḷaṅgaḷumaṁ nōḍiyupaśamakke sandu
tānuṁ tāmareya pūgaḷaṁ tandu pratidinamarcisi pūjisi
poḍevaṭṭu pōkumā cāraṇariṣiyaraḍivoṇaranarcisida
puṇyadindaṁ sattilli nīṁ campāpurakkadhipatiyay
gandhabhājananembarasanāday sukēśiniyuṁ jātismareyāgi
tanna munnina bhavada bhartāranappa malayasundaranaṁ nenedu
ninnindaṁ kolesattudaṟa kōḻkaḷanādamānuṁ bigidappikoṇḍu
sattudarkkidu kāraṇaṁ matte nīṁ munne sundaranembāneyāgi
cāraṇariṣiyara pādayugaḷaṅgaḷanarcisuvandu ninnaṁ
kaṇḍāyeraḍuṁ piḍigaḷ ninnoḍavōgiyarcisi puṇyamaṁ
nerapida phaladindaṁ sukēśiniyuṁ varāṅganumādarendu

yaśōdhara kēvaligaḷ savistaraṁ pēḻdoḍe
gandhabhājananembarasaṁ kēḷdu mattamintendaṁ bhaṭārā sukēśini
sattīgaḷelli puṭṭidaḷendu besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭārarintendu
pēḻdar
suraṭamembudu nāḍalli girinagaravembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
ninnāḷ mahāsāmantanatirathanembonātanarasi gauriyembaḷā
irvarggaṁ sukēśini sattu manōhariyemboḷ magaḷāgi
puṭṭidaḷ mattā arasana mantri vijayanembonātana bhārye
vīraśrīyemboḷā irvvarggaṁ malayasundaraṁ sattu kubēra
kāntanemboṁ maganāgi puṭṭidoṁ vibhavaiśvaryaṅgaḷindaṁ
kubēranoḷōrannanappoṁ mattā poḻaloḷ rājaśrēṣṭhi
dhanadanembonātana paradi dhanaśrīyemboḷā irvarggaṁ
malayasundaraṁ sattudaṁ sukēśini kaṇḍu sairisalāṟade
prāṇaparityāgaṅgeydaḷaṁ nenedu dravyatapadoḷ kūḍi
tapaṅgeydu varāṅgaṁ sattu śrīdharanemboṁ maganāgi
puṭṭidonātana bhārye kubēraśrīyemboḷā śrīdharaṁ
kubērakāntaṅgiṣṭamitranāgi sale mattondu divasaṁ
śrīdharaṁ kubērakāntanoḍane maṟalundiyātana
ratnakambaḷamaṁ podedu tanna manege barpponaṁ kaṇḍu
savatiyoḷappa śaṅkeyindaṁ prāsādada mēgaṇindaṁ
nelakkikki biḻdu sattoḷā sattoḷaṁ śrīdharaṁ kaṇḍādamānuṁ
duḥkhaṅgaidu śōkābhibhūtanāgirdonaṁ kubērakāntaṁ
bandu kaṇḍu śrīdharā paramamitrā intēke bardi bambaḷaṁ
bāḍi pāḍaḻidubbegambaṭṭirddeyendu besagoṇḍoḍe tanna
keḷeyaṅgintendu śrīdharaṁ pēḻguṁ ninna ratnakambaḷamaṁ
podedu manege vandoḍe savatiyoḷappa śaṅkeyindenna
bhārye kubēraśrī māḍada mēgaṇindaṁ tannaṁ nelakkikki biḻdu
sattaḷinnumāyirddaḷendu tōṟidoḍe

kubērakāntaṁ nōḍe nōḍe jātismaranāgi keḷeyaṅgintendu
pēḻgumenna peṇḍati malayāvatiyappa piḍi puruḍinindaṁ
candanamalayamemba parvvatada śikharadindaṁ tannanikki sattante
ninna peṇḍatiyuṁ sattaḷendu pēḻdubbegambaḍalvēḍendu
santayisi tanna manege vōgi jātismaranappudaṟiṁ
kubērakāntaṁ tanna munnina malayasundaranappa bhavada
negaḻtegaḷellamaṁ malayāvati padmāvati modalāgi
kariṇīvr̥ndasahitaṁ vanahastikrīḍegaḷellamanondu paṭadoḷ
baredadaṁ nōḍuttaṁ pāḍuttaṁ hā enna malayāvati hā
enna nallaḷe nīnīgaḷellirddeyendaṟasuttaṁ maruḷgoṇḍu
praḷāpaṅgeyyuttaṁ ujjayanta parvvatamaṁ balagoṇḍu
barponaṁ citrāṅgadanemba vidyādharaṁ kaṇḍu karuṇisi
dharmavātsalyadindaṁ tanna kāmamudrikeyaṁ svēpsita
kāryasiddhiyaṁ māḍuva vidyeyaṁ kubērakāntaṅge koṭṭaṁ
kubērakāntanuṁ vidyādēvateyaṁ besagoṇḍenna munnina
bhavada prāṇavallabheyellirddaḷene vidyādēvateyendaḷ
ninna prāṇavallabheyatirathanembarasaṅge magaḷ
manōhariyāgirdaḷendu vidyādēvate pēḻe kēḷdaṟidu

piśācavēṣamaṁ kaikoṇḍaramaneyaṅgaṇadoḷirdu paṭamaṁ
nimircciyetti tōṟi pāḍuttamele malayāvati hā enna
kādalaḷe nīnīgaḷellirddeyendu pāḍuvudaṁ kēḷdu paṭamaṁ
nōḍi manōhari jātismareyāgi tanna munnina bhavamanaṟidu
dāmarathiyemba tanna dādigosageyindamintendaḷīyaṅgaṇa
doḷ paṭamaṁ tōṟuvātanenna munnina bhavada bhartāranendu
pēḻdu mattamintendaḷabbā nīnenna prāṇamaṁ kāvudu
kāraṇamāgi ātanallige vōgi ēkāntadoḷintendu
pēḻ padmāvatiya taleyoḷaḻtiyindaṁ nīṁ tāvareya
pūvaṁ munnaviṭṭu malayāvati prāṇavallabhe
ellirddeyendīgaḷēke malayasundarā nīnāraydappeyendu
pēḻdu mattamintendu pēḻ ninna prāṇavallabhe ninnaneyaṟasi
bayasuttirppaḷāke ninnoḷ kūḍuvannegamī paṭamaṁ
tōṟiyākeya prāṇamaṁ kāvenendu paṭamaṁ
bēḍikoṇḍu bā endu kalpisiyaṭṭidoḍākeyuṁ
kalpisida pāṅginoḷātanalligevōgēkāntadoḷellamaṁ
nuḍidu kubērakāntana keyyapaṭamaṁ bēḍi koṇḍupōgi
manōharige koṭṭaḷ manōhariyumā paṭamaṁ koṇḍu
devasakkamaḻkaṟoḷ nōḍuttirkkuṁ

mattitta kubērakāntaṁ tanna maruḷvēṣamaṁ toṟedu
svābhāvikanāgi tanna manege vandoḍe prasannarūpanāgirddonaṁ
vijayanintendu besagoṇḍaṁ magane nīninitu
divasamēke maruḷāgirdde īgaḷentu maruḷtanaṁ
piṅgitendu besagoṇḍoḍe kubērakāntanintendu
pēḻdanīyarasara magaḷappa manōhari enna munnina
bhavada peṇḍatiyākeyanaṟasalvēḍi initu divasaṁ
maruḷgoṇḍirddeṁ mattīgaḷāraydaṟasi kaṇḍenappudaṟindaṁ
maruḷtanaṁ piṅgitendu pēḻdoḍe tandeyendaṁ magane ninna
munnina peṇḍatiyendaṟideyappoḍamīgaḷākeyarasana
magaḷāgirppudaṟiṁ ninagati durlabhe bhāgyamilladudaṁ
peṟalāga ninagākeyoḷappa bēṇṭamanuḻivudu magane
endoḍe kubērakāntaṁ kāmavidyeyindaṁ hastyaśva
rathapadātibalasamūhamanenitānumaṁ vibhavaiśvarya
samanvitaṁ tandege tōṟidoḍe tandeyuṁ magana
sāmarthyamaṁ kaṇḍādamānuṁ santasambaṭṭirdaṁ
mattondu divasaṁ atiratha mahārājaṁ mantriyarkaḷoḍane
mantaṇamirddalli mantriyarkaḷanintendu besagoṇḍaṁ
manōharige yauvanaṁ neṟedudu kūsu kuḍalkādudārge
kuḍuvamendu mantriyarkkaḷaṁ besagoṇḍoḍe uḻida
mantriyarkaḷellaṁ tantamma bagedarasugaḷa pesarggaḷaṁ pēḻdavargge
kuḍuvamendoḍe kubērakāntana tandeyappa vijayanemba
mantriyurkkevadindavara pēḻda madavakkaḷaṁ nirākarisi
manōhariya rūpiṅgaṁ javvanakkaṁ kaḷāguṇaṅgaḷanaṟivu
darkkamavar yōgyar madavakkaḷallar kūsiṅge svayambaramaṁ
paṇṇuvaṁ svayambaradoḷ tanna bhāgyadoḷ maccidavaraṁ
kaykoḷgendu nuḍidoḍe

arasanumātana mātanoḍambaṭṭu svayambarasāleyaṁ
māḍisi arasugaḷgellaṁ baḻiyanaṭṭi barise
svayaṁvarasāleyoḷ neredirddaraṅga veṅgi kaḷiṅga
kāmbhōja kāśi kauśala pallava pāñcāḷa magadha māḷava
vatsa mahārāṣṭra kuṇāḷa kurujāṅgaṇa draviḷa lāḷa karnnāṭa
gauḷa suhuma surakānta sūrasēnīya prabhati nānā
viṣayādhipatigaḷapparasugaḷellaṁ neredirddalliyārumaṁ
meccade dāṇṭi pōgi kubērakāntaṅge māleyaṁ
sūḍidaḷāgaḷarasugaḷellaṁ neredāmēkaika pradhānaremirddantire
baḍavaṅgēnumalladoṅge māleyaṁ sūḍidaḷendu
sabhākṣōbhamāgi kubērakāntanoḷanibaruṁ
neredu yuddhaṅgeydoḍe saṅgrāmaraṅgadoḷ
suvarmmavarmmaṁ modalāgoḍeyarkaḷellarumaṁ geldu
manōhariyaṁ pāṇigrahaṇa purassaraṁ maduvenindu
sopārakkadhipatiyāgirddan

intu kubērakāntaṁ manōhariyoḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttamireyire suvarmmavarmmanembarasaṁ
rājyaparibhraṣṭanāgi tāpasatapamaṁ kaikoṇḍu negaḻdu sattu
pratisūryanemba vyantaradēvanāgi puṭṭidoṁ matte
śrīdharanuṁ kubērakāntanuṁ manōhariyumanyōnyāti
snēhadoḷ kūḍi rājyaṅgeydu tamma geyda dānadharmada
phaladindaṁ anyajanmadoḷintappa vidyeyakkendu
mūvaruṁ nidānaṅgeydu munnaṁ śrīdharaṁ sattu
vijayārdhaparvatada uttara śrēṇiyoḷ aḷakāpuramembudu
poḻaladanāḷvoṁ gaganavallabhanembonātana bhārye
anaṅgamāleyemboḷāyirvvarggaṁ śrīdharaṁ caṇḍavēga
nemboṁ maganāgi puṭṭidoṁ ā caṇḍavēgana mahādēvi
vidyullateyemboḷāyirvvarggaṁ kubērakāntaṁ sattu
vidyunmāḷiyemba maganāgi puṭṭidoṁ mattaṁ dakṣiṇaśrēṇi
yoḷ vidyullateya sōdara tammaṁ mēghakūṭādhipati
mēghamāḷiyemboṁ vidyādharanātana mahādēvi
ratibinduvemboḷāyirvvarggaṁ manōhari sattu
viraḷavēgeyemboḷ magaḷāgi puṭṭidaḷ

mattondu divasaṁ caṇḍavēganuṁ vidyunmāliyumantu
tammirvvaruṁ ujjayanta parvatada śikharadoḷ
ariṣṭanēmi bhaṭṭārara parinirvvāṇa bhūmiyoḷ bhaktiyiṁ
pūjisalendarcaneyaṁ koṇḍu pōdoḍā parvvatada
śikharamaṁ kaṇḍu vidyunmāli mūrchevōgi jātismaranāgi
manōhariyaṁ nenedu māsōpavāsaṅgeydu prajñaptiyemba
mahāvidyeyaṁ sādhisidoḍā vidye besanēnendu munde
nile enna munnina bhavada prāṇavallabheyappa manōhari īgaḷī
lōkadoḷellirddaḷembudanaṟasi bēgamenage pēḻendoḍā
vidyeyintendu pēḻdattu
vijayārdha parvatada dakṣiṇa śrēṇiyoḷ mēghakūṭa
purādhipati mēghamāḷiyemboṁ vidyādharaṁ ninna sōdara
māvanātaṅge manōhari sattu viraḷavēgeyemboḷ
magaḷāgirdoḷendoḍantappoḍe nīnenna māvana manege
vōgi viraḷavēgegintendu pēḻ ele manōhari nīṁ
munnina bhavadoḷ kubērakāntanoḍane krīḍisida krīḍegaḷaṁ
nenedā endu pēḻendu vidyeyaṁ kalpisiyaṭṭidoḍā
vidyeyuṁ pōgi kalpisida pāṅginoḷe nuḍidoḍe viraḷavēge
mūrchevōgirddu nīḍaṟindeḻcattu jātismareyāgi
virahasantāpadiṁ tanna munnina bhartāranaṁ neneyuttire
vidyunmāḷiyuṁ tanna manege vōgi tande caṇḍavēgaṅge tanna
vr̥ttāntamellamaṁ pēḻdoḍātanumādamānumosedu
tanna maidunanappa mēghamāḷi vidyādharanallige perggaḍegaḷaṁ
kūsaṁ bēḍiyaṭṭi pettu viraḷavēgeyaṁ vidyunmāli maduve
nindākeyoḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāmabhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ
palakālaṁ sale
mattondu divasaṁ vidyānirmita vicitramāguttirda
vimānamanēṟikoṇḍu pōpalli himavanta parvvatada
mēge pāṟuva vimānamaṁ muṁ pēḻda pratisūryanemba
vyantaradēvaṁ kaṇḍu tanna suvarmavarmmanappa bhavada pageyaṁ
nenedirvvarumaṁ kūḍi kondan

intirvvaruṁ sattu gaṅgeyemba mahānadiya teṅkaṇa paḍuvaṇa
kōṇoḷ sukauśaḷamemba viṣayadoḷayōdhyāpuramemba
poḻaloḷ sāgarasēnanemboṁ rājaśrēṣṭhiyātana bhārye
dharaṇiyemboḷāyirvvargaṁ vidyunmāḷiyemba vidyādharaṁ
kālaṅgeydu siddhārthanemboṁ maganāgi puṭṭidoṁ
pitr̥mātr̥gaḷosageyaṁ māḍuttaṁ śrīvibhava rūpakānti
saubhāgyādiguṇaṅgaḷiṁ neṟedoṁ
mattitta magadheyembudu nāḍalli rājagr̥hamemba poḻaloḷ
samudravijayanemboṁ rājaśrēṣṭhiyātaṅge sāgaraseṭṭiya
sōdara taṅge sumatiyemboḷaṁ koṭṭarāyirvvarggaṁ
viraḷavēgeyemba vidyādhari kālaṅgeydu śrīkānteyemboḷ
magaḷāgi puṭṭidoḷatyanta rūpalāvaṇya saubhāgyakānti hāva
bhāva vilāsa vibhramaṅgaḷiṁ kūḍidoḷ dēvagaṇikeyane
pōlvaḷākeyaṁ sōdara māvana magaṅge piriduṁ vistāradiṁ
siddhārthaṅge koṭṭarantu siddhārthanuṁ śrīkānteyuṁ
tammoḷanyōnya snēhadoḷ kūḍi iṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ palakālaṁ sale mattondu divasaṁ
saptataḷaprāsādada mēlirvvarumiṣṭaparivāra sahitaṁ
diśāvaḷōkanaṅgeyyuttaṁ sukhasaṅkathāvinōdadindirppannegaṁ
vicitramāguttirdda vimānamanēṟi ākāśapathakkogedu mēge
pōpa vidyādharayugaḷamaṁ kaṇḍirvvaruṁ mūrchevōgi
nīḍaṟindeḻcart jātismararāgi tamma munnina bhavamaṁ
nenedu saṁsārada pollameyumananityateyumaṁ
bagedu vairāgyapararāgi irvvaruṁ tapaṁ baḍuva
buddhiyanoḍeyarāgi svajana parijana mantri mitravarggakkellaṁ
baḻiyanaṭṭi barisi saṁsārada pollameyumaṁ tantamma
bageda kāryyamumanavara munde nuḍidoḍavarggaḷellaṁ
neredintendarammā pūrvadindaṁ banda kulasantatiyaṁ
kāvorārumillinitu bhāramanārggoppisi tapambaṭṭappiradaṟiṁ
kelavu kāladiṁ maganādoḍe magaṅge samasta bhāramaṁ
nirūpisi tapambaḍuvudendu nuḍidoḍe siddhārthanendaṁ
nimmellara pēḻdudanimbugeydappenendu maganādandenna
tapambaḍuvandāruṁ vakrambarasallendu nuḍidoḍambaḍisi
kelavu kālaṁ parivāraṁ bārise māṇdirdiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttireyire

matte siddhārthana piriyarasi jayāvatiyemboḷ makkaḷaṁ bēḍi
dēvarggaṁ dēvategaḷgaṁ parasi pūjeyaṁ māḍuttirppoḷondu
divasaṁ vijayabhadraremba bhaṭāraravadhijñānigaḷ
carigevokkoḍe kaṇḍavaraṁ jayāvati niṟisiyādamānuṁ
bhaktiyindaṁ kaiyalikki nirantaraṁ māḍi kuḷḷirdda baḻikkintendu
besagoṇḍaḷ bhaṭārā enage makkaḷakkumo āgado endu
besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭārarintendar vibhavavaiśvarya rūpakānti
saubhāgyādi guṇaṅgaḷindaṁ siddhārthanindaggaḷaṁ kulatilakanappa
maganaṁ peṟuvay pettāgaḷentu puṇṇamiyandina candranaṁ
kaṇḍāgaḷādityanastamānakke salgumante maganaṁ kaṇḍāgaḷe ninna
bhartāranuṁ tapambaḍugumā risiyaraṁ kaṇḍāgaḷe maganuṁ
tapambaḍugumendu bhaṭārar pēḻdu pōdaritta jayāvatige
harṣaviṣādaṅgaḷeraḍumormmodalāge kālaṁ sale mattitta
caṇḍavēgaṁ palakālamarasugeydu āyuṣyāntadoḷ
kaḻidu jayāvatiya garbhadoḷ nelasi garbhamādoḍe
jayāvati muṁ nelamaneyaṁ māḍisi enage kuttaṁ
jalōdaramādudarkke kriyegeysidappenendu siddhārthaṅge
pēḻdu kuttamaṁ bhāvisi nelamaneyoḷagirdu navamāsaṁ
neṟedandu prasūteyāgi maganaṁ pettu tānuṁ dādiyuṁ
mattaṁ besakeyva toḻtumintu mūvarumaṟivoruḻidarāru
maṟiyarintu divasaṅgaḷ sale

mattondu divasaṁ besakeyva toḻtu nīraṁ taral pōdalli
nīra poḻeyoḷākeya keḷadi nāgabbeyemboḷākeyaṁ
kaṇḍintendu besagoṇḍaḷelege kundabe paladivasadindaṁ
ninnaṁ kaṇḍenillinitu divasadiṁ muṁ kāṇadudarkke kāraṇamaṁ
pēḻendu besagoṇḍaḷge kāraṇamaṁ ninage pēḻdappeṁ nīnārggaṁ
pēḻeyappoḍendu sūruḷisi intendu pēḻdaḷ nōḍā
emma seṭṭiti jayāvati besaleyādaḷ kiruṇḍeganaṁ
pettaḷārumanaṟiyalīyade nelamaneyoḷaḍaṅgirppoḷendu
pēḻdoḍā mātanalliyorvaṁ sañjevārisuttirdda brāhmaṇaṁ
dāridryābhibhūtaṁ sōmaśarmmanembātaṁ kēḷdādamānuṁ
santōṣambaṭṭu piridondu māduphalamaṁ koṇḍu
pōgi siddhārthanaṁ kaṇḍintendu binnavikuṁ siddhārthaseṭṭi
mahāpuruṣā ninagānondosageyaṁ pēḻal bandeṁ
jayāvati besaleyādaḷ magambettaḷendu pēḻdoḍe pēḻda
bhaṭṭaṅge kaṭaka kaṭisūtraṁ modalāgoḍeya aṅgacittamumaṁ
piridu kasavaramumaṁ koṭṭu pārvaṅge dāridryamōkṣamaṁ
māḍi siddhārthanī pārvana mātaṁ kēḷdāgaḷe putramukhamaṁ
nōḻpenendu bhōṅkane nelamaneyoḷagaṁ pokku
nōḻpannegaṁ jayāvati tanna sōṅkila mēgiṭṭāḍisuttirppa
kūsaṁ eḷanēsaṟa tējadoḷōrantappanaṁ kaṇḍu palavu
kālaṁ bāḻveyāgendu maganaṁ parasi mattamintendanenna
mūvatteraḍu kōṭi kasavarakkaṁ rājaśrēṣṭhipadakkamenna
santatigamellavinninditta nīne arasanendu nuḍidu
samastabhāramellamaṁ kūsiṅge samarpisi sōṅkiloḷirda
kūsiṅge seṭṭivaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi parasi sēseyanikki sōṅkiloḷirddanaṁ
kaṇḍanappudaṟiṁ sukauśalasvāmiyendu pesaraniṭṭu

nelamaneyaṁ poṟamaṭṭu svajana parijana bandhuvarggakkellaṁ
niśyalyaṅgeydu nīminibaruṁ sukauśalasvāmiyaṁ piḍidu
bāḻimendu kalpisi santayisi vinayandharararembācāryara
pakkade palambarumberasu tapambaṭṭaṁ matte śrīkānte
modalāgoḍeya palambar peṇḍirkkaḷ vinayandharabhaṭṭārar
gurugaḷāge guṇamati kantiyar kantiyarāge tapambaṭṭu
palakālamugrōgra tapaścaraṇaṅgeydu samādhi maraṇadindaṁ
muḍipi dēvalōkadoḷanibaruṁ puṭṭidar mattitta
siddhārtharisiyuṁ panneraḍu varuṣambaraṁ gurugaḷanagalade
dvādaśāṅga caturdaśa pūrvamappāgamamellamaṁ
kaltēkavihāriyappeṁ bhaṭārā endu gurugaḷaṁ
besagoṇḍavaranumatadindēkavihāriyāgi grāmē ēkarātraṁ
nagarē pañcarātraṁ aṭavyāṁ daśarātramembī nyāyadiṁ
vihārisuttaṁ chaṭṭhaṭṭhama dasama duvāḷa sāṣṭōpavāsa
pakṣōpavāsa māsōpavāsaṅgaḷaṁ māḍuttaṁ palakālaṁ
tapaṅgeyyuttamirdar

itta jayāvati muṁ bhaṭṭārar pēḻdādēśamaṁ nenedu tanna
maneyaṁ risiyaraṁ pugalīyadantire bāgilgāpinavaraṁ
kalpisidoḷ matte siddhārtha riṣiyara mēge krōdhamaṁ bhāvisi
bālavaddeyaṁ kūsaṁ sisuvanavyaktanaṁ visuṭṭentu tapambaṭṭe
pāpakarma dayeyilladoṁ niṣkaruṇi endu baydaḷ matte
sukausaḷa svāmiyaṁ moleyūḍuva dādi subrateyemboḷ
sumatiyemboḷūḍuva dādi nandeyemboḷāḍisuva
dādi suprabheyemboḷ majjanambugisuva dādi
mēghamāleyemboḷ pasadanaṅgoḷisuva dādi intayvar
dādiyarkkaḷ naḍape sukhadindaṁ baḷedu padināṟuṁ
varuṣambōgi yauvanavādoḍe mūvattirvvararasu
makkaḷa kūsugaḷanatyanta lāvaṇya saubhāgya kānti hāva
bhāva vilāsa vibhramaṅgaḷiṁ kūḍidoraṁ bēḍiyonde
paseyoḷ maduve niṟisidaḷ mattēkaśāla dviśāla
triśāla catuḥśāla svastika nandyāvarttaṁ modalāgoḍeya
māḍaṅgaḷuṁ mūvatteraḻbaḷḷimāḍaṅgaḷumaṁ māḍisi tanna
maneyaṅgaṇadoḷ seṇḍāḍuva taḻiyumāneyanēṟuva
vinōdaṁ modalāgoḍeya vinōda sthānaṅgaḷellamaṁ
māḍisi poṟamaḍalīyadantu kāpaṁ māḍi
maganaiśvaryamaṁ vinōdamumanaḻtiyindaṁ divasakkaṁ
nōḍuttirkkumā sukauśaḷa svāmiyuṁ mūvattirvvar
peṇḍirkkaḷoḍane iṣṭa viṣaya kāma bhōgasukhaṅgaḷaṁ
palakālamanubhavisuttire

mattondu divasaṁ sukauśaḷasvāmiyuṁ pr̥thvīdharamemba
prāsādadēḻaneya neleya mēge tānuṁ tāyuṁ
suvrate modalāgoḍeya ayvar dādiyaruṁ
svayamprabhe modalāgoḍeya mūvattirvvar
peṇḍirkkaḷintinibarindaṁ parivēṣṭitanāgi
gavākṣajālāntaradoḷ diśāvaḷōkanaṅgeyyuttaṁ sukha
saṅkathāvinōdadindirppannegamitta siddhārtha risiyar grāma
nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba pattana drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttayōdhyānagaramaṁ bandu māsōpavāsada
pāraṇeyandu carigevokku kiṟumane permaneyennaduṇal takka
manegaḷaṁ yathākramadiṁ puguttaṁ barpar sukausaḷasvāmiya
maneyaṁ pokku poṟamaḍuvar giḍigiḍijantraṁ
miḷimiḷinētrarappa māsōpavāsaṅgeyda risiyar pōpudaṁ
sukauśaḷasvāmi kaṇḍu

ī pōparēnembarabbā apūrvarūparinnaranenduṁ
kaṇḍaṟiyenendu tāyaṁ besagoṇḍoḍe tāy intendu
pēḻdaḷ magane ītanaṅgaḍiyalavaḍaṁ peṟuki tindu
bāḻvoṁ baikaṅguḷi bēḍi poḻalellamaṁ toḻaldu basiṟaṁ
porevoṁ dēsiganārumilladoṁ kōvaṇakkappoḍaṁ
bhāgasamilladonendu jayāvati pēḻdoḍe suvrateyemba
dādi mārkkoṇḍintendaḷ hā polladaṁ nuḍiday
svāmiyaṁ paramēśvaranaṁ nīṁ modalāgoḍeya
mūvattirvvarumoḷpeṇḍirkkaḷumaṁ mūvatteraḻkōṭi
kasavaramumaṁ koḷada pulladarkkaṁ toṟevantanitumaṁ
toṟedu karmakṣayārthaṁ tapambaṭṭātananiḷisi paribhavisi
muṭṭugiḍisi nuḍiyalvēḍendu bārisidoḷaṁ jayāvati kaṇketti
bārisidoḍe kemmagirddu peṟapeṟavane nuḍiyal taguḷdoḍe
sukauśaḷasvāmiyavarirvara nuḍigaḷ sagarbhavacanaṅgaḷendu
tanna manadoḷe bageyuttirpinaṁ bāṇasigaṁ bandu
bōnamettiyōgaramāṟidappudendu pēḻdoḍe tāyuṁ
suvrate modalāgoḍeya dādiyarayvarumātana
peṇḍirkkaḷ svayamprabhe śrīdatte bandhumati bhānumati
mitrasēne priyaṅgu sundari priyade śyāmalate vidyullate
acale vimaḷamati śrīkānte śaśiprabhe sūrasēne anantamati
sarasvati vijaye vaijayante aparājite kanakamāḷe dhānye
dhanaśrī vasundhareyendivar modalāgoḍeyarellar
neredintendar vēḷātikramamādapudārogisalkēḻimendu
nuḍidoḍe sukauśaḷasvāmiyintendanī
vr̥ttāntamellamanaṟidoḍalladuṇbenallenadaṟiṁ pēḻ
suvrate ēnaṁ kaṇḍirāruḷḷudanuḷḷante pēḻeyappoḍe
ninagennāṇeyendu tanna mēge sūruḷisi besagoṇḍoḍe
suvrateyemboḷ moleyūḍida dādiyintendu pēḻdaḷ
kēḷ magane ivar ninna tandevir siddhārtharembor nīn
toṭṭiloḷirddante ninage seṭṭivaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi saṁsārakke pēsi
karmakṣayārthaṁ tapambaṭṭī meyyaṁ niṟisalvēḍi poḻaloḷage
carigevokku bāvarivuguttuṁ bandu ninna maneyaṁ pokku
poṟamaṭṭu pōdarendu pēḻdinnārōgisalvēḻkuṁ ēḻu
magane endoḍe

sukauśaḷasvāmiyendanantappoḍānumavarantappa rūpaṁ
kaikoṇḍalladuṇṇe nendu pratijñegeydirdoḍe svajana parijana
bandhuvargamellaṁ neredintendar nīninnuṁ kūsay
kāmabhōgaṅgaḷanubhavisuva divasaṅgaḷ tapambaḍuva
divasamallaṁ prāyambōdimbaḻikke ninnammanentu ninage
seṭṭivaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi samastabhāramaṁ samarpisi tapambaṭṭanante
nīnuṁ ninage maganādoḍe magaṅge seṭṭivaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi
samasta bhāramaṁ nirūpisi tapambaḍuvudendellaruṁ
nuḍidoḍintendanannegamēṁ sāvaro bāḻvaro
entaṟiyalakkuṁ mānasavāḻembudu panipulla mugila
sañjeyoḷōrantappudaṟindār bārisidoḍaṁ nilvenallendu
svayamprabheyemboḷ basiṟa peṇḍatiyākeya basiṟa kūsiṅge
seṭṭivaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi maneyindaṁ poṟamaṭṭu

risiyarirddeḍeyaṁ besagoḷuttaṁ pōgi bahirudyānavanadoḷ
sphaṭikaśilātalada mēgirdda siddhārtha bhaṭṭāraraṁ kaṇḍu
sukauśaḷasvāmi jātismaranāgi darśanaviśuddhiyoḷ
kūḍida śubhapariṇāmadindaṁ bandisidāgaḷavadhijñāna
mumāge avara tanna munnina bhavāntaraṅgaḷellamaṁ
pratyakṣamāgaṟidu manadoḷintendu bagedanivaṁ munnina
bhavāntaradoḷ priyadarśananemba seṭṭi kālaṅgeydu
malayasundaranembāneyāgi puṭṭidanalliṁ baḻiyaṁ
kubērakāntanembonādanalliṁ baḻiyaṁ vidyunmāḷiyemba
vidyādharanādanalliṁ baḻiyaṁ siddhārthanembonīgaḷāgi
tapambaṭṭanantu siddhārtha bhaṭṭārara bhavaṅgaḷaidu mattāṁ
munnina bhavadoḷ priyasēneyemba mālegārttiyeṁ
kālaṅgeydu padmāvatiyemba piḍiyāgi puṭṭidenalliṁ
baḻiyaṁ varāṅganādenalliṁ baḻiyaṁ śrīdharanādenalliṁ
baḻiyaṁ caṇḍavēganemba vidyādharanādenalliṁ baḻiyaṁ
siddhārthaṅgaṁ jayāvatigaṁ maganenāṁ sukauśaḷasvāmiyāgi
puṭṭidenintenna bhavāntaramāṟu mattāṁ priyasēneyappandenna
keḷadi sukīrtiyembaḷ priyadarśanana bhārye kālaṅgeydu
malayāvatiyemba piḍiyāgi puṭṭidoḷalliṁ baḻiyaṁ
sukēśiniyādaḷalliṁ baḻiyaṁ manōhariyādaḷalliṁ
