baḻiyaṁ viraḷavēgeyemba vidyādhariyādaḷalliṁ
baḻiyaṁ śrīkānteyādoḷākeyaṁ siddhārthaṅge
koṭṭudantu śrīkānteya bhavāntaramāṟantu mūvara
bhavāntaraṅgaḷanaṟidu saṁsārakke vairāgyamāgi siddhārtha
bhaṭṭārara pakkade sukauśaḷasvāmi tapambaṭṭaṁ suprabheyuḻiye
uḻida mūvattirvvar peṇḍiruṁ siddhārtha bhaṭārar
gurugaḷāge guṇamati kantiyar kantiyarāge tapambaṭṭu
palakālamugrōgra tapaścaraṇaṅgeydu samādhi maraṇadiṁ
muḍipi dēvalōkadoḷ puṭṭidar

mattitta jayāvatiyuṁ tanna bārisevārise sukauśalasvāmi
tapambaṭṭanendu muḷidu jinadharmavaṁ paḻidu
unmārggōpadēśadindārtadhyānadoḷ kūḍi
sattu moggaḷagiriyemba parvatadoḷ peṇbuliyāgi
puṭṭidaḷ mattitta sukausalasvāmi dvādaśāṅga caturdaśa
pūrvamappāgamamellamaṁ kaltu gurugaḷoḍane grāma
nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba pattana drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ palakālaṁ tapambaṭṭu moggaḷagiriyemba
parvatakke vandu maḻegāladoḷirvaruvonde guheyoḷ
jōgugoṇḍu nālku tiṅgaḷirvarumupavāsaṅgeydu
jōgu neṟedoḍe cāturmāsada pāraṇeyendu
sukauśalasvāmiyappa risiyar guheyindaṁ munna
poṟamaṭṭu desegaḷaṁ nōḻpanannegaṁ tāyappa peṇbuli palavu
divasamāhāramaṁ peṟade pasidu malmala maṟuguttirddu
risiyaraṁ kaṇḍu muḷidu masagi mēlvāyal paritappudaṁ
kaṇḍu sukausalasvāmi āhāra śarīrakke yāvajjīvaṁ
nivr̥ttiyendu kāyōtsargaṁ geydu

lg.l: khammāmi savvajīvāṇaṁ savvē jīvā khamantu mē
mettī mē savvabhūdēsu vēraṁ majjhaṇa kēṇaci
majjha sahāvaṁ ṇāṇaṁ daṁsaṇacaraṇaṁ ṇakōvi lāvaṇṇaṁ
jō savvayaṇaggāhi sō haṁ ṇō gāhavēyadā
chijjau bhijjau jāu khau jōiya ēhu sarīru
appā bhāvahi ṇimmalau jēṁ pāvahi bhavatīru

div.p: endintu kṣameyaṁ bhāvisi

dharmadhyāna śukladhānyaṅgaḷaṁ dhyānisuttamire puli bandu
pāydu basiṟaṁ pōḻdu nettaraṁ kuḍidu tegaleyaṁ pōḻdu
tinbāgaḷ siddhārtharisiyuṁ guheyaṁ poṟamaṭṭu bandu
kaṇḍu hā pañcamahāpātaki magananēke kondu tinde munne
kuṅkumapaṅkitamappa dibyadēhadoḷ bemara bindugaḷaṁ
kaṇḍu nettarendu bagedu mūrchege salvākeye īgaḷ maganaṁ
pōḻdu tindappay ahō kaṣṭaṁ saṁsāramendu siddhārtha
bhaṭṭārar nuḍiva vacanamaṁ kēḷdu vakṣaḥsthaḷada śrīlāñchanamaṁ
kaṇḍu jātismareyāgi mūrchege sandu nīḍaṟindeḻcarttu
hā pañcamahāpātakiyenenna maganaṁ pōḷdu
tindenendu tannaṁ tāṁ nindisi taleyaṁ kālgaḷaṁ pāṣāṇa
vr̥kṣaṅgaḷoḷ śatacūrṇamāge baḍidukoṇḍu hā magane
polladaṅgeydenendu praḷāpaṅgeydu mahāśōkaṅgeyyuttire
bhaṭṭāraradarke dharmaśravaṇaṅgeydu saṁsāra sthitiyanaṟiye
pēḻdu vrataṅgaḷanēṟisidoḍupaśamakke sandāhāra śarīrakke
yāvajjīvaṁ nivr̥ttigeydu śubhapariṇāmadoḷ kūḍi
muḍipi saudharma kalpadoḷ puṭṭittu siddhārtharisiyaruṁ
samyagdarśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi karma
kṣayaṅgeydu mōkṣamaneydidar sukausalasvāmiyuṁ
tirikōpasarggamaṁ sairisi sarvārthasiddhiyoḷ sayasattama
dēvanāgi puṭṭi mūvattumūṟu sāgarōpa
māyuṣyamanoḍeyanappahamindranādon

embidellamaṁ yaśōdhara kēvaligaḷ pēḻe
campāpurādhipatiyappa gandhabhājananembarasaṁ
kēḷdādamānuṁ santuṣṭacittanāgi bhaṭārarggeṟagi
poḍevaṭṭu saṁsāra śarīra bhōga nirvvēga
parāyaṇanāgi dhātrivāhananemba tanna piriya
magaṅge rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi nūrvararasu makkaḷverasu
yaśōdhara kēvaligaḷa pakkade tapambaṭṭaṁ
mattapsaraseyarkkaḷoḷōrannarapparasiyaraynūrvaruṁ
yaśōdhara kēvaligaḷ gurugaḷāge padmāvati kantiyar
kantiyarāge tapambaṭṭu samādhi maraṇadindaṁ muḍipi
saudharmaṁ modalāgoḍeya dēvalōkadoḷ
puṭṭidaritta gandhabhājana muniyuṁ dvādaśāṅga caturdaśa
pūrvamappāgamamellamaṁ kaltu palakālamugrōgra
tapaścaraṇaṅgeydu grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba
pattana drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ pōgi
pāṇḍya viṣayadoḷ paḷikuntaḷeyamba parvatada
mēgirdu bāhyābhyantara parigraha parityāgapūrvakaṁ
kāyōtsargaṅgeydu dharmadhyāna śukladhyānaṅgaḷaṁ jānisi
karmakṣayaṅgeydu surāsurēndrarkkaḷiṁ pūjeyaneydi mōkṣakke
vōdar

mattārādhakarappavargaḷ sukauśalasvāmiya tirikōpasargamaṁ
manade bagedu pasivuṁ nīraḻke dāha vātaṁ sūleyendivu
modalāgoḍeya vēdanegaḷaṁ sairisi darśanajñāna
cāritraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi samādhi maraṇadiṁ muḍipiyabhyudaya
niśśrēyasa sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: gajakumārana kathe
div.p: gajakumārana katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ

lg.l:
bhūmīe samaṁ khīlābhā ida dēhōvi
allacammaṁ va
bhagavaṁ pi gajakumārō paḍivaṇṇō uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ

div.ab:
bhūmī e samaṁ – neladoḷōrantāge malarcikkiyuradiṁ
taguḷdu nābhivaregaṁ basiṟaṁ pōḻdu, allacammaṁ –
pandovalaṁ tegedu, khīlābhā ida dēhōvi – kāyda
karbbonna niḍiyavuṁ tōramumappa kīlgaḷindaṁ
meyyellamuṁ nirantaramurci pōgi nelanaṁ tāpinaṁ
kīliṟiyepaṭṭa meyyanoḍeyanāgiyuṁ, bhagavaṁ – piridappa
permeyanoḍeyaṁ, gajakumārōpi – gajakumāranuṁ,
paḍivaṇṇō – pordidoṁ, uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ – mikka darśana
jñāna cāritraṅgaḷārādhaneyaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharata kṣētradoḷ suraṭamembudu
nāḍalli dvārāvatiyembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ viṣṇu
ardhacakriyātana tande vasudēvasvāmiyembonā
vasudēvasvāmiyarasi gāndharvadatteyemboḷāyirvargaṁ
gajakumāranemboṁ maganapponantavargaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ kālaṁ sale

mattitta sūradattamembudu nāḍalli paudanapuramembudu
poḻaladanāḷvonaparājitanembonarasanādamānuṁ
pracaṇḍa baḷagarvitanārumanuṟadoṁ viṣṇugaṁ
besakeyyanondu divasaṁ viṣṇu poḻaloḷ gōsaṇeya
toḻalcidanāvanorvaṁ paudanapurādhipatiyappaparājitanaṁ
saṅgrāmadoḷ kādi geldu piḍikoṇḍu barkumātaṅgeyātana
bēḍuvudellamaṁ kuḍuvenendu toḻalva gōsaṇeyaṁ
gajakumāraṁ piḍidoḍā mātanarasaṁ kēḷdu
gajakumāranaṁ kareyisiyātanoḍane cāturdanta
baḷamaṁ kūḍiyaṭṭidoḍātanuṁ pōgiyaparājitanoḍane
mahāyuddhaṅgeydu geldu peḍaṅgeyyuḍiye kaṭṭi gaja turaga
vastuvāhana sahitaṁ tandu viṣṇugoppisidoḍātanumosedu
nīn meccidudaṁ bēḍikoḷḷene peṟatēnumanollen
nimma prasādadindenagellamuṇṭu ondaṁ bēḻpeṁ
nimmantaḥpuramuḻiye poḻaloḷagenna meccida
peṇḍirane koṇḍennicceyoḷ meccidante bāḻvenī
dāyamaṁ bēḍirdenidanenage dayegeydu salisuvu
dendoḍarasanumantegeyyendu gajakumāraṅge bēḍidudaṁ
koṭṭaṁ

gajakumāranuṁ tanna bēḍida varamaṁ pettu paradara
pārvarokkaligara sāmantara poḻaloḷaguḷḷa oḷpeṇḍirellaraṁ
kaṇgaṁ manakkaṁ meccidavaroḷ tannicceyindaṁ moṟedu
moṭṭayisiyuydu bāḻuttire mattamā poḻaloḷ paṅguḷa
nemba suvarṇagāṟana peṇḍati vasundhariyemboḷatyanta
rūpa lāvaṇya saubhāgya kānti hāva bhāva vilāsa
vibhramaṅgaḷanoḍeyoḷaṁ kaṇḍu gajakumāranākegāṭisi
tanna maneyoḷiṭṭākegāsaktanāgi bāḻuttirkumā ēraṇiganuṁ
peṇḍatiya viyōgadoḷ santāpadindamiruḷuṁ
pagalumanavarataṁ bēyuttamasamarthanappudaṟindaṁ
manadoḷ gajakumāraṅge muḷiyuttirkkuṁ

intu palakālaṁ sale mattondu divasamariṣṭanēmi
bhaṭṭārara samavasaraṇaṁ vihārisuttaṁ dvārāvatige vandoḍe
viṣṇuvinoḍane gajakumāraṁ tribhuvana paramēśvaranallige
vōgi vandisi pūjisirdu bhaṭārar dharmamaṁ
pēḻvalliyagamyāgamanaṅgeyvoḍaṁ peṟara sajjanaṅgaḷoḷ
bardoḍameyduva durgatigaḷoḷappa duḥkhaṅgaḷaṁ pēḻe
kēḷdu nānyathājinabhāṣitamendu nambi bhōgaṅgaḷge pēsi
vairāgyamāgi ellamaṁ toṟedariṣṭanēmi bhaṭṭārara pakkade
tapambaṭṭugrōgra tapaścaraṇaṅgeydu

panneraḍu varṣaṁ pōdoḍe grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa
maḍamba paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ
mattamā dvārāvatige vandu rēvatōdyānavanadoḷ
rātri pratimenindonaṁ svajana parijana bandhuvargamuṁ
śrāvakarkaḷuṁ bandarcisi poḍevaṇṭu pōparaṁ

paṅguḷanemba suvarṇakārakaṁ kaṇḍu besagoṇḍu bhaṭārara
baravaṁ kēḷdaṟidu pagevananiṟiyalpettenendu rāgisi palavu
niḍiyavuṁ tōramumappa karbbonna kīlgaḷaṁ koṇḍu
bandu kṣamāṅganāliṅgitanappa mahāmuniyaṁ malarci
paṭṭirisiyuraḥsthalamaṁ nābhivaregaṁ vidārisi pandoval
poretāpinegaṁ samantavayava pradēśaṅgaḷoḷ kāyda karbonna
kīlgaḷaṁ nelanaṁ tāpinamurcipōgiṟidoḍe kṣameyaṁ
bhāvisi dharmadhyāna śukladhyānaṅgaḷaṁ jānisi ratnatrayamaṁ
sādhisi samādhimaraṇadiṁ muḍipi dēvalōkamemba
prāsādakke kaḷasamāguttirdda sarvārthasiddhiyemba svargadoḷ
mūvattumūṟu sāgarōpamāyuṣyasthitiyanoḍeyanēka
hastapramāṇanuṁ puṇḍarīkavarṇaṅgaḷanoḍeyonahamindra
dēvanāgi puṭṭidoṁ

mattaṁ peṟarumārādhakarappavargaḷ gajakumārana
manuṣyōpasargadoḷāda vēdaneyaṁ manadoḷ bhāvisuttaṁ
pasivu nīraḻke dāha vātaṁ sūle modalāgoḍeya
vēdanegaḷaṁ sairisi darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi
samādhimaraṇadindaṁ muḍipi svargāpavarga sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: sanatkumāra cakravartiya kathe
div.p: sanatkumāra cakravartiya katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ
div.ab:
kaccu – kerakuṁ, jara – nareyuṁ, khāsa – kemmuṁ, sōsō –
bāy battuvuduṁ, bhattacchadi – chardiyuṁ, acchikucchidukkhāṇi
– kaṇṇa basiṟa bēnegaḷumendivu modalāgoḍeya,
adhiyāsidāṇi – sairise paṭṭavu, sammaṁ – oḷḷittāgi,
saṇaṅkumārēṇa – sanatkumāra cakravarti risiyindaṁ,
vāsasadaṁ – nūṟu varuṣaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharata kṣētradoḷ kurujāṅgaṇamembudu
nāḍalli hastināpuramembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
viśvasēna mahārājanembarasanātana mahādēvi
sahadēviyemboḷāyirvvarggaṁ sanatkumāranemboṁ
puṭṭidonātaṁ sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇaṁ sakaḷakaḷāpāragaṁ
celviniṁ dēvāsurarkaḷaṁ gelva rūpanoḍeyanātaṅge keḷeyaṁ
siṁhavikramanemba sāmantana magaṁ mahēndrasiṁha
nembonantavargganyōnya prītiyindaṁ kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ ēkacakrapurādhīśaṁ
bhūrāmanāmadhēyanappa śatrundamaṁ viśvasēna
mahārājaṅge pāguḍamanaṭṭe paṭṭavāramaragamemba
duṣṭāśvamaṁ kumāranēṟi lakṣmīgr̥hamembudyānavanada
madhyasthamappasthaladoḷ salvanā duṣṭāśvamaṁ kosegoḷe
gāḷiyindaṁ bēgamāgi vāritapūritaṁ paridu
kumāranaṁ koṇḍu mahāṭaviyaṁ pokkoḍitta viśvasēna
mahārājana mahāsāmantarkkaḷuṁ parivāramumellaṁ
kudurevaḍivajjeyaṁ nōḍi nāḍegeṭṭupōgi mūṟaneya
divasadandu aḍivajje keṭṭoḍe pōda deseyanaṟiyade
hā putrā endu mahāduḥkhākrāntanāgi pralāpaṅgeyva
nr̥patiyaṁ mahēndrasiṁhaṁ santayisi intendu nuḍidaṁ
kumāranaṁ pātāḷamaṁ pokkanappoḍamaṟasikoṇḍubarpeṁ
nimmaḍi nīmubbegambaḍade maguḻimendarasanaṁ maguḻci
parivāramberasu mahāṭaviyaṁ pokku toḻaldu nōḻpi
naṁ parijanaṅgaḷ kumārananaṟasi kāṇade bēsattu
mahēndrasiṁhanaṁ bisuṭu poḻalge vōdar

itta mahēndrasiṁhanorvane nānā vidha girigahana viṣaya
viṣama pradēśaṅgaḷumaṁ vyādhanivāsaṅgaḷumaṁ
yathākramadindaṁ kaḻidu pōgi priyaṅguṣaṇḍamemba
vanamaneydi tadvana madhyastha gr̥hadoḷiruḷirddu mitrana
viyōgadoḷappa duḥkhadindaṁ kāruṇyamāge praḷāpaṅgeydaḻtu
dēvateya munde nidregeydoṁ manōhariyemba jāvadāgaḷ
kariṇī śataṅgaḷiṁ parivēṣṭitanāgi tiḷinīra koḷadoḷage
krīḍisuva sorkkāneyumaṁ phalabharitamāda māvina
maranumaṁ kanasinoḷ kaṇḍu manōratha siddhiyāytendu
osedu maguḻdu nidrāvaśagatanādonaṁ kaṇḍu karuṇisi
bhūtāmbaranemba vyantaradēvanettikoṇḍu pōgi vijayārdha
parvatakkāsannamappa bhūtaramaṇamemba vanada naḍuvinoḷirdda
kṣullakamānasamemba sarōvarada taḍiyoḷikki pōdan
āgaḷātanuṁ nēsarmmūḍuvāgaḷ tūṅkaḍugeṭṭu desegaḷaṁ
nōḻpaṁ samudradoḷōrantappa kōkanada kumuda
kuvalaya kalhā rēndīvarādigaḷindaṁ haṁsa cakravāka baḷāka
vipakṣigaṇaṅgaḷ nīroḷagāḍuttuṁ muḻuguttuṁ nānā
prakāradindaṁ māṟuliva danigaḷindamatiramaṇīyamappa
koḷanaṁ kaṇḍādamānuṁ vismayacittanāgi ā
bhūtaramaṇavemba vanadoḷaśōka punnāga vakula campaka
sahakāra lavaṅga kramuka nāḷikēra nāgavallī pinaddha
drumaṣaṇḍa maṇḍitamanindravanadoḷōrantappudaṁ
nōḍuttuṁ toḻalvoṁ tanaganukūlamappa
śakunanimittaṅgaḷumaṁ kaṇḍindamōghamenna svāmiyaṁ
kāṇbenendu santuṣṭacittanāgiyā banada naḍuve toḻalvoṁ
mr̥dumadhuragambhīradhvaniyoḷ kūḍida mr̥daṅga vaṁśa
tāḷādigaḷa dhvanigaḷumaṁ mandra tāralayānvitamāge kivigaṁ
manakkaṁ sogayisuvantappa pāṭamamaṁ kēḷdu haricandana
kāḷāgaru malayaja turuṣkādigaḷa kampu bandu tīḍidoḍidu
dēvanivāsamakkumendu bagedu bhayāścaryadindaṁ vyākuḷita
manadonāgi innidanamōghaṁ nōḻpenendā desegāgi salvanaṁ

kanatkanakavinirmitamaṁ nānāmaṇigaṇa pinaddhamaṁ
caḷatkētupatākādyamaṁ vidyādhara yuvatī
janakrīḍanārthamappa prāsādamaṁ kaṇḍu vismayacittanāgi
yadaṟa samīpakke sārdondu maranaṁ maṟegoṇḍu
nōḻpoṁ tatpuraḥsthitamappa maṇimaṇṭapadoḷ
divyastrījanaṅgaḷ vilāsadiṁ cāmaramikke divyaśayyātaḷada
mēgirdu nāṭakamaṁ nōḻpa kumāranaṁ kaṇḍu
harṣacittadindaṁ kusumita kadamba vr̥kṣambol kaṇṭakita
rōmāñcitagātranāgi paridu varponaṁ kaṇḍidireydeyā
tanuṁ kumārana caraṇāravindaṅgaḷgeṟagi birdu mūrchāgata
nādoḍāgaḷ śītaḷa kriyegaḷindeḻcattaṟudiṅgaḷiṁ kaṇḍeṁ svāmi
ninnaṁ nambirde nānendu mahāduḥkhadindaḻvanaṁ santayisi
vipuḷaśrīyemba vidyādhara viḷāsiniyaṁ karedintendu
pēḻdanenna sahōdaranentuṁ śramamaṁ nīgi sukhadiṁ
taṇidonakkumantāge snānapānabhōjanādi kriyegaḷiṁ
bēgaṁ māḍendu pēḻdoḍākeyumantegeyvenendātanaṁ
mahāvibhūtiyindaṁ vidyādhara vilāsini majjanambugisi
divyāhāramanūḍi vastrābharaṇa gandhamālyādi
tāmbūlādigaḷiṁ taṇipidāgaḷātanuṁ munnina
duḥkhamellamaṁ maṟedaṁ munnaṁ klēśabhāgiyappa puruṣaṁ
svargamaneydi māṟappavole āytāgaḷalliṁ bandu
kumāranōrāsanadoḷirdu sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitanāgi
nētramanōhariyemba divya sabheyaṁ nōḍi vismayacittanāgi
intendaṁ svāmi vrataśīlōpavāsa tapaścaraṇa saṁnyasanādi
śubhānuṣṭhāna kriyegaḷiṁ satpuruṣaṁ maṟubhavadoḷ
dēvāṅganeyarkkaḷeṟeyanakkuṁ nīmībhavadindintappa
vibhavamaneydidiridenage mahāvismayamene
kumāranintendanivarggaḷ dēvakanneyarallar
vidyādhariyarkaḷene ivarggaḷaṁ nīmentu pettirelli
mēṇāva svarūpadiṁ bandiridanenage tiḷiye pēḻimene
kumāraniruḷellamatirañjaneyemba nāṭakamaṁ nōḍi
nidrāsukhamaṁ peṟadonā kamaḷamatiyemba vidyādhara
viḷāsiniyaṁ vidagdheyaṁ karedenna sambandhiyappa katheyellamaṁ
mahēndrasiṁhaṅge pēḻendu nidrāvaśagatanāgi vāsagr̥hamaṁ
pokkanittākeyumātaṅgintendu pēḻal taguḷdaḷ

kumāranindārūḍhamappa duṣṭāśvaṁ kumāranaṁ koṇḍu
manōvēgadiṁ giri vana dari nadīpradēśaṅgaḷoḷ
mūṟudivasamiruḷuṁ pagaluṁ pariyuttirdudu karuḷ
paṟidu tegaleyoḍedu kālaṅgeydattāgaḷ kumāranuṁ
pasivuṁ nīraḻkeyindamādaṁ bādhisepaṭṭu basamaḻidu
piridondālada marada keḻage śilātaḷada mēge
paṭṭirddanāgaḷalliyā vaṭavr̥kṣavāsiyappa manōharanemba
yakṣaṁ kaṇḍī puruṣaṁ sakalacakravartiyappanendaṟidu
gandhōdakamaṁ mēle taḷidu taṇgāḷiyaṁ vigurvvisi
dēhakkāpyāyanaṁ māḍi svarṇa bhājanadindāmōda
sugandhamappa kōḍuva nīranātaṅge kuḍiyaleṟedanāgaḷ
kumāraṁ nīnārggī nīranelliṁ tanday pēḻendu
besagoṇḍoḍātanintendanānī vaṭavr̥kṣa nivāsiyen
manōharanemba yakṣanen kṣullakamānasamemba sarōvaradiṁ
tandenī nīranene antappoḍe nīnennanā koḷakkoḍagoṇḍu
pōgalliyā nīraṁ mindu kuḍidoḍalladenage nīraḻke
kiḍadendu pēḻdoḍe kumārananettikoṇḍu pōgi yakṣanā
sarōvarada taḍiyoḷiḻipi pōdan

ā avasaradoḷ sitayak vyantaradēvaṁ kumārana
pūrvavairi bhaumavihārakke bandu kumāranaṁ kaṇḍu
krōdhāgni percci bhairavarūpadhāriyāgi kaḷakaḷadhvaniyindaṁ
garjisi barpponaṁ kaṇḍāgaḷ siṁhanādaṅgeydu khaḻgasannibha
mappa mahāśileyaṁ kiḻtettikoṇḍu pratirākṣasambol
ninda kumāranaṁ nōḍi vyantaradēvaṁ nāgapāśadindaṁ
vēṣṭisidoḍe kumāranadaṁ hastataḷadiṁ paṟiye poydanāgaḷā
dēvaṁ nānāvidha māyā yuddhaṅgaḷiṁ kāde kumāranaṁ
yaṣṭi muṣṭi prahārādigaḷiṁ geldirddonanettikoṇḍu samudrada
baḍavāmukhadoḷikki kolvenamōghamendu neladindurbi
bandākāśakke negapidona skandhamaṁ tividoṁ kumārana
avr̥ṣṭi vajraghātambolappa muṣṭiyiṁ divyapuruṣana
hastaprahāramemba mudrāpīḍeyiṁ trastābhibhūtanāgi
bennittōḍidanāgaḷ tannivāsigaḷappa yakṣa kinnarādigaḷ
mastakadoḷ nyastahastarkkaḷāgi jayajaya śabdaṅgaḷindaṁ
puṣpādigaḷiṁ kumāranaṁ pūjisidar

ā avasaradoḷindraprabhanemba vidyādharaṁ bandu
kumārana caraṇāravindaṅgaḷgeṟagi poḍevaṭṭintendan
svāmi mūvattāṟu varuṣaṁ ninna baravanānennarasana
besadiṁ pāruttirddeṁ nīnenna bhāgyadinillige banday
ēṟu vimānamanene antegeyvenenna bayakeyaṁ
tīrcidabaḻikkēṟuvenendu koḷanaṁ pokku svēccheyiṁ krīḍisi
poṟamaṭṭananā khēcaraṁ koṇḍu pōgi tadvanadoḷati
ramaṇīyamappa pradēśadoḷāḍuttirdda vidyādhara kanneyarkkaḷa
pakkadirisi pōdan itta khēcara kanneyarkaḷa kaṇgaḷemba
mīṅgaḷ kumārana rūpemba gāḷadiṁ tegeyepaṭṭu
tapana tāpana dahana vimōhana maraṇa svarūpada kāma
śaraṅgaḷavarggaḷerdeyanurci pōgi paravaseyarāgi
maṟugidaṟunīra mīṅgaḷvolādaridēṁ cōdyamo
kusumabāṇana bilbalme

ivarggaḷ tanmukha nirīkṣaṇadoḷāsakteyarāgirddarāgaḷā
indraprabhanemba vidyādharaṁ priyasaṅgamamemba poḻalaneydi
bhānuvēganemba vidyādharaṅge pēḻdanādēśapuruṣanaṁ
tandu bhūtaramaṇada jyōtirvitānamemba maṇi
maṇṭapadoḷ kanneyara pakkadirisi bandenene āgaḷātaṅge
taṇivinegaṁ tuṣṭidānaṅgoṭṭu vipuḷaśrīyemba khēcariyaṁ
karedintendaṁ śīghraṁ pōgi kīrtidhavaḷaṅge bhōjanādi
vidhiyaṁ māḍendu pēḻdoḍākeyumantegeyvenendu
saparivāraṁ berasu bandātaṅge majjana bhōjana
prasādhanādigaḷumaṁ māḍi matte kumāranaṁ
divyaśayyātaḷadoḷ sukhadinirisi anaṅgasundariyemba
vidyādhariyanāḍavēḻdu nāṭakamanabhinayisuttaṁ kumārana
munde vinayānviteyāgirdoḷaṁ kumāraṁ nōḍi
intendaṁ nīmenagī dr̥gvidhamappupakāramanēke geydappir
nīmēnārggendu besagoṇḍoḍe

ākeyintendaḷ kēḷ pēḻveṁ svāmi vijayārdha
parvatadoḷ priyasaṅgama purādhipatiyappa
bhānuvēganemba vidyādharaṅge śrīmāle modalāgoḍeya
mahādēviyareṇbaravargge puṭṭidorīyeṇbaruṁ kanneyarkaḷ
lakṣmīmati kanakakānte mandārasēne aḷake alambhūṣe
hēmavati hēmamāḷini vijayārdhavatiyendī
pesargaḷanoḍeyareṇbaruṁ makkaḷanārge kuḍuvamendondu
divasaṁ naimittikanaṁ bhānuvēgaṁ besagoṇḍoḍātanintendaṁ
kṣullakamānasamemba koḷadoḷ sitayakṣanemba dēvanaṁ
saṅgrāmadoḷāvoṁ gelgumātaṅge kūsugaḷaṁ kuḍimendu
pēḻdanadaṟiṁ nīnemma svāmiyendu pēḻdavasaradoḷ
mahāvibhūtiyiṁ barpa khēcarēndranaṁ tōṟidoḍītaṁ
nimma māvanendāgaḷ kumāranumidireḻdu tadyōgyamappa
vinayamaṁ geydirdonaṁ vidyādharēndraṁ kumāranaṁ nōḍi
tribhuvanakkellaṁ tiḷakamāgirddaḷiyanaṁ nāne pettenendāda
mānuṁ santuṣṭacittanāgi kumāranaṁ koṇḍupōgi tanna
poḻalaṁ pokkā devasadoḷeṇbar kanneyarkkaḷaṁ kainīreṟedu
kumāraṅge koṭṭaṁ kumāranuṁ divyāṅganeyarkkaḷoḍane
sukhadindondidan

āgaḷondu vanadēvate bandu sunandeyemba kanneya
duḥkhamaṁ kāṇalāṟade karuṇisi kumārananettikoṇḍu
pōgi harikūṭamemba parvatada jyōtirvanadoḷ
divyaśayyātaḷamaṁ vigurvisiyadaṟa mēge kumārananiṭṭu
pōdoḍātanuṁ prabhātasamayadoḷeḻcattu desegaḷaṁ
nōḻponā vanamumaṁ tannirdda latāmaṇṭapamumaṁ nōḍi
enagidu mahāvismayaṁ rātriyoḷ vivāhakalyāṇamenage
svapnadoḷādudo nirutamo endu sandēhacittanāgi tanna
kaiyoḷ kaṭṭida kaṅkaṇamaṁ nōḍi kaṇḍu kumāranintendu
bagedaṁ

lg.l: vipattau kiṁ viṣādēna sampattau vismayēna kiṁ

div.p:
endintu vastusvarūpamaṁ kumāraṁ bageyuttirpinegaṁ
dūrāntaradoḷ sañchannamāguttirdda vanadoḷirda
kanneyintendu puyyaliṭṭaḷ sākētapurādhipatiyappa
surathanembarasaṅgaṁ candrayaśiyemba mahādēvigaṁ puṭṭiden
sanatkumārana bhāryeyen sunandeyenembenennananyāyadiṁ
vajravēganemba vidyādharaṁ tandaṁ kinnara kimpuruṣa garuḍa
gandharva yakṣa rākṣasādi dēvarkkaḷirā vidyādhararkkaḷirā
śaraṇāgimārappoḍamennaṁ rakṣisimemba kāruṇyasvaramaṁ
kēḷdāścarya manadonāgi deseyaṁ nōḍi salvoṁ
sphaṭikamayamappa śilāgr̥hada keḻagirdda yakṣakanneyaṁ kaṇḍu
nīnārggēnembeyā sanatkumāranembonārggendu kumāraṁ
besagoṇḍoḍākeyintendu pēḻdaḷ
ayōdhyāpuramanāḷvoṁ surathanembonarasanātana
mahādēvi candrayaśiyemboḷāyirvarggaṁ puṭṭideṁ
sunandeyembeṁ sanatkumāraṅge garbhadoḷirddante
nivēdisepaṭṭenennaṁ madanōdyānadoḷuyyalāḍuttirdoḷaṁ
bhaumavihārārthaṁ bandu vajravēganemba vidyādharaṁ
kaṇḍennanettikoṇḍu puyyaliḍeyiḍe bandanindiṅgēḻu
divasamuṇṭu mattā sanatkumāranemboṁ hastināpurama
nāḷvoṁ viśvasēna mahārājanembonarasanātana
mahādēvi sahadēviyemboḷāyirvvarggaṁ puṭṭidaṁ
sanatkumāranembonendu pēḻdoḍe kumāranendanātanaṁ
kaṇḍoḍēnaṟivō endu besagoṇḍoḍe sunandeyintendaḷ
enna tande viśvasēna mahārājanoḷappa mitrasambandhadinondu
divasaṁ hastināpurakke vōgi kumāranaṁ kaṇḍātana rūpaṁ
paṭadoḷ baredu tandā rūpanellā poḻtuṁ nōḻpenuṁ
barevenuṁ bhāvisuttirpenappudaṟindaṟivenā rūpuṁ nimmane
pōlkumeneyantappoḍāṁ sanatkumāranenappenendāgaḷ
harṣarōmāñca kañcukite vikasitavadaneyāgiyaṟapabaḷḷi
kāltoḍardattembantevolāytenna bhāgyadindaṁ svāmi
nīmillige bandirā vajravēgaṁ tanna taṅgeyanenage kāpiṭṭu tanna
poḻalge nidregeyye pōdanākeyuṁ jaḷakrīḍege vōdaḷavaḷ
bāradannegaṁ bēgaṁ pōpamene kumāranintendanañjadir
ninna tandonanamōghaṁ mr̥tyumukhakkuydoḍallade pōgenene
bhayadindaṁ naḍugi intendaḷātanākāśagāmi nīmentu
kolvirene kumāraṁ nakkintendaṁ ākāśagāmiyappa kāgeyanēṁ
kolvudaride endu nuḍiyuttirpannegaṁ vajravēgana baravaṁ
kaṇḍā kanneyañji prāsādadoḷage pōgi pokkirdaḷ

khēcaranuṁ kumāranaṁ kaṇḍu puruḍiṁ muḷisu
percciyenna peṇḍatiyoḍane nuḍiyuttirddonanamōghaṁ
kolvenendu kiḻta bāḷverasu bandeṟagi iṟidātanēṟaṁ
bañcisi siṁhalaṅghanadiṁ mēge negedu vajrasamānamappa
kaiyindaṁ kumāranātana tegaleyaṁ tividoḍātanalli
tanna vidyādharakaraṇamaṁ tōrppambole mēguccaḷisi
biḻdāgaḍe maḍidaṁ kumāranintendu bagedanorvaḷe irda
strīya pakkade satpuruṣaṅgiral takkudallendu munne tannirda
latāmaṇṭapadoḷ pōgirdanannegamitta vajravēgana
taṅge sandhyāvaḷiyemboḷ mānasa sarōvaradoḷ
jalakrīḍeyāḍi barpoḷannegaṁ tammaṇṇaṁ sattudaṁ kaṇḍu
mūrchāgateyāgi biḻdu nīḍaṟindeḻcattu krōdhāgni
perci emmaṇṇanaṁ konda durātmanaṁ pātāḷamaṁ
pokkirdanappoḍamaṟasi kolvenamōghamendu bhayaṅkara
rūpaṁ kaikoṇḍu desegaḷaṁ nōḻpoḷannegamārumaṁ
kāṇade sunandeyaṁ besagoṇḍoḍākeyintendaḷ
duṣṭanigraha śiṣṭapratipālana svarūpadiṁ pr̥thviyaṁ rakṣisuva
svāmi cōra jāra pādarigarkkaḷaṁ kolladirkkume
endoḍātanāvonellidoṁ tōṟendu besagoṇḍoḍe
sunandeyuṁ pōgi kumāranaṁ tōṟidoḍe

ākeyumasikhēṭakahasteyāgi vibhīṣaṇamappa
rūpumaṁ vigurvisi kolvenendu sārdāgaḷ kumāraṁ
sauṣṭhavadoḷirddonaṁ nōḍi krōdhaṅgeṭṭu snēhaṁ perci
kāmaśaraṅgaḷiṁ smaravaśahr̥dayeyāgi intendu tannoḷ
bagedoḷemmaṇṇaṁ tanna dōṣadiṁ sattonītaṅgēnuṁ
dōṣamillendu vikāramappa rūpamanupasaṁharisi tanna
munnina svābhāvikamappa rūpaṁ kaikoṇḍu tammaṇṇanaṁ saṁskarisi
nīriḻidu tadvirahānaḷaniṁ bendu karagi koragi basamaḻidirdda
meyyanoḍeyoḷ bandu sunandegintendaḷ ninna prasādadiṁ
bāḻveṁ nīnenage sōdaramuṁ kalyāṇamitreyumāday
adaṟiṁ nīnī kumāraṅge pōgi intendu pēḻu vijayārdha
parvatadoḷagramandirapurādhipatiyappaśanivēganemba
vidyādharaṅgaṁ vidyutprabheyemba mahādēvigaṁ magaḷ
sandhyāvaḷiyemboḷ nīme śaraṇendirddoḷākeyaṁ
nīmamōghaṁ kaikoḷalvēḻkumendintu nuḍiyendu
kalpisiyaṭṭidoḍākeyuṁ kumāraṅge tadvr̥ttāntamellamaṁ
pēḻdoḍātanuṁ pitr̥mātr̥gaḷīyada strīyaraṁ
kaikoḷvudenagayōgyamendu maṟumātugoṭṭoḍe
sunandeyemboḷ mitrasambandhigaḷappa janaṅgaḷ muntiṭṭu
kuḍe koḷal takkudendu nuḍidoḍambaḍisi divyadēvategaḷane
bāndhavajanamāgoḍeyaḷaṁ mahāvibhūtiyindaṁ
pāṇigrahaṇa purassaraṁ sandhyāvaḷiyaṁ kumāraṅge koṭṭaḷ
sandhyāvaḷiyuṁ sunandeyaṁ kumāraṅge koṭṭaḷintanyōnya
sambandhadiṁ gāndharvavivāhadiṁ kalyāṇadoḷkūḍi
sukhadindirpor

annegamittaśanivēgaṁ tanna magaṁ piridu poḻtu pōgi
taḍedanendu maganavastheyanaṟidu bāyendavaḷōkiniyemba
vidyeyanārayyalaṭṭidoḍā vidyeyuṁ pārāvata
rūpadindāraidu pōpudaṁ sandhyāvaḷiyaṟidintendu tanna
bhartāraṅge pēḻguṁ svāmi enna tande vidyādharanādamānuṁ
pracaṇḍa mahābaḷa parākramaṁ vajravēgana
sāvanaṟidamōghaṁ nimma mēle barkumadaṟiṁ nīmī
prajñaptiyemba mahāvidyeyaṁ koḷḷimene kumāraṁ nakku
prahasitavadananāgi khēcararemberalegaḷaṁ nipātisalkenage
vidyeyuṁ bēḻkume endolladirdona pādadvayaṅgaḷgeṟagi
poḍevaṭṭamōghaṁ koḷalevēḻkumendu balātkāradiṁ
vidyeyaṁ koṭṭoḍā avasaradoḷ

mattitta rathanūpura cakravāḷapurādhipatiyappa candrayaśanemba
vidyādharaṅgaṁ vidyudvēgeyemba mahādēvigamantirvargaṁ
puṭṭidar candravēganuṁ bhānuvēganumembar makkaḷāgi
intiṣṭa viṣaya kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttire mattondu
divasaṁ nr̥patige saṁsāravairāgyamāgi candravēganemba
piriya magaṅge rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi kiṟiyātanappa bhānuvēgaṅge
yuvarājapaṭṭamaṁ kaṭṭi guṇadhararemba cāraṇarisiyara
pakkade jainadīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍu palakālaṁ tapaṅgeydu
sammēda parvatadoḷ mōkṣakke vōdar mattā
candravēgaṅge nūrvar peṇgūsugaḷādoravarggaḷatiśaya
rūpulāvaṇyamanoḍeyoravaranā aśanivēgaṁ tanna magaṁ
vajravēgaṅganavarataṁ pāguḍamuṁ perggaḍegaḷumanaṭṭuttirkkuṁ
mattaṁ peṟaruṁ vidyādhararkkaḷanavarataṁ kūsugaḷaṁ
bēḍiyaṭṭuttire ārgaṁ kuḍalollade mattondu divasaṁ
makkaḷanārge kuḍuvamendu daivajñanaṁ besagoṇḍoḍāta
nintendu pēḻdaṁ mānasasarōvaradoḷ sitayakṣanaṁ
yuddhadoḷāvoṁ gelvoṁ mattaśanivēgana magaṁ
vajravēganumaṁ muṣṭiprahāradiṁ kolvonā aśanivēga
numaṁ saṅgrāmadoḷ nipātisuvanāvanorvvanātaṅge
nimma magaḷaṁ kuḍimendu dēvaguruvemba naimittikaṁ pēḻdaṁ
matteyātanupadēśadiṁ taṟisanda manadonāgi sarvāyudha
sannaddharāgi divyarathamberasu hariścandra candrasēnarkkaḷemba
makkaḷanaṭṭidoḍavarggaḷuṁ bandu kumāraṅgeṟagi
poḍevaṭṭintendar rathanūpura cakravāḷapurēśvaranappa
candravēgaṅgaṁ maṇidēvigaṁ puṭṭidevu hariścandra
candrasēnarkkaḷememmammana besadiṁ nimmanōlagisal
bandemendu pēḻdu sukha saṅkathāvinōdadindirppannegamavara
baḻiyane sahōdararkkaḷappa candravēganuṁ bhānuvēganuṁ
tammuḷḷa samastabalamberasu kumāranaṁ kūḍidar

mattittaśanivēgaṁ tanna magana kaḻida
vr̥ttāntamellamanavaḷōkiniyemba vidye pēḻe kēḷdaṟidu
muḷidu garjisi masagi samasta balamberasindrana maṟevokkaḍa
mamōghaṁ kolvenendu mēleḻtandanaṁ candravēgaṁ
kaṇḍu sanatkumāraṅgintendaṁ dēvā nānāvidhamappa
vidyādharayuddhamaṁ nīṁ kemmane nōḍuttirāne sālvenendu
saṅgrāmakkabhimukhanāgi kādal taguḷdanitta kumāranuṁ
gaganataḷadoḷ vajrasāramemba rathamanēṟi chatracāmara
piñchātapatra pāḷidhvaja patākādyanēka mahāvibhūtiyoḷ
kūḍi saṅgrāmamaṁ nōḍuttamire mattaśanivēgaṁ kumāranaṁ
kaṇḍu krōdhāgni perci enna maganaṁ kondonaṁ bēgaṁ
mr̥tyurājanaṁ kāṇbantire māḻpenendu muḷidu masagi
barpponaṁ kumāraṁ kaṇḍāgaḍe bāṇāsana hastanāgi
ardhacandramemba saradindātana taleyaṁ mokkanevōgeccaṁ
adu jvalanmaṇimakuṭakuṇḍalaṅgaḷindopputtirdudu
vidyutkapālambol neladoḷ biḻdattāgaḷā taleyaṁ
maṟuvakkadar kaṇḍu kelarañji trastābhibhūtarāgiyōḍi
kelar śaraṇendu kumārana kālgeṟagi pullaṁ karci poḍevaṭṭar
kumāranumāgaḷabhayaghōṣaṇeyaṁ poysiyavarggabhaya
dānamaṁ koṭṭanāgaḷ candravēganuṁ saṅgrāma
bhūmiyanarcisi mahāvibhūtiyiṁ kumārananoḍagoṇḍu
pōgi poḻalaṁ pokku praśasta dina vāra nakṣatra hōrā
muhūrta lagnadoḷ tanna makkaḷ candramati candraśrī
candralēkhe śaśikānte manōhāriṇi hariṇāṅke
kamalamukhi priyadarśaneyendivar modalāgoḍeya
nūrvar kanneyarkkaḷaṁ pāṇigrahaṇa purassaraṁ koṭṭanantā
nūrvar kanneyarkkaḷuṁ munnina khēcariyarkkaḷuṁ
peṟavumendivaroḷ kūḍi kumāraṁ vidyādhara śrēṇiyoḷ
sukhamananubhavisuttirpannegaṁ

mattondu divasaṁ candravēgaṁ siddhakūṭakke vandanābhaktige
vōgi dēvaranarcisi vandisi sumāḷigaḷembavadhijñānigaḷappa
cāraṇa risiyaraṁ gurubhaktigeydu vandisi dharmamaṁ kēḷdu
tadanantaramintendaṁ bhaṭārā sanatkumāraṅgaṁ sitayakṣaṅgaṁ
vairasambandhakke kāraṇamēnendu besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭāraruṁ
tatsambandhiyappa katheyanintendu pēḻal toḍagidar

ī jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷ magadheyembudu
nāḍalli kāñcanamembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
pratimukhanembarasanaṣṭaśatamantaḥpurakkadhipanāgi kālaṁ sale
mattā poḻaloḷ nāgacandranemboṁ sārthādhipatiyātana
bhārye viṣṇuśrīyemboḷatyanta rūpa lāvaṇya saubhāgya
kānti hāvabhāva viḷāsa vibhramaṅgaḷiṁ kūḍidoḷondu
divasaṁ arasanudyānavanakke pōguttaṁ prāsādadoḷirda
dēvāṅganāsannibheyappaḷaṁ kaṇḍu kāmaśaraṅgaḷiṁ
jarjharita hr̥dayanāgi maṁtra prayōgadindaṁ viṣṇu
śrīyanoḷakoṇḍanākeyumātaṅgagravallabheyāgi
salvoḷaṁ samastamantaḥpuramākege muḷiyuttirkumondu
divasaṁ sārvabhaumanemba paṭṭavardhana gajaṁ sorki masagi
kaṭṭugaḷellamaṁ paṟidu hatatavitata kōḷāhaḷameḻedu
poḻalellamaṁ kolvudanarasaṁ kēḷdāneyaṁ kaṭṭisalendu
pōdan

annegamitta anibararasiyarkaḷ neredu
viṣaprayōgadindaṁ kondārumaṟiyadantire
śmaśānadoḷīḍāḍidorannegamarasanumāneyumaṁ
kaṭṭisi bandarasiyaṁ kāṇadellirdaḷendu besagoṇḍoḍe
sattaḷembā mātaṁ kēḷdu mūrchitanāgi nīḍaṟindeḻcartu
mahāduḥkhaṅgeydu śmaśānakkākeya dēhamaṁ
nōḍalendu pōgiyadaṟa bhībhatsamaṁ kaṇḍādamānuṁ
pēsi śarīravairāgyamanoḍeyanāgi anyāyadiṁ
parastrīharaṇaṅgeydeṁ mahāpātakanenendu tannaṁ
tānādamānuṁ nindisi vimaḷavāhananemba piriya magaṅge
rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi suvratarembācāryara pakkade dīkṣeyaṁ
kaikoṇḍu palakālaṁ tapaṅgeydu samādhi maraṇadiṁ muḍipi
prāṇata kalpadoḷirppattu sāgarōpamāyuṣyasthitiya
noḍeyoṁ pratīndranāgi puṭṭi dēvalōkada divyasukhamaṁ
palakālamanubhavisi bandilli jambūdvīpada bharata kṣētradoḷ
magadheyembudu nāḍalli kanakamembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
harivāhananembarasaṁ mattamā poḻaloḷ rājaśrēṣṭhi
arhaddāsanembonātana bhārye jinadatteyemboḷā
irvvargaṁ magaṁ jinavarmanembonāgi puṭṭi rūpalāvaṇya
saubhāgya kāntitvadindādamānuṁ neṟedonāgi intu kālaṁ
sale arhaddāsaṅgēnānumondu kāraṇadindaṁ vairāgyamāgi
jinavarmaṅge rājaśrēṣṭhi padamaṁ koṭṭu śivaguptācāryara
pakkade dīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍu tapaṅgeydu mōkṣakke vōdan
mattitta jinavarmanuṁ palavuṁ jinālayaṅgaḷaṁ māḍisi
dāna pūje śilōpavāsamendintu caturvidhamappa
śrāvakadharmadoḷaggaḷanāgi negaḻuttamintu palakālaṁ sale

mattā munnina bhavada nāgacandranemboṁ sārthādhipati
viṣṇuśrīyemba tanna bhāryeya viyōgaṁ kāraṇamāgi
ārtadhyānadiṁ sattu tiryaṅnarakādigaḷoḷ palakālaṁ
toḻaldī bharatakṣētradoḷ kapilanemba pārvvaṅgaṁ
gaṅgeyemba pārvvantigaṁ bhāradvājanemba maganāgi puṭṭi
kanakadaṇḍiyemba parivrājakaṅge śiṣyanāgi nānā dēśaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ kanakapurakke vandu māsōpavāsaṁ
geyyuttaṁ mahātapasviyāgi negaḻuttire tatpurādhipaṁ
harivāhananembarasaṁ kaṇḍādamānumā tapasvige bhaktanāgi
besakeyye kālaṁ sale mattondu divasamarasanoḍane
jinavarmanā parivrājakana nivāsakke vōdoḍe jinavarmanaṁ
kaṇḍu pūrva vairasambandhadindāda krōdhāgni perci
maṟuguttirdda manamanoḍeya tapasviyanarasanintendaṁ
nīmemma maneyoḷ pārisalvēḻpudendu
prārthisidoḍātanintendaṁ ondu pāṅginoḷ nimma
maneyoḷ pārisuvenī jinavarmana bennoḷaḍiyillada
taḷigeyaniṭṭu bisiya tuyyalanuṇbudenagaḻtiyī
pāṅginoḷennanūḍalārpoḍuṇbenalladāgaḷuṇṇenendu
pēḻdoḍe kēḷdacciganādarasanaṁ jinavarmaṁ kaṇḍintendaṁ
dēvā tapasvigāva pāṅginoḷ meccu meccida
pāṅginoḷuṇgendoḍambaṭṭan

āgaḷā garbhasukhiya bennoḷ piriya pariyāṇamaniṭṭadaṁ
tekkane tīvi baḍḍisidoḍe kudiyuttirdda tuyyalaṁ
taṇṇittāgiyāṟuvannegaṁ pāruttirddu nīḍumbēgamuṇḍu
sameda baḻikke taḷigeyanettidoḍā taḷigeyoḍane benna
tovalellamerdupōdudanarasaṁ kaṇḍītaṁ tapasviyallaṁ
rākṣasaṁ pañcamahāpātakananī poḻaloḷiralīyadaṭṭi
kaḷeyimendu nr̥pati muḷidoḍe jinavarmaṁ tapasvige
muḷiyalvēḍendu bārisi ītaṅgēnuṁ dōṣamillenna
pūrvakr̥ta karmaphaḷavipākamendu nr̥patige pēḻdu
parivrājakaṅge niśśalyaṅgeydarasanumaṁ svajana parijana
bandhuvargamumaṁ biḍisi śrīvarmarembācāryara
pakkade dīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍu mahiṣagiriyemba parvatadoḷī
puṇ tīrvannegaṁ kaiyanettikoḷḷenendu kāyōtsargadiṁ
nindonaṁ gr̥dhravāyasādigaḷ puṇṇaṁ tōḍi tine
mēruparvatambolacaḷitadhairyanāgondu tiṅgaḷvaregaṁ
sairisi samādhimaraṇadiṁ muḍipiyacyutakalpadoḷirppatteraḍu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyasthitiyanoḍeyonacyutēndranāgi
puṭṭiyalliya dēvalōkada divyasukhamaṁ palakālamanubhavisi
bandilli sanatkumāranādanā parivrājakanumāyacyutēndraṅge
vāhanadēvanādonalliṁ baḻcibandilli caturgati saṁsāradoḷ
nīḍuṁ toḻaldañjanagiriyemba parvatada taṭadoḷ
tāpasāśramadoḷ vasiṣṭhanemba tāpasaṅgaṁ ghūkeyemba
tāpasigaṁ bakanemboṁ maganāgi puṭṭi tāpasa tapamaṁ
kaikoṇḍu negaḻdu maḍidu sitayakṣanādanendintirvvara
pūrvabhavavairasambandhiyappa katheyaṁ savistaramāgi
sumāḷigaḷembavadhijñānigaḷappa cāraṇarisiyar pēḻe enna
svāmiyappa khacarēndraṁ kēḷdādamānuṁ santuṣṭacittanāgi
bhaṭāraraṁ bandisi tanna poḻalgevōdan

endintu kathāsambandhamellamaṁ kamaḷamatiyemba
khēcaraviḷāsini sanatkumāraṁ pēḻavēḻdoḍe
mahēndrasiṁhaṅge pēḻdoḷā avasaradoḷ
kumāraṁ nidrāsukhavimuktanādoḍātana
samīpakke mahēndrasiṁhaṁ pōgi intendaṁ ninna
viyōgadoḷappa duḥkhadindaṁ viśvasēna mahārājanuṁ
sahadēvi mahādēvi modalāgoḍeyavarggaḷellaṁ
prāṇasandēhamāgirkkumadaṟiṁ nimma poḻalge
pōgalvēḻkumendu pēḻdoḍātanumantegeyvenendu tamma
māvaṅgaḷaṁ biḍisi vicitramappa ratha gaja turaga garuḍa
kaḷahaṁsa mayūra makara siṁha vimānādhirūḍharkkaḷappa
vidyādhararkkaḷumaṣṭasahasra saṅkhyā pramāṇamapparasiyarkkaḷuṁ
berasu mahāvibhūtiyindaṁ bandu hastināpuramaṁ
pokkanibaruṁ viśvasēna mahārājaṅgaṁ sahadēvi
mahādēvigaṁ sāṣṭāṅgameṟagi poḍevaṭṭu avarāśīrvacana
śatasahasraṅgaḷanāntukoṇḍu sukhadindire sanatkumāraṅge
cakraṁ puṭṭi sakaḷa cakravartiyāgi bhōgōpabhōgaṅgaḷemba
mahāsamudradoḷ palakālaṁ krīḍisuttirppannegaṁ

mattondu divasaṁ saudharma kalpadoḷā saudharmēndraṁ
tanna dēvasabheya naḍuve siṁhāsana mastakasthitaṁ dēvarkkaḷiṁ
parivēṣṭitanāgi saudāminiyemba nāṭakamaṁ
nōḍuttirppannegaṁ īśānakalpadindaṁ sahōtpanna
saṅgamadēvaṁ bandu saudharmēndrana sabheyanavayavadiṁ
pokkirddāgaḷā sabheyoḷirdda dēvarkaḷa rūpuṁ tējamuṁ
lāvaṇyamumellamaṁ māsisi tanna tējameyaggaḷamāgi
rddoḍentu candranudayaṅgeydāgaḷ grahanakṣatratāregaḷa tējaṁ
kundugumantellara tējamumaṁ kundisi tāneyaggaḷamāge
beḷaguttirdonaṁ dēvarkkaḷellaṁ vismayambaṭṭu nōḍi
saudharmēndrananintendu besagoṇḍar svāmi ī
saṅgamanemba dēvanatiśayamappa rūpuṁ lāvaṇyamuṁ
tējamuṁ dvādaśādityarkkaḷormodale udayaṅgeydante
beḷagidappudēkāraṇadindādudendu besagoṇḍoḍe

intendu saudharmēndraṁ pēḻal toḍagidan ītaṁ munnina
bhavadoḷ ī jambūdvīpada pūrvavidēhadoḷ sīteyemba
toṟeya baḍagaṇa deseyoḷ puṣkaḷāvatiyembudu
nāḍalli puṇḍarīkiṇiyembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ sakaḷa
cakravarti vimaḷavāhananembarasanātana mahādēvi
vimaḷamatiyemboḷā irvvarggaṁ puṭṭidoṁ magaṁ
kṣīrakumāranembonātaṁ vairāgyamanoḍeyanāgi
tapambaḍalkendu bagedirddoḍe tāy
tapambaḍalīyadenitānuṁ teṟadiṁ nuḍidu taguḷdoḍe
tāya vacanamanatikramisalāṟade maneyoḷirddante
brahmacaryaṁ modalāgoḍeya brataṅgaḷaṁ pratipāḷisi
ācāmlavardhanamemba nōmpiyaṁ panneraḍu varṣambaraṁ
nōntu samādhimaraṇadindaṁ muḍipe intappa rūpuṁ
tējamuṁ lāvaṇyamumadaṟindītaṅgādudendu
saudharmēndraṁ pēḻdoḍe mattaṁ dēvarkkaḷintendu
besagoṇḍar svāmi ītanantappa rūpuṁ tējamuṁ
lāvaṇyamumanoḍeyar peṟarārānumoḷare endu
besagoṇḍoḍe saudharmēndranendanoḷan hastināpuradoḷ
kuruvaṁśadātaṁ sanatkumāranemboṁ cakravartiyātaṁ
dēvarkaḷa rūpuṁ lāvaṇyamuṁ tējamumanoḍeya
nādamānumaggaḷamendu pēḻdoḍe

indrana mātaṁ nambade vijaya vaijayantarembarirvar
dēvarkkaḷ pārvara rūpaṁ kaikoṇḍu hastināpurakke
sanatkumāra cakravartiya rūpaṁ nōḍalendu bandu
bāgiloḷirdda paḍiyaṟaranendar nimmarasaṅgintendu
pēḻiṁ geṇṭaṟiṁ bandevu nimma rūpanaḻtivaṭṭu
nōḍalkendoḍavaruṁ pōgi tammarasaṅgaṟipidoḍe
arasananumatadindavararamaneyaṁ pokkarasana sārevōgi
nōḻpāgaḷarasaṁ sugandha tailadiṁ meyyanabhyaṅganaṅgeydu
majjanambugalendirddavasaradoḷ dēvarkkaḷ sanatkumāra
cakravartiya rūpaṁ vāḷāgradiṁ toṭṭu nakhāgrambaregaṁ
nakhāgradiṁ toṭṭu vāḷāgrambaregaṁ ēṟeyumiḻiyeyuṁ
nīḍuṁ bhāvisi nōḍi cōdyambaṭṭintu rūpuṁ tējamuṁ
gāḍiyuṁ yauvanamuṁ dēvarkkaḷgamillendu cakravartiya
rūpaṁ pogaḻdoḍarasanintendaṁ nīmārgēnembirelliṁ
bandirendu besagoṇḍoḍavarendar dēvalōkadiṁ
bandevu dēvarkaḷevu saudharma kalpadoḷ dēvarkaḷa
sabheya naḍuve saudharmēndraṁ nimma rūpanādamānuṁ
nacci baṇṇisidoḍindrana mātaṁ nambade nimmaṁ nōḍal
bandemindrana vyāvarṇisuvudarkkaggaḷame nimma rūpuṁ
yavvanamuṁ lāvaṇyamumaṁ kaṇḍemendu pēḻdāminnemma
dēvalōkakke pōpemendoḍarasaṁ manaṁ perci tannoḷ tanna
rūpaṁ nacci kiṟidubēgaṁ māṇimabhyaṅganaṁ geyda rūpaṁ
kaṇḍiriṁ majjanambokku pasadanaṅgoṇḍirdda rūpaṁ nōḍi
pōgimendarasaṁ nuḍidoḍe

antegeyvemendu dēvarkkaḷirddoḍarasanuṁ majjanambokku
bēgaṁ sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitanāgi āsthāna maṇṭapadoḷ
siṁhāsana mastakasthitanāgi sāmanta mahāsāmantar
mūvattirchāsirvar makuṭa baddharkaḷuṁ vidyādhararkaḷuṁ
yakṣadēvarkaḷuṁ baḷasiyumirdōlagise mūvatteraḍuṁ
cāmaraṅgaḷikke saudharmēndranirppantirdu dēvarkaḷge
baḻiyaṭṭi barisi nōḍiminnenna rūpanendu tannaṁ tōṟidoḍe
dēvarkaḷ nōḍi vismayambaṭṭidēṁ cōdyamo
endu

ī kṣaṇamātradoḷe manuṣyara rūpuṁ gāḍiyuṁ celvuṁ
tējamuṁ yauvanamuṁ kundittene cakravartiyendanenna rūpaṁ
munne nīme pogaḻdarīgaḷēke paḻidappirene dēvarendar
kēḷarasā dēvarkaḷa tējamuṁ lāvaṇyamuṁ puṭṭida
prathama samayadiṁ toṭṭu percuttuṁ pōkumāyuṣyada
naḍuvaregamallindatta kunduttuṁ pōkumāyuṣyāntambaregaṁ
mattāmuṁ nimma rūpaṁ yauvana bharadoḷirddudumaṁ
kaṇḍemīgaḷāyuṣyamuṁ tējamuṁ rūpuṁ
lāvaṇyamuṁ yauvanamuṁ kiṟidu kundidudaṁ
kaṇḍemene cakravarti nīmentaṟidirendu besagoṇḍoḍe
dēvarkkaḷendaremagavadhijñānamuṇṭappudaṟindaṟidevu
manuṣyarggaṟiyalāgadendondu dōṇikoṇḍamaṁ
tarisi nīraṁ tekkane tīviyadaṟoḷage camariyanarddi tegedu
baḷasiyuṁ bīsidāgaḷ sabheyoḷirda mānasaramēgellaṁ
nīr panitudaṁ tōṟi dēvarendar pēḻimī camariyoḷ
taguḷdu biyamādanitu nīraṁ koṇḍadoḷ kundidudaṁ
tōṟimendoḍavarumaṟiyadirddoḍentidaṁ
nīmaṟiyalāgadante mānasarāyuṣyamuṁ tējamuṁ
lāvaṇyamuṁ yauvanamuṁ pratisamayaṁ kundutirkumā
vīcimaraṇamaṁ nimagaṟiyalāgadendu pēḻdu

hētu dr̥ṣṭāntaṅgaḷindaṁ pratyakṣamaṁ tōṟi cakravartiyaṁ
nambe nuḍidu dēvarkkaḷ tamma saudharma kalpakke vōdar
mattitta sanatkumāra cakravartigaduve nirvēgakke kāraṇamāgi
śarīrabhōgakke pēsi intendu manadoḷ bageguṁ
endu

intu vairāgyamaṁ bhāvisi vijayakumāranemba piriya
magaṅge rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi parivārakkellaṁ niśśalyanāgi
bāhyābhyantara parigrahaṅgaḷellamaṁ toṟedu palambar
makuṭabaddharkaḷarapparasumakkaḷverasu vinayandhara
bhaṭārara pakkade tapambaṭṭu dīkṣōpavāsatrirātraṁ
geydu śarīrasandhāraṇa nimittaṁ carigevokko
ḍorvaḷ baḍabirdi niṟisi prathama divasadoḷe
pārakina kūḻumavareyumeṇṇeyumāḍinaḷeyumaṁ
baḍḍisidoḍadanamr̥tamanuṇbantuṇḍu mattaṁ trirātrakke
paccakhkhāṇaṅgoṇḍarā kāladiṁ toṭṭāhāradoḷappa
dōṣadindaṁ kacchu jara khāsa sōsō bhattacchadi acchikucchi
dukkhāṇi endivu modalāgoḍeyavēḻunūṟu byādhigaḷaṁ
nūṟu varuṣambaraṁ oḷḷittāgi sairisi ugrōgra tapadiṁ
dīptatapaṁ mahātapaṁ ghōratapamendivu modalāgoḍeya
tapaṅgaḷaṁ geyye tapada mahātmyadindaṁ āmōṣadhi
khēḷōṣadhi javōṣadhi vippōṣadhi sarvōṣadhiyendivu
modalāgoḍeya r̥ddhigaḷ puṭṭidoḍaṁ vyādhige takka
pratīkāramaṁ māḍadintu ghōravīra tapaścaraṇaṁ geyye

mattondu divasaṁ saudharmēndraṁ tanna sabheyoḷ
siṁhāsana mastakasthitanāgi dharmaśravaṇānantaraṁ
risiyarkaḷa guṇaṅgaḷaṁ vyāvarṇisuttirdu sanatkumāra
risiya guṇagaṇamanādamānuṁ kaikoṇḍintendu
pēḻal taguḷdon vāta pitta ślēṣma śvāsa khāsa
jarāruci chardyati sārākṣi kukṣivēdanāsphōṭakaṁ
piṭakaṁ śūla bhagandaraṁ kuṣṭha kṣaya gaṇḍa śirōvēdane
modalāgoḍeyavēḻunūṟu vyādhigaḷormodale
meyyoḷ puṭṭidoḍantu tāmuṁ r̥ddhisampannarāgiyuṁ
vyādhige takka pratīkāraṅgeyyade nūṟu varuṣambaregaṁ oḷḷittāgi
sairisi tapaṅgeydapparendu saudharmēndraṁ pogaḻdoḍe
kēḷdu munne banda dēvarkaḷirvaruṁ vaidyara rūpinoḷ
mardugaḷaṁ pasumbeyoḷ tekkane tīvi parīkṣisalkendu
sārevandu vandisi intendar bhaṭārā nimma meyya
kuttaṅgaḷellamaṁ mardaṁ māḍi kiḍisal neṟevevu mardaṁ
māḍuvudanoḍambaḍavēḻkumendoḍe bhaṭṭāraruṁ
mōnaṅgoṇḍu nuḍiyade kemmagirdoḍe piriduṁ
bēgamirdeḻdu pōgi maṟudivasaṁ maguḻdu bandintendar
bhaṭārā vaidyaśāstradoḷādamānuṁ kuśalaremuṁ
granthārtha svarūpadindellā kuśalaremuṁ karmajñaremuṁ
mardugaḷumabhinavaṅgaḷādamoḷḷidavirduvuṁ nimma meyya
kuttaṅgaḷellamanēḻu divasadindoḷage kiḍisi nīrōgamappantire
māḍuvevu baḻikkēnuṁ saṅklēśamillade tapaṅgeyyimendoḍe
bhaṭāraravaroḍane nuḍivāgaḷuguḻa sīkaraṅgaḷ tamma
muṅgeyya mēge biḻdoḍe beraliṁ sīṇṭi tōṟidāyeḍe
suvarṇāyamānamāgi toḷaguttirda meyya tējamumaṁ
dēvarkkaḷ vismayambaṭṭu nōḍuttire bhaṭārarintendaremage
mardu bāḻteyappoḍemagāme mardaṁ ballememagadu
bāḻteyaltu nīmuṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṅgaḷembemma kuttamaṁ
kiḍisalārpoḍā mardanoḍambaḍuvemuḻidāva
mardumanoḍambaḍuvemallemendoḍe dēvarkaḷumintendar
jātijarāmaraṇaṅgaḷemba kuttamaṁ kiḍisalkāmāṟemā
kuttamaṁ kiḍisalke bhaṭārā nīme samartharir
paramavaidyariradarkkendu mattaṁ dēvarkaḷendar bhaṭārā
saudharmēndraṁ nimma tapadoḷappa guṇaṅgaḷumaṁ
vyādhigaḷaṁ sairisi negaḻva negaḻteyumaṁ dēvarkaḷa sabheya
naḍuveyādamānuṁ kaikoṇḍu pogaḻdoḍāmindrana mātaṁ
nambade nimmaṁ parīkṣisalkendu bandevu saudharmēndrana
pogaḻdudēnuṁ tappillendu nuḍidu guṇaṅgoṇḍu maguḻdu
vandisi mardugaḷellamanondu paḻavāviyoḷ poydu
dēvarkaḷ tamma dēvalōkakke vōdorā mardina bāviya
nīraṁ mindorggellaṁ kuttaṅgaḷ kiḍuvuvādavu

sanatkumāra bhaṭārarumēḻunūṟuṁ vyādhigaḷaṁ
nūṟuvaruṣambaregaṁ sairisi ghōravīratapaścaraṇaṅgeydu
ālada marada keḻage saṁnyasanaṅgeydu samādhimaraṇadiṁ
muḍipi mikka ratnatrayaṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi sanatkumārakalpadoḷ
ēḻu sāgarōpamāyuṣyasthitiyanoḍeyonindranāgi
puṭṭidoṁ

mattārādhakarappa bhavyarkaḷellaṁ sanatkumāra bhaṭāraraṁ
manadoḷ bagedu vyādhigaḷoḷappa vēdanegaḷumaṁ pasivuṁ
nīraḻke modalāgoḍeya bādheyumaṁ sairisi dēvaraṁ
dhyānisuttaṁ pañcanamaskāramaṁ manadoḷuccarisuttaṁ
mikka darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi svargāpavarga
sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: aṇṇikāputrana kathe
div.p: aṇṇikāputrana katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ
div.ab:
ṇāvāe – nāve, ṇibbuḍāē – muḻugidudādoḍe,
gaṅgāmajjhē – gaṅgāmahānadiya naḍuve,
amūḍhamāṇamadī – mōhisada buddhiyanoḍeyanāgi,
ārādhaṇaṁ – nijātmārādhaneyaṁ, pavaṇṇō – lēsāgi
porddidoṁ, kālagado – kālaṅgeydonāgi, ēṇiyā putto
– aṇṇikeya magaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷ magadheyembudu
nāḍalli uttaramadhureyembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
prajāpāḷanembonarasanātana mahādēvi
suprabheyemboḷantavarggaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttire mattā poḻaloḷ
sārthādhipati dhanadattanemboṁ paradaṁ dhanakanaka
samr̥ddhanātana bhārye dhanaśrīyemboḷāyirvargaṁ magaṁ
dhanadēvanembonantavargaḷge sukhadiṁ kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ dhanadēvaṁ paradiṅgendu piriduṁ
sāramappa bhaṇḍamaṁ tīvikoṇḍu piriduṁ sārthamberasu
dakṣiṇa madhurege vōdoḍā poḻala rājaśrēṣṭhi
tiḷakaśrēṣṭhiyembonātana bhārye nandeyemboḷāyirvargaṁ
makkaḷ padmāvati sumati guṇamatiyendivar
modalāgoḍeya eṇbar peṇgūsugaḷādoḍavaroḷagellariṁ
kiṟiyaḷaṇṇikeyemboḷākeyaṁ dhanadattana maganappa dhanadēvanaṁ
rūpa lāvaṇya saubhāgya kānti guṇaṅgaḷiṁ kūḍidonaṁ tiḷaka
śrēṣṭhiyuṁ nandeyuṁ kaṇḍātaṅge bayasi aṇṇikeyemba kūsaṁ
koṭṭoḍe kelavu divasamā poḻaloḷirddu tamma koṇḍu
pōda bhaṇḍamaṁ māṟi peṟadaṁ tammanāḻkapūrvamappa
bhaṇḍamaṁ tīvikoṇḍu tamma poḻalguttara madhurege
bandirddarannegamaṇṇikege garbhamāgi magaṁ puṭṭidoḍe
dhanadēvana tāyuṁ tandeyuṁ naṇṭarumellaṁ neredaṇṇikeya
maganendātaṅgaṇṇikāputranendu pesaraniṭṭoḍātaṁ
kramakramadiṁ sukhadiṁ baḷedu navayauvananāgirppannegaṁ

itta damasūrigaḷembavaravadhijñānigaḷappa ācāryar piriduṁ
risi samudāyamberasu grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba
paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ barporuttara
madhurege bandu bahirudyānavanadoḷirddaranaṇṇikāputraṁ
pōgi vandisi dharmamaṁ kēḷdu samyaktvapūrvakaṁ
śrāvakavrataṅgaḷellamaṁ kaikoṇḍu tadanantarame bhaṭārā
enagāyuṣyavenitendu tannāyuṣya pramāṇamaṁ
besagoṇḍoḍe

bhaṭāraruṁ kiṟide ninagāyuṣyamendu pēḻdoḍe
vairāgyaparāyaṇanāgi tāyuṁ tandeyumaṁ naṇṭarumaṁ
biḍisi niśśalyaṅgeydu damasūrigaḷembācāryara pakkade
tapambaṭṭu dvādaśāṅga caturdaśa pūrvamappāgamamellamaṁ
kaltu gurugaḷanoḍambaḍisi ēkavihāriyāgi grāmēkarātraṁ
nagarē pañcarātraṁ aṭavyāṁ daśarātramembī
nyāyadiṁ grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa
drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ tīrthaṅgaḷellamaṁ
vandisalkendu gaṅgāmahānadiyaṁ pāydu pōpa
bageyindaṁ nāveyanēṟidoḍadondutpāta vāta
dindaṁ gaṅgāmahānadiya naḍuve maḍuvinoḷ
bhayaṅkaramāguttirdda tereyanoḍeyadaṟoḷ
muḻugidoḍā aṇṇikāputranemba risi piridappa mahātmyamaṁ
mōhisada buddhiyanoḍeyoṁ caturvidhamappāhārakkaṁ
śarīrakkaṁ yāvajjīvaṁ nivr̥ttigeydu kāyōtsargaṁ nindu
dharmadhyāna śukladhyānaṅgaḷaṁ jānisi sakaḷakarmaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisi
antargata kēvaliyāgi mōkṣakke vōdar

mattaṁ peṟarārādhakarappavargaḷellamaṇṇikāputranemba risiyaṁ
manadoḷiṭṭu acētanōpasargaṁ modalāgoḍeya
upasargaṅgaḷumaṁ nīraḻke modalāgoḍeya
parīṣahaṅgaḷumaṁ sairisi darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi
svargāpavargada sukhaṅgaḷaṁ bhavyarkaḷeyduge

div.head: bhadrabāhu bhaṭārara kathe
div.p: bhadrabāhu bhaṭārara katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ
div.ab:
ōmōdariē – are uṇisinindaṁ, ghōrāe – ādamānuṁ
kaḍidappudaṟindaṁ, bhaddabāhū – bhadrabāhu bhaṭṭārar ,
asaṅkiliṭṭhamadī – saṅklēśa pariṇāmamilladonāgi,
ghōrāe – kaḍidappa, tigiñcchāē – pasivinindaṁ, paḍivaṇṇō
– pordidoṁ, uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ – mikka darśana jñāna
cāritrārādhaneyaṁ
div.p:
ī jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷ puravardhanamembudu
nāḍalli kauṇḍinīnagaramembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
padmarathanembonarasanātana mahādēvi padmaśrīyembo
ḷantavargaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttire
mattā arasana purōhitaṁ nālku vēdamumāṟaṅgamuṁ
padineṇṭu dharmaśāstraṅgaḷumaṁ balloṁ sōmaśarmanemboṁ
pārvanātana bhārye pratyakṣa śrīyādēvateyane pōlva
sōmaśrīyemboḷāyirvarggaṁ magaṁ puṭṭidoṁ tāygaṁ
tandegamellā naṇṭargeyutsāhamuṁ sukhamuṁ vibhavamumaṁ
paḍevudaṟindamā kūsiṅge bhadrabāhuvemba pesaranellaruṁ
nerediṭṭoḍātanuṁ bidigeya candranante kramakramadiṁ sukhadiṁ
beḷedu muñjigaṭṭuva prāyamādoḍe praśasta divasa vāra
nakṣatra muhūrtadoḷ muñjibandhana kriyeyaṁ māḍida
baḻikke

tannōragegaḷappa palambar māṇigaḷverasu poṟavoḻaloḷ
baṭṭāḍuttire bhadrabāhuvemba māṇiyondu baṭṭina
mēge padinālku baṭṭanondondaṟa mēgōḷi
yoḷiṭṭāḍuttirpannegaṁ
itta vardhamānabhaṭṭārar mōkṣakkevōdimbaḻikke
caturdaśapūrvadhārigaḷappa śrutakēvaḷigaḷ nālkaneyavar
gōvardhanaremba bhaṭṭārarujjayantamaṁ vandisalendu
vihārisuttaṁ barporā kauṇḍinī nagarakke vandu
poṟavoḻaloḷondu baṭṭina mēge padinālkuṁ
baṭṭanondondaṟa mēgōḷiyoḷiṭṭāḍuttirpa
bhadrabāhumāṇiyaṁ gōvardhana bhaṭṭārar piriduṁ
bēgaṁ nōḍuttirdintenduddēśaṁ geydorītanemmimbaḻikke
caturdaśapūrvadhāriyappa mahātmyamanoḍeyoṁ
bhadrabāhu bhaṭṭāraremborapporendu bagedātanavara
manegoḍagoṇḍu pōgiyavara tāytandegaminteṁ
darītananemagoppisimellā śāstraṅgaḷumaṁ kalpisi
paṇḍitanaṁ māḍi nimagoppisuvomendoḍavaru
mantegeyyimendoḍātananoḍagoṇḍu pōgi
kelavu divasadindoḷage vyākaraṇaṁ pramāṇaṁ
chandamalaṅkāra nighaṇṭu kāvya nāṭakaṁ modalāgoḍeya
lōkadoḷuḷḷa śāstraṅgaḷellamaṁ kalpisidoḍadhigama
samyag dr̥ṣṭiyāgiyāgamadoḷellamanaṟidu saṁsāra
śarīra bhōga vairāgyaparāyaṇanāgi bhaṭṭārā enage
dīkṣeyaṁ dayegeyyimene bhaṭṭārarendaremagantu
dīkṣeyaṁ kuḍalāga magane ninna poḻalge nīṁ pōgi
ninna kaltavidyeyaṁ paṇḍitikkeyumanā poḻaloḷ
negaḻci negaḻda paṇḍitarkaḷoḍane vādaṅgeydavaraṁ geldu
daśadiśegaḷoḷellaṁ ninna pāṇḍityada yaśamaṁ pasarisi
ninnanāmoḍagoṇḍu bandudarke tāytandegaṁ santōsaṁ
māḍiyavaraṁ biḍisiyoḍambaḍisi bandoḍe tapamaṁ
kuḍalakkumanteyāgadendoḍe

bhadrabāhu māṇiyu bhaṭṭāraraṁ vandisi tanna poḻalgevōgi
tāyuṁ tandeyumaṁ kaṇḍu poḻaloḷ negaḻda
paṇḍitarkaḷoḍane vādaṅgeydu geldu daśadiśegaḷoḷellaṁ
tanna pāṇḍityada yaśamaṁ pasarisi tāytandegaṁ santōsaṁ
māḍiyavaranoḍambaḍisi bandu gōvardhana bhaṭṭārara
pakkade kumāra brahmacāriyāgi bhadrabāhu tapambaṭṭu
kelavu divasadindoḷage dvādaśāṅga caturdaśa
pūrvamappāgamamellamaṁ granthārtha svarūpadiṁ kaltu
sakalaśāstra pārāvāraganāgi ellā vōdugaḷumaṁ
neṟeyōdi kaltu śrutadoḷappa bhaktikāraṇamāgi
pratimāyōgaṁ nindoraṁ dēvarkaḷuṁ manuṣyarkaḷuṁ bandu
piridappa pūjeyaṁ māḍiyarcisi pūjisi bandisidoḍellā
r̥ṣisamudāyamumaṁ pratipālisalke samartharāgirppannegaṁ
gōvardhana bhaṭṭārar samādhimaraṇadindaṁ ratnatrayamaṁ
sādhisi muḍipi dēvalōkakke vōdar

itta bhadrabāhu bhaṭṭārar caturdaśapūrvadhārigaḷuṁ
kaḍeyārisiyaydaneya śrutakēvaḷigaḷavadhijñānigaḷuṁ
palavuṁ r̥ddhigaḷiṁ kūḍidorellā r̥ṣisamudāyamumaṁ
pratipāḷisuttaṁ grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa
drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttirppannegaṁ

mattitta magadheyembudu nāḍalli pāṭaḷīputramembudu
poḻaladanāḷvoṁ nandanembarasaṁ palakālamarasugeyyuttire
mattondu divasaṁ cāṇākyanemba bhaṭṭanaṁ nandaṁ
paribhavisi nūṅkiyaṭṭi kaḷeyisidoḍātanuṁ muḷidu
nandanaṁ keḍisi nandana rājyasthānadoḷ peṟanorvanaṁ
candraguptanembonaṁ niṟisidoḍātanuṁ palakālamarasugeydu
kaḻidoḍātana magaṁ bindusāgaranembonarasugeydu
kaḻida baḻikkātana maganaśōkanembonarasaṅgeyyuttire
ātana magaṁ pratāpadiṁ tējadindādityanoḷōrannanappoṁ
kuṇāḷanembonantavargaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ kālaṁ sale mattondu
divasamaśōka mahārājaṁ paracakrada mēgetti pōgi
allindaṁ mantri purōhita taḷavaṟādigaḷgiṁ
tendōleyaṭṭidonupādhyāyaṅge kaḻameya
kūḻaṁ tuppamaṁ toveyumanuṇalkoṭṭu
kumārananōdisugendōleyanaṭṭidoḍe vācaka
nōleyarthamanaṟayade viparītamāgintendu bācisidan

upādhyāyaṁ śāliṁ kūrañca maśiṁ ghr̥taṁ dattvā
kumāramandhāpayēt

endintu viparītamāgi lēkhārthamaṁ bācisidoḍanibaruṁ
kēḷdu apratihata śāsananappa nr̥patiyājñege bhayastharkaḷāgi
upādhyāyaṅge kaḻameya kūḻuṁ masiyuṁ
tuppamumanuṇalkoṭṭu kuṇāḷanemba kumāraneraḍuṁ
kaṇgaḷumanoḍedu kuruḍaṁ māḍida kelavu divasadindarasaṁ
paracakramaṁ sādhisi bandu magaṁ kuruḍādudaṁ
kaṇḍādamānumubbegambaṭṭu sairisalāṟade kuṇāḷanarasi
candrānaneyomboḷge magaṁ puṭṭidoḍātaṅge samprati
candraguptanendu pesaraniṭṭu rājyābhiṣēkaṅgeydu paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi
samasta rājyabhāramellamaṁ nirūpisi kuṇāḷanumanendaṁ
magane bēḍu nīnendoḍātanuṁ kākiṇī ratnamaṁ bēḍidoḍā
ratnaṁ cakravartigalladillendu magaṅge maṟumātugoṭṭu
saṁsāra vairāgyamādamānuṁ perci suvrataremba bhaṭṭārara
pakkade jinadīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍu paratreyaṁ sādhisidoṁ mattitta
samprati candragupta mahārājanarasugeyyuttire

samādhiguptarembācāryaravadhijñānigaḷ vihārisuttaṁ
barparā pāṭaḷīputrakke vandu poṟavoḻala
bahirudyānadoḷirdoraṁ samprati candraguptaṁ pōgi
vandisi dharmamaṁ kēḷdu tadanantaraṁ tanna bhavāntaraṅgaḷaṁ
besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭṭārar pēḻal toḍagidar

ī jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷavantiyembudu
nāḍalli vaidiśamembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
jayavarmanembonarasanātana mahādēvi
dhāriṇiyemboḷantavargaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttire mattā poḻala sāre
parāḷakūṭamembūroḷ dēvilanemboṁ śākaṭikaṁ
paradanātana bhārye pr̥thviśrīyemboḷākeya garbhadoḷ
pāpakarma jīvaṁ nelasidoḍēnuṁ nevamillade kasavaramellaṁ
keṭṭattu mattondu divasaṁ palambar śākaṭika paradarumberasu
baṇḍigaḷoḷ paḻtiyaṁ dhānyamaṁ tīvikoṇḍu poḻalge
māṟalendu pōpannegameḍeyoḷaḍaviyoḷ kaḷḷar baṭṭegaṭṭi
mēlvāydiṟidoḍe dēvilaṁ modalāgoḍeya palambar
paradar sattaruḻidarellamōḍi keṭṭoḍe baṇḍamumeḻtugaḷuṁ
modalāgellamaṁ kaḷḷar koṇḍupōdarā prastāvadoḷ
pr̥thviśrī besaleyāgi nandimitranendā kūsiṅge
pesaraniṭṭu eraḻmūṟu tiṅgaḷiṅge tāy kaḻidoḍe
banda naṇṭar naḍape baḷedoḍā naṇṭaruṁ kaḻiduḷḷarella
sattu kulakṣayamādoḍūravarellamintendarī taruvali
nammūroḷire namage sāvuṁ kēḍumamōghamakkumivananaṭṭi
kaḷeyimendūrindanibarumaṭ kaḷedoḍātan
keladūrgaḷumaṁ nāḻgaḷumaṁ toḻaldu baikandiridelliyānuṁ
pettuṁ peṟadeyumintu bāḻuttaṁ padinaidu padināṟu
varuṣada prāyadātanāgi vaidiśamemba poḻalge varpon

annegaṁ kāṣṭhakūṭanemba besadavaṁ puḷḷiya poṟeyaṁ
pottu poḻalgevarponaṁ kaṇḍātanoḍane goṭṭiyoḷ
bandu poṟavoḻaloḷāraveyoḷ kāṣṭhakūṭaṁ sēdegeṭṭu
puḷḷiya poṟeyaniḻpipi paṭṭirdoḍe tānuṁ paṭṭiralendu
bagedu taleyattiḍalkaṟasiyēnumaṁ kāṇade tarponeṇbarindaṁ
taḷarcalāṟadantappa piridondu sileyaṁ tandu taleyattiṭṭu
paṭṭirdudaṁ kāṣṭhakūṭanātana balamaṁ kaṇḍu tanna
manegoḍagoṇḍu pōgiyūḍi ninagī poḻaloḷārānuṁ
naṇṭaroḷareyendu besagoṇḍoḍārumilleṁ
doḍantappoḍe nīnennoḍanirettaluṁ pōgadirendu tāṅgi
tānumātanumantirvaruṁ divasakkaṁ puḷḷiyaṁ tare padimbar
tarpa poṟeyanorvane tarpanantu palavu divasaṁ sale
kāṣṭhakūṭaṁ tanna peṇḍati jayaghaṇṭeyemboḷanintendu
kalpisidanītaṅge nīṁ basiṟ tīve baḍḍisadireṇṇeyaṁ
tiṇṇameṟeyadir mīyal bēḍidoḍameṟeyadirendu
kalpisidoḍākeyumā pāṅginoḷ divasakkaṁ baḍḍise
nandimitranuṁ piriya puḷḷiya poṟegaḷaṁ divasakkaṁ tandu
kuḍalavaṁ māṟi kāṣṭhakūṭanoḍeyonādonintu
divasaṅgaḷ sale

mattondu divasaṁ jayaghaṇṭe karuṇisi taṇiye
baḍḍisidoḍuṇḍu maṟudivasamirvaruṁ puḷḷige pōdalli
nandimitranendanayyā enaguḍalillēnumondu dammakkā
doḍaṁ sīreyaṁ koṇḍīyimendoḍantegeyvemendu
maṟumātugoṭṭirvaruṁ puḷḷiya poṟeyaṁ manege
tanda baḻikke kāṣṭhakūṭaṁ peṇḍatiyanendanītaṅge nīṁ
basiṟ tīveyuṇalikkidā endoḍe karuṇisi parvamendu
taṇiyeyuṇalikkidenendoḍe muḷidu sāyebaḍidu
maneyiṁ peṇḍatiyanaṭṭi kaḷedoḍe nandimitraṁ pōgi jaya
ghaṇṭeyaṁ besagoṇḍan ninnanēke kāṣṭhakūṭaṁ baḍidanabbā
endu besagoṇḍoḍe ninage ninne taṇiyeyuṇalikkidenendu
muḷidu baḍidaṭṭikaḷedonendoḍintappa pañcamahāpātakana
maneyoḷ māriyirkendu kāṣṭhakūṭanaṁ bisuṭu pōgi
bēṟe tanage puḷḷigaḷaṁ divasakkaṁ tandu māṟal taguḷdoḍeṇṭu
dammada puḷḷiyaṁ tandoḍamondu paṇamanappoḍaṁ peṟade
basirkūḻgamambaligameṇṇegaṁ kaḻigaṁ koṭṭu pōkumintu
bāḻuttumire

mattondu divasaṁ puḷḷige pōgi puḷḷiya poṟeyaṁ
pottu barponannegameḍeyoḷ śivaguptācāryaraṣṭāṅga
nimittaṅgaḷaṁ balloraḍavige vōgi siddhāntamaṁ pari
viḍigeydandina divasamalliye dēvaraṁ vandisi pakṣōpavāsada
pāraṇegendu poḻalge carigevugutandoḍe nandimitraṁ
kaṇḍāścaryabhūtanāgi nīḍuṁ nōḍiyivarellige
vōdapparō endu baḻivaḻiyane vandu poṟavoḻala
basadiya prākāradoḷage puḷḷiya poṟeyanikki
nōḻpanannegamivaranendavaraṁ baḻivaḻiyane barpannegamā
divasamarasaṁ śivagupta bhaṭṭārakarggāṁ pāraṇeyaṁ māḍuveṁ
peṟarāruṁ niṟisal sallendu poḻaloḷagellaṁ gōsaneyaṁ
toḻalcidoḍañjiyāruṁ niṟisuvarillade bhaṭāraruṁ
kiṟumane permaneyennaduṇaltakka manegaḷaṁ carigevuguttaṁ
barporaramaneyaṁ pokkāgaḷ kaṇḍarasanuṁ mahādēviyuṁ
suvarṇapūrṇa kaḷaśamuṁ kannaḍiyuṁ pūvumakkiyuṁ
māduphalamuṁ modalāgoḍeyanēkārcaneyindidiraṁ
bandu niṟisi balagoṇḍu bandu bhaṭārara kālaṁ mahādēvi
nīrvoyye arasaṁ tāne prakṣāḷisi baḻikkoḍavōda
bōḻadaleya dēsigana kālaṁ brahmayyā nīḍiṁ nimma kālaṁ
toḷevemendu mahādēvi tāne kālaṅkarci bhaṭṭārakargeṟagi
kuḷḷirisi

piriya ponna taḷigeyumuccamappaḍḍavaṇigeyumani
ṭṭu brahmacārigaṁ ponna taḷigeyumaḍḍaṇigeyumaniṭṭu
bhaṭṭārakargarasaṁ tāne baḍḍisaltaguḷda baḻiyaṁ rājānnada
kūḻuṁ pesaṟa toveyuṁ beṇṇegāsidāmōda sugandha
parimaḷaṁ nārpa tuppamuṁ palavuṁ teṟada bāḍugaḷuṁ
tuyyaluṁ pūrigeyiḍḍalige sōdige lāvaṇige ghr̥tapūraṁ
laḍḍuge maṇḍage modalāgoḍeya padineṇṭuṁ teṟada
bhakṣyarūpaṅgaḷumaṁ nānā prakārada pānaṅgaḷumaṁ
bhaṭṭārarge baḍḍisidante brahmayyaṅge mahādēvi
baḍḍisidoḍe dēsigaṁ kaṇḍu beṟagāgi puṭṭidandiṁ
toṭṭintappuṇisaṁ kanasinoḷappoḍaṁ kaṇḍaṟiyada magaṁ
cōdyambaṭṭendappoḍaṁ taṇiyeyuṇalpeṟada dēsigaṁ
nānāprakāraduṇisaṁ sugandhamappa divyāhāramanākaṇṭha
pramāṇambaregaṁ taṇiyuṇḍu baḻikke karpūra sammiśramappa
nelavattiyaḍakeya pōḻgaḷumaṁ kaitīvideleyumaṁ
brahmayyaṅge koṭṭu bhaṭārar carige māḍida
baḻikkarasanumaṁ mahādēviyumaṁ karmakṣayamumakṣaya
dānamumakkendu parasi poṟamaṭṭu basadige pōpāgaḷ
bhaṭṭārara baḻivaḻiyane pōdaṁ bhaṭṭārar basadiyaṁ
balagoṇḍaṁ kālaṅkarcoḷagaṁ pokkīryāpattiyaṁ biḍisi
gōcāraniyamaṅgeydudaṁ nandimitraṁ nōḍuttirddintendu
manadoḷ bagedappanintappa rūpumaṁ kaikoṇḍoḍe
lōkadoḷ gauravamuṁ pūjeyumaṁ peṟalakkumonduṁ
klēśamillade divyāhāramanellā kālamuṇalpeṟalakkumendu
bagedu bhaṭārar niyamaṁ geydu samedirda baḻikke bandu
munde nindu kaigaḷaṁ mugidintendan bhaṭārā ennaṁ nimmante
māḍimendoḍe bhaṭārarātanaṁ nōḍiyalpāyuṣyanu
māsanna bhavyanappudanaṟidoḷḷitappa muhūrtadoḷ
tapambaḍisidoḍātanuṁ tapambaṭṭu dīkṣōpavāsaṁ
geydirdan

annegamarasanumarasiyuṁ bhaṭṭāraroḍavanda brahmacāri
tapambaṭṭanembudaṁ kēḷdosedu munnemma maneyoḷuṇḍu
tapambaṭṭaniṁ nāḷe namma maneyoḷ pānigaṭṭuvamendu
bagedirdu maṟudivasaṁ sāmanta mahāsāmantarkaḷuṁ
rājyacihnaṅgaḷuṁ berasu mahāvibhūtiyindarasaṁ poḻtaḍina
bēgaṁ basadige vandu vāhanadindiḻidu balagoṇḍu
bandu gandha puṣpa dīpa dhūpākṣategaḷiṁ dēvaranarcisi
kriyāpūrvakaṁ vandisi bhaṭṭārarge gurubhaktigeydu
pañcamuṣṭiyiṁ vandisiyante kittayyaṅgaḷumanā
mārgadiṁ vandisi bhaṭārarallige vandu kuḷḷirdu
dharmamaṁ kēḷda tadanantaramerdu bhaṭārā binnapaṁ
kittayyaṅgaḷanindemage kāruṇyaṁ geyvudāvu niṟisi
pānigaṭṭi puṇyamaṁ nerapikoḷvamendoḍantegeyyimendā
nuḍiyaṁ kittayyaṅgaḷ kēḷdu sāmanta mahāsāmantarge
svāmiyappī pr̥thvīśvaraṁ bandennumanarcisi bandisi
nīcavr̥ttiyiṁ kiṅkurvāṇaṅgeydappanahō āścaryamī
tapada dharmada phalamilliye pratyakṣamāytinnuṁ munde
piridāgade māṇadendu tannoḷe taṟisandu mattamā
divasamupavāsamaṁ kaikoṇḍar

ittal jayavarma mahārājaṁ bhaṭārarumaṁ
kittayyaṅgaḷumaṁ bandisidudaṁ bhaṭāraraṟidu kittayyaṅgaḷge
ēṣaṇāsamiti modalāgoḍeya brataṅgaḷaṁ mattaṁ saṅkṣēpadiṁ
pēḻdu kittayyaṅgaḷirā nimage śramamādappudu dēvaraṁ bandisi
carigege poṟamaḍuvudene mattaṁ tāvu koṇḍupavāsamaṁ
gurugaḷge prakaṭisidanarasaṁ jayavarma mahārājaṁ kēḷdu
binnane mogaṁ māḍi bhaṭārarumaṁ kittayyaṅgaḷumaṁ bandisi
tannaramanege vōgi mahādēvigendanindenage risiyaraṁ niṟisi
puṇyaṅgoḷva bhāgyamillendoḍe mahādēviyantappoḍe
nāḷeyāṁ niṟisi puṇyamaṁ kaikoḷvenendoḍarasanendoṁ
ninagamenagaṁ samabhāgaṁ puṇyamendusire nīmēkenagindu
samabhāgamīyadādirī puṇyamanānindu niṟisi kaikoḷveṁ
nīṁ nāḷe niṟisendu nuḍidu basadige vōgirenna bhāgyamēṁ
kiḍisugume nāḷeyuṁ niṟisiyāvagaṁ puṇyamaṁ
kaikoḷvenendarasaṅge maṟumātugoṭṭu

maṟudivasaṁ dhāriṇi mahādēviyaynūrvararasiyarkaḷuṁ
peṇḍavāsadaggaḷada sūḷeyarkaḷuṁ berasu vēsarigaḻtegaḷuṁ
piḍigaḷuṁ sibigegaḷumanēṟi sīgurigaḷumaṁ koḍegaḷumaṁ
piḍiyisi ekka maddaḷeya koḻala jhaṅkārada paṟegaḷ
munde bājisuttaṁ baḻiyaṁ kāpinavar vare mundaṇa
mānasaraṁ paḍiyaṟar tolagisuttaṁ bare vidyādhariyarkaḷ
barpante bandu bāgilmāḍada poṟagaṇa deseyoḷ
tantamma vāhanaṅgaḷindiḻidu pokku basadiyaṁ
balagoṇḍu bandoḷagaṁ pokku darśana vandanegaḷumaṁ
pēḻdīryāpattiyaṁ biḍisi gandha puṣpa dīpa dhūpākṣataṅgaḷiṁ
dēvaranarcisi kriyāpūrvakaṁ dēvaraṁ bandisi
śivaguptabhaṭṭārarumanarcisi gurubhaktigeydu bandisi śrāvaka
brataṅgaḷanēṟisikoṇḍu baḻikintendaḷ bhaṭṭārā indemmallige
nīmuṁ kittayyaṅgaḷanoḍagoṇḍu bandu pakkadirdu pānigaṭṭi
mārgamaṁ tōṟi maguḻe bijayaṅgeyyimene kittayyaṅgaḷaṁ
nīme besagoḷḷimavaroḍambaṭṭoḍāmoḍagoṇḍu barpe
mendoḍe dhāriṇi mahādēvi kittayyaṅgaḷallige vōgi
kālaṁ piḍidu vandisi intendaḷ kittayyā nimagindu
nām pānigaṭṭuvememma manegeḻtaravēḻpudendu kālaṁ
piḍidu poḍevaṭṭirdāgaḷarasiyaṁ mogamaṁ nōḍi
neṟeye toṭṭuṭṭu pasadanaṅgoṇḍirda dēvagaṇikeyarane
pōlvaynūrvararasiyarkaḷindaṁ sūḷeyarkaḷindaṁ
parivēṣṭiteyāgirda śacīmahādēviyane pōlva dhāriṇi
mahādēviyenna kālgeṟagi poḍevaṭṭirdaḷidellamī tapada
phalaminnuṁ munde piriduṇṭendu bagedarasigendarabbā
indemaguṇalke bageyillupavāsaṅgeydappemendu paricchēdisi
nuḍidoḍe binnane mogaṁ māḍi bhaṭāraraṁ vandisi
pōgiyarasaṅge kittayyaṅgaḷindupavāsaṅgeydorendu
pēḻdāgaḷ

mattiruḷina karaṇavēḷeyoḷ vajrasēnanemba
mantriyarasaṅgintendu binnapaṅgeydaṁ dēvā nāḷeyāṁ
niṟisi kittayyaṅgaḷge pāraṇeyaṁ māḍuvenene ante
geyyendoḍe maṟudivasaṁ basadige vandu bhaṭṭārā
kittayyaṅgaḷanemmalligoḍagoṇḍu bandu carigedōṟi nīmuṁ
bijayaṅgeyyimene kittayyaṅgaḷoḍambaṭṭoḍoḍagoṇḍu
barpemavaranoḍambaḍisimendoḍe kittayyaṅgaḷallige vōgi
kittayyā indemma maneyoḷ pārisalvēḻkumendu kālaṁ
piḍidu poḍemaṭṭirdonaṁ nōḍi ‘rājōvā rāja
maṁrtyōvā’ endu sāmanta mahāsāmantarkaḷiṁ
parivēṣṭitanāgirda mantriyenage poḍemaṭṭanivellaṁ tapada
mahātmyaminnuṁ munde piriduṇṭendu bagedintendarā
mindupavāsaṅgeydemendoḍātanenage puṇyamillāgade
endu nuḍidu bhaṭṭāraraṁ vandisi pōdaṁ mattamiruḷina
karaṇavēḷeyoḷarhaddāsanemboṁ rājaśrēṣṭhiyarasaṅge
binnapaṅgeydaṁ nāḷeyāṁ kittayyaṅgaḷge pāraṇeyaṁ
māḍuvenendoḍarasanantegeyyimendoḍātanuṁ basadige
vōgi bhaṭṭāraraṁ vandisi kittayyaṅgaḷumaṁ vandisi
gurugaḷanumatadindemma manege carigevaralvēḻkumendu
nuḍidoḍupavāsaṅgeydenendoḍātanuṁ bhaṭṭāraraṁ vandisi
pōdaṁ
itta nandimitra kittayyaṅgaḷge śramamaṁ bhaṭṭāraraṟidu
kittayyā pañcanamaskāramaṁ māṇadiruḷuṁ
pagalumōduttamirimendu kalpisidoḍavarumiruḷuṁ
pagalumōduttire

mattitta iruḷinōlagadoḷ neredirda neraviyoḷarasanuṁ
mahādēviyuṁ kittayyaṅgaḷa tapamaṁ guṇamumaṁ pogaḻutte
tapambaṭṭa divasadiṁ taguḷdindiṅgaydu divasamuṇbudilla
kuḍivudillupavāsaṅgeydirdarāmenitu kīṟi nuḍidoḍaṁ
carigemāḍalollarinnavu sāhasamuṁ satvavumārgamoḷave
endarasanumarasiyuṁ pogaḻvudaṁ kēḷdu yuvarājanerdu
binnapaṅgeydu dēvā kittayyaṅgaḷge nāḷeyāṁ pāraṇeyaṁ
māḍisuvenendoḍarasanantegeyyendoḍe maṟudivasaṁ
yuvarājaṁ mahāvibhūtiverasu basadige vōgi dēvaraṁ
bhaṭṭārarumanarcisi bandisi bhaṭārā kittayyaṅgaḷindemma
maneyoḷ pārisuvantire besasimene kittayyaṅgaḷanoḍambaḍisi
niṟisimene kittayyaṅgaḷa kālaṁ piḍidu poḍemaṭṭu kittayyā
emma maneyoḷindu nīmuṁ pārisalvēḻpudendoḍe
kittayyaṅgaḷātana śrīyuṁ vibhūtiyuṁ tējamumaṁ kaṇḍu
intappa kṣatriya putrādigaḷellamenageṟagi poḍemaṭṭu
kiṅkurvāṇaṅgeydapruṇbudarkēnīgaḷ saṅkaṭamī
tapada phalaminnuṁ munde piriduṇṭendu
bagedindupavāsaṅgeydevendu maṟumātugoṭṭoḍe
virāganāgi yuvarājaṁ bhaṭāraraṁ vandisi
pōdanintāṟudivasaṁ pōda baḻikkēḻaneya divasadandu
nēsaṟ mūḍidoḍe bhaṭārarallige nandimitraṁ vandu
bandisi intendaṁ bhaṭārā initu kālamuṇḍudu
sālgumemage yāvajjīvaṁ bāḻvannegamupavāsa
paccakkhāṇaṅguḍuvudendoḍe

bhaṭārarendar nīmuṁ mahāpuruṣarir nimmannar
dhairyavantaruṁ satvavantarumārumillaṁ initu kālaṁ
tapaṅgeydappemagappoḍaminitu dhairyamuṁ satvamumillendu
gurugaḷ pogaḻdoḍe gurugaḷa pogaḻtege rāgisi
santōsambaṭṭirdoḍe bhaṭārarendar nimagindina
divasadaniteyāyuṣyamendu pēḻduṁ jāvajjīvaṁ
caturvidhamappāhārakkaṁ śarīrakkaṁ nivr̥ttigeyyendu
paccakkhāṇaṅgoṭṭu basadiyoḷondu kōṇeyoḷī
eḍeyoḷ nīmondu keladoḷ maguḻade taḷarade
kaiyuṁ kālgaḷumanuḍugade nīḍade bāḻvannegaṁ paṭṭirdu
pañcanamaskāramaṁ manadoḷōduttirimendu kalpisi paṭṭirisi
ārādhaneyanarcisi bhaṭṭārarārādhaneyaṁ vakkhāṇisuvudaṁ
kēḷuttirdaṁ mattitta kittayyaṅgaḷ saṁnyasanaṅgeydarembā
mātanarasanādiyāgi poḻala janaṅgaḷellaṁ kēḷdu piriduṁ
sambhramamāgiyarasanuṁ mahādēviyuṁ mantriyuṁ
rājaśrēṣṭhiyuṁ yuvarājaṁ modalāgi poḻala
janamellamirpottumarcaneyuṁ koṇḍubandarcisi
kiṟidu bēgamirdārādhaneyaṁ vakkhāṇisuvudaṁ kēḷdu
mithyādr̥ṣṭigaḷappavar śrāvaka brataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍar śrāvakaruṁ
dr̥ḍhasamyag dr̥ṣṭigaḷāgi bandisi pōdar
itta nēsaṟ paṭṭoḍe kittayyaṅgaḷgāsannakālamādudembudaṁ
bhaṭṭāraraṟidintendar kittayyā nimagīgaḷ prāṇaṁ
pōgal bagedappudu dēvaraṁ jānisuvudu
pañcanamaskāramanōduttamuccārisuvudaṁ
kēḷuttamirimendu kalpisi bhaṭṭārar pañcanamaskāramaṁ piridu
bēgaṁ pēḻe prāyōpagamanadinentante śubhapariṇāmadiṁ
samyag darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi muḍipi

saudharmakalpadoḷeraḍu sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyoṁ
kanakadhvajanemboṁ dēvanāgi puṭṭiyavadhijñānadiṁ tanna
bhavamanaṟidī śarīradindamintappa divyaśarīramuṁ
dēvalōkadoḷappa sukhamaiśvaryamumādudendu
mūṟukōṭi parivāra dēvarkaḷuṁ mūṟu lakke
dēviyarapparasiyarkaḷuṁ gaṇikeyarkaḷuṁ berasu
suratnamayamappa divyavimānamuṁ ghaṇṭājāḷa
muktājāḷa hēmajāḷaṅgaḷindoppuva vimānamanēṟi
mahāvibhūtiyiṁ tagaḷduragāmaraṁ berasu pāḍuttaṁ
barpannegamitta vaidiśamemba poḻaloḷ nandimitra
kittayyaṅgaḷ muḍipidarembudaṁ kēḷdarasanuṁ
mahādēviyuṁ mantriyuṁ pergaḍeyuṁ modalāgi
poḻaloḷaguḷḷa janamellamarcanegaḷaṁ koṇḍu bandarasaṁ tāṁ
pakkadirdu kṣapaṇakananuyva vimānamumaṁ mattaṁ śōbhegendu
palavu vimānaṅgaḷumanoḷḷiduvāgi māḍisi palavuṁ nētrada
paḻivullavaṅgaḷ dhvaja patākegaḷumanettisi cāturvarṇa
śravaṇa saṅgha sahitaṁ paṭupaṭaha tuṇava bhambhā mardaḷe
jhallari mukunda tāḷa kāhaḷa śaṅkha vaṁśa vīṇāsvaraṅgaḷeseye
kavivararuṁ peṇḍavāsadoḷveṇḍirkaḷuṁ vimānaṅgaḷa
mundāḍuttaṁ dammamumaṁ ponnumaṁ kēḷi māḍi munde
sūsuttamoyvudaṁ

kanakadhvajanemba dēvaṁ kaṇḍenna
dēhakkivarellaminiviridarcaneyumaṁ pūjeyumaṁ
vibhavamaṁ prabhāvaneyumaṁ māḍidapparendoḍānenna
dēhakke māḍadirpeneyendu palavu vimānaṅgaḷaṁ
vigurvisi kṣapaṇakana vimānada munde baḷasiyuṁ pōpantu
māḍiyākāśamellamaṁ vimānamayamāge vigurvisi
dēvalōkada paṟegaḷaṁ bājisuttaṁ namēru mandāra
santānaka pārijātaṅgaḷemba pūgaḷaṁ suriyuttaṁ dēvarkaḷa
dēviyarkaḷ sahitaṁ kṣapaṇakana vimānada munde intendu
pēḻdāḍidaṁ

lg.l:
pecchaha pecchaha ōdaṇa muṇḍaṁ accara majjhagayaṁ
ramaṇijjaṁ

jañjeṇa manteṇa kāraṇa yēṇa pacca iyavvaṁ hōi
ṇarēṇa

div.p:
endu chanda chandadiṁ pēḻdāḍuvudaṁ kaṇḍarasaṁ
modalāgi poḻala janavellaṁ cōdyambaṭṭu
beṟagāgi nōḍuttirdintendarasaṁ besagoṇḍaṁ
nīmārgēnembirelliṁ bandirintēke pēḻdāḍidappirendu
besagoṇḍoḍānalte nandimitranappa kittayyanenuṇisiṅgendu
tapambaṭṭēḻudivasamupavāsaṁ geydu muḍipi
saṁnyasanaṅgeydu muḍipi dēvalōkadoḷ kanakadhvajanemboṁ
dēvanāgi puṭṭi enna dēhamuṁ pūjisalu nimagenna
vibhavamaṁ tōṟal bandenendu pēḻdu tanna śarīramaṁ
divyamappa gandha puṣpa dīpa dhūpākṣategaḷindarcisi
tanna gurugaḷappa śivaguptarembācāryarumaṁ
pūjisi nimma prasādadindenaginiviridu śrīyuṁ
mahāvibhūtiyumaiśvaryamuṁ dēvatvamumādudendu
pēḻdu bandisi tanna dēvalōkakke pōdan

ittalarasanumadellamaṁ kaṇḍu saṁsāra śarīra bhōga vairāgya
parāyaṇanāgi śrīvarmanemba tanna piriya magaṅge rājya
paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi palambararasumakkaḷuṁ mahādēvi modalāgi
palambararasiyarkaḷuṁ parivāradavaruṁ poḻala palambar
janaṅgaḷellaṁ berasu śivagupta bhaṭṭārara pakkade tapambaṭṭu samyag
jñāna cāritryaṅgaḷoḷagoḷḷitāgi negaḻdu paścātkāladoḷ
saṁnyasanaṅgeydu muḍipiyanibaruṁ dēvalōkakke vōdar
mattaṁ kanakadhvajanemba dēvaṁ palakālaṁ dēvalōkada
sukhamananubhavisi bandilli nīṁ samprati candraguptanāgi
puṭṭideyendu samādhigupta bhaṭṭārar tanna bhavamaṁ pēḻdoḍe

ādamānumosedu santōṣambaṭṭu bhaṭṭāraraṁ vandisi
tannaramanege vōgi intu samprati candragupta mahārājaṁ
pr̥thviyanēkacchatracchāyeyindamāḷuttamujjēniyoḷ
sukhadindirpannegaṁ

itta dvādaśāṅga caturdaśa pūrvadhārigaḷappa
bhadrabāhubhaṭṭārar piridu r̥ṣisamudāyaṁ berasu grāma
nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ barporujjēnige vandā poḻala bahirudyāna
vanadoḷirdaradanarasaṁ kēḷdu parivārasahitaṁ pōgi
bhaṭāraraṁ vandisi saddharmamaṁ kēḷdu śrāvaka brataṅgaḷanē
ṟisikoṇḍu vandisi tannaramanege vōdanitta bhaṭāraruṁ
palavu divasamā poḻaloḷire mattondu divasaṁ
r̥ṣisamudāyavellamaṁ carigevogisuttamellarumaṁ
niṟisi tāvorvareyondu maneyaṁ pokkāgaḷā
maneyoḷārumillōsarigeyoḷ toṭṭiloḷirdavyakta
kiṟugūsu bōḷaha bōḷaha bhaṭṭārā endattāgaḷā
vacanamaṁ bhaṭṭārar kēḷdu divya vākyamendaṟidu
kālapramāṇamaṁ besagoṇḍoḍe dvādaśavarṣamendu pēḻdattu
bhaṭṭārar kāladōṣadiṁ prajāpīḍeyādappudendaṟidu
kāruṇya buddhiyindāhāramaṁ koḷḷade alābhaṁ
māḍiyante basadige vōgi gōcāra niyamaṁ geydu baḻikke
risiyarkaḷgellaṁ baḻiyanaṭṭi barisi intendarīnāḍoḷ
panneraḍu varuṣambaregamanāvr̥ṣṭiyāgi durbhikṣamādappudī
nāḍoḷagirda risiyarkaḷgellaṁ bēgaṁ baḻiyaṭṭi barisiṁ
pōpaṁ dakṣiṇāpathakkendu risiyarkaḷgellamaṁ baḻiyanaṭṭidar

ittarasanumā divasadiruḷ padināṟuṁ polla kanasugaḷaṁ
kaṇḍanavāvuvendoḍe ādityanastamānakke salvudumaṁ
kalpavr̥kṣada kōḍuḍivudumaṁ nelakke varutirda vimānaṁ
bāradeḍeyinde mēge maguḻdudumaṁ panneraḍu taleya
pāvumaṁ candranoḍedudumaṁ kaḍugaḍiyavapperaḍānegaḷ
tammoḷ pōral sārdu peṟapiṅgi pōdudumaṁ
mīnambuḻuvumaṁ nīrillada keṟeya naḍuvumaṁ poge
perce negeda kāḻkirccumaṁ siṁhāsanada mēgēṟida
kōḍagamumaṁ ponnataḷigeyoḷ nāy tuyyaluṇbudumaṁ
kōḍagavēṟirda sorkāneyumaṁ kasakuppeyoḷ tāmare
mūḍidudaṁ samudraṁ mēredappidudumaṁ beḷgaḻte pūḍida
ponna rathamaṁ beḷgaḻteyanarasarkaḷēṟuvudumaṁ intī
padināṟuṁ kanasugaḷaṁ samyag darśana śuddhi modalāgoḍeya
guṇaṅgaḷiṁ kūḍida samprati candragupta mahārājaṁ polla
kanasugaḷaṁ kaṇḍenendañji nēsaṟ mūḍidāgaḷ bhadrabāhu
bhaṭṭārarallige pōgi vandisi tanna kaṇḍa kanasugaḷaṁ bhaṭārarge
pēḻdavaṟa phalaṅgaḷaṁ besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭārarintendu pēḻal
toḍagidar

ādityanastamānakke salvudaṁ kaṇḍudaṟindī bharata kṣētradoḷ
caturdaśa pūrvadhārigaḷumavadhijñānigaḷumillindi
ttalāgar kalpavr̥kṣada kōḍuḍidudumaṁ kaṇḍudaṟindindina
divasaṁ kaḻidoḍe kulabala vibhavadiṁ piriyarappa
makuṭabaddharapparasugaḷ tapambaḍuvarallar nelakkevaruttirda
vimānameḍeyindaṁ mēge maguḻdudaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ
dēvarkaḷuṁ vidyādhararkaḷumillindittī kṣētrakke vārar
panneraḍu taleya pāvaṁ kaṇḍudaṟindilliṁ toṭṭī nāḍoḷ
panneraḍu varṣambaraṁ raudrapasavamakkuṁ candranoḍedudaṁ
kaṇḍudaṟiṁ saddharmada modala pordida mārgadiṁ
beḷeyoḷ pulgaḷ palavakkuṁ kaḍugaḍiyavapperaḍānegaḷ
tammoḷ pōral sārdu peṟapiṅguvudaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ
prajegaḷa meccidante maḻekoḷḷavu maṇḍalavarṣaṅgaḷakkuṁ
mīnambuḻuvaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ mīnambuḻavinoḷōrannavu
śāstraṅgaḷumaṅgabāhyamappa caturdaśa vidyāsthānaṅgaḷuṁ
kundiyupadēśa tanumātrame nilkuṁ nīrillada keṟeya
naḍuvaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ tīrthaṅkara cakravartigaḷa puṭṭida
madhyadēśadoḷ pinna negaḻteyāgadu ā madhyadēśakke
sambandhiyī gāhe

lg.l: puvvēṇa aṅgavisaō dakkhiṇadō jāvahō i kōsambī
avarēṇa jāva dūṇā kuṇāḷa visayōya uttaradō

div.p:
endu madhyadēśa pramāṇaṁ mattaṁ pogeyindaṁ perci
negeda kāḻkircaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ dhūrtarappa pollaliṅgigaḷa
percakkuṁ mattaṁ daye modalāgoḍeya saddharmakke
viruddhamāgi negaḻva piridappa hiṁsādigaḷaṁ geyva
vēdādiśāstraṅgaḷa percakkuṁ siṁhāsanamanēṟirda
kōḍagamaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ kulajaralladavararasugeyvar
ponna taḷigeyoḷ nāy tuyyalanuṇbudaṁ kaṇḍudaṟiṁ
pollaliṅgigaḷarasarkaḷindaṁ pūjise paḍuvar
kōḍagamāneyanēṟuvudaṁ kaṇḍudaṟindādamānuṁ śuddha
kuladoḷ puṭṭidarasumakkaḷuttama kuladoḷappabhimānamaṁ
toṟedu bāḻkāraṇamāgi kulajaralladavargāḷāgi
bāḻvar kasakuppeyoḷ tāmare mūḍidandaṁ
kaṇḍudaṟiṁ dayeyupaśamamuṁ parigrahaparityāgamuṁ
samādhiyuṁ satyamuṁ śaucamuṁ kṣameyumendivu
modalāgoḍeyavaṟoḷ kūḍida mikka saddharma
mārgamaṁ dravyapatigaḷumarasumakkaḷuṁ tamma dravyādi
madadindaṁ toṟevar nīcajātigaḷuṁ baḍavaruṁ
saddharmamaṁ kaikoṇḍu negaḻvar samudraṁ mēredappuvudaṁ
kaṇḍudaṟindarasumakkaḷ tamma maryādeyaṁ mikku
dravyaṁ modalāgoḍeyavaṟoḷ lōbhiṣṭharappar oḷitappa
satya śauca cāritravendivaṟiṁ kundiyādamānuṁ
nirdayarkaḷappar beḷgaḻte pūḍida ponnarathamaṁ
kaṇḍudaṟindaṁ samyagdarśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷindaṁ pavitramappa
nirggranthaliṅgamappudanaḻidoḷḷitappa tapamaṁ kaikoḷepaṭṭuṁ
piridappa puruṣakāramuṁ satyamuṁ manōbalamuṁ
vīryamumendivaṟindaṁ kūḍidavargaḷindamoḷḷidarappa
tīrthakara parama dēvarkaḷindaṁ cakravartigaḷindaṁ
caramadēhadhārigaḷindaṁ negaḻepaṭṭudanoḷḷitappa
mōkṣamārgamaṁ pordiyuṁ viṣaya sukhaṅgaḷoḷ
mōhitarkaḷāgi kiḍuvar beḷgaḻteyanarasarkaḷēṟuvudaṁ
kaṇḍudaṟinduttama kuladavargaḷge kulajaralladavaroḍane
maduveyoḷ toṭṭa naṇpugaḷakkumendintu padināṟuṁ
kaṇḍa kanasugaḷa phalaṅgaḷaṁ samprati candragupta mahārājaṅge
bhadrabāhu bhaṭṭārar pēḻdu mattamī kaliyuga mahārājana
svarūpamanintendu pēḻal toḍagidar

lg.l: yatiṣu niyataṁ vākpāruṣyaṁ vipattiṣu ca kriyā
kālē samprativartatē kaliyugē satyā narā durlabhā

nānā cōragaṇā muṣanti pr̥thivīmāryō janaḥ
kṣīyatē
putrasyāpi na viśvasanti pitaraḥ kaṣṭaṁ yugaṁ vartatē
nirvīryā pr̥thivī gatauṣadhirasā nīcā mahatvaṁ gatāḥ
bhāryā bhartari naiva baddhahr̥dayā putrāḥ pitr̥dvēṣiṇaḥ
ityēvaṁ samupasthitē kaliyugē dhanyā vanaṁ prasthitāḥ

div.p: endintu bhaṭṭārar pēḻe

samprati candragupta mahārājaṁ kēḷdu mattandina divasaṁ
kaḻidoḍe maṇḍaḷikar jinadīkṣeyaṁ kaikoḷḷarembudaṁ
kēḷdādamānuṁ bhītanāgi siṁhasēnanemba tanna piriya
magaṅge rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi bhadrabāhu bhaṭṭārara pakkade
palambararasumakkaḷverasā divasame tapambaṭṭaṁ

mattitta madhyadēśadoḷirda risiyarkaḷgellaṁ baḻiyaṭṭi
barisi bhaṭṭārarintendar panneraḍu varṣambaregamī
nāḍoḷanāvr̥ṣṭiyāgi mahāraudra pasavamakkuṁ
madhyamadēśamellaṁ pāḻakkumī nāḍoḷirda
risiyarkaḷge bratabhaṅgamappudadaṟiṁ pōpaṁ
dakṣiṇāpathakkendācāryarkaḷ sahitamircchāsira
risisamudāyamuṁ samprati candraguptamuniyuṁ
berasu dakṣiṇāpathakke pōdaritta rāmilācāryaruṁ
sthūlācāryaruṁ sthūlabhadrācāryarumintī
mūvarācāryaruṁ bhaṭāraroḍane pōgalollade tantamma
r̥ṣisamudāyaṁ berasu sindhu viṣayakke pōdaritta
bhaṭṭāraruṁ piridu r̥ṣi samudāyaṁ berasu grāma
nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
kaḻidu pōgi kaḻbappunāḍaneydi pōguttaṁ bhadrabāhu
bhaṭṭārar tammāyuṣyapramāṇamaṟidāmilli
saṁnyasanaṅgeydappevu nīmellaṁ pōgimendu tamma piriya
śiṣyar daśapūrvadhārigaḷ viśākhācāryaremboralliṁ
baḻiyamārya suhastigaḷumarabhadraruṁ subhadramitraruṁ
mahāgiriyuṁ sumatiyuṁ mahāmatiyuṁ
viśākhanandiyumendivargaḷellarumanācāryar
māḍi draviḻa viṣayakke pōgimendu
viśākhācāryaroḍane eṇchāsirvar risiyaranaṭṭidar
candraguptamuniyumanivaroḍane pōgimendu
bhaṭṭārar kīṟi pōgalvēḻdoḍāmuṁ pōgalollevu
nimmaḍigaḷge vinayaṅgeyyuttamirddappemendu pōgalollade
pakkadirdaruḻidarellaṁ pōdaritta bhadrabāhubhaṭṭārar
kaḻbappu nāḍaḍaviya beṭṭada mēgaṇēkasaṟiya mēgirdu
caturvidhamappāhārakkaṁ śarīrakkaṁ jāvajjīvaṁ
nivr̥ttipūrvakaṁ saṁnyasanaṅgeydar
itta candragupta muniyumaṣṭōpavāsaṅgeydirdoraṁ
bhaṭṭārarendarāmuṁ nōntirpevu nīmuṁ
carigevuguvudalteyendoḍe bhaṭṭārā ūrilla
kēriyillīyaḍaviyoḷellige carigevuguvudendoḍe
bhaṭṭārarendar kāntāra bhaikṣamembudāgamadoḷ
pēḻdudārānuṁ baṭṭevōpar bīḍaṁ biṭṭirdar
niṟisuvarappudaṟinde carigevuguvudendoḍe

antegeyvenendu dēvaraṁ bandisi carigevokkaḍaviyaṁ
toḻalvalliyondu marada poḻaloḷirdu māṇikada muttina
piṇḍugaṅkaṇamaṁ toṭṭa kaiyindaṁ ponna saṭṭugamaṁ
tīvi bhaikṣamaṁ piḍiyendu nīḍida kaiyanitane kaṇḍu
toḻaldalābhamāgi tammāvāsakke pōdoḍe bhaṭṭārar
nilevaṭṭudeyendu besagoṇḍoḍavaruṁ tamma kaṇḍudaṁ
pēḻdoḍe bēsaṟade divasakkaṁ carigevoguvudendu
bhaṭṭārar kalpisidoḍantegeyvamendu maṟudivasaṁ
carigevokkaḍaviyaṁ toḻalvalliyondu marada
carigevoguvudendu bhaṭṭārar kalpisidoḍantegeyvamendu
maṟudivasaṅkeḻage ponnamaḍakeyoḷ bōnamanoḍḍi
neṟeye toṭṭuṭṭu maṅgaḷavasadanaṅgoṇḍu divyastrī
bandu niṟisidoḍe intendarabbā nīnorvaḷeye
peṟarārumillintu risiyarkaḷge nilalāgadendu pēḻdu
tammirdeḍege vōdoḍe bhaṭṭārarintendar nilevaṭṭude
endu besagoṇḍoḍavarintendar orvaḷ divyastrī
sarvābharaṇabhūṣiteyondu marada keḻage bōnama
noḍḍirdidiraṁ bandu niṟisidoḍorvaḷe peṟarārumillendene
nillade bandemendoḍoḷḷikeydirendorintu
pattupavāsaṅgeydu pannondaneya divasadandu
carigevokkaḍaviyaṁ toḻalvannegaṁ piridondu poḻaluṁ
dhavaḷāraṅgaḷuṁ neleya māḍaṅgaḷuṁ sūḷegērigaḷuṁ
dēvālayaṅgaḷumāne kuduregaḷuṁ mānasara baruvumaṁ
pōgumaṁ kaṇḍinitu divasamīmaragaḷa giḍugaḷa
podaṟugaḷa maṟegaḷoḷī poḻalaṁ kaṇḍemillendu
manadoḷ bagedu poḻaloḷage carigevokkāgaḷorvaḷ
divyastrī parivārasahitamidiraṁ bandu niṟisi tanna
māḍakkoḍagoṇḍu pōgi kālaṅkarciyarcisi gurubhaktigeydu
vandisiyādamānuṁ bhaktiyindaṁ divyāhāramaṁ maguḻe
maguḻe baḍḍise carigemāḍi parasi tammāvāsakke pōdoḍe
bhaṭṭārar nilevaṭṭudeyendu besagoṇḍoḍe nilevaṭṭu
dendoḍelli nindirendu besagoṇḍoḍintendar bhaṭṭārā
initu divasaṁ maraṅgaḷa podaṟugaḷa maṟegaḷoḷī
poḻalaṁ kaṇḍemillindinisānuṁ tiṇṇaṁ toḻalvalli
piridondu poḻalaṁ kaṇḍu carigevokkoḍorvaḷ
divyastrī parivārasahitamidiraṁ bandu niṟisi tanna
manegoḍagoṇḍupōgi kālaṅkarciyarcisi gurubhaktigeydu
vandisiyādamānuṁ bhaktiyindaṁ divyāhāraṅgaḷaṁ baḍḍise
śramaṁ vōge carigemāḍi parasi bandemendu bhaṭṭārarge
pēḻdoḍoḷḷittāyittendu santōsambaṭṭirdarintu divasakkaṁ
poḻalge pōgi carige māḍuvaritta bhadrabāhubhaṭṭārar
munne tamma tapaṅgeyvandellā kālamumavamōdarya
carigemāḍi pasivaṁ sairisi tamma meyyaṁ kṣayakke
tandu saṁnyasanaṅgeydu palavu divasadindaṁ pasivuṁ
nīraḻkeyumaṁ sairisi śubhapariṇāmadindaṁ samyag darśana
jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi muḍipi brahmakalpadoḷ pattu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyoṁ amita kāntiyemboṁ
dēvanāgi puṭṭidoṁ

candraguptamuniyuṁ bhaṭṭārara nisidigeyaṁ bandisuttamā
dēvate besakeyye carige māḍi tapaṅgeyyuttaṁ panneraḍu
varuṣambaregamintirpannegamitta timuḻanāḻge vōda
r̥ṣisamudāyamellaṁ panneraḍu varuṣambaregaṁ
sukhadoḷirdu nirupasargadiṁ darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ
pratipāḷisi baḍaganāḍa pasavu tiḷidudembudanā nāḍindaṁ
bandar pēḻe kēḷdaṟidu bhaṭṭārara nisidigeyaṁ bandisi
pōpamendu viśākhācāryar modalāgoḍeya
r̥ṣisamudāyamellaṁ dakṣiṇāpathadindaṁ bandu
bhaṭṭārara nisidigeyaneydidāgaḷ candragupta muniyuṁ
risiyarkaḷa baravaṁ kaṇḍidiraṁ bandu r̥ṣi
samudāyamellamaṁ bandisidoḍe risiyarkaḷintendu
bagedarīyaḍaviyoḷinnegamivar kandamūlaphalaṅgaḷaṁ
tindu toṟeya paḷḷada nīrgaḷaṁ kuḍidu panneraḍu
varuṣambaregamentu bardorendu tammoḷ nuḍidu
mattaṁ talenavir beḷedudumaṁ kaṇḍārappoḍaṁ
prativandaneyaṁ koṭṭudilla mattā risiyarkaḷanibarumā
divasamupavāsaṅgeydarcisi kriyegeydu bhaṭṭārara nisidigeyaṁ
bandisiyā divasamalliye kendu maṟudivasaṁ pōpāgaḷ

candragupta munigaḷendar bhaṭārā ninne
baṭṭevandupavāsaṅgeydu sēdevaṭṭirindina divasamillirdu
carigevokku sēdeyanāṟisi nāḷe pōkendoḍe
bhaṭṭārarendarūrilla kēriyillelli carigevuguvamantu
kemmanēkemmaṁ tāṅgidapirendoḍe piridondu
poḻaluṇṭu nīmuṁ saṅklēśaṁ baḍadirindina
divasamirkendoḍanibarumendarindina divasamupavāsaṁ
geydappoḍamivarembudanimbukeyvamendirdoḍe
madhyāhnamappāgaḷ dēvaraṁ bandisavēḻdoḍanibaruṁ bandisi
candraguptamuniya baḻiyaṁ r̥ṣi samudāyamellaṁ
taguḷdu kiṟidantaramaṁ pōpannegaṁ piridondu
poḻalaṁ kaṇḍu carigevokkanibarumaṁ niṟisi kela
risiyarumācāryarkaḷuṁ berasu tāmondu maneyoḷ
nindarintanibaruṁ divyāhāraṅgaḷaṁ śramaṁ pōge
carigemāḍi tammāvāsakke bandu viśākhācāryarendar
brahmayyā kālaṅkarcal guṇḍigeyaṁ koṇḍubannimendoḍe
brahmayyanendaṁ guṇḍigeyanuṇḍa maneyoḷ maṟedu
bandenene bēgaṁ pōgi koṇḍu bāyene brahmayyaṁ
pōgi poḻaleḍeyaṁ kāṇadaḍaviyellamaṁ toḻaldu
nōḍi guṇḍigeyaṁ kāṇadattamittaṁ nōḻpannegamondu
marada tuttatudiyoḷirdeḻalva guṇḍigeyaṁ kaṇḍu
bandu gurugaḷgintendaṁ bhaṭṭārā nāmuṇḍeḍeyoḷā
poḻalilla nammuṇḍa maneyumilla guṇḍigeyumondu
niḍiya marada tuttatudiyoḷirdudārānumēṟal
balloranaṭṭugendoḍanibaruṁ risiyarkaḷellaṁ cōdyambaṭṭu
nōḍalpōgi poḻalaṁ kāṇadaḍaviyoḷ niḍiya
marada tuttatudiyoḷirdeḻalva guṇḍigeyaṁ kaṇḍu
tegeyisikoṇḍu pōgi candraguptamuniyananibaruṁ
risiyarkaḷ neredintendarāmuṁ nimmanīyaḍaviyoḷ
kandamūlaphalaṅgaḷaṁ tindu paḷḷada nīraṁ kuḍidu initu
kālaṁ bardirendu nimmaṁ bagedu bandisidemillidarke nīmuṁ
manadoḷēvaṅgoḷḷade kṣamiyisimendu nuḍidu vandisi
mattamintendar nīmuṁ dēvatādhiṣṭhitarir nimage dēvategaḷ
besakeyvuvu dēvategaḷ māḍidāhāramaṁ nīminnegamuṇḍu
tapaṅgeydirinnuṇalvēḍa dēvategaḷa māḍidāhāramaṁ
risiyarge carige māḍalāgadendu bārisiyavarge
lōcugeydu brataṅgaḷanēṟisi paḍikamaṇambēḻdoḍa
goṇḍuttarāpathakke payaṇambōgi katipaya divasaṅgaḷindaṁ
madhyadēśamaneydiyā nāḍoḷ r̥ṣisamudāyamellaṁ
nirupasargamirdattu

mattitta rāmilācāryaruṁ sthūlācāryaruṁ
sthūlabhadrācāryarumantu mūvaruṁ sindhu viṣayakke
tantamma r̥ṣisamudāyaṁ berasu pōdoḍā nāḍoḷ
mānasar mānasaraṁ timbantuṭappa mahāghōraṁ
pasavādoḍalliya śrāvakarellaṁ neredu risiyarallige vōgi
intendar bhaṭārā lavaṭugaḷa kaiyal pagaluṇalumaḍaluṁ
peṟalāga mēlvāydeḻedu koṇḍumbar lōgarellamavara
bhayakke pagalaḍugeyaṁ bisuṭṭiruḷaṭṭuṇal taguḷdaradaṟiṁ
nīmumindittiruḷ bhaikṣabhājanaṅgaḷaṁ koṇḍu pōgi śrāvakara
manegaḷaṁ toḻaldu bhaikṣaṁ bēḍikoṇḍu kūḻaniruḷ tandiṭṭu
pagaluṇbudendoḍantegeyvamendu iruḷ toḻaldu bhaikṣamaṁ
tandu maḍagiṭṭu pagaluṇborādarintī pāṅginoḷ kālaṁ
sale mattondu divasamorva nirggranthayati bhaikṣabhājanamaṁ
koṇḍu śrāvakara manegaḷaniruḷ bhaikṣaṁ bēḍi toḻaluttaṁ
pōparondu maneyaṁ pokku bhaikṣamaṁ bēḍidoḍorvaḷ
posa śrāvaki basirppeṇḍati vēḷāsvāminiyemboḷ
kardiṅgaḷiruḷoḷ kaḻtaleyoḷ nirggranthamappa rūpaṁ kaṇḍu
bercidoḍākege basiṟiḻidattadaṁ kaṇḍu śrāvakarellaṁ neredu
risiyarallige vōgi intendar bhaṭṭārā kālamappoḍe
keṭṭatoḷḷittappa kālamādandu prāyaścittaṅgoṇḍu nimma
tapaṅgaḷoḷ nillimīgaḷī pasavu kaḻivannegaṁ nīmumeḍada
kaiyaneḻalikkiyarddhagappaḍamaneḍada muypinamēgikki
oḷage nirggranthamappa rūpaṁ tāḷdi balada kaiyoḷ bhaikṣada
bhājanamaṁ piḍidu toḻaldu bhaikṣamaṁ bēḍi maḍagiṭṭu
pagaluṇṇimendoḍavargaḷumantegeyvemendavara pēḻda
pāṅginoḷ negaḻdu pasivaṁ nīgi

kālamoḷḷittādoḍe rāmilācāryaruṁ sthūlācāryaruṁ
sthūlabhadrācāryarumantu mūvaruṁ tantamma
r̥ṣisamudāyaṁ berasu vihārisuttaṁ madhyadēśakke
risiyarkaḷirdallige bandoḍe viśākhācāryar
modalāgoḍeya ācāryarkaḷavaranintendar
nīmellamardhagappaḍamaṁ bisuṭṭu nirggrantharūpumaṁ kaikoṇḍu
brataṅgaḷanēṟisi prāyaścittaṅgoṇḍu paḍikamaṇaṅgēḷdu
tapadoḷ nillimendoḍantegeyvemendu rāmilācāryaruṁ
sthūlācāryaruṁ tantamma r̥ṣisamudāyaṁ berasu
viśākhācāryara pakkade ardhagappaḍamaṁ bisuṭṭu
paḍikamaṇaṅgēḷdu prāyaścittaṅgoṇḍu yathōktamappa
cāritradoḷ nindar sthūlabhadrācāryar modalāgi
kelambar koḷalolladavar jinakalpaṁ sthavirakalpamenderaḍu
bhēdaṁ māḍi ardhagappaḍada tīrthamaṁ negaḻcidar

intardhagappaḍada tīrtha pāramparyadindaṁ
surathamembudu nāḍalli vaḷabhiyembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
vaprapāḷanembonarasana rājyambaregamardhagappaḍada tīrthaṁ
negaḻdattu mattaṁ vaprapāḷanembarasaṁ mithyādr̥ṣṭiyātana
mahādēvi svāminiyemboḷardhagappaḍada tīrthada
tapasviyara śrāvakiyāgi intu kālaṁsale mattondu
divasaṁ naḍuvagalarasanuṁ mahādēviyumintirvaruṁ
prāsādada mēgirdu gavākṣa jāḷāntaraṅgaḷindaṁ
diśāvalōkanaṁ geyyuttirpannegamardhagappaḍada saṅghaṁ
bhaikṣaṁ kāraṇamāgiyaramaneyaṁ puguvudanarasaṁ
kaṇḍarasiyanintendanele mahādēvi ī ninnardhagappaḍada
yatiyara dharmamoḷḷitaltivaruṭṭarumallar
battalegarumallarendu nuḍidu mattondu divasamardhagappaḍada
saṅghamanarasaṁ baḻiyaṭṭi varisi intendaṁ nīmardha
gappaḍamaṁ bisuṭṭu nirggranthamappa risirūpaṁ kaikoṇḍu
baḻiye tapaṅgeyvudendoḍavarolladirdoḍarasaṁ
mattamintendaṁ nirggranthamappa rūpaṁ kaikoḷalollirappoḍardha
gappaḍamaṁ bisuṭṭu paḻiyaṁ saytuṭṭukoṇḍirimendoḍante
geyvemendā divasaṁ taguḷdu baḍaganāḍavar vaprapāḷana
rājyadoḷardhagappaḍamaṁ bisuṭṭu kaccegaṭṭade saytuḍuvaruṁ
kuṟivaḍavaṁ podevarumādorallinditta kambaḷa
tīrthavembudādudavaruṁ śvētapaṭaremborādar
dakṣiṇāpathadoḷ sāmaḷiputranembarasanappanavaraye santatiya
śvētabhikṣu jāpuli saṅghakke modaliganādaṁ

mattitta samprati candraguptamuniyumugrōgra tapaścaraṇaṅgeydu
saṁnyasanavidhānadindaṁ paramaśuddhasahaja ratnatrayamaṁ
sādhisi muḍipi brahmakalpadoḷ pattu sāgarōpa
māyuṣyamanoḍeyoṁ śrīdharanemboṁ dēvanāgi
puṭṭidonintidu bhadrabāhubhaṭārara kathe pēḻdudu

peṟaruṁ saṁnyasanaṅgeydorellaṁ bhadrabāhubhaṭārakara manade
bagedavarentu pasivu nīraḻke śītamuṣṇa daṁsamasakādi
parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ sairisi parama śuddha ratnatrayamaṁ sādhisidarante
saṁnyasanaṅgeyda bhavyarkaḷuṁ pasivuṁ nīraḻke modalāgoḍeya
parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ sairisi samādhimaraṇadiṁ muḍipi
paramaśuddhasahaja ratnatrayaṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi svargāpavarga
sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: lalitaghaṭeya kathe
div.p: lalitaghaṭeya katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ

lg.l: kōsambī lalitaghaṭā ōḍhā ṇadīe pūrēṇa tivvēṇa

div.ab:
kōsambī – kauśambiyemba poḻaloḷ , lalitaghaṭā
– lalitaghaṭe, ōḍhā – eḻeyepaṭṭattu, ṇadīe pūrēṇa
– toṟeya pūradindaṁ, tivvēṇa - ādamānuṁ
kaḍidappudaṟindaṁ, ārādhaṇaṁ – nijātmārādhaneyaṁ, pavaṇṇā
– pordittu, pāōvagayā – prāyōpagamanakke sandudāgi,
amūḍamadī – mōhisada buddhiyanoḍeyadu
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambū dvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷ vatseyembudu
nāḍalli kauśambiyembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
haridhvajanembonarasanātana mahādēvi vāruṇi
yemboḷāyirvarggaṁ makkaḷ śrīvardhanaṁ vijayandharaṁ
vīrabāhu modalāgi mūvattirvar kumāraruṁ
sāmanta mahāsāmantara makkaḷumantellamaynūrvaruṁ
rūpinoḷaṁ tējadoḷaṁ yauvanadoḷaṁ śrīyoḷaṁ
tammoḷōrannarapparadaṟiṁ lalitaghaṭeyemboranibaruṁ
mithyādr̥ṣṭigaḷ paṇḍitarum

ondu divasaṁ śrīkāntamemba parvatadaḍaviganibaruṁ
bēṇṭeyāḍal pōdalli irdorabhayaghōṣaremba
bhaṭāraravarggabhayaghōṣaremba pesarentādudendoḍavar
garbhadoḷirdante avara tāyge jīvaṅgaḷaṁ kolladantappa
bayakeyāgi abhayaghōṣaṇeyaṁ poḻaloḷaṁ
nāḍoḷaṁ poysi jīvaṅgaḷgabhayadānaṅgoṭṭu
puṭṭidarappudaṟindavarggabhayaghōṣaremba pesarādudantappa
bhaṭṭāraraḍaviyoḷire avara tapōmāhātmyadiṁ
lalitaghaṭegondu migamappoḍaṁ bēṇṭe samanisade
poḻalgevōdorintēḻu divasamuṁ biḍadaḍavige
bēṇṭeyāḍal pōgi ondu mr̥gamappoḍaṁ samanisade
bēsattaḻaldu poḻalgevōgi eṇṭaneya divasadandu
śrīkāntamemba parvatadaḍavige lalitaghaṭe bēṇṭe
yāḍal pōgi aḍaviyoḷ mr̥gaṅgaḷanaṟasuttaṁ
toḻalvarannegamabhayaghōṣa bhaṭārarāyatiyiṁ toṭṭane
sarvāṅga maladhārigaḷondu śilātaḷada mēgirdāgamamaṁ
pariviḍigeyyuttumarthamaṁ bhāvisuttaṁ svādhyāyadoḷ
taguḷdirdoraṁ sañchannamappaḍaviya maṟeyoḷ geṇṭaṟindaṁ
lalitaghaṭe kaṇḍapūrvamidondu kariya mr̥gamirdudendu
bagedu śrīvardhanakumāraṁ modalāganibaruṁ bilgaḷanēṟisi
tiruvāyoḷambaniṭṭisalendu tegedisuvannegamanibara bilgaḷuṁ
muṟidudavarggaḷanibaruṁ peṟagaṇguruḷdu biḻdoḍidu
mahācōdyaṁ sāre pōgi nōḻpamendu pōparannegaṁ
r̥ṣiyara rūpaṁ kaṇḍivar r̥ṣiyar mr̥gamaltendu
sāre pōgi avarupaśamumaṁ tapamumaṁ kaṇḍa
nibarggupaśamamāgi kuḷḷirdu dharmamaṁ pēḻiṁ bhaṭṭārā
endu besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭṭārarintendu pēḻal toḍagidar

lg.l:
sō dhammō jattha dayā sō vi taō visayaṇiggahō
jattha

div.p:
endintu jīvaṅgaḷaṁ kolladude dharmaṁ bāhyābhyantara
parigrahaṅgaḷaṁ toṟedaydumindriyaṅgaḷaṁ geldu irppatteraḍu
parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ sairisi yama niyama svādhyāya dhyānānuṣṭhāna
parāyaṇarāgi tapaṅgeyva risiyarkaḷe tapasviyar pasivu
