nīraḻke modalāgoḍeya padineṇṭu dōṣaṅgaḷanilladoṁ
paramātmanendintu pēḻdu mattamintendar

lg.l:
pāvēṇa ṇirayatiriyaṁ gammai dhammēṇa dēvalōgaṁ
tu
missēṇa māṇusattaṁ doṇhaṁ pi khayēṇa ṇivvāṇaṁ

div.p:
embudaṁ pāpaṅgeydavaruṁ bēṇṭeyāḍuvaruṁ
madhumadyamāṁsaṅgaḷaṁ sēvisuvaruṁ
bālavadhe strīvadhe gōvadhe brāhmaṇavadhe
r̥ṣivadheyendī pañcamahāpātakaṅgaḷaṁ
geydavarumagamyāgamanapēyāpēyamabhakṣyābhakṣyaṁ
modalāgoḍeya pollamegaḷoḷ negaḻdu ghōramuṁ
piriyavumappa pāpaṅgaḷaṁ geydēḻaneya narakadoḷ
mūvattumūṟu sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyar
nārakarāgi puṭṭi chēdana bhēdana pūraṇa cūraṇa pīḍana
bandhanaṅgaḷumaṁ muṭṭigeyoḷiṭṭu tegapuvuduṁ
kontaṅgaḷindamiṭṭigaḷindaṁ karuḷgaḷaṁ sōre kuttuvuduṁ
cakraṅgaḷindaṁ tegaleyaṁ mokkanevōgiḍuvuduṁ maraṅgaḷaṁ
pōḻvante karagasaṅgaḷindamuddaṁ piḍidu pōḻvudumendivu
modalāgoḍeya duḥkhaṅgaḷaṁ kaṇṇemeyikkuvanitu
poḻtappoḍamusir pattillade duḥkhaṅgaḷananubhavisuvar
mattoyyane pāpaṅgaḷaṁ geydavarāneyuṁ siṁhamuṁ
puliyuṁ karaḍiyuṁ pulleyuṁ molanuṁ pandiyuṁ
tōḷanuṁ sīrnāyuṁ mattameḻtu kaḻteyuṁ
paśuvumermeyuṁ kudure nāyoṭṭeyumuḍuvuṁ
pāvumiliyuṁ berkumontiyuṁ kappeyuṁ muṅguriyuṁ
modalāgoḍeya sthalacaraṅgaḷuṁ mīnuṁ mosaḷeyuṁ
negaḻumāmeyuṁ makaramuṁ timitimiṅgiḷaṁ modalā
goḍeya jalacaraṅgaḷuṁ kāge gūge pardu cakōraṁ haṁse
kurku giḷi puruḷi peṅguru kāraṇḍamānde modalāgoḍeya
gaganacaraṁ pañcēndriyaṅgaḷumāgi mattamēkēndriya
dvīndriya trīndriya caturindriyaṅgaḷāgi tirikagatiyoḷ
puṭṭi jīvaṅgaḷintu māḍida pāpada phalaṅgaḷindaṁ
duḥkhaṅgaḷaneyduguṁ

vākyamissēṇa māṇusattamembudu
puṇyapāpaṅgaḷeraḍumaṁ negaḻvar manuṣyagatiyoḷ puṭṭi
muṅgey pāpakarmadudayadindaṁ śārīra mānasāgantuka
sahajamappa duḥkhaṅgaḷumaniṣṭa saṁyōgamiṣṭa
viyōgamuṁ rāgaśōkaṅgaḷuṁ dāridryamendivu
modalāgoḍeyavaṟindamappa duḥkhaṅgaḷaneydi mattamā
jīvaṅgaḷ śubhakarmadudayadindaṁ śrīyuṁ sampattuṁ
vibhavamuṁ aiśvaryamumārōgyaśarīraṅgaḷumāgi
putra mitra kaḷatra svajana bandhuvargadoḷ kūḍi sukhaṁ
bāḻvudumakkumintu

lg.l: cakravat parivartantē duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca

div.p:
intu manuṣyagatiyoḷ puṭṭi sūḻ sūḻoḷe
sukhaduḥkhaṅgaḷaṁ jīvaṅgaḷanubhavisugum

ante gammaña dhammēṇa dēvaḷōyamhi embuduṁ kēvaḷame
dharmaṅgeydavar saudharma īśāna sanatkumāra māhēnd
brahma brahmōttara lāntava kāpiṣṭha śukra mahāśukra śatāra
sahasrāra ānata prāṇatāraṇācyutamemba padināṟuṁ
kalpaṅgaḷoḷamalliṁ mēgaṇa sudarśanāmōgha suprabuddha
yaśōdhara subhadra suviśāḷa sumanasa saumanasa
prītiṅkaramemba navagraievēyakaṅgaḷoḷamalliṁ mēgaṇa lacchi
mahālacchi māḷini vaire vairōcane sōme sōmarūpe
aṅke paḷike ayiccheyemba navānuddisegaḷoḷamalliṁ mēgaṇa
vijaya vaijayanta jayantāparājita sarvārthasiddhiyendintu
pañcāṇuttaregaḷoḷameraḍu ghaḷigeyindoḷage pāsina
poreyoḷ puṭṭi indrapratīndra sāmānikatrayastriṁśa
pāriṣadātmarakṣa lōkapālāhamindratvamendī mahardhika
dēvarāgi aṇimā mahimā laghimā prāpti prāgalbhyamīśit
vaśitva kāmarūpitvamendī aṣṭa guṇaiśvaryaṅgaḷoḷ
kūḍi atyanta rūpa lāvaṇya saubhāgya kāntitvamuṁ
sugandhamappa śvāsaniśvāsaṅgaḷumanoḍeyarāgi
āyuṣyāntambaregaṁ navayauvanarāgi muppumapamr̥tyu
mūtra purīṣaṅgaḷuṁ gaṇḍakakṣā kukṣipradēśaṅgaḷa
rōmaṅgaḷuṁ rōga śōka duḥkhaṅgaḷuṁ rasa
rudhira māṁsa mēdōsthi majja śuklamendintu
saptadhātugaḷumendivu modalāgoḍeyavillador
sahajamappa kaṭaka kaṭisūtra kuṇḍalābharaṇaṁ
modalāgoḍeya padināṟumābharaṇaṅgaḷaṁ toṭṭu
divyavastraṅgaḷanuṭṭādityana tējadindaggaḷamappa tējadorāgi
kaṇṇemeyikkuvanitu poḻtappoḍaṁ duḥkhamilladoreraḍu
sāgarōpamaṁ modalāgi mūvattumūṟu
sāgarōpamambaregamāyuṣyamanoḍeyarāgi āṭa pāṭa
vinōdaṅgaḷindaṁ dēviyarapsarasiyarkaḷoḍane palakālaṁ
divyasukhamananubhavisi

āyuṣyāntadoḷintilli manuṣyagatiyoḷ kuruvaṁśa
bhōjavaṁśamikṣvākuvaṁśa nāthavaṁśa harivaṁśamugravaṁśaṁ
sūryavaṁśa sōmavaṁśa mayūravaṁśa nandavaṁśamendivu
modalāgoḍeya uttamakuladoḷ śrāvakara basiṟoḷ puṭṭi
pūrvakōṭi paramāyuṣyamanoḍeyarāgi atyanta rūpa
lāvaṇya saubhāgya kāntitvadoḷ kūḍi ēkacchatracchāyeyindaṁ
pr̥thviyellamanāḷdu paścātkāladoḷēnānumondu vairāgya
kāraṇamāgi magaṅge rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi bāhyābhyantara
parigrahaṅgaḷellamaṁ toṟedellaroḷ niśśalyaṅgeydu
tapambaṭṭu ghōravīratapaścaraṇaṁ geydu utkr̥ṣṭadindaṁ
mūṟu bhavaṅgaḷoḷ madhyamadindamaydu bhavaṅgaḷoḷ
kaniṣṭhadindēḻu bhavaṅgaḷoḷage aṣṭavidha karmaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisi
mōkṣamaneyduvar

doṇhampi khayēṇa ṇivvāṇaṁ endu tapadindaṁ
śubhāśubhakarmamendirteṟada karmada kēḍinindaṁ
mōkṣamaneyduvarantappa mōkṣamentendoḍe
jāti jarāmaraṇaṅgaḷuṁ bhayamumaniṣṭa
saṁyōgamumiṣṭaviyōgamuṁ śārīra
mānasāgantuka sahajamappa duḥkhaṅgaḷuṁ āhāra bhaya
maithuna parigrahaṅgaḷuṁ vāta pitta ślēṣma khāsa śvāsa
jvarāruci chardyatisārākṣi kukṣivēdanāsphōṭaka śūla
bhagandara kuṣṭha kṣaya gaṇḍa śirōvēdaneyumendivu
modalāgoḍeya aydu kōṭiyumaṟuvatteṇṭu
lakkeyuṁ tombattombay sāsirada innūṟeṇbattu
nālku vyādhigaḷuṁ krōdha māna māyā lōbhaṅgaḷuṁ
rāgadvēṣa mōhaṅgaḷa maguḻdu maguḻdu baravuṁ
śōkamendivu modalāgoḍeya duḥkhaṅgaḷavilladuda
nupamārahitamappudanaḷaviyilladudanāvakālamuṁ
kiḍadudaṁ pāpadiṁ poreyadudaṁ sukhamanoḍetappudaṁ
tanniṁ tānādudanantappa mōkṣasukhamaneydi anantajñāna
anantadarśana anantavīrya anantasukhamemba ananta
catuṣṭayadoḷ kūḍi lōkālōkamanellamanormmodale
kāṇuttamaṟiyuttumanantakālaṁ
mōkṣadoḷirparembudumaṁ

abhayaghōṣa bhaṭārar lalitaghaṭege dharmaśravaṇaṅgeyye
kēḷdu śrīvardhanaṁ modalāgi anibaruṁ paścāttāpamāge
pañcamahāpātakaremuṁ pollakeydemuṁ bhaṭṭāraraṁ
kondemumavar tapada mahātmyadindaṁ
barduṅkidarendanibaruṁ manade bagedī geyda pāpamintallade
piṅgadivara kālaḍigaḷanemma talegaḷemba tāmareya
pūgaḷindarcisidoḍallade pāpaṁ piṅgadendu bagedu
kaidugaḷatta kaiyaṁ nīḍal bagevannegaṁ bhaṭṭārar vārisidarantu
bageyalvēḍendoḍe śrīvardhana kumāranāmēnaṁ
bagedomendoḍe nīmuṁ nimma talegaḷanaridemma
kālaḍigaḷanarcisuvamendu bagedirendoḍintu manade
bagedudanārānumaṟivaroḷare endanibaruṁ cōdyambaṭṭu
bhaṭṭārarggeṟagi poḍevaṭṭu śrīvardhana kumāranendaṁ bhaṭṭārā
nimmaḍiyanemma talegaḷindarcisadāgaḷemma geyda pāpamentu
kiḍugumendoḍā pāṅginiṁ kiḍadeneyantappoḍe dīkṣeyaṁ
dayegeyyimendoḍe bhaṭārarendoroḷḷittaṁ bagedir
nimagellargaṁ kiṟideyāyuṣyamendoḍe
śrīvardhana kumārana tammaṁ mūvattirvariṁ kiṟiyoṁ
nandimitranemboṁ bhaṭārara mātaṁ kēḷdu nakkintendanāmellaṁ
kūsugaḷemuṁ navayauvanaremuṁ tējadoḷaṁ
satvadoḷaṁ balaparākramadoḷaṁ kūḍidememagellorggaṁ
kiṟideyāyuṣyamembudanentu nambalakkumendoḍe
bhaṭārarendar nīnēke nakkappeyammā nimagellarggamirppattondu
divasamāyuṣyaṁ nīradeseyindaṁ nimage sāvakkumendoḍe
śrīvardhana kumāranendaṁ bhaṭārā emagirppattondu
divasamāyuṣyamembudarke sābhijñānamēnendu
besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭārarendar nīmīgaḷ poḻalge
pōpāgaḷ nimageraḻkāḷiṅga nāgaṅgaḷ peḍegaḷanetti
nālagegaḷaṁ poḷeyisuttaṁ bandoḍe nīmodaṟiyavaṁ
baggisidoḍadr̥śyaṅgaḷāgi pōkumidondu sābhijñānaṁ
mattante pōpāgaḷondu kiṟugūsu kōlaṁ piḍidu
nimmaṁ baḍiyalkendu bandoḍadaṟa keytamaṁ kaṇḍu
nīmuṁ nakkoḍe nimma nōḍe nōḍe bhayaṅkaramappa
piridondu bētāḷarūpaṁ kaikoṇḍākāśambaregaṁ baḷeda
dr̥śyamakkumidondu sābhijñānaṁ mattante pōpannegaṁ toṟe
tīvugumidondu sābhijñānaṁ mattamindiniruḷ nimma tāy
nimma mūvattirvarumaṁ rākṣasaṁ nuṅgi timbudaṁ kanasugaṇḍu
pēḻgumidondu sābhijñānamendu pēḻdoḍe

anibaruṁ bhaṭāraraṁ bandisi tamma poḻalgevōpāgaḷ
bhaṭārar pēḻdudellamaṁ pēḻda pāṅginoḷe baṭṭeyoḷ
pōguttuṁ kaṇḍu pratyakṣamāgi mattiruḷ tamma
mūvattirvarumaṁ rākṣasaṁ nuṅgidudaṁ tāy
kanasugaṇḍudaṁ tamage nēsarmūḍe pēḻdoḍe
nambugeyāgi ubbegambaṭṭintirpannegaṁ vardhamāna bhaṭṭārara
tīrthaṁ vihārisuttaṁ kauśambige vandoḍe lalitaghaṭe
piridarcaneyaṁ koṇḍupōgi bhaṭāraranarcisi bandisi
dharmaśravaṇānantaramintendu vardhamāna bhaṭṭāraraṁ
besagoṇḍaṁ bhaṭārā emagāyuṣyamenituṇṭendu
besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭārarendar nimaganibargaṁ kiṟide
āyuṣyamendu pēḻdoḍāmēno bhavyaremo abhavyaremo
endu besagoṇḍoḍe nīmellaṁ bhavyarir bhavyarirādoḍaṁ
parama śuddha sahaja darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu
negaḻdoḍallade mōkṣamāgadentu svarṇapāṣāṇadoḷ
suvarṇamuṇṭāgiyuṁ dahana tāpana piṇḍibaddhanādi
kriyeveṟadannegaṁ ponnāgadante tapadindallade
mōkṣamāgadendu pēḻdoḍe

anibaruṁ vardhamāna bhaṭṭārargge śiṣyarāgi tapambaṭṭu
pañcamahāvrataṅgaḷanēṟisikoṇḍu prāyōpagamanada
maraṇada vidhānamaṁ besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭārarintendu pēḻdar

lg.l: sthitasya vā niṣaṇṇasya yāvat suptasya vā punaḥ

div.p:
intuṭā prāyōpagamanada lakṣaṇamendu bhaṭārar
vakkhāṇisi pēḻe kēḷdaṟidu lalitaghaṭeyanibaruṁ bhaṭārara
pakkade caturvidhamappāhāramuṁ śarīramuṁ yāvajjīvaṁ
toṟedu bhaṭāraraṁ bandisi pōgi viśāḷeyemba
toṟeya taḍiyoḷanibarumēkapārśvadoḷ paṭṭirdu
kaiyuṁ kālumanāḍisadondu keladindondu kelakke
maguḻade kuḷḷirade nindirade nuḍiyade kelaṅgaḷaṁ
nōḍadintu prāyōpagamanaṅgeyda padinaydu divasaṁ
meyyaṁ toṟedirdorannegaṁ mēge piridondu
maḻe koṇḍu pūraṁ bandavaraneḻedukoṇḍu pōgi
piridondu maḍuvinoḷikkidoḍe nīroḷagirdu
mōhisada buddhiyanoḍeyarāgi dēvaraṁ jānisuttaṁ
pañcanamaskāramaṁ manadoḷuccārisuttaṁ śubhadhyāna
doḷ pariṇatarāgi darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷanārādhisi
muḍipi aynūrvaruṁ vaijayantamemba
pañcāṇuttareyoḷutkr̥ṣṭamappa mūvattumūṟusāgarōpa
māyuṣyamanoḍeyorēkahastapramāṇa
śvētavarṇadoḷahamindradēvarāgi puṭṭidar

matte peṟaruṁ ratnatrayaṅgaḷanārādhisuvārādhakarkaḷuṁ
lalitaghaṭeyaṁ manadoḷ bagedu caturvidhamappupasargamaṁ
pasivuṁ nīraḻke modalāgoḍeyavirppatteraḍu
parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ sairisi śubhapariṇāmadiṁ samyag darśana jñāna
cāritraṅgaḷanārādhisi svargāpavarga sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: dharmaghōṣa bhaṭārara kathe
div.p: dharmaghōṣa bhaṭārara katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ
div.ab:
campāe – campeyemba poḻaloḷ , māsakhavaṇaṁ
karittu – māsōpavāsaṁ geydu, gaṅgātaṭamhi –
gaṅgāmahānadiya taḍiyoḷ , taṇhāe – nīraḻkeyindaṁ,
ghōrāe – ādamānuṁ kaḍidappudaṟindaṁ, dhammaghōsō
– dharmaghōṣanemba bhaṭṭārakaṁ, paḍivaṇṇō – pordidoṁ,
uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ – mikka darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷārādhaneyaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷ kauśambiyembudu
nāḍalli vāraṇāsiyembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
kīrtidharanembonarasanātana mahādēviyarkaḷ arati
ratiyemborā irvarggaṁ makkaḷ dharmaghōṣanuṁ
dharmakīrtiyumemborantavargaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttirpannegaṁ mattondu divasaṁ grāma
nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba pattana drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ barporā vāraṇāsige vandu
bahirudyānavanadoḷ sphaṭika śilātalada mēge panthāticāra
niyamaṅgeydir guṇōttamaremba bhaṭāraraṁ vanakrīḍegevōda
dharmaghōṣanuṁ dharmakīrti kumāranuṁ kaṇḍu bandisi
bhaṭārā emage dharmamaṁ pēḻimendoḍe bhaṭārarintendu
dharmamaṁ pēḻdar

lg.l:
kō dharma pravarō dayātmasubhagaḥ kaḥ syānnaraḥ
paṇḍitaḥ
kiṁ saukhyaṁ bhuvi śāstravācanamatiḥ kāvā gatirnivvr̥tiḥ
yēṣāṁ na vidyā na tapō na dānaṁ
krimayaḥ kiṁ na jīvanti bhakṣayitvā parasparaṁ
narakō gamyatē yēna tatkarma na samācarēt

div.p: intu saṅkṣēpadiṁ bhaṭārar dharmamaṁ pēḻe

kēḷdirvvarggaṁ vairāgyamāgi tāyuṁ tandeyuṁ svajana
bandhuvargamumaṁ biḍisi niśśalyaṁ geydu bāhyābhyantara
parigrahaṅgaḷaṁ toṟedu guṇōttama bhaṭārara pakkade
tapambaṭṭu panneraḍu varṣambaregaṁ gurugaḷoḍanirdu
prathamānuyōga caraṇānuyōga karaṇānuyōga
dravyānuyōgaṅgaḷaṁ kaltu śāstrapāragarāgi bhaṭāraraṁ
besagoṇḍavaranumatadindirvaruṁ bēṟevēṟe vihārisal
taguḷdu grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba pattana
drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ campānagarakke pōgi
tāmaregoḷada taḍiya maṟeyoḷirvaruṁ māsōpa
vāsaṅgeydu pāraṇeya divasadandu campānagarada
śrāvakarkaḷellaṁ namma nōntudanaṟivaradu kāraṇadiṁ
namage pāraṇeyaṁ māḻpāgaḷayathākarmada dōṣaṁ
sārtarkumadaṟiṁ nāmilli carigevugade gaṅgeya taḍiyoḷirda
tuṟupaṭṭige pōpamendirvaruṁ pōpar annegamā
tuṟupaṭṭiyumallinderdu nāḍe geṇṭu pōdattu

pōdoḍe dharmakīrti bhaṭārar peṟatondu tuṟupaṭṭige
pōdar dharmaghōṣa bhaṭārar pōgalāṟade gaṅgeya
taḍiya marada keḻage pasivu nīraḻkeyiṁ sēdegeṭṭu
basamaḻidirdoraṁ gaṅgādēvate kaṇḍanukampeyuṁ
bhaktiyuṁ kāraṇamāgi sarvābharaṇabhūṣiteyāgi divyamappa
śvētavastramanuṭṭu suvarṇamayamappa piriya karagamaṁ
tekkane tīvi taṇṇidavuṁ sugandhamappa nīrgaḷaṁ tandu
dharmaghōṣa bhaṭāraranintendaḷ bhaṭārā prāsukamappa
nīraṁ poḻtadoḷ bandudaṁ kuḍidu nimma sēdeyanāṟisiṁ
nimagaramanege pōgi kūḻaṁ tandapenannevaraṁ nīraṁ
kuḍidu tr̥ṣeyaṁ piṅgisuvudendoḍe bhaṭārarāmollevabbā
kuḍiyalkāgadendoḍe

gaṅgādēvate pūrvavidēhakke pōgi sīmandhara tīrthaṅkara
paramadēvaraṁ kaṇḍu bandisi intendu besagoṇḍaḷ
bhaṭārā orvar r̥ṣiyar nīraḻkeyindaṁ karaṁ sēdegeṭṭu
basamaḻidirdoraṁ kaṇḍu piridondu ponnakaragamaṁ
tekkane tīviyādamānuṁ taṇṇiduvuṁ kammiduvumappa
nīrgaḷaṁ poḻtadoḷ koṇḍu pōgi kuḍiyaleṟeye
koḷdarillendoḍe bhaṭārarendar prāsukamādoḍaṁ
poḻtadoḷ tandoḍaṁ dēvarkkaḷa dēviyarkaḷa kaiyoḷ
r̥ṣiyarkkaḷguṇaluṁ kuḍiyaluṁ tagadu nimage samyaktvamuṁ
pūjeyuṁ r̥ṣiyarkaḷge prātihāryamaṅgeyvuduṁ
nimmabhiprāyaminiteyendu pēḻdoḍe tīrthaṅkara parama
dēvara mātaṁ kēḷdu bēgaṁ gaṅgādēvate dharmaghōṣa
bhaṭārargge taṇṇitappa gāḷiyuṁ sugandha jalavarṣamumaṁ
māḍidoḍāpyāyanamāgi śukladhyānamaṁ dhyānisi
ghātikarmaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisi kēvala jñāniyādoḍe caturvidha
mappa dēvanikāyaṁ bandarcisi pūjisi pōdoḍavaruṁ
baḻikkaghātikarmaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisi mōkṣakke vōdar

mattamavariṁ kiṟiyar dharmakīrti bhaṭārar peṟatondu
tuṟupaṭṭige pōdoḍā tuṟupaṭṭiyumallinderdu
peṟatondu desege nāḍe geṇṭupōdoḍe nirāśeyāgi
pasivuṁ nīraḻkeyindaṁ bādhise paṭṭorāgi sēdegeṭṭu
basamaḻidu śubhapariṇāmakke sandoraṁ munnina dēvate
kaṇḍaṟidu pratibōdhisal taguḷdavaraṁ tiḷipalāṟade matte
pūrvavidēhakke pōgi sīmandhara tīrthakara paramasvāmiyaṁ
kaṇḍu poḍevaṭṭu avara samāvastheyellamaṁ bhaṭārargge
pēḻdu samādhi sandhānōpāyamaṁ besagoṇḍoḍe
sarvajñarintendu pēḻdarāsannabhavyar mūṟaneya bhavadoḷ
mōkṣakkevōparendu sīmandhara tīrthaṅkara parama dēvar
pēḻdarembudaṁ kēḷdāgaḍe aśubhapariṇāmamaṁ toṟedu
nīgi śubhapariṇāmadoḷ kūḍi samādhiyanoḍeyarappar
nīṁ bēgampōgi pratibōdhisendu pēḻdoḍe
gaṅgādēvateyantegeyvenendu poḍevaṭṭu pōgi ā
risiyaraneydi intendaḷ bhaṭārā nīmī bhavadiṁ toṭṭu
mūṟaneya bhavadoḷ karmakṣayaṅgeydu kēvaḷa jñāniyāgi
mōkṣakke vōdapirendu sīmandhara tīrthakara paramadēvar
pēḻdarendoḍā mātaṁ dharmakīrti bhaṭārar kēḷdu
unmārgadindaṁ manamanuḍugi sanmārgadoḷ niṟisi

lg.l:
hā duṭṭhu kayaṁ hā duṭṭhu kāriyaṁ hā duṭṭhu
aṇumōdiyaṁ
jīvō antō antō dajjhai pacchattāvēṇa vēvantō

div.p: endu

polladaṁ bagedenendu tannaṁ tāṁ paḻiyuttaṁ sīmandhara
svāmigaḷa nāmagrahaṇaṅgoṇḍāgaḷaśubhapariṇāmadiṁ piṅgi
śubhaśuddha pariṇāmadoḷ kūḍi mikka ratnatrayaṅgaḷanārādhisi
padināṟaneya kalpadoḷ utkr̥ṣṭamappa irppatteraḍu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyonacyutēndranāgi puṭṭidaṁ

mattaṁ peṟarumārādhakarappavargaḷ dharmaghōṣa bhaṭāraraṁ
manadoḷ bagedu pasivuṁ nīraḻke modalāgoḍeya
parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ sairisi samyag darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ
sādhisi svargāpavarga sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: siridiṇṇanemba bhaṭṭārara kathe
div.p: siridiṇṇa bhaṭārara katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ
div.ab:
sīdēṇa – aykilindaṁ, puvvavēriya dēvēṇa –
munnina bhavada pagevanappa dēvanindaṁ, viguvvidēṇa
– vigurvisepaṭṭudaṟindaṁ, ghōrēṇa – ādamānuṁ
kaḍidappudaṟindaṁ, saṁsittō – taḷiyapaṭṭonāgi, siridiṇṇō
– siridiṇṇanemba bhaṭārakaṁ, paḍivaṇṇo – pordidoṁ, uttamaṁ
aṭṭhaṁ – mikka darśana jñāna cāritrārādhaneyaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷaṅgamembudu nāḍalli
campānagaramembudu poḻaladanāḷvonadhigama
samyag dr̥ṣṭi śrāvakaṁ siṁharathanembonarasaṁ mattitta
magadheyembudu nāḍalli sākētamembudadanāḷvoṁ śrāvakaṁ
sumantanembonarasaṁ mattitta maṅgaḷāvatiyembudu
nāḍalli iḷāpaṭṭaṇamembudu poḻaladanāḷvonadhigama
samyag dr̥ṣṭi śrāvakaṁ jitaśatruvembonarasanātanarasi
iḷāmahādēviyemboḷā arasana dādi
vinayamatiyemboḷantavargaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ kālaṁ sale

phālguna nandīśvaraṁ bandoḍe mūvaruṁ maṇḍalikaruṁ
tantamma poḻalgaḷoḷeṇṭu divasamarhadbhaṭṭārakarge
mahāmahimegaḷaṁ māḍal toḍagidarittajitaśatruvuṁ tanna
poḻaloḷeṇṭu divasaṁ jinamahāmahimeyaṁ māḍal
toḍagidanātana dādi vinayamatiyemboḷ gujji viraḷadante
ādamānuṁ virūpe pēsepaḍuvaḷ nōḍida janakke
bhayamaṁ paḍevoḷ nāṇise paḍuvoḷantappāke arasanoḍane
jinamahāmahimeyaṁ nōḍal pōpāgaḷarasanendonabbā
nīmuṁ mahimege baralvēḍa nimmaṁ kaṇḍu mahimege vanda
neraviyañjuguṁ pēsugumamaṅgaḷameṅgumadaṟiṁ nīmuṁ
maneyoḷirimendirisi tānuṁ sahasrakūṭamemba caityālayakke
mahāmahimeyaṁ māḍal pōdan

itta dādiyuṁ magana māḍuva mahāmahimeyaṁ nōḍal
pettenillendubbegambaṭṭu tannaṁ tāṁ paḻidu nandīśvaradeṇṭu
divasamabhiṣēkamumarcaneyumaṣṭōpavāsamumaṁ
māḍi dēvaraṁ bandisutta pūjisuttirdaḷittarasanumeṇṭu
divasaṁ mahāmahimeyabhiṣēkamumaṁ māḍi
sameyisida baḻikke dādige baḻiyaṭṭivarisi intendanabbā
nīmintēke karambaḍapaṭṭirddirendoḍe dādiyintendaḷ
magane eṇṭu divasamupavāsaṅgeydu maneyoḷ
dēvarggabhiṣēkamuṁ pūjeyumaṁ māḍisuttirdenendoḍe
adaṁ kēḷdādamānumarasanosedu baḍavādudumaṁ kaṇḍu
karuṇisi abbā nimagosedeṁ varamaṁ bēḍikoḷḷimendoḍā
keyintendaḷ magane nīnenagosedeyappoḍenagendu
mattameṇṭu divasaṁ dēvargge mahāmahimeyaṁ māḍendu
pēḻdoḍe

antegeyvenendarasaṁ dādi kāraṇamāgi mattameṇṭudivasaṁ
mahāmahimeyaṁ māḍal toḍaṅgidoḍenna
mahāmahimeyoḷentuṇbenendu pārisade
mattamaṣṭōpavāsaṅgeydu pāraṇeya divasadandākeya
śramamuṁ sēdeyumaṁ himavantaparvatada padmeyemba
koḷadoḷ vasiyisirpa śrīyādēvate kaṇḍaṟidu tanna
parivāra sahitaṁ vimānaṅgaḷanēṟi mahāvibhūtiyiṁ bandu
svarṇapīṭhadoḷ dādiyanirisi sugandhōdakaṅgaḷiṁ tīvida
suvarṇa kalaśaṅgaḷindamabhiṣēkaṅgeydu namēru mandāra
santānaka pāriyātrakamemba pūgaḷaṁ suridu kammitappa
tambelar vīsi dēvadundubhigaḷaṁ bājisi śrīyādēvate
tannāvāsakkevōdaḷ

itta dādiyuṁ śrīyādēvateya vibhūtiyaṁ
kaṇḍu nidānaṅgeydu kelavu divasadiṁ kālaṅgeydī
jambūdvīpada himavanta parvatada padmeyemba koḷadoḷ
śrīyādēvateyāgi puṭṭi iḷāpaṭṭaṇakke bandā poḻala
janaṅgaḷgella miruḷ kanasinoḷāṁ śrīyādēvateyeṁ
nimma poḻalgevandenenage śrīvihāramaṁ māḍi enna
pratimeyaniṭṭu pūjisuttumōlagisuttumirimānuṁ
nimage bēḍida varavanīvenendu kanasinoḷ tōṟidoḍe
poḻala janamellaṁ neredu śrīvihāramaṁ māḍi
śrīyādēvateya pratimeyaṁ sthāpisi mahimeyaṁ māḍuttaṁ
pūjisuttamōlagisuttamirpudaṁ kaṇḍu

iḷāmahādēvi aputrike makkaḷaṁ bēḍi panneraḍu
varuṣambaregaṁ niccaluṁ śrīvihārakke pōgi
śrīyādēvateyanarcisuttaṁ pūjisuttaṁ mahāmahimeyaṁ
māḍuttaṁ āḍuttaṁ pāḍuttamōlagisuttamireyadaṁ
kaṇḍaṟidu śrīyādēvate pūrvavidēhakke pōgi
svayamprabharemba tīrthakara paramadēvaraṁ kaṇḍeṟagi
poḍemaṭṭintendu besagoṇḍaḷ bhaṭārā enna poḻaloḷirpa
iḷāmahādēvige makkaḷēnakkumo endu besagoṇḍoḍe
bhaṭārarintendar svargadinda baḻci bandilli orva dēvaṁ
iḷāmahādēvige maganāgi puṭṭugumendoḍadaṁ kēḷdu
bhaṭṭārarggeṟagi poḍevaṭṭu iḷāpaṭṭaṇakke pōgi

iḷāmahādēvige kanasinoḷintendu pēḻdaḷiḷāmahādēvi
ninagenna prasādade saudharmakalpadoḷ mēghamālamemba
vimānadiṁ baḻci vardhamānanemba dēvaṁ bandu ninage
maganāgi puṭṭugumendu śrīyādēvate pēḻdoḍiḷā
mahādēviyādamānuṁ santasambaṭṭirdu kelavu
divasadiṁ garbhamāgi navamāsaṁ neṟedu maganaṁ pettoḍe
śrīyādēvate maganaṁ koṭṭaḷendā kūsiṅge tāyuṁ
tandeyuṁ naṇṭarumellaṁ neredu siridiṇṇanendu pesaraniṭṭar
ātanuṁ śukla pakṣada candranante kramakramadiṁ baḷedu
navayauvananuṁ sarvakaḷākuśaḷanumāgirpannegam

itta sākētapurādhipatiyappa sumantanembarasana magaḷ
sumatiyemboḷākeya svayaṁvarakkarasumakkaḷellaṁ
neredirdallige siridiṇṇaṅgaṁ baḻiyaṭṭi barisidoḍe
svayambaradoḷ sumatiyellaraṁ nōḍiyārumaṁ
meccade siridiṇṇaṅge māle sūḍidoḍe maduveyāgi
kelavu divasamallirdu māvanavaraṁ besagoṇḍiḷāpaṭṭaṇakke
vōpemendoḍātaṁ tanna magaḷappa sumatige baḻivaḻigoṭṭu
magaḷoḍane vācāḷanappa giḷiyumanaṭṭidoḍavargaḷuṁ
katipaya divasaṅgaḷindiḷāpaṭṭaṇakke pōgi sukhadindire

mattondu divasaṁ giḷiyaṁ sākṣimāḍi irvaruṁ
caduraṅgamāḍuttire arasiyarasanaṁ geldoḍe giḷi
neladoḷeraḍu bareyaṁ baregumarasanarasiyaṁ geldoḍe onde
bareyambaregumintu piriduṁ bēgamāḍi arasanarasiyaṁ
geldoḍeraḍu bareyaṁ tegedudanarasaṁ kaṇḍu kaḍumuḷidadaṟa
gōṇaṁ muṟidoḍā giḷiyuṁ sattā poḻala
bahirudyānavanadoḷ vyantaradēvanāgi puṭṭitintirvaruṁ
palakālamiṣṭa viṣaya kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttirpannegaṁ

mattondu divasaṁ saptataḷa prāsādada
mēgirvaruṁ diśāvaḷōkanaṁ geyyuttirpannegaṁ
sahasrakūṭākāramappudondu mugilaṁ kaṇḍintuṭondu
caityālayamaṁ māḍisuvenendu palageyoḷ
rēkhegoṇḍu matte nōḻpannegaṁ karagidudaṁ kaṇḍaduve
nirvēgakke kāraṇamāgi tāyuṁ tandeyuṁ naṇṭarumaṁ
biḍisi niśśalyaṁ geydu bāhyābhyantara parigrahaṅgaḷaṁ
toṟedu varadharma bhaṭṭārara pakkade tapambaṭṭu panneraḍu
varuṣambaregaṁ gurugaḷanagaladirdu dvādaśāṅga
caturdaśapūrvamappāgamamellamaṁ kaltu baḻikke gurugaḷaṁ
besagoṇḍavaranumatadindēkavihāriyāgi grāma nagara
khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba pattana drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ māghamāsadandiḷāvaṭṭaṇakke vandā poḻala
bahirudyānavanadoḷirdu rātri pratimāyōgadoḷ nindar

annegaṁ munnavara kaiyoḷ satta giḷi vyantaradēvanāgi alli
puṭṭirdudu kaṇḍēnuṁ kāraṇamillennaṁ kondanendu
muḷidādamānuṁ ghōramappa vātamuṁ śītamumaṁ
vigurvisi nīrgaḷaṁ mēge suridu bīsuttamintu nālku
jāvamuṁ ghōrākāramāgiyupasargamaṁ māḍe
bhaṭāraruṁ dēvōpasargamembudanaṟidu

lg.l: khammāmi savvajīvāṇaṁ savvē jīvā khamantu mē
mettī mē savvabhūdēsu vēraṁ majjha ṇa kēṇa ci

div.p:
endintu samatvībhāvaneyaṁ bhāvisi śukladhyānamaṁ jānisi
eṇṭu karmaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisi mōkṣakke vōdar

mattaṁ peṟaruṁ ratnatrayaṅgaḷanārādhisuva
bhavyarkaḷ siridiṇṇa bhaṭṭāraraṁ manadoḷ bagedu
dēvōpasarga manuṣyōpasarga tirikōpasargama
cētanōpasargamendintu caturvidhamappupasargamumaṁ
pasivu nīraḻke modalāgoḍeyavirppatteraḍu parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ
sairisi vyādhigaḷindappa vēdaneyaṁ sairisi svargāpavarga
sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: vr̥ṣabhasēna bhaṭṭārara kathe
div.p: vr̥ṣabhasēnabhaṭṭārara katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ

lg.l: uṇhaṁ vādaṁ uṇhaṁ siḷātaḷaṁ ādavaṁ ca ati uṇhaṁ

div.ab:
uṇhaṁ vādaṁ – bisidappa gāḷiyumaṁ, uṇhaṁ –
bisidappudaṁ, siḷātaḷaṁ – yōgapīṭhada sileya mēgumaṁ,
ādavaṁ ca – bisilumaṁ, ati uṇhaṁ – ādaṁ bisidappudaṁ,
sahiūṇa – lēsāgi sairisi, usahasēṇō – vr̥ṣabhasēnaremba
muni, paḍivaṇṇō – pordidoṁ, uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ – mikka
darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷārādhaneyaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷavantiyembudu nāḍalli
ujjēniyembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ pradyōtanembarasanātana
mahādēvi jyōtirmāleyemboḷantavargaḷiṣṭa viṣaya
kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasamarasaṁ kāḍāneyaṁ
piḍiyalvēḍiyāneyanēṟi aḍavigevōdoḍadu
madavihvaḷitanāgi meyyaṟiyade diśāpaṭṭaṅgoṇḍondesege
koṇḍōḍi daṇḍakāraṇyamappaḍaviya naḍuve tanna bēgadiṁ
pariye nāḍeyantarambōdoḍondu maradaḍḍabirda
kombaṁ kaṇḍarasaṁ piḍidu nēldirdoḍāneyuṁ
peṟatondu desege vōytantarasanuṁ maradindiḻidu nāḍa
baṭṭeyoḷ taguḷdu aḍaviyaṁ poṟamaṭṭu bandondu
khēḍamembūraneydiyadaṟa sāreyondu keyyuṇṭadaṟa
sāreyoḷ bāviyuṇṭadaṟa taḍiyoḷ bandu kuḷḷirdu
pasivinindaṁ tr̥ṣeyindaṁ pathaśramadindādamānuṁ sēdegeṭṭu
bambaḷaṁ bāḍirpannegam

āvūra gāvuṇḍaṁ jinavādikanembonātana gāvuṇḍi
jinamatiyemboḷāyirvarggaṁ magaḷ jinadatteyemboḷatyanta
rūpalāvaṇya saubhāgya kāntiyumendivanoḍeyoḷ
nīraṁ taralkendu bāvige vōdākeyaṁ kaṇḍarasanele kūse
nīraṁ kuḍiyaleṟeyā endoḍantegeyvenendātana
rūpuṁ gāḍiyuṁ tējamuṁ lāvaṇyamumaṁ kaṇḍāṭisi
nīraṁ sēdikoṇḍu bandu kuḍiyaleṟeye kuḍiye kuḍiye
karagada dāreyanugidukoṇḍoḍarasanākeya mogamaṁ
nōḍi nakkēke kāḍuvau kūse kāḍade kuḍiyaleṟeyā
endoḍākeyuṁ kuḍiyalkeṟedu tanna manege vōgi tanna
tandegintendaḷammā ūra poṟagaṇa bāviyoḷorvaṁ
mahāpuruṣaṁ bandirdonātanaṁ nīmoḍagoṇḍu manege
bannimendoḍantegeyvenendātanuṁ pōgiyoḍagoṇḍu
bandātana śramaṁ pōge divyamappāhāramanūḍirdan

annegamarasanaḍivajjeyaṁ nōḍuttaṁ peṟagaṇindaṁ
tantramellaṁ bandarasanillige vandoneyendūroḷagellamaṟasi
besagoṇḍavararasanaṁ kaṇḍeṟagi poḍevaḍuvudumaṁ
jīya mahāprasādavembudumaṁ gāvuṇḍaṁ kaṇḍele
ītanarasanendaṟidaggaḷaṁ pratipattiyuṁ gauravamumaṁ
māḍidoḍarasaṁ tanna pergaḍegaḷindaṁ kūsaṁ bēḍi pettu
maduvenindākege mahādēvivaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi tanna poḻalge vōgi
karumāḍamaṁ baḷasiyumirdantaḥpuradoḷagondoḷḷitappa
māḍamaṁ koṭṭirisi ellā arasiyarkaḷumanuḻidu
jinadattegāsaktanāgi palakālamākeyoḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttirpannegam

ondu divasamaḍaviya sorkidāne gaṇiyānegaḷverasu
bandu bāviyaṁ pokkoḍe piriduṁ kaḷakaḷamāgi
arasaṅgaṟipidoḍarasanuṁ kēḷdu turipadiṁ poṟamaṭṭu
kāḍāneyaṁ kaṭṭisalendu bāvige vōdonā
prastāvadoḷ jinadatte pasadanaṅgoṇḍirdāke ennaṁ
bisuṭṭarasaṁ pōdonendu muḷidu nuḍivudu
marasanākeyanoḍagoṇḍu pōgadudaṁ kaṇḍarasiyarkaḷellaṁ
santōsamāgi innemagamarasaṁ sūḻuṁ
pāḻiyumanīgumendu rāgisi nuḍiva mātugaḷaṁ jinadatte
kēḷdu kinisi innātanenage bāḻteyallanendu tanna māḍadiṁ
poṟamaṭṭu peṟatondu prāsādadoḷ pōgirdoḷ
annegamittarasanāneyaṁ kaṭṭisi jinadatteya māḍakke vōgi
arasiyaṁ kāṇadellirdaḷendu besagoṇḍoḍorvanintendaṁ
nīmoḍagoṇḍu pōdirillendarasi muḷidu puruṣavratamaṁ
koṇḍu tapasviniyāgi peṟatondu māḍadoḷirdoḷendu
pēḻdoḍā mātanarasaṁ kēḷdādamānuṁ muḷidintappa
vratamaṁ tapamumennalli kūḍadendu nuḍidākeyaṁ
beḷkāḍoḷ masaṇadoḷ koṇḍu pōgikkimendāḷgaḷge
besanaṁ pēḻdoḍavarumantegeyvemendarasiyanoḍagoṇḍu
pōgi masaṇadoḷombattu tiṅgaḷa garbhiṇiyaṁ pottu
pōgiyākeyanallikki intendarabbā emagēnuṁ dōṣamuṁ
pāpamumilla kṣamiyisimarasana besadoḷ tandikkidemendu
nuḍidu pōdarannegamā iruḷoḷarasi besaleyāgi maganaṁ
pettoḷ

ittarasanumā iruḷoḷ śvētavr̥ṣabhanaṁ kanasinoḷ
kaṇḍu poḻtaṟinōlagadoḷ āsthānada naḍuve
siṁhāsanamastakasthitanāgi tanna kaṇḍa kanasaṁ mantrige
pēḻdoḍe mantriyumintendu kanasina phalamanarasaṅge
pēḻdaṁ dēvā nimagindu putralābhamādudendu
pēḻdoḍadaṁ kēḷdarasiyarkaḷoḷagārvesaleyāgi
maganaṁ pettaḷendāraydu bannimendu paḍiyaṟarge
besavēḻdoḍavar rāṇivāsakke pōgi arasiyarkaḷellarumaṁ
bēṟevēṟe nimagaṁ puṭṭidane endu besagoṇḍoḍa
vargaḷanibarumintendaremage saubhāgyamilladavarge bhartārana
deseyindappa sūḻuṁ pāḻiyumilladorge basiṟuṁ
maganumentakkuṁ nīmārānuṁ saubhāgyamuḷḷoralli
basiṟuṁ maganumanārayyimemmalli ēnanārayvirendu
nuḍidoḍavarggaḷuṁ śmaśānakke vōgi jinadatte besaleyāgi
maganaṁ pettirdoḷaṁ kaṇḍarasaṅge pōgi intendar dēvā
śmaśānadoḷ jinadatteyarasi besaleyāgi maganaṁ pettirdaḷendu
pēḻdoḍadaṁ kēḷdarasaṁ kūsumanarasiyumanoḍagoṇḍu
bannimendu tarisi munninandoḷirisi kanasinoḷ vr̥ṣabhanaṁ
kaṇḍudaṟindā kūsiṅge vr̥ṣabhasēnanendu pesaraniṭṭarasiyaṁ
dānasanmānādigaḷiṁ pūjisiyākeyoḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttamire

vr̥ṣabhasēna kumāranumeṇṭu varuṣada
prāyadātanāgirpannegamondu divasamarasaṁ tapambaḍuva
bageyindaṁ vr̥ṣabhasēna kumāraṅgintendaṁ magane
ninage paṭṭaṅgaṭṭal bagedappenendoḍātanintendanayyā
enage nīmuṁ rājyampaṭṭaṅgaṭṭidapiro
mōkṣapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭidapiro endu tandeyaṁ besagoṇḍoḍe
magane ninage manuṣyarājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭidappenembuduṁ
dēvā rājyapaṭṭabandhanamuṁ mōkṣasukha
rājyapaṭṭabandhanamumentene mōkṣasukharājyapaṭṭamaṁ
tapaṅgeyvoṅge kaṭṭuvudendoḍantappoḍe manuṣya
rājyapaṭṭamanollenenage mōkṣarājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭimendu
nuḍidoḍarasanendaṁ magane nīninnu kūsanai bālavaddeyannegaṁ
baḷedarasugeydiṣṭa viṣaya kāma bhōgaṅgaḷanubhavisuttaṁ
baḻikke paścātkāladoḷ tapambaḍuvudendoḍe
kumāranintendanannegaṁ sāvaro bāḻvaro entaṟiyalakkuṁ
manuṣyara bāḻuṁ

lg.l: saṇhaṁ vā badaraṁ taṁ majjhaṁ vimuttāṇa muttipahaṁ

div.p:
embudaṟiṁ bhōgaṅgaḷuṁ kimpākaphaḷadoḷōrannavadu
kāraṇadiṁ rājyadoḷappa bhōgasukhaṅgaḷanolleṁ
jātijarāmaraṇagaḷindappa bādheyinagalda śāśvatamappa
mōkṣasukhamane bēḻpenendu taṟisandu nuḍidoḍe

arasaṁ jyōtirmāleyembarasiya magaṁ vasupāḷanemboṅge
rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi tandemakkaḷirvarumellaroḷaṁ
niśśalyaṅgeydu bāhyābhyantara parigraha parityāgaṅgeydu
guṇadhararembācāryara pakkade dīkṣeyaṁ kaikoṇḍu panneraḍu
varuṣambaregaṁ gurugaḷanagaladirdāgamaṅgaḷellamaṁ kaltu
bhaṭāraraṁ besagoṇḍavaranumatadiṁ vr̥ṣabhasēnamuniyuṁ
grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba pattana drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ barpor vatseyembudu nāḍoḷ kauśambi
yemba poḻalgevandadaṟa sāre udayāvata parvatamemba
parvatamuṇṭadaṟa mēge vr̥ṣabhasēna bhaṭārar nālku
tiṅgaḷumātapasthitayōgamaṁ kaikoṇḍu divasakkaṁ kalnilenile
poḻalavargaḷ kaṇḍanibaruṁ śrāvakabhaktaruṁ besakeyvaru
mādar

mattā poḻaloḷ buddhajanembonupāsakanātaṁ
r̥ṣiyaroḷappa mātsaryaṁ kāraṇamāgi bhaṭārar
carigevōdarannegaṁ pinde pāpakarmaṁ yōgaśileya
mēgumuṁ keḻagumaṁ baḷasiyuṁ palavuṁ piriyavumappa
taṟiya puḷḷigaḷaṁ kaḍidoṭṭi kiccanikki suṭṭu kiccina
baṇṇadantāgi sileyaṁ māḍi keṇḍaṅgaḷanondu kelaṁ
sārci pōdanannegaṁ bhaṭārar carigevōgi barpor
dhagaddhagisuttirda kiccina baṇṇadantappa keccanāgirda sileyaṁ
kaṇḍemaginiteyāyuṣyamendaṟidu kriyegeydu
caturvidhamappāhāramumaṁ śarīramumaṁ jāvajjīvaṁ
toṟedu kāydirda yōgapīṭhamanēṟi kāyōtsargaṅgeydu
jyēṣṭha māsada bisiluṁ jhaḷamuṁ beṅkeyuṁ kiccumaṁ sairisi
nīroḷagirpantirdu śukladhyānamaṁ dhyānisi eṇṭu karmaṅgaḷaṁ
kiḍisi mōkṣakke vōdar matte pradyōtanemba r̥ṣi samyag
darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi svargadoḷ puṭṭidaṁ

mattaṁ peṟarumārānuṁ sahajaratnatrayamanārādhisuttirda
bhavyarkaḷ vr̥ṣabhasēna bhaṭāraraṁ manadoḷ bagedu jhaḷamuṁ
beṅkeyumaṁ dāhamuṣṇamuṁ śītamuṁ vātamuṁ bēneyuṁ
pasivuṁ nīraḻke modalāgoḍeyavirppatteraḍu parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ
sairisi śubhapariṇāmadiṁ samyag darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ
sādhisi svargāpavargasukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: kārtika r̥ṣiya kathe
div.p: agnirājana maganappa svāmi kārtika r̥ṣiya katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ

lg.l:
rōhēdayammi sattīe hadō koñcēṇa
aggidayidō vi

div.ab:
rōhēdayammi – rōhēdakamemba poḻaloḷ , sattīe
hadō – śaktiyembāyudhadindiṟiye paṭponāgi, koñcēṇa
– krauñcanembarasinindaṁ, aggidayidō vi – agnirājana
kādalisepaḍuva magaṁ, tavvēdaṇaṁ – ā vēdaneyaṁ,
adhiyāsiya – lēsāgi sairisi, paḍivaṇṇō – pordirdoṁ,
uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ – mikka darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷārādhaneyaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷ lāḷaviṣayadoḷ
kr̥ttikāpuramembudu poḻaladanāḷvonagnirājanembarasanātana
mahādēvi vīramatiyemboḷāyirvvarggaṁ makkaḷ
bandhumati śivasēne śrīmati svayamprabhe lakṣmīmati kr̥ttike
yendintaṟuvar peṇgūsugaḷantavarggaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ phālguṇa māsada nandīśvaradandaṟuvaruṁ
koḍagūsugaḷupavāsaṅgeydu basadigarcaneyaṁ
koṇḍupōgi dēvaranarcisi nandīśvaraṅgeydu
bandisi risiyarkaḷumaṁ gurupariviḍiyiṁ vandisi
vrataṅgaḷanēṟisikoṇḍu siddhaśēṣeyaṁ koṇḍubandu tāygaṁ
tandegaṁ koṭṭu pōpāgaḷarasaṁ kiṟiya magaḷappa kr̥ttikeya
rūpuṁ tējamuṁ gāḍiyumaṁ kaṇḍākegāṭisi

sāmanta mahāsāmantarkkaḷgaṁ parivārakkaṁ mantrivargakkaṁ
vīramati mahādēvigamella samayigaḷgaṁ baḻiyaṭṭi
barisiyarasanintendanennāḷva maṇḍaḷaṅgaḷoḷ puṭṭida
lēsappa vastuvārgakkumendu bēṟevēṟeyarasananibarumaṁ
besagoṇḍoḍavarggaḷellamintendaroḷḷitappāneyuṁ
kudureyuṁ muttuṁ māṇikamuṁ strīratnamuṁ
modalāgoḷḷitappaggaḷa vastuvellaṁ pr̥thviyanāḷvoṅgakkumendu
pēḻdoḍarasaṁ r̥ṣiyarumaṁ besagoṇḍoḍe
r̥ṣiyarendarāva vastu pēḻiṁ pēḻdoḍe takkudu
tagadudumanaṟiyalakkumendoḍarasanintendanivarellara
pēḻvantu pēḻvarallaroḍambaḍuvarallar bahu praḷāpigaḷivaraṁ
poḻalindaṭṭi kaḷeyimendaṭṭi kaḷeduḻidarellarumaṁ
besagoṇḍoḍanibarumoḍambaṭṭoḷḷittappa vastu
ninagakkumendoḍe arasanenagakkuṁ balamendu mūṟu
sūḻvaraṁ sāṟi nuḍidoḍambaḍisi vīramati mahādēviyaṁ
bēḍi kr̥ttikeyappa kiṟiya magaḷaṁ maduvenindonā divasame
vīramati mahādēviyuṁ brahmacarya vratamaṁ kaikoṇḍu
negaḻdaḷ

matte kr̥ttikege navamāsaṁ garbhamādandu
saravaṇamembudyānavanadoḷagaṇa saravaṇamemba bāviyoḷ
jalakrīḍeyāḍal bayakeyādudendarasaṅgaṟipi
doḍarasananumatadiṁ jalakrīḍeyāḍi maganaṁ pettoḍātaṅge
svāmikārtikanendu pesaraniṭṭar mattātaniṁ baḻiyaṁ
peṇgūsumaṁ pettoḍe ākege vīraśrīyendu pesaraniṭṭu
baḷedoḍākeyaṁ kōgaḷiyanāḷva krauñcanembarasaṅge
koṭṭarintu kālaṁ sale

mattitta nami modalāgoḍeya tammandirappa kumāraroḍane
svāmikārttikaṁ baḷedu padināṟu varuṣada prāyamādandu
mattondu divasamanibaruṁ kumārarkkaḷudyānavanakke
vanakrīḍeyāḍal pōgiyāḍuttirpannegamellā kumārarkkaḷgaṁ
tāy tandeyajjarkkaḷa maneyindaṁ pūsalumuḍaluṁ
tuḍaluṁ pūvuṁ tambulamuṁ timbaḍaṅgaḷuṁ banduvu svāmi
kārttikaṅgārumaṭṭadirdoḍe manadoḷ baḻdi rdidonāgi
vanakrīḍeyanāḍi manege vandu tāyanintendanabbā nimma
tandeyappemmajjanoḷano illeyo endu besagoṇḍoḍe
tāy manadoḷ baḻdirdidoḷāgi ēnaṁ pēḻveṁ magane
ninage tandeyappātanenagaṁ tandeyendu pēḻdoḍadaṁ kēḷdu
aduve vairāgya kāraṇamāgi

śrīvararembācāryara pakkade tapambaṭṭāgamaṅgaḷellamaṁ
kaltu gurugaḷaṁ besagoṇḍavaranumatadindēka vihāriyāgi
grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba pattana drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ teṅkanāḍa kiṣkindhamemba parvatamaneydi
yadaṟa mēge rātripratimāyōgaṁ geydorā iruḷ
piridondu maḻe koṇḍu meyya maḷamellamaṁ karci
kaḷedu pāṣāṇamemba maḍuvaṁ nīr pokkāgaḷā maḍuvina
nīr sarvauṣadhiyādoḍantalliya nīraṁ mindavarggellā
vyādhiyuṁ kiḍuvuvāduvalliṁ toḍagi dakṣiṇāpathadoḷadu
tīrthamāytu

matte svāmi kārttika r̥ṣiyuṁ vihārisuttaṁ bandu
kōgaḷiyaneydiyalliya basadiyoḷ panthāticāra
niyamaṅgeydu dēvaraṁ bandisi madhyāhnadāgaḷ
carigevokku cāturvarṇyada manegaḷumaṁ toḻaluttaṁ
bandaramaneyaṁ pokkāgaḷā prastāvadoḷ karumāḍada
mēgaṇa neleyoḷirdu vīraśrī mahādēviyarasana taleyaṁ
tanna toḍeya mēliṭṭugurisutirddāke bhaṭārara baravaṁ
kaṇḍaṟidemmaṇṇaṅgaḷappa bhaṭārar carigevandapporendu
maṟalundidarasana taleyaṁ keḻagondādhāramaniṭṭu
niṟisalendu karumāḍadindiḻidu paritarpannegaṁ bhaṭārar
vandaramaneyaṅgaṇamaṁ pokku maguḻdupōgi bāgil
māḍamaneydidāgaḷarasi peṟagaṇiṁ paritandu bandu munde
nindu kaigaḷaṁ mugideṟagi nilke bhaṭārā endu niṟisidoḍe
bhaṭārarendarabbā maneyaṁ pokku bandominnemage
nilalāgadendoḍarasiyintendaḷ bhaṭārā nīmenage
dayegeydamōghaṁ nilalvēḻkumendu pōgalīyade kālaṁ
piḍidu tāṅguttirpannegam

ittarasaneḻcattu desegaḷaṁ nōḍiyarasiyaṁ
kāṇadarasiyellirdoḷendu keladavaraṁ
besagoṇḍoḍavarendorarasiyorva savaṇaṁ
bandoḍātanaṁ kaṇḍu karumāḍadindiḻidu paridu
baḻiyaṁ taguḷdu bāgil māḍadalli savaṇanoḍanā
pōruttirppoḷ nōḍimendarasaṅge tōṟidoḍarasaṁ
kaṇḍennanagaldu niccalī savaṇanallige parivaḷendu kinisi
karumāḍadindiḻidu risiyarirdalligevōgi śakti
yembāyudhadinduramanurcipōgiṭṭarasiyumaṁ talenaviraṁ
piḍidu daṟadaṟaneḻedukoṇḍubandaṁ

svāmi kārttikar̥ṣiyuṁ kṣameyaṁ bhāvisi nettarokku
basamaḻidu bēsageya kaḍuvisilindaṁ jhaḷadindaṁ
beṅkeyindaṁ nīraḻkeyadhikamāgi taṇpinoḷoḷḷittu
samādhiyakkumendu manadoḷ bagedirddonannegaṁ
tammajjiyappa vīramati mahādēvi brahmacaryavratamaṁ
koṇḍu kālaṁ geydu vyantaradēvateyāgi
puṭṭidākegāsanakampamāgiyaṟidu bandu bhaṭārā
besanēnivarellarumaṁ kondappenendoḍe bhaṭārarendarantēnuṁ
bēḍa nīnemmaṁ taṇpineḍege koṇḍupōgendoḍe dēvate
navilarūpinindettikoṇḍu bennoḷiṭṭu kōgaḷiya mūḍaṇa
deseya parvatada koḷada taḍiyoḷ latāmaṇṭapadoḷirisi
pōdoḍe beṭṭada mēgaṇiṁ pāytarpa nirjharaśīkaraṅgaḷiṁ
meygāpyāyanamāgi saṁnyasanaṅgeydu śubhapariṇāmadiṁ
muḍipi sarvārthasiddhiyoḷ mūvattumūṟu sāgarōpa
māyuṣyamanoḍeyonahamindranāgi puṭṭidoṁ

mattitta bhaṭārara taṅgeyappa vīraśrīyuṁ hā
bhaṭāra endiruḷuṁ pagaluṁ palavu divasamonde
pāṅginoḷ praḷāpisi duḥkhaṅgeyye arasanumākege
kaḍunallanappudaṟindādamānumubbegaṁ
baṭṭirddintendanārorvararasiyaḻkeyaṁ maḻgisi
duḥkhamaṁ maṟeyisuvoravarggosageyaṁ māḍuvenendu
poḻaloḷage gōsaṇeyaṁ toḻalcidoḍadaṁ kēḷdu lōgar
pagaraṇigarāgi enitānuṁ teṟada rūpugaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu
maramogaṅgaḷaniṭṭu bandu munde āḍiyuṁ pāḍiyuṁ
nagisiyumentumaḻkemaḻgadirdoḍorvaṁ kariya
kaccuṭamanuṭṭu meyyellaṁ masiyaṁ pūsi bōḻadaleverasu
bāyoḷ kavaḍikegaḷaṁ palgaḷante māḍi kuñcamuṁ
guṇḍigeyumaṁ piḍidu barponanarasaṁ kaṇḍintendaneleyarasi
ninna sahōdaraṅgaḷappa bhaṭārarā barporeyendu
pēḻdāgaḷellirdarendeḻdu nōḍi kāṇadā rūpaṁ kaṇḍu
nakku duḥkhamaṁ maṟedoḷāgaḷā nagisida pagaraṇigaṅge
piridu kasavaramanittonandinditta bādubbeya parvamuṁ
pagaraṇadāṭapāṭamumāduvu matte svāmi kārttika
r̥ṣiyar muḍipidalliyavara taṅgeyappa vīraśrī basadiyaṁ
māḍidoḍandinditta svāmiyemba tīrthamāytu

mattitta kr̥ttikeyemba poḻalanāḷvagnirājanembarasaṁ tanna magaḷaṁ
tāne koṇḍu moṟeyaḻidanappudaṟindalliya janamuṁ

endarasanaṁ kaṇḍu moṟeyaḻidu negaḻal taguḷdoḍā
poḻalge bhōgaṅkārōhaṇamendu pesaraniṭṭar

idu svāmi kārttika r̥ṣiya kathe matte peṟaruṁ parama sahaja
ratnatrayaṅgaḷanārādhisuvavarggaḷ svāmi kārttika r̥ṣiyaraṁ
manadoḷ bagedēṟuṁ puṇṇuṁ vyādhiyuṁ pasivu nīraḻke
śītavātōṣṇaṅgaḷumaṁ sairisi svargāpavarga sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head:
abhayaghōṣaremba
muniya kathe
div.p: abhayaghōṣaremba muniya katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ
div.ab:
kākandi – kākandiyemba poḻaloḷ , abhayaghōsō
vi – abhayaghōṣaremba risiyuṁ, caṇḍavēgēṇa
– caṇḍavēganembonarasinindaṁ, chiṇṇasavvaṅgō –
koṟeyepaṭṭellā meyyanoḍeyanāgi, tavvēdaṇaṁ – ā
vēdaneyaṁ, adhiyāsiya – lēsāgi sairisi, paḍivaṇṇō
– pordidoṁ, uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ – mikka darśana jñāna
cāritraṅgaḷārādhaneyaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharata kṣētradoḷ
magadheyembudu nāḍalli kākandiyembudu
poḻaladanāḷvonabhayaghōṣanembonarasanātana
mahādēvi abhayamatiyemboḷantavarggaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasamarasaṁ poṟamaṭṭu poṟavoḻala
śōbheyaṁ toḻaldu nōḍuttirppannegamorva
mīṅguliganondāmeyaṁ bāḻevāḻe nālku kālaṁ
kaṭṭi baḷḷiyaṁ koraloḷ taguḷciyeḻale piḍidukoṇḍu
poḻalgidiraṁ barpponanarasaṁ kaṇḍu tanna binnaṇamaṁ
nereda neravige meṟeyalvēḍi geṇṭaṟiṁ cakradiṁ nālku
kālumanormodale paṟiyiṭṭoḍe mīṅguligaṁ
prāṇamuḷḷantirāmeyaṁ tanna manege koṇḍu pōdoḍā
iruḷoḷāme piridu vēdaneyindaṁ namedu sattā
poḻaloḷabhayaghōṣa nr̥patigabhayamati mahādēvigaṁ
caṇḍavēganemba maganāgi puṭṭidanantavarggaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōga sukhaṅgaḷananubhavisuttirpannegam

mattondu divasamarasanumarasiyuṁ karumāḍada mēgaṇa
neleyoḷ bhōgōpabhōga sukhaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ
vinōdadindirppannegaṁ candragrahaṇamādudanarasaṁ
kaṇḍanityamaṁ bhāvisiyaduve vairāgyakke kāraṇamāgi
caṇḍavēganemba magaṅge rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi bāhyābhyantara
parigraha parityāgaṅgeydu nandanarembācāryara pakkade
tapambaṭṭu panneraḍu varuṣamavaroḍanirddellā vōdu
gaḷumaṁ kaltu gurugaḷaṁ besagoṇḍavaranumatadindēka
vihāriyāgi grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa
drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ barppor tamma
munnina kākandiyemba poḻalge vandudyānavanadoḷ
vīrāsanamirdorannegaṁ munnāmeyappa jīvanavara
maganappa caṇḍavēgaṁ karumāḍada mēgaṇa neleyoḷirdu
nōṇṭakke geṇṭu pōge cakramaniṭṭoḍā cakraṁ vandu
r̥ṣiyareraḍu keyyuṁ kālgaḷumaṁ mokkane pōge koṇḍoḍe

caturvidhamappāhārakkaṁ śarīrakkaṁ jāvajjīvaṁ nivr̥ttigeydu
vēdaneyaṁ sairisi śubhapariṇāmadiṁ ratnatrayamaṁ
sādhisi padinālkaneya prāṇatamemba kalpadoḷirpattu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyonindranāgi puṭṭidoṁ

matte peṟarumārādhakaruṁ ratnatrayamanārādhisuttirdda
bhavyarkkaḷabhayaghōṣa bhaṭāraraṁ manade bagedu pasivuṁ
tr̥ṣeyumēṟuṁ vyādhiyuṁ śīta vātōṣṇaṅgaḷumendivu
modalāgoḍeya duḥkhaṅgaḷaṁ sairisi paramaśuddha
sahaja darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi svargāpavarga
sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: vidyuccōranemba risiya kathe
div.p: vidyuccōranemba risiya katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ

lg.l:
daṁsēhiya masakēhi ya khajjantō vēdaṇaṁ
paramaghōraṁ

div.ab:
daṁsēhiya – cikkuṭugaḷindaṁ, masakēhi ya –
guṅguṟugaḷindaṁ, khajjantō – tinepaḍutirdonāgi, vēdaṇaṁ
– vēdaneyaṁ, paramaghōraṁ – ādamānuṁ kaḍidappudaṁ,
vijjuccōrō – vidyuccōranemba risi, adhiyāsiya –
lēsāgi sairisi, paḍivaṇṇō – pordidoṁ, uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ –
mikka darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷārādhaneyaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharata kṣētradoḷ vidēhamembudu nāḍalli
mithiḷeyembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ padmarathanembonarasana
santatiyiṁ banda vāmarathanemborasanātana
mahādēvi bandhumatiyemboḷantavarggaḷiṣṭa viṣaya
kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ palakālaṁ sale mattā
poḻaloḷ yamadaṇḍanemboṁ taḷāṟaṁ mattalli irpoṁ
vidyuccōranemboṁ kaḷḷan

ātaṁ jr̥mbhini stambhini mōhini sarṣapi tāḷōdghāṭini
vidyāmantra cūrṇa yōga ghuṭikāñjanamendivu
modalāgoḍeya taskaraśāstraṅgaḷoḷādamānuṁ
kuśalanantappa kaḷḷaṁ poḻala kasavaraṅgaḷaniruḷ kaḷdu poḻalge
nāḍeyantaradoḷondu parvatamuṇṭalli piridondu
guheyuṇṭadaṟoḷage kaḷda kasavaraṅgaḷellamaṁ pūḻdiṭṭu
guheya bāgilaṁ piridondu sileyaṁ tandiṭṭu mucci bandu
pagalellaṁ pāḻdēguladoḷañjanamanecci tāṁ tonnanāgi
muruṇṭida kaiyuṁ kāluṁ berasu mūgoḷagardu rasige
suriye noḻavugaḷ musuṟikoṇḍu tine pēsidanāgi
lōgara manegaḷoḷ bhaikṣamaṁ bēḍi manemaneyaṁ
toḻaldu tanna tonnugoṇḍirpudanaṟiputtumintu
pagalellamirdiruḷappāgaḷ divyamappa tanna svābhāvikamappa
munnina rūpaṁ kaikoṇḍu puṭṭigeyanuṭṭu meyyaṁ pūsi
pūvaṁ muḍidu karpūra saṁmiśritamappa tambulandinuttuṁ
sūḷegērigaḷaṁ toḻaldu tannaṁ meṟeyuttaṁ manakke
vandaggaḷadoḷpeṇḍiroḷotteyaniṭṭu bhōgōpabhōgaṅgaḷge
kasavaramaṁ koṭṭanubhavisuttamārumaṟiyadantirdu baccara
dūsigara niyōgigaḷa aggayileyarappa sūḷeyara sāmantara
kasavaraṅgaḷellamaṁ kaḷdu

mattondu divasaṁ padmarathaṅgosedacyutēndranaṭṭida
divyamappa sarvarujāpahāramemba hāraṁ santatiyiṁ
vāmarathaṅge bandudaṁ vāmarathaṁ karumāḍadēḻaneya
neleyoḷ tanna lunduvōvarigeya puḍikeyoḷiṭṭellā
kālamuṁ gandha puṣpa dīpa dhūpākṣataṅgaḷindarcisuttaṁ
poḍemaḍuttamirkkum

intappa hāramaṁ vidyuccōranañjanamaṁ kaṇṇoḷecciyāruṁ
tannaṁ kāṇadantāgire aramaneyaṁ pokkarasana maṟalundu
vōvariyaṁ pokku taledeseyoḷarcisirda puḍikeyaṁ teṟedu
hāramaṁ koṇḍaramaneyiṁ poṟamaṭṭu pōgi poṟavoḻala
guheyoḷ pūḻdiṭṭu poḻalgevandu munninante tonnarūpaṁ
kaikoṇḍirdaṁ

mattittarasaṁ nēsarmūḍe hāramaṁ kāṇade
āsthānamaṇṭapadoḷ siṁhāsanamastakasthitanāgirdu
taḷāṟanappa yamadaṇḍaṅge baḻiyaṭṭi varisi intendanelavo
yamadaṇḍā poḻala pārvara paradara sūḷeyara
okkala makkaḷa kasavaramellamaṁ kaḷdoḍamārayyade
kemmagirpeyalladeyumemma sejjeyōvariyaṁ kaḷḷaṁ
pokku puḍikeyaṁ teṟedacyutēndranitta kuladhanamappa
hāramaṁ koṇḍupōdaṁ bēgaṁ kaḷḷananāraydu
hāramaṁ koṇḍu bā alladāgaḷ kaḷḷaṅge takka nigrahamaṁ
ninage māḍidappenendoḍe taḷāṟanendaṁ dēvā
ēḻudivasamenageḍeyanīvudēḻudivasadindoḷage
kaḷḷananārayyalāṟadāgaḷ dēvarennaṁ
meccukeyvudendoḍarasanantegeyyendoḍe

aramaneyindaṁ poṟamaṭṭu poḻaloḷage
sūḷegērigaḷoḷamaṅgaḍigaḷoḷaṁ basadigaḷoḷaṁ
vihāraṅgaḷoḷaṁ kērigaḷoḷamāramegaḷoḷaṁ
dēvālayaṅgaḷoḷaṁ poṟavoḻaloḷaṁ kelada
poḻalgaḷoḷamāṟuṁ divasaṁ nirantaramāraydelliyuṁ
kāṇadēḻaneya devasadandu pāḻdēguladoḷirdu tonnaṁ
pōpāgaḷaḷiṟuvaḷḷamaṁ kaṇḍadaṁ vidyādharakaraṇadiṁ
laṅghisi pōpudaṁ yamadaṇḍaṁ geṇṭaṟoḷirdu kaṇḍivane
kaḷḷanendu niścayisi piḍidaramanege puyyaliḍeyiḍe
koṇḍupōgiyarasaṅge kaḷḷanaṁ tandenendu tōṟi ītaṁ
kaḷḷanendarasaṅge vēḻdoḍe tonnanintendaṁ
dēvā nāṁ kaḷḷanalladudarke poḻalellamaṟiguṁ
kaḷḷananārayyalāṟadennaṁ tanna sāviṅgañji baḍavanaṁ dēsiganaṁ
poḻaloḷ baikandiriduṇḍu bāḻvanaṁ piḍidukoṇḍu bandu
kolisidappanendoḍe taḷāṟaṁ kaḷḷaranārayva śāstraṅgaḷo
ḷādamānuṁ kuśalanappudaṟindarasaṅgintendanītaṁ tanna
rūpugarediruḷ poḻalellamaṁ kaḷdu divasakkī pāṅginoḷ
tonnanāgirpoṁ nīmuṁ nambadāgaḷ pratyayamaṁ māḍi
tōrpenendāgaḷ pratighuṭikāñjanaṅgaḷaṁ tonnana kaṇṇino
ḷeccidoḍe divyamappa tanna munnina rūpāgirdiotendanītaṁ
ghuṭikāñjana kuhakaṁ indrajālaṅgaḷaṁ ballonappudaṟindellā
rūpugaḷaṁ māḍal ballonendoḍe taḷāṟanendaṁ peṟargge
māḍī pratyayamaṁ tōrpenendarasananumatadindarasiyara
sūḷeyara kaṇgaḷoḷ ghuṭikāñjanaṅgaḷaneccidoḍanibaruṁ
tonneyirāgirppannegaṁ
mattaṁ baḻikke pratighuṭikāñjanaṅgaḷaneccidoḍe svābhāvikamappa
tamma munnina rūpugaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍirddorāgaḷarasaṅge
nambugeyāgi neṭṭanivaṁ kaḷḷanapponītanaṁ daṇḍisendu
yamadaṇḍaṅge besavēḻdoḍe

ātanante geyvenendātanaṁ tanna manegoḍagoṇḍu
pōgi māghamāsadiruḷ kaḍusītadoḷ ghōramappa
mūvatteraḍu daṇḍaṇegaḷiṁ nīḍuṁ daṇḍiseyanitumaṁ
bāḻevāḻe avayavade sairisiyuṁ kaḷḷanallenayyō
ballāḷtanadindennaṁ taḷāṟaṁ kondappanendoḷaṟi puyyaliḍe
taḷāṟaṅge kaḷḷanītanallembudondu nambugeyāgi nēsaṟ
mūḍeyaramanege pōgi arasaṅgintendu binnapaṅgeydaṁ
dēvā mūvatteraḍu ghōramappa daṇḍaṇegaḷindaṁ
kaḷḷanaṁ daṇḍisi nōḍidenātanamōghaṁ kaḷḷanallennaṁ
dēvar meccukeyvudendoḍarasaṁ śmaśānada sūladoḷ
yamadaṇḍananikkimendāḷgaḷge besavēḻdoḍavarumātanaṁ
śmaśānakkeḻedukoṇḍu pōgi darkkaṁ basidu
sūladoḷikkuvāgaḷavaroḍavōgi tonnaṁ rūpa
parāvartanaṅgeydu tanna svābhāvikamappa vidyuccōranappa
divyarūpaṁ kaikoṇḍu sūladoḷikkalīyade
aḍḍamāgirdarasana kāpinavaranendaneleyaṇṇagaḷirā nīmītanaṁ
kondirītanuṁ sūladoḷikkepaṭṭanāgi sattavanendavaroḷ
nuḍidu

taḷāṟananintendanele gaḷā yamadaṇḍā nīnumānuṁ
kiṟiyandorvarupādhyāyara pakkadoḷōduvandu
nandanavanadoḷage nīnenna pūṇda pratijñeyaṁ nenadā onduṁ
dōṣamillade ninnaṁ kolisideno koliseno pūṇda
pratijñeyaṁ neneveyō neneyeyo ene yamadaṇḍanoḷḷittāgi
nenedenendoḍe vidyuccōranintendaṁ mattīgaḷ nīnēn
satteyo sāyeyo mattēno endāgaḷ yamadaṇḍanendaṁ
dēvā nīṁ geldeyāṁ sōltenuṁ sattenumendirvar
padiriniṁ nuḍiva sūḻmātugaḷaṁ kāpinavaruṁ poḻala
janamuṁ kēḷdu cōdyambaṭṭu beṟagāgirdoḍe vidyuccōraṁ
kāpinavaranintendanennumanītanumanarasanallige koṇḍu
pōgiyarasana mundītaṅgamenagaṁ mātuṇṭalli nuḍida
baḻikkarasanītanaṁ meccukeyge entuṁ kolavēḻdoḍaṁ mūṟu
sūḻ besagoṇḍallade kolalāgadendu nītiśāstradoḷ
pēḻdudaṟindemmirvarumanaramanege koṇḍupōgi arasaṅge
tōṟimendoḍe

ā kāpinavarirvarumanarasanallige koṇḍupōgi intendu
binnapaṅgeydar dēvā ītaṁ yamadaṇḍanaṁ kolalīyade
bārisidanendu vidyuccōranaṁ tōṟi nuḍidoḍarasanēke nīṁ
bārisideyendu besagoṇḍoḍe vidyuccōranendaṁ
yamadaṇḍaṅgēnuṁ pollameyuṁ dōṣamumilla
nimma dēvatārakṣitamappa sarvarujāpahāramembudu
modalāgi poḻala kasavaramaniruḷī rūpinoḷ kaḷdu
pagalellaṁ tonnanāgi pāḻdēguladoḷirpenadaṟindennaṁ
kollimītaṅgēnuṁ dōṣamillendoḍarasanendanā
kaḷda kasavaramanellamanēgeydeyendu besagoṇḍo
ḍanitumirduvaysāsiramaṟusāsira dīnāramenna
sūḷege biyamāduduḻiduvellao vaṇṇao
caḷiyadirdudendoḍarasaṁ vidyuccōranaṁ hāramaṁ koṇḍu
bā poḻalavarggaṁ kasavaramaṁ maḍagideḍeyaṁ tōṟendu

ātanoḍane poḻala janamumanaṭṭe kāpuverasu
pōgi poḻalge nāḍeyantaradoḷ piridondu
parvatamuṇṭalliyondu vistīrṇa guheyuṇṭadaṟa
bāgilu muccirda piriya sileyaṁ kaḷedadaṟoḷage pokku
hāramaṁ koṇḍu poḻala janamellamanendaṁ nimma nimma
kasavaramappudanāraydu pallaṭisalīyade nōḍikoḷḷimendu
tōṟidoḍavaruṁ tantamma kasavaramanellamanāraydu
koṇḍar matte vidyuccōranuṁ hāramaṁ koṇḍu
pōgiyarasaṅgoppisidoḍe

arasanintendu vidyuccōranaṁ besagoṇḍaṁ
māghamāsadiruḷina sītadoḷ nālku jāvamuṁ
mūvatteraḍuṁ ghōramappa daṇḍaṇeyanentu sairiside
yendoḍātanintendarasaṅge pēḻguṁ
dēvā ondu divasaṁ sahasrakūṭa caityālayakke
kiṟiyandennanōdisuvōjarumānuṁ pōgi ōjaṁ
dēvaraṁ bandisuvannegaṁ carita purāṇaṅgaḷaṁ vakhkhāṇisuttirda
śivaguptarembācāryara pakkade kuḷḷirdu vakhkhāṇeyaṁ
kēḷuttirpannegaṁ narakavyāvarṇaneyanā bhaṭārarintendu
pēḻvudaṁ kēḷdeṁ vrataśīla cāritra guṇaṅgaḷanilladavaruṁ
jīvaṅgaḷaṁ kolvaruṁ bēṇṭeyāḍuvaruṁ rāgadvēṣa
lōbhaṁ kāraṇamāgi pusi nuḍidu jīvaṅgaḷge
santāpamaṁ vadheyumaṁ māḍisuvarumāṟaḍigoḷvaruṁ
kaḷvoruṁ perara peṇḍiroḷ maṟevāḻvarumaparimita
parigrahamaṁ nerapuvaruṁ mattaṁ madhu madya
māṁsaṅgaḷumaydu pālmarada paṇgaḷumāḷambeyuṁ
saṇambina pūvumendivaṁ sēvisuvaruṁ
mattamamōghamapēyapēyamabhakṣyabhakṣyamendivaṟoḷ
negaḻvaruṁ pañca mahāpātakaṅgaḷaṁ geydorumivarellaṁ
nivr̥tti pariṇāmamillade kālaṅgeydēḻuṁ narakaṅgaḷoḷ puṭṭi
duḥkhaṅgaḷaneyduvar

lg.l:
acchiṇimīḷaṇa mettaṁ ṇatthi suhaṁ dukhkhamēva
aṇubaddhaṁ

div.p: mattaṁ

lg.l: naḍuvaṁ koṟe kutti karuḷgaḷaṁ tege mogamaṁ

div.p:
mattaṁ kontaṅgaḷindamiṭṭigaḷindaṁ kuttisiṟindaṁ
karuḷ mālegaḷ neladoḷ suriye kuttuvuduṁ
muṭṭigaḷoḷiṭṭu tegapuvuduṁ karagasaṅgaḷindaṁ
maranaṁ pōḻvante keyyaṁ kālanagalci piḍidaḍasi
kaṭṭiyuddambiḍidu bāḻvudumintivu modalāgoḍeya
duḥkhaṅgaḷaṁ kaṇṇemeyikkuvanitu poḻtappoḍamusir
pattilladutkr̥ṣṭadindamēḻaneya narakadoḷ mūvattumūṟu
sāgarōpamakālambaregaṁ duḥkhaṅgaḷaneyduvar mattaṁ
dāna pūje śīlōpavāsamendintu caturvidhamappa śrāvaka
dharmadoḷ negaḻvavaruṁ tapaṅgeyvaruṁ svargāpavarga
sukhaṅgaḷaneyduvarendintu pēḻe

kēḷdu bhaṭārara pakkade ānaṇuvrata guṇavrata śikṣāvratamendintu
dvādaśa vidhamappa śrāvaka dharmamumanarhanta parama
dēvare dēvar kolladude dharmaṁ bāhyābhyantara
parigrahamilladude tapamarhanta parama dēvarāgamadoḷ
pēḻepaṭṭa jīvājīva puṇyapāpāsrava saṁvara
nirjara bandhamōkṣamendintu navapadārthaṅgaḷumaṁ
pañcāstikāyaṅgaḷumaṁ ṣaḍ dravyaṅgaḷumaṁ nambuvudu
samyaktvamembudakkumā samyaktvadaticāraṅgaḷ
śaṅkādyaṣṭa maḷaṅgaḷumeṇṭu madaṅgaḷuṁ mūṟu
mūḍhamumāṟanāyatana sēvegaḷumendintirppattaydakku
mavaṁ piṅgisi niśśaṅkādyaṣṭa guṇaṅgaḷiṁ kūḍida śuddhamappa
samyaktvapūrvakaṁ vrataṅgaḷanēṟisikoṇḍu matte narakaṅgaḷa
duḥkhaṅgaḷaṁ kēḷdavaṟa śatasahasra bhāgakkappoḍamī
duḥkhamillendu manadoḷ bagedu mūvatteraḍuṁ
daṇḍaṇegaḷaṁ sairisidenendoḍarasaṁ kēḷdu ninagosedeṁ
bēḍikoḷ ninna bēḍidudellamaṁ kuḍuvenendoḍe
peṟatēnumanollenenna keḷeyanappa yamadaṇḍaṅge
kṣamiyisuvudane bēḍidenendoḍarasanintendu besagoṇḍaṁ
yamadaṇḍaṁ ninagentu keḷeyanādaṁ matte nīṁ śrāvaka
vrataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍeyappoḍēke kaḷveyendu besagoṇḍoḍāta
nintendaṁ yamadaṇḍanenage keḷeyanappudumaṁ nimma poḻala
kasavaramaṁ kaḷdudakke kāraṇamumaṁ pēḻveṁ kēḷarasā endu
vidyuccōranintendu pēḻaltoḍaṅgidaṁ

ī jambūdvīpada bharata kṣētradoḷ tilakamane pōlvudu
dakṣiṇāpathadoḷābhīramembudu nāḍalli varṇeyemba
toṟeyā taḍiyoḷ vēṇātaṭamembudu poḻaladu
poḻala guṇaṅgaḷinādamānuṁ ramyamappudu svargamane
pōlvudadanāḷvoṁ jitaśatruvembonarasanātana
mahādēvi vijayamatiyemboḷā irvarggaṁ maganenāṁ
vidyuccōranembeṁ mattā poḻaloḷ yamapāśanemboṁ
taḷāṟanātana peṇḍati nijaguṇadēvateyemboḷā irvarggaṁ
maganītaṁ yamadaṇḍanemboṁ mattāmirvemuṁ
samānavayasaremaydāṟu varṣada prāyadandu
śrāvakanappa siddhārthanembupādhyāyana pakkade irvaru
manōdaliṭṭoḍēḻeṇṭu varuṣadoḷage vyākaraṇaṁ
pramāṇaṁ chandamalaṅkāraṁ nighaṇṭu kāvyaṁ nāṭakaṁ
sāmudrikaṁ vātsyāyanaṁ śālihōtraṁ pālakāpyaṁ cāṇakyaṁ
vaidyaṁ modalāgoḍeya śāstraṅgaḷanellamanirvaruṁ kaltu
baḻikkītaṁ taḷāṟana maganappudaṟiṁ tanage takka kaḷḷaranārayva
teṟanaṁ pēḻva surakhamembōdaṁ kaltonānuṁ kaḷvupāyamaṁ
pēḻva karapaṭaśāstramaṁ kaltenintemaganyōnya prītiyindaṁ
kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasamirvaruṁ
vanakrīḍeyāḍalendindrōpamamemba vanakke
pōgiyalliyaśōka punnāga vakuḷa tiḷaka tamāḷa campaka
kramuka nāḷikēra kharjūra jambu jambīra panasa dāḍima
kadaḷī drākṣā sahakāraṁ modalāgoḍeya palavuṁ
teṟada vr̥kṣa jātigaḷindaṁ kikkiṟigiṟidirda nandanavana
doḷirvarumuḷiseṁḍanāḍuttiralōkana vidyeyanītaṁ
kaltanappudaṟindelliyuḷidoḍaṁ kāṇalāgadītanaṁ
nīḍumaṟasi kāṇade desegeṭṭu bēsattānintendenakkuṁ magane
nīṁ taḷāṟanappandu ninna kāpinoḷ kaḷdu ninnaṁ kolisadāgaḷē
nāytendu nuḍidoḍītanumintendanakkuṁ magane nīnenna
taḷāṟugeyvandu kaḷdoḍe ninnaṁ piḍiduḍiye kaṭṭi kaḷḷara
daṇḍaṇeyiṁ daṇḍisadāgaḷēnāytendu nuḍidoḍī nuḍiyaṁ
maṟeyalvēḍendirvarumōrorvaraṁ mūdalisi pratijñegeydu

kelakāladindenna tandeyenage rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi śrutasāgararemba
bhaṭṭārara pakkade tapambaṭṭanītana tandeyuṁ tanna
santānamanītaṅge koṭṭarasanoḍane tapambaṭṭaṁ
mattānuṁ rājyaṅgeyyuttire ītanumā poḻaloḷ
taḷāṟugeyyuttirkumintu sukhadoḷirvarggaṁ kālaṁ
sale mattondu divasamītaṁ tanna manadoḷintendu
bagedanennarasaṁ kaḷḷanānumī poḻaloḷ taḷāṟugeyvenidu
kajjamoḷḷittaltendenagañji nāḍaṁ biṭṭu bandu
nimagāḷādanānumītananennāḷva nāḍeṇṭudeseya grāma
nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba pattana drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷo
ḷāraysiyuṁ kāṇade paramaṇḍalaṅgaḷoḷamāraysiyuṁ
kāṇadilligārayyalaṭṭidoḍe carapuruṣarāraydu kaṇḍu
bandenagintendu pēḻdar
dēvā mithiḷeyemba poḻaladanāḷvoṁ vāmarathanembarasaṅge
yamadaṇḍaṁ pōgiyāḷāgi poḻala kāpambettu taḷāṟanāgi
sukhadoḷirdonendu pēḻdoḍā mātanāṁ kēḷdu
puruṣōttamanemba mantrige mithiḷeyemba poḻalgānāru
maṟiyadantire pōgi yamadaṇḍananoḍagoṇḍu
bandapenendu pēḻdu vajrasēnanemba pergaḍeyaṁ kareyisi
ānondu manevāḻtege pōgi bandapenenna barpannegaṁ
rājyamaṁ pratipālisuttirendu kalpisi samasta rājyabhāramaṁ
samarpisi ardharātradāgaḷ kappaḍamaṁ paṟiduṭṭu
baḻikārumaṟiyalīyadorvane poṟamaṭṭu bandī
poḻalaṁ pokku pratijñe kāraṇamāgi kasavaramaṁ kaḷdītanaṁ
kolisuvantu māḍidenidu kaḷdudarke kāraṇamītanumenagī
pāṅginoḷ mitranendu pēḻdu mattamintendaṁ nimma
dēvatādhiṣṭhitamappa sarvarujāpahāramemba hāramadhigama
samyag dr̥ṣṭiyenappudaṟindenna keygevanduduḻida
mithyādr̥ṣṭigaḷa keyge vāradendoḍe

arasaṁ tanna sabheyoḷirda neravigellaṁ hāraṁ banda
teṟananintendu pēḻal toḍagidoṁ dhanvantari
viśvānulōmarkaḷa katheyaṁ modaliṁ taguḷdu pēḻutta
mintendanemma santatiya padmarathanembarasanondu
divasaṁ vāsupūjyatīrthakara paramadēvaraṁ
bandisal pōguttirdonaneḍeyoḷacyutēndranuṁ
viśvānulōmacaranappa vāhanadēvanumintirvaruṁ
kaṇḍu acyutēndraṁ vāhanadēvananintendanītaṁ
adharmiyinde dharmamaṁ keykoṇḍu vāsupūjyatīrthakara
paramadēvaraṁ bandisidalladuṇṇenendāgrahaṅgoṇḍu
campānagarakkevōdapponītanaṁ pōgalīyade
maguḻcalārpoḍe maguḻcendu nuḍidoḍe vāhanadēvanuṁ
tannārpa teṟadindellamenitānuṁ teṟadupasargaṁ
geydu maguḻcalāṟade bēsattuḻidoḍe acyutēndraṁ
padmarathaṅgosedu tanna toṭṭa sarvarujāpahāramemba hārama
nātana koraloḷ tāne kaṭṭi pogaḻdu pūjisipōdonintī
pāṅginoḷemagī hāraṁ santatiyiṁ bandudendu

pēḻirda tadanantaraṁ irvar parivoṭṭeyavarōleyaṁ
koṇḍubandarasana maneya bāgiloḷ nindu
paḍiyaṟaṅge pēḻdoḍe paḍiyaṟaṁ tammarasaṅge
pēḻdoḍarasananumatadindaramaneyaṁ
pokkāsthānamaṇṭapadoḷirda vidyuccōranaṁ kaṇḍu
poḍevaṭṭātana mundōleyanikkidāgaḷ sandhivigrahi
ōleyaṁ koṇḍarasana mundintendu bācisidaṁ vidyuccōra
paramasvāmige mantri puruṣōttamanuṁ pergaḍe
vajrasēnanuṁ sāṣṭāṅgaveṟagi poḍevaṭṭu kāryamaṁ
binnavippar tāmuṁ palavu divasaṁ pōgirdar peṟataṇa
manevāḻteyaṁ maṟedirdar tāmillade rājyamaṁ
pratipālisuvorārumillīyōleyaṁ kāṇaloḍaṁ taḍeyade
poṟamaṭṭu bēgaṁ barkendu bācisidudaṁ vāmarathaṁ kēḷdu
munnītana pēḻdudumōleya mātumondādudendu
sandēhamilladāgaḷ nambi ītaṁ maṇḍaḷikanendaṟidu

tanna siṁhāsanadoḷōrantappāsanamanikkalvēḻdirisi
intendanenna taṅgeya maganay sōdaradaḷiyanay
ninagennamakkaḷaṁ śrīmati vasumati guṇamati sulōcane
suprabhe sukānte suśīle manōhariyembeṇbaruṁ
kanneyaratyanta rūpa lāvaṇya saubhāgya kānti hāva bhāva
vilāsa vibhramaṅgaḷanoḍeyar navayauvaneyarakṣarālēkhya
gaṇita gāndharva nr̥tya citrakarma patracchēdyamendivu
modalāgoḍeya catuṣṣaṣṭi kalegaḷoḷādamānuṁ
kuśaleyar paramaṇḍalikar palar pāguḍaṅgaḷumōlegaḷuṁ
pergaḍegaḷumananavarataṁ kūsugaḷaṁ bēḍiyaṭṭuttirpa
ravarārumaṁ nāṁ meccade kuḍadinnegamintivargaḷaṁ
tāṅgirdenī kanyāratnaṅgaḷge nīne yōgyanay ninageṇbarumaṁ
koṭṭen maduvenillendoḍātanintendanānorvaḷge
bēṇṭaṅgoṇḍirdenivaraṁ koṇḍēvenendoḍarasanārge
bēṭaṅgoṇḍirdeyendu besagoṇḍoḍe muktiśrīyemboḷ
peṇḍatige bēṇṭaṅgoṇḍirdenākeyaṁ maduve
nilalvēḻkumendu paricchēdisi nuḍidu mattamintendanenna
keḷeyananenagoppisalvēḻkumendoḍe

arasanumoppisidenendoḍe arasanaṁ bīḻkoṇḍu yamadaṇḍa
purassaramirvarumoṭṭeyanēṟi turipadiṁ katipaya
divasaṅgaḷiṁ vēṇātaṭamaneydi poṟavoḻaloḷirdu
pēḻdaṭṭiyaṣṭaśōbheyaṁ māḍisi mantri mahattara parivāra
sāmanta mahasāmantaruṁ peṇḍavāsada sūḷeyaruṁ
poḻala janamellamidiraṁ bandu kaṇḍu poḍevaṭṭu
sēsegaḷinikkida baḻikke paṭṭavardhanamanirvarumēṟi
beḷgoḍe modalāgoḍeya rājyacihnaṅgaḷ munde pariye
pañcamahāśabdaṅgaḷuṁ baddhavaṇada paṟegaḷuṁ bājise
aramaneyaṁ pokkuṁ

maṟudivasamāsthānamaṇḍapadoḷ siṁhāsanamastakasthitanāgi
sāmanta mahāsāmantarkaḷaṁ mantrimahattara purōhita
parivāradavargaḷamarasiyarkaḷaṁ baḻiyaṭṭi barisi intendu
nuḍidanānī saṁsāradoḷappa bhōgōpabhōgaṅgaḷge pēsi
viraktanāgi tapambaḍal bagedappenendoḍanibaruṁ neredintenda
rinnumāvudu kālaṁ tapambaḍalinnuṁ nīṁ kūsanay
navayauvananay kelakālamarasugeydu paścātkāladoḷ
tapambaḍalakkumendoḍarasanintendanentaṟiyalakkumannegaṁ
sāvaro bāḻvaro endī prastutaṅgaḷanavarggāḍi pēḻal
toḍaṅgidaṁ

lg.l:
vīryaṁ svēṣṭa samāgamō vasumatiḥ saubhāgya
bhāgyōdayō

yadi jātijarāmaraṇaṁ na bhavēt yadi
cēṣṭaviyōgabhayaṁ na bhavēt

yadi sarvamanityamidaṁ na bhavēt iha janmani kasya
ratirnabhavēt

div.p:
adaṟiṁ mānasara rūpuṁ yauvanamuṁ tējamuṁ
lāvaṇyamuṁ saubhāgyamuṁ āyuṣyamuṁ śrīyuṁ sampattuṁ
vibhavamuṁ nalmeyuṁ endivu modalāgoḍeyavanityaṅgaḷ
mattaṁ meyyoḷḷitteyendoḍaduvuṁ tānintuṭe

lg.l:
ēdaṁ sarīramasuciṁ ṇiccaṁ kali kalusa
bhājaṇamacōkkhaṁ
antō bāhiradiṭṭhaṁ sakkibbisa bharidaṁ tu amējjhapuraṁ
rasa majja māṁsa sōṇida puppusa kālijja sēmma sīhāṇaṁ
aṭṭhihi chaṇṇaṁ ṇāḷihi baddhaṁ kalimalabharidaṁ kimikulapuṇṇaṁ
chāyēva sakadakammaṁ aṇuyādi kāragaṁ ṇa sēsaṁ
durgandhē durdharē duḥkhē duḥsvabhāvē ca naśvarē
durvilōkē vr̥thā kāyē kintu jñāni tavāgrahaḥ

div.p: adaṟiṁ

lg.l:
ātmaśrēyasi tāvadēva viduṣā kāryaḥ prayatnō
mahān
prōddīptē bhavanē tu kūpakhananaṁ pratyudyamaḥ kīdr̥śaḥ

div.p:
endivu modalāgoḍeyavanōdiyavaṟarthamaṁ neravigellaṁ
vakhkhāṇisi pēḻdu mattamintendaṁ

lg.l: khammāmi savvajīvāṇaṁ savvē jīvā khamantu mē
mētti mē savvabhūdēsu vēraṁ majjhaṇa kēṇaci

div.p:
endellarumaṁ kṣamegoḷisi niśśalyaṅgeydu vidyudaṅganemba
piriya magaṅge rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi rājyābhiṣēkaṅgeydītanaṁ
piḍidu nīmellaṁ sukhambāḻimendu kalpisi yamadaṇḍaṅgaṁ
poḻala taḷāṟikeyaṁ koṭṭu maṅgaḷavasadanaṅgoṇḍu
paṭṭavardhanamanēṟi satiyar saṅgaḍaṁ bare peṇḍavāsada
sūḷeyarirbar peṟagēṟirkkeladoḷaṁ cāmaraṅgaḷanikkuttuṁ
bare beḷgoḍegaḷuṁ pāḷidhvajaṅgaḷuṁ tajinevaḻayigegaḷuṁ
candrādityarkaḷuṁ siṁha vyāghra makara matsyaṅgaḷendivu
modalāgoḍeya rājyacihnaṅgaḷ munde pariye
pañcamahāśabdaṅgaḷuṁ baddavaṇada paṟegaḷuṁ bājise
vandi māgadha yācaka prabhr̥tigaḷgaṁ dīnānāthāndharkaḷgaṁ
tuṣṭidānamaṁ koḍuttaṁ pōgi sahasrakūṭa
caityālayamaneydi

paṭṭavardhanadindiḻidu basadiyaṁ triḥpradakṣiṇaṅgeydu
dēvaraṁ vandisi guṇadhararembācāryaraṁ
gurubhaktigeydu vandisi intendaṁ bhaṭārā
saṁsāramemba samudradoḷ muḻuguttirddennaṁ
muḻugalīyadettimenage dīkṣeyaṁ prasādaṅgeyyimendu
nuḍidoḍambaḍisi sāsirvararasumakkaḷverasu kaṭaka
kaṭisūtra kuṇḍalābharaṇādigaḷaṁ kaḷedu bāhyābhyantara
parigrahamellamaṁ toṟedu guṇadhara bhaṭṭārara pakkade
tapambaṭṭaṁ matte dēvagaṇikeyarane pōlva saundari mahādēvi
modalāgēḻnūrvararasiyarkaḷ guṇadhara bhaṭārare guru
gaḷāge tammattevirappa vijayamati kantiyar kantiyarāge
tapambaṭṭu giḍigiḍijantraṁ miḷimiḷinētramāgi ghōravīra
tapaścaraṇadoḷ negaḻuttirdar

itta vidyuccōra muniyuṁ panneraḍu varṣambaregaṁ
gurugaḷanagalade dvādaśāṅga caturdaśa
pūrvamappāgamamellamaṁ kaltugrōgra tapaścaraṇadoḷ
negaḻuttumācāryarāgi aynūrvar śiṣyarkaḷ
verasu grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa
drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ pōgi pūrvadēśadoḷ
khāḷimaṇḍaḷamemba nāḍoḷ tāmraliptiyemba poḻala
poṟavoḻalaneydidāgaḷalli varāṅgāyiyemboḷugra
dēvategaṟudiṅgaḷaṟudiṅgaḷiṅgellā kālamuṁ jātreyappudā
jātrege nāḍeyaṣṭamiyandu bandu neredu jātreyaṁ
māḍe durgādēvate risiyara baravaṁ geṇṭaṟoḷirdu
kaṇḍidiraṁ pōgi intendaḷenna jātre samevannegaṁ nīmī
voḻalaṁ pugadirimendu bārisidoḍe śiṣyarkaḷendar nammaṁ
dēvateyēgeydappoḷ pōpaṁ bhaṭārā endu bhaṭārara
noḍagoṇḍu dēvate bārisevārise poḻalaṁ pokku

mattiruḷ poḻala paḍuvaṇadeseya kōṇṭeyiṁ poṟagaṇa
deseyoḷ vidyuccōra bhaṭārar pratimāyōgaṁ nindoḍe
dēvate muḷidu poṟasugaḷaniviriyavu daṁsamasakaṅgaḷaṁ
vigurvise meyyellamaniruḷ nālku jāvamuṁ tine
narakavēdaneyindamaggaḷame vēdaneyappantupasargaṅgeyye
antappa duḥkhamuṁ vēdaneyumaṁ manadoḷilladantire
sairisi ājñāvicayamapāyavicaya vipākavicaya
saṁsthānavicayamembī nālkuṁ dharmadhyānaṅgaḷaṁ dhyānisi
baḻikke pr̥thaktvavitarkavīcāravemba prathama śukladhyānamaṁ
dhyānisuttaṁ kṣapakaśrēṇiyanēṟi ēkatvavitarkavīcāraṁ
sūkṣmakriyāpratipāti samucchinna kriyānivr̥ttiyemba
śukladhyānaṅgaḷaṁ dhyānisi ghātikarmaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisi
antargatakēvaḷiyāgi aghātikarmaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisi mōkṣakke
vōdar

matte saṁnyasanaṁ geyyuttirda bhavyarkaḷ parama śuddha sahaja
ratnatrayamanārādhisuttirdor vidyuccōra r̥ṣiyaraṁ
manadoḷ bagedu daṇḍaṇegaḷumaṁ vēdanegaḷumaṁ
vyādhigaḷumaṁ caturvidhamappupasargamumaṁ
pasivuṁ nīraḻkeyuṁ śītōṣṇa vāta daṁsa masakaṁ
modalāgoḍeyavaṟindappa vēdanegaḷuṁ duḥkhaṅgaḷumaṁ
sairisi parama śuddha sahajaratnatrayaṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi svargāpavarga
sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: gurudatta bhaṭārara kathe
div.p: gurudatta bhaṭārara katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ
div.ab:
hatthiṇapura – hastināpuramumaṁ munnāḷva, gurudattō –
gurudatta risi, sammali thāḷīva – sūḍivottisepaṭṭanante,
doṇṇimantamhi – dōṇimantamemba parvatada sāre,
dajjhantō – bēyuttirdonāgi, adhiyāsiya –
upasargamaṁ sairisi, paḍivaṇṇō – pordidoṁ, uttamaṁ
aṭṭhaṁ – mikka darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷārādhaneyaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharata kṣētradoḷ
kuṇāḷamembudu nāḍalli sāvastiyembudu
poḻaladanāḷvonuparicaranembonarasanātana
mahādēviyar padmāvati amitaprabhe suprabhe
prabhāvati antu nālvaruṁ mahādēviyar modalāgi
arasiyarkaḷaynūrvar padmāvati mahādēviya
magananantavīryanamitaprabheya magaṁ vajrapāṇi suprabheya
magaṁ vajrabāhu prabhāvatiya magaṁ vajradharanintī nālvaruṁ
mahādēviyara makkaḷ uḻidarasiyara makkaḷaynūrva
rantavargaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ
palakālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ vasantakāladoḷ aṅkurita
pallavita kōrakita kusumita phalitamappa
manōharōdyānakkaynūrvararasiyarkaḷumaṇugarkaḷuṁ
berasu pōgi mahāvibhūtiyiṁ vanakrīḍeyaṁ piriduṁ
bēgamāḍi baḻikkā nandanavanadoḷagaṇa sudarśanamemba
maṇikuṭṭimamappa boḍḍaṇa bāviyoḷ karpūra kāḷāgaru
turuṣka kuṅkuma candanādi sugandha dravyaṅgaḷiṁ berasepaṭṭu
daṟoḷ mattaṁ nīlōtpala kuvaḷayaṁ modalāgoḍeya
nānā prakārada puṣpajātigaḷindaṁ sañchannamappudaṟoḷ
cakravāka baka baḷāka haṁsa maṇḍūka jīvaṁ jīvaka
cakōrādi jalacaravihaṅga samūhaṅgaḷanoḍeyadaṟoḷ
nālvaruṁ mahādēviyar verasondorvaraṁ nānā prakārada
yantraṅgaḷindaṁ jīrkoḻavigaḷindaṁ taḷiyuttaṁ nīrgaḷaṁ
sūsuttaṁ jalakrīḍeyaṁ manakkevandarasiyarkaḷoḍane nīḍuṁ
bēgamāḍuttirpannegaṁ

mattitta vijayārdha parvatada uttara
śrēṇiyoḷaḷakāpuramembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
vajradāḍanemba vidyādharananēka vidyābalagarvitanātana
mahādēvi madanavēgeyemboḷantavarirvarumondu
divasaṁ ramya pradēśaṅgaḷoḷ krīḍisalvēḍi bhaumavihārakkendu
vicitramāguttirda vimānamanēṟiyākāśapathadoḷ
pōguttirdavargaḷ dēvasamānarappa sāmanta
mahāsāmantarkaḷindaṁ dēvagaṇikeyarapsareyarkaḷaṁ
pōlvaynūrvararasiyarkaḷindaṁ peṇḍavāsadeḷaveṇḍi
rindaṁ parivāra janaṅgaḷindamintu divyamappa sabheyindaṁ
parivēṣṭitanāgi paṭu paṭaha paṇava tuṇava bhambhā mardaḷa
jhallari mukunda śaṅkha vaṁśa tāḷa bhērīmr̥daṅga vīṇā
kahaḷādi nānā prakārada tūryadhvanigaḷ dēvadundubhi
moḻaguvante bhōrgaredu moḻage

mahāvibhūtiyindaṁ jalakrīḍeyanāḍuttirpuparicara
mahānr̥patiyanirvaruṁ kaṇḍu vimānamaṁ niṟisi
nīḍuṁ bēgaṁ nōḍi madanavēgeyintendaḷ
nāmākāśadoḷ kāgegaḷantire pāṟuvanitallade namaginitu
vibhavamumaiśvaryamuṇṭe śrīyoḷaṁ rūpinoḷaṁ
vibhavadoḷaṁ nānā prakārada vinōdaṅgaḷindamuparicara
mahārājanindaggaḷaṁ peṟarārumillamī saṁsāradoḷ
barda bāḻanītane bardanendu pogaḻdoḍe vajradāḍaṁ
kēḷdu manadoḷ muḷidu puruḍisi tanna poḻalge vōgi
madanavēgeyanalliṭṭu tānorvane vimānamanēṟi
turipadiṁ bandu jaḷakrīḍeyanāḍuttirppuparicara
mahānr̥patiya mēge vidyeyindaṁ vigurvisi piridondu
śileyanettikoṇḍu bandu maṇikuṭṭimamappa sudarśanamemba
bāviya bāgilellamaṁ niśchidramāgi mucci kavidik
pōdaṁ pōdoḍe padmāvati modalāgoḍeya nālvar
mahādēviyaruṁ mōhisada buddhiyanoḍeyaradhigama
samyag dr̥ṣṭigaḷ caturvidhamappāhārakkaṁ śarīrakkaṁ
jāvajjīvaṁ nivr̥ttigeydu pañcanamaskāramanuccārisuttaṁ
dēvaraṁ jānisuttaṁ darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷanārādhisi
muḍipi saudharmakalpadoḷ svastikāvartamemba
vimānadoḷondu sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyar
sāmānika dēvarāgi nālvaruṁ puṭṭidar mattu
paricaranapparasaṁ mithyādr̥ṣṭiyappudaṟiṁ tannudyānavanadoḷ
rājyavibhūtiyoḷādamānuṁ mōhisida buddhiyanoḍeya
nārtadhyānadiṁ sattu tanna manōharōdyānavanadoḷ
pervāvāgi puṭṭidaṁ

matteraḍaneya divasadandu sāmanta mahāsāmantarkaḷuṁ
parivāramuṁ neredu anantavīryanemba piriya
magaṅge rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭidar mūṟaneya divasadandu
sārasvatarembācāryaravadhijñānigaḷaynūrvar
r̥ṣiyarverasu grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa
drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ ā poḻalge vandu
manōharavemba nandanavanadoḷagaṇa sphaṭikaśiḷātaḷada
mēgirdoraṁ r̥ṣinivēdakaṁ kaṇḍubandanantavīrya
nr̥patige pēḻdoḍātanuṁ saparivāraṁ bhaṭārarallige vandanā
bhaktige vōgi balagoṇḍu gurubhaktigeydu vandisiyuḻida
risiyarellarumaṁ gurupariviḍiyindaṁ vandisi piridubēgaṁ
dharmamaṁ kēḷdu

baḻikintendu besagoṇḍaṁ bhaṭārā emma tandegaṁ
tāyvirkaḷgamākasmikamormodalanibargamē kāraṇaṁ
sāvādudār kondarendu besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭārarintendu
pēḻdar sudarśanamemba boḍḍaṇa bāviyoḷ nimma
tandeyuṁ nālvar tāyvirkaḷuṁ jaḷakrīḍeyanāḍuttirpannegaṁ
bhaumavihārārthaṁ vimānamanēṟi pōguttirda
vajradāḍanemba vidyādharanumātana mahādēvi madanavēge
yemboḷāyirvaruṁ kaṇḍu nimma tandeya vibhavamaṁ
madanavēge pogaḻdoḍe vajradāḍaṁ puruḍu puṭṭi
bāviya bāgilaṁ niśchidramāgi mucci mēge piridondu
śileyanikkipōdoḍī pāṅginoḷavargaḷanibargaṁ
mr̥tyuvādudendu pēḻdoḍe mattamavarelli puṭṭidarendu
besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭārarintendar nimma tāyvirkaḷ
bratamaṁ paripālisi sāva kāladoḷāhārakkaṁ śarīrakkaṁ
jāvajjīvaṁ nivr̥ttigeydu samādhimaraṇadindaṁ muḍipi
saudharmakalpadoḷ svastikāvartamemba vimānadoḷondu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyar kāntanuṁ sukāntanuṁ
nandanuṁ sunandanumemba dēvarkaḷāgi puṭṭidavargaḷ
nimmumaṁ nimma tandeyumaṁ pratibōdhisalkīgaḷe
bandapparendu pēḻdu matte nimma tandeyuṁ tanna peṇḍir
makkaḷ parivāraṁ kasavaramendivaṟoḷ mōhisida
buddhiyanoḍeyanāgi alliya nandanavanadoḷagaṇa
sarpāśrayamemba guheyoḷ mahākāyaṁ pervāvāgi
puṭṭidanendoḍe dharmamaṁ kaikoḷgumo kaikoḷḷano endu
besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭārarintendar nīn pēḻe dharmamaṁ
kaikoḷgumendoḍe

tammandiruṁ parivāramuṁ berasu pōgi guheya
bāgiloḷirdintendaneleyuparicara mahārājā pervāvāgi
puṭṭiyumintappavastheyoḷaṁ bāḻkeyoḷaṁ innuṁ ninagaḻtiye
ninage dōṣamillēkendoḍe jīvaṅgaḷa svabhāvamintuṭu

lg.l: tatra tatra ratiṁ yānti svēna svēnaiva karmaṇā

div.p:
embudu tamma karmavaśadiṁ saṁsārijīvaṅgaḷelli
puṭṭugumalliyalliyaḻtiyuṁ meccugeyumakkuṁ munne
nīn karumāḍadoḷ siṁhāsanamastakasthitanāgi sāmanta
mahāsāmantarkaḷindamaynūrvararasiyarkaḷindaṁ
peṇḍavāsadaggaḷada sūḷeyarkaḷindaṁ
parivāradindamintappa dibyasabheyindaṁ parivēṣṭita
nāgi āṭapāṭavinōdaṅgaḷindirpātanay
īgaḷ pervāvugaḷoḍane nerediramāytu matte
divyamappa śayyātaḷadoḷ nidregeyvātanay īgaḷ
peṭṭegaḷuṁ kiṟugalgaḷumotte nidregeyveyāday
mattamr̥tōpamamappa dibyāhāramanuṇbātanay īgaḷ
kappegaḷumesaḍugaḷumiligaḷumontigaḷuṁ modalāgoḍeya
jīvarāśigaḷaṁ kondu tinbeyāday innavaṁ tindu
narakambugalāṭisidappay endu pēḻe

jātismaranāgi guheya bāgiloḷ bandirdu dharmamaṁ
kēḷuttirppannegamā saudharmakalpadoḷ puṭṭirda nālvaruṁ
dēvarkaḷ tamma munnina peṇṇarūpaṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu bandu
munde nindāgaḷ makkaḷ tamma tāyvirkaḷge kṣēmaṅguḍalendu
pōdoḍannegaṁ avar muṭṭade mēgaṇge negedirdoḍidēnendu
besagoṇḍoḍavar vajradāḍaṁ kole sattu tamma
dēvagatiyoḷ puṭṭida teṟanellamaṁ pēḻdu uparicara
mahānr̥patiyaṁ

lg.l:
ētat kṣētraṁ madīyaṁ gr̥hamidamaparaṁ mātr̥
bhāryā mamaitāḥ

putrōmēyaṁ mē sukānta svasr̥ duhitr̥janō
mānuṣō bandhuvargaḥ

arthō mē bhāryā mē putrō mē
svajanabandhuvargō mē
iti mē mē kurvāṇaṁ puruṣa paśuṁ hanti kālavr̥kaḥ

div.p:
endivaṟarthamanintendu pēḻdoḍe enna māḍamenna
poḻalenna nāḍenna tāyenna peṇḍirenna makkaḷenna taṅgevirenna
māvandirenna bandhuvargamennānegaḷenna kuduregaḷennemmegaḷenna
paśugaḷenna parivāramenna toḻtirenna māṇika bhaṇḍāraṁ
suvarṇa bhaṇḍāraṁ paṭṭisa bhaṇḍāramendivaṟoḷ
mōhisida buddhiyanoḍeyanāgiyārtadhyānadiṁ sattu
pervāvāgi puṭṭirdoḍīgaḷāmuṁ peṇḍirāgiyumi
niviridu śrīyuṁ vibhavamumaneydidemendu
pēḻduṁ tamma dēvatvamaṁ tōṟalvēḍi ākāśamellaṁ
citrapaṭaṅgedaṟidante vimānaṅgaḷiṁ sañchannamāgi
vyāpise parivāradēviyarkaḷindaṁ dēvarkaḷindaṁ
gaṇikeyarkaḷindamapsaraseyarkaḷindaṁ parivēṣṭitarāgi
nālvaruṁ dēvarkaḷ ghaṇṭājāḷa muktājāḷa samanvitamappa
ratnamayamāguttirda vicitramappa vimānaṅgaḷanēṟi
dēviyarkaḷ cāmaramikkeyāṭapāṭavinōdaṅgaḷindintu
tammaiśvaryamellamaṁ tōṟi intendar idellamemage
jinadharmada paramasatvada prasādadinādudu
mattuparicara mahārājaṁ puruṣanāgiyuṁ
mahāsatvamanoḍeyanāgiyuṁ mithyātvaṁ
kāraṇamāgiyārtadhyānadiṁ sattu pervāvāgi puṭṭidanendu
pēḻdu makkaḷaṁ pervāvumaṁ pratibōdhisi tamma svargalōkakke
vōdar

matte pervāvennarasiyarkaḷ dēvarāgi puṭṭidarendādamānuṁ
santōṣambaṭṭu dharmapariṇāmadoḷ kūḍirdudaṁ
sārasvata bhaṭāraraṟidu r̥ṣisamudāyamberasu
pervāvirdeḍege pōgi intendu dharmamaṁ pēḻdapar

lg.l:
sō dhammō jattha dayā sō vi taō
viṣayaṇiggahō jattha
dasa aṭṭhadōsarahiō sō dēvō ṇatthi sandēhō

div.p: mattaṁ

lg.l:
samāgamāḥ svāvasamāhi sarvē vibhūtayōpi
pratibhaṅgurāḥ syuḥ
niścayamuditasya ravēḥ patanaṁ jātasya maraṇamapi sarvasya
puṣpa phalabhāra taruvadyauvana bala vibhava rūpa saubhāgyāni

girisaridambhaḥ pratimaṁ sarvēṣāṁ jīvitaṁ ca dhāvati
śīghram

ēgō ya maradi jīvō ēgō ya divaṁ
uvavajjai
ēgō sa jāi maraṇaṁ ēgō sajjāi ṇirayaṁ vā
kasya mātā pitā kasya kasya bhāryā sutōpivā
jātau jātau hi jīvānāṁ bhaviṣyanti parē parē
arthā gr̥hēṣu tiṣṭhanti śmaśānēṣu ca bāndhavāḥ

div.p:
endintu piridu bēgaṁ dharmamaṁ pēḻdu
śrāvakabrataṅgaḷanēṟisi mattamintendar ninagāyuṣyaṁ
padinaydu divasamendu pēḻdoḍāmātaṁ kēḷdu
āhāra śarīrakkaṁ jāvajjīvaṁ nivr̥ttigeydu saṁnyasanaṁ
geydirdoḍadaṁ bhaṭāraraṟidanantavīryaṅge pēḻdaridu
saṁnyasanaṁ geydirdudidarke pūjeyaṁ māḍimene ātanuṁ
piriyapandaraṁ māḍisiyalli nānā prakārada nētra
paḻiyullavaṅgaḷumaṁ dhvajaṅgaḷumaṁ kaṭṭisi dēvatā
pratimeyaṁ niṟisiyabhiṣēkaṁ geyyuttaṁ mūṟu poḻtuṁ
mahāmahimeyaṁ pūjegaḷumaṁ poḍemaḍisuttire bhaṭāraru
mārādhaneyanarcisi svādhyāyaṅgoṇḍintendārādhaneyaṁ
vakkhāṇisal taguḷdar

lg.l:
muhūrtakālēhr̥dayē lalāṭējīvaṁ karaṁ nyasya samasthi
tasya
puvvēmaraṇaṁ jāī maraṇaṁ ṇirayē suvēdaṇāō ya
ekkaṁ paṇḍiya maraṇaṁ chindai jāīsadāṇi bahugāṇi
taṁ maraṇaṁ maridavvaṁ jēṇa madaṁ summadaṁ hōi
jai uppajjai dukkhaṁ tō daṭṭhavvō sabhāvadō ṇirayē
kadamaṁ maē ṇa pattaṁ saṁsārē saṁsarantēṇa
āhāridā ya pariṇāmidāya ṇacamē gadā tittī
āhāraṇimittaṁ kira macchā gacchanti sattamaṁ puḍhaviṁ
saccittō āhārō ṇakhamadi maṇasā vi patthēduṁ
ṇa imō jīvō sakkō tappēduṁ kāmabhōgēhiṁ
jaha jaha bhuñjai bhōgē taha taha bhōgēsu vaḍḍhadē taṇṇā
aggīva indhaṇāiṁ taṇhaṁ dīvaoti sē bhōgā

gurduṁ pordida cāturaṅga balamuṁ meygāpumā
vēḷegoṁ
ḍirdatyugra bhaṭarkaḷuṁ kavacamuṁ mitrarkaḷuṁ miḻtu mē
ekkamhi bhavaggahaṇē samāhimaraṇaṁ marējja jadi jīvō
sattakkhara sajjāyaṁ arahantāṇa ṇamō tti bhāvēṇaṁ
jō kuṇai aṇṇamaī sō pāvai savvakallāṇaṁ
maṅgaḷēsu ya savvēsu paḍhamaṁ havai maṅgaḷaṁ
ē aggēṇa visuddō tō hōhisi mōkkha suhabhāī

div.p:
endintārādhaneyaṁ padinaydu divasaṁ vakkhāṇise
dharmānurāgadiṁ kēḷdu muḍipuvāgaḷ vajradāḍaṁ durātmaṁ
niṣkāraṇamennaṁ kondanendu manadoḷ rōṣamaṁ bagedu
muḍipi bhavanavāsigalōkadoḷ nūṟu paḷitōpamā
yuṣyamanoḍeyoṁ nāgēndra dēvanāgi puṭṭidoṁ

mattanantavīryanuṁ bhaṭārar pēḻe dharmaśravaṇamaṁ kēḷdu
dharmada phaladindaṁ tamma tāyvirkaḷ dēvagatiyoḷ piridu
vibhūtiyanoḍeyor dēvarkaḷāgi puṭṭidudumaṁ kaṇḍu
rājyavimōhadiṁ tandeya pollagatiyoḷ puṭṭidudumaṁ
kaṇḍu manuṣyajanma durlabhatvamumaṁ bhōgōpabhōgaṁ
gaḷoḷappanityatvamumaṁ manadoḷ bagedu saṁsāra śarīra
bhōgadoḷappa vairāgyamanoḍeyanāgi subāhuvemba tanna
piriya magaṁ tannoḍane toṟeyal bagedirdonaṁ bārisi
ballāḷtanadiṁ rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi saṅkṣēpadiṁ rājyanītiyanintendu
kalpisidaṁ

lg.l:
tr̥ṣṇāṁ chindhi bhaja kṣamāṁ tyaja madaṁ pāpē ratiṁ mā
kr̥thāḥ
satyaṁ brūhyanuyāhi sādhu padavīṁ sēvasva vidvajjanaṁ

kīrtiṁ pālaya duḥkhitē kuru dayāmētatsatāṁ
cēṣṭitaṁ

div.p:
endintu maganaṁ kalpisi ellaroḷaṁ niśśalyaṅgeydu
bāhyābhyantara parigrahaṅgaḷaṁ toṟedu
palambararasumakkaḷverasu sārasvata bhaṭārara pakkade tapambaṭṭu
ugrōgra ghōravīra tapaścaraṇaṅgeydu sammēda parvatada
mēgirdeṇṭu karmaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisi mōkṣakke vōdan

mattitta dharaṇīndranondu divasaṁ jinēndra caityālayaṅgaḷaṁ
bandisalvēḍi mandaragirige vimānamanēṟi pōpāgaḷ
vajradāḍaṁ mattaggaḷamapūrvamappa vidyegaḷaṁ sādhisalvēḍi
kaḷatra sahitaṁ vimānamanēṟi mandaragirige vandātanaṁ
kaṇḍu tanna vibhaṅgajñānadindenna pagevanītanendaṟidelavo
pāpakarmā niṣkāraṇamennaṁ jalakrīḍeyāḍuvonaṁ
kaḷatra sahitaṁ kondeyendu mūdalisiyātana
vidyeyellamaṁ koṟedikki kaḷatrasahitaṁ piḍidettikoṇḍu
pōgi samudradoḷ mahāpātāḷada modaloḷikki
puḍukunīraḻduttaṁ piriduṁ bēgaṁ duḥkhamaneydisi kāḍi
koleyātaṁ sattu prathama narakadoḷatighōramappudaṟoḷ
khaḷakhaḷamemba naraka biladoḷ mūṟu
paḷitōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyoṁ nārakanāgi puṭṭi
yalliya duḥkhaṅgaḷellamananubhavisiyāyuṣyāntadoḷ
poṟamaṭṭu bandu piridappa nīlagiriyemba parvatadoḷ
puliyāgi puṭṭidoṁ dharaṇīndranumāyuṣyāntadoḷ
bandu kurujāṅgaṇamemba nāḍoḷ hastināpuramembudu
poḻaladanāḷvonikṣvāku vaṁśada vijayadattanembarasaṅgaṁ
vijayamati mahādēvigaṁ gurudattanāgi puṭṭidoṁ

ondu divasaṁ putrārthiyappa vijaya mahādēviyiṁ
besagoḷepaṭṭa gurugaḷemba r̥ṣiyarādēśadiṁ
puṭṭidoṁ gurugaḷittarappudaṟindātaṅge pitr̥ mātr̥gaḷ
gurudattanendu pesaraniṭṭar mattēḻu varṣadoḷage
catuṣṣaṣṭi kaḷegaḷuṁ dvāsaptati vijñānaṅgaḷumanellamaṁ
niravaśēṣaṁ kaltādamānuṁ rūpuṁ tējamuṁ gāḍiyuṁ
saubhāgyamanoḍeyanāgirdeṇṭaneya varuṣadandu
gurudattaṅge vijayadatta nr̥pati rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi sudharmaremba
bhaṭārara pakkade tapambaṭṭanitta gurudatta kumāranarasanāgi
siṁhāsanamastakasthitanāgi tandegentappoḍaṁ kappaṅgoḍada
maṇḍaḷikarkaḷa mēgetti moṭṭayisiṟidu maṇḍalaṅgaḷuṁ
durga vastu vāhanaṅgaḷuṁ samasta kappaṅgoṇḍellarumanañjisi
yaśamuṁ kīrtiyumanoḍeyanāgi intu
pr̥thivīrājyaṅgeyyuttirpannegam

ondu divasaṁ puliyupadravamaṁ nāḍavarvandintendu
pēḻdar dēvā nīlagiriyemba parvatada baḷasiyumirda
nāḍellaṁ pāḻādudā parvatada guheyoḷondu
perbuliyirdudu nāḍellarumaṁ javana rūpinoḷ
kondudappudārappoḍaṁ nāḍoḷiralaṇmarendoḍā
mātaṁ kēḷdu pūrva vairaṁ kāraṇamāgi krōdhāgni perci
kaḍumuḷidu puliyaṁ kolalendu payaṇambōgi
puliyirpa guheyaneydiyadaṁ baḷisiyuṁ mutte mahā
samudrada garjaneyane pōlvajanaravamuṁ paṭu paṭaha
śaṅkha tāḷa mardaḷa kahaḷādi dhvanigaḷumanenitenitanā
puli kēḷgumanitanitañji guheyoḷaḍaṅgirdattu
poṟamaḍalolladirdoḍā guheya bāgiloḷenitānuṁ
pulluṁ puḷḷiyumanoṭṭi kiccaṁ taguḷci puliyaṁ suṭṭu
kondu tanna poḻalgevōgi arasugeyuttirdanā
puliyuṁ karmanirjareyiṁ sattu surāṣṭra viṣayadoḷ
drōṇimantamemba parvatada sāre pallikhēḍamembūroḷ
salidābharaṇanemba pārvaṅgaṁ kaṭukiyemba pārvantigaṁ
haḷamukhanemboṁ maganāgi puṭṭidoṁ

mattittaṅgamembudu nāḍalli campānagaramembudu
poḻaladanāḷvoṁ dhātrivāhananembarasanātana
mahādēvi śrīmatiyemboḷāyirvvarggaṁ magaḷa
bhayamatiyemboḷākeyatyanta rūpa lāvaṇya saubhāgya
kānti hāva bhāva vilāsa vibhramaṅgaḷanoḍeyoḷākeyaṁ
gurudattanenitānuṁ sūḻ bēḍiyaṭṭidoḍarasaṁ
kuḍalollanantavargaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ dhātrivāhana nr̥pati tanna
baḍagigaḷ viśvakarmanuṁ viśvamatiyumemboraṁ
kareyisiyintendanaṟudiṅgaḷoḷage nīmirvarumō
rorvaraynūṟu rathaṅgaḷaṁ bēgaṁ māḍi
enagoppisalvēḻkumendu pēḻdoḍavarumantegeyvemendu
rathaṅgaḷaṁ māḍal taguḷdu aṟudiṅgaḷoḷā aynūṟu
rathamaṁ samedu viśvamatiyarasaṅge tandu tōṟidoḍarasaṁ
kaṇḍādamānumātaṅgosedu tuṣṭidānaṅgoṭṭaṁ
matte viśvakarmanaṟudiṅgaḷoḷ rathadondu gāliyaṁ
sameyisi tandu tōṟidoḍarasaṁ kaṇḍu muḷidātanaṁ
kolal bagedoḍañji ātanumā gāliyanarasana munde
maṇikuṭṭimamappa bhūmiyoḷettikki prāṇabhayadindōḍi
gurudatta nr̥patiyallige pōdonā gāliyuṁ padinaydu
divasambaregaṁ tanage tāneyantarikṣadoḷ nelanaṁ muṭṭade
tiṟrane tiriyuttirdudaṁ kaṇḍarasaṁ viśvakarmaṅgosedātanaṁ
bēgamāraydukoṇḍu bannimendoḍe keladavarendarātaṁ
nimagañjiyōḍipōgi gurudattaṅgāḷāgirdonene kēḷdarasaṁ
gurudattanallige tanna pergaḍegaḷanintendu kalpisiyaṭṭidoṁ
kappamberasemma baḍagiyaṁ bēgamaṭṭugendu pōgi
pēḻimendoḍavaruṁ pōgiyāmātaṁ gurudatta nr̥patige
tammarasaṁ kalpisidante nuḍidoḍe

ā mātaṁ gurudatta nr̥pati kēḷdādamānuṁ muḷidintendaṁ
maṇḍaḷamanāḷvarasanāgiyuṁ peṟarge kappaṅguḍuvoḍī
siṁhāsanamuṁ beḷgoḍegaḷuṁ cāmaraṅgaḷuṁ pāḷidhvajaṅgaḷuṁ
pañcamahāśabdaṅgaḷuṁ sorkkānegaḷuṁ jātyaśvaṁ
gaḷumembī balaṅgaḷiṁ kajjamēnendu nimmarasaṅge pēḻiṁ
tanna magaḷabhayamati kanneverasu tanna paṭṭavardhanamumaggaḷa
vastuvāhanaṅgaḷumaṁ bēgamaṭṭugaṭṭadāgaḷ tanna
taleverasukoḷvenendu pēḻimendavara perggaḍegaḷoḷ nuḍidu
nimma baḻiyane ānuṁ payaṇaṁ bandappenendu nuḍidavarggaḷaṁ
pōgalvēḻdavara baḻiyane piridu vibhūtiyiṁ cāturvalaṁ
berasu poṟamaṭṭu payaṇambōgi katipaya divasaṅgaḷiṁ
campānagaramaneydi poḻalaṁ mūvaḷasu vaḷasi muttidāgaḷ
dhātrivāhanaṁ tanna samasta sādhanaṁ berasu
poṟamaṭṭoḍḍaṇamanoḍḍe bil billoḷ kudure
kudureyoḷ rathaṁ rathadoḷaṇiyaṇiyoḷ ghaṭeyāne
ghaṭeyāneyoḷ taḷtu tāgi palavu divasaṁ kādeyondu
divasaṁ gurudatta nr̥patiya pradhānananappa mahāsāmantaṁ
mahēndradattanembarasanātana muṅgay dhātri
vāhanana yōdhaniṁ cakrapāṇiyiṁ khaṇḍise paṭṭudāgi
neladoḷ birdudaṁ pardu kaṇḍukoṇḍākāśadoḷ
pāṟipōguttamabhayamati tanna kanyāmāḍaderaḍaneya neleya
mundaṇa cavukigeya mēle dādiyuṁ sakhījanaṅgaḷ berasu
naḍapāḍuttirdaḷa mundā keyyaṁ pardu tandikkidoḍadu vajra
vaiḍūrya padmarāga puṣyarāga sasya karkētana indranīlaṁ
modalāgoḍeya anarghyamappa māṇikadiṁ sameda palavuṁ
nānā prakārada kaṅkaṇaṅgaḷumaṁ toṭṭa muṅgeyyuṁ
beralgaḷuṁ śaṅkha cakra padmāṅkuśa cāmara tōraṇa patākādi
śubhalakṣaṇāṅkitamāgi kendāvareya baṇṇadantappa taḷamumaṁ
kaṇḍī taḷamanoḍeyātaṁ sāmānya puruṣanallaṁ
piriyarasanāgale vēḻkumendu mattī keyyēke khaṇḍisi
birdudabbā endu dādiyaṁ besagoṇḍoḍākeyintendaḷ
magaḷe nīṁ kāraṇamāgi intappavayavaṅgaḷanoḍeya
arasugaḷ palambaruṁ sattaparendoḍāṁ kāraṇamāgi ēke
sattaparenagadanaṟiye pēḻabbā endoḍā dādiyintendu
pēḻguṁ

kurujāṅgaṇamembudu nāḍadarke tilakamane
pōlvudu hastināpuramembudu poḻaladādamānuṁ
sēvyamappudadanāḷvoṁ gurudattanembonarasanātanatyanta
rūpalāvaṇya saubhāgya kānti dīpti dhr̥ti kīrti śaurya
vīrya baḷa parākramanoḍeyoṁ navayauvanaṁ sākṣāt
kāmadēvane ādamānuṁ pracaṇḍa dōrdaṇḍanuṁ
balagarvitanuṁ paramaṇḍalaṅgaḷaṁ palavumaniṟidoṭṭayisi
koṇḍāḷdapponantappātaṁ ninnaṁ bēḍi pāguḍaṅgaḷaṁ
perggaḍegaḷumaṁ palavu sūḻaṭṭidoḍaṁ nimmammaṁ ninnaṁ
kuḍalolladirdoḍe munidātana taleverasu kūsaṁ koḷvenendu
garjisi praḷayakālada samudraṁ mēredappidante cāturdanta
balaṁ berasu bandu poḻalaṁ mūvaḷasāgi muttidoḍe
nimmarasaṁ tannuḷḷa balaṁ berasu poṟamaṭṭoḍḍi nindaninteraḍuṁ
paḍegaḷindiṅgēḻu divasaṁ kādidappudu sāmanta
mahāsāmantar modalāgi palambarumarasumakkaḷ
sattarāne kudure padāti sattudarkke pramāṇaṁ mēreyumilla
mahāghōrataraṁ kāḷegamāgirkkumendu pēḻdoḍadaṁ
kēḷdantappoḍabbā nīmarasanallige pōgi intendu nuḍiyiṁ
nimma magaḷintendu pēḻdaṭṭidoḷennaṁ gurudattaṅge kuḍuvoḍe
kuḍugeyuḻida puruṣarkkaḷellaṁ moṟeyalladavarenage tamma
meccalladāgaḷīgaḷe tapambaḍuvenendaṭṭidoḷendabhayamati
kalpisida mātellamanarasaṅge dādi pēḻdoḍe arasanuṁ kēḷdu
tanna pradhānarappa nālvaruṁ perggaḍegaḷaṁ kalpisi gurudattanallige
kūsaṁ koṭṭenendaṭṭidoḍātanuṁ tanna balamaṁ kādalīyade
bārisidaṁ dhātrivāhananuṁ tanna balamaṁ bārisidaninteraḍuṁ
paḍegaḷ saṅgrāmamanupasaṁharisi sattavargge nondavargge takka
vidhiyaṁ māḍida baḻikke

kelavu divasadiṁ praśasta divasa vāra nakṣatradiṁ hōrā
muhūrtadoḷ kūsinanukūladoḷ mahāvibhūtiyiṁ
pāṇigrahaṇa purassaramabhayamati kanneyaṁ gurudatta nr̥patige
koṭṭu sanmānadānādigaḷindātanaṁ pūjisidanātanuṁ
campānagaradoḷ palavu divasamirddinnemma nāḻke
pōpamendarasanaṁ besagoḷalaṭṭidoḍarasanuṁ kūsiṅge
takka peṇḍavāsada palambarumaggaḷada sūḷeyarkaḷumaṁ
kari kariṇi turagāśva ratha śibikādyanēka vāhanaṅgaḷumaṁ
muttina māṇikada ponna mūdeṟada palavuṁ nānā
prakāradanarghyamappa tuḍugegaḷumaṁ baḻivaḻigoṭṭirvarumaṁ
parasiyavara nāḻke kaḻipidaṁ
matte gurudattanr̥patiyuṁ katipaya divasaṅgaḷiṁ tanna
poḻalaṁ hastināpuramaneydi mahāvibhūtiyiṁ pokkirdiṣṭa
viṣaya kāma bhōgaṅgaḷaṁ palakālamabhayamatiyoḷ
anunayadindanubhavisuttireyākege suvarṇabhadranemboṁ
magaṁ puṭṭidanintu santōṣadiṁ kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ hastināpurada sāre dharaṇibhūṣaṇamemba
parvatadoḷamr̥tāsravaremba gurugaḷuṁ aynūrvar
r̥ṣiyarirdarembudaṁ kēḷdu putra mitra kaḷatra
parivāra samētaṁ vandanābhaktige pōgi geṇṭaṟoḷ
vāhanaṅgaḷindiḻidu balagoṇḍu bandarcisi gurubhakti
geydu bhaṭāraraṁ bandisiyuḻida r̥ṣiyarkaḷumaṁ
gurupariviḍiyindaṁ bandisi piridubēgaṁ dharmamaṁ kēḷdu
tadanantaramintendu besagoṇḍaṁ bhaṭārā enna munnina
bhavaṅgaḷenagaṟiye besasimene bhaṭārarintendu vēḻdarī bhavadiṁ
toṭṭu nālkaneya bhavadandu nīṁ sāvastiyemba poḻaloḷ
uparicaranemba maṇḍaḷikanay jaḷakrīḍeyanāḍuttirpannegaṁ
vajradāḍanemba vidyādharaniṁ kolepaṭṭeyāgi sattā
poḻaloḷ pervāvāgi puṭṭideyallindaṁ sattu bhavanavāsiga
lōkadoḷ dharaṇīndranāgi puṭṭideyalliṁ bandīgaḷ
gurudattaneyādeyendu ātana nālku bhavaṅgaḷaṁ savistaraṁ
bhaṭārar pēḻe kēḷdādamānuṁ vairāgyamanoḍeyonādoṁ

mattabhayamatiyuṁ enna bhavamumaṁ bhaṭārā
enage besasimendu besagoṇḍoḍe bhaṭārarintendu
pēḻdar campānagaradoḷorvaṁ puḷuṅgāṟaṁ
garuḍavēganembonātaṅge nīṁ munnina bhavadoḷ
peṇḍatiyay gōmatiyembeyondu divasaṁ
samādhiguptaremba bhaṭārar palambar risiyarverasu grāma
nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ campānagarakke vandoḍavara pakkade nīṁ
pōgi dharmamaṁ kēḷdu kollada kaḷḷada madhu madya
māṁsaṅgaḷumaydu pālmarana paṇṇuṁ giṇṇumāḷambeyuṁ
intivellamaṁ tinnada brataṅgaḷumaṁ kaikoṇḍu bhaṭāraraṁ
vandisi manege pōgeyannegaṁ ninna bhartāraṁ bēṇṭeyāḍi
palavuṁ lāvugeyuṅke korasuṁ modalāgoḍeya
pakṣijātigaḷaṁ baleyanoḍḍi piḍidu kaṭṭi bāḻevāḻe
maneyoḷ tandiṭṭu matte bēṇṭege vōdanannegaṁ nīnavaṁ
kaṇḍu kāruṇya bhāvadindanitumaṁ biṭṭu kaḷedoḍavu
pāṟipōdavu matte ninna bhartāraṁ bandu pakkigaḷaṁ kāṇade
biṭṭu kaḷedarārendu besagoṇḍoḍāṁ biṭṭu kaḷedenendoḍe
intappa dharmārthiyenna maneyoḷiralvēḍendu baydu
poydaṭṭikaḷedoṁ nīnuṁ maneyindaṁ poṟamaṭṭu
pōgi naṇṭara maneyoḷirdeyannegamondu divasamā
campāpuramanāḷvoṁ dhātrivāhananembonarasumātana
mahādēvi śrīmatiyumantirvaruṁ mahāvibhūtiyiṁ
poḻalaṁ poṟamaṭṭavara śrīyuṁ vibhūtiyumaṁ
kaṇḍivargāṁ puṭṭidoḍoḷḷittendu manadoḷ
bagedirdu kelavu divasadiṁ sattu śrīmatiya
garbhadoḷ nelasireyākegellā jīvaṅgaḷaṁ dayegeyva
bayakeyādudanarasaṁ kēḷdu tanna poḻaloḷaṁ
nāḍoḷamārappoḍaṁ jīvaṅgaḷaṁ kolladantu gōsane
gaḷeyisidanadu kāraṇadiṁ ninagabhayamatiyendā tāyuṁ
tandeyuṁ pesaraniṭṭu bāḻdar

endirvara bhavaṅgaḷumaṁ bhaṭārar
pēḻdoḍarasanumarasiyuṁ kēḷdu saṁsāra śarīra bhōga
vairāgyamanoḍeyarāgi śrīdattanemba piriyamagaṅge
rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi palambararasumakkaḷverasamr̥tāsrava bhaṭārara
pakkade gurudatta mahārājaṁ tapambaṭṭanabhayamatiyumā
bhaṭārare gurugaḷāge suvrateyemba kantiyare kantiyarāge
tapambaṭṭu samyaktvapūrvakaṁ mahāvrataṅgaḷaṁ
kaikoṇḍācāramārādhane modalāgoḍeya
caraṇagranthaṅgaḷaṁ kaltu palakālamugrōgra tapaścaraṇaṅgeydu
nōmpigaḷindaṁ giḍigiḍi jantraṁ miḷimiḷinētramāgi
tamma meyyaṁ tavisi paścātkāladoḷ saṁnyasanaṅgeydu
samādhimaraṇadiṁ muḍipi kāpiṣṭamembeṇṭaneya
svargadoḷ svayamprabhamemba vimānadoḷ padinālku
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyanamitakāntanemboṁ
dēvanāgi puṭṭidoḷ

itta gurudatta bhaṭāraruṁ panneraḍu
varuṣambaregaṁ gurugaḷanagaladirdu dvādaśāṅga
caturdaśapūrvamappāgamamellamaṁ kaltu gurugaḷaṁ
besagoṇḍavaranumatadindēkavihāriyāgi ghōravīra
tapaścaraṇaṁ geyyuttaṁ grāmēkarātraṁ nagarē pañcarātraṁ
aṭavyāṁ daśarātramembī nyāyadiṁ grāma nagara
khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ kramadiṁ surāṣṭramaneydiyalli
drōṇimantamemba parvatada sāre haḷamukhanemba
pārvanirpa pallikhēḍamembūraneyduvannegameḍeyoḷ
nēsarppaṭṭoḍe yatrāstamitavāsigaḷelli nēsarppaṭṭattalliye
nilvarappudaṟindūra poṟavoḻala poladoḷ
baṭṭeya kaṇṇoḷ rātri pratime nindorannegamiruḷ nālku
jāvamuṁ bhōrendu permaḻe koṇḍu kesaṟādoḍe
nēsarmmūḍidoḍaprāsukaṁ baṭṭeyendu kaiyanettikoḷḷade
mattante sūryapratimenindorannegaṁ

haḷamukhanemba pārvaṁ tanna mūḍaṇa keyyanuḻalendu
