pōgi kesarādudaṁ kaṇḍuḻal padanaltendu beṭṭada paḍuvaṇa
keyyanuḻal pōguttaṁ tanna keyya sāre sūryapratimeninda
bhaṭāraraṁ kaṇḍintendanajjā enna peṇḍiti kūḻanillige koṇḍu
bandoḍe paḍuvaṇa keyge vōdanendu pēḻdaṭṭiṁ gaḍimendu
paḍuvaṇa keyge vōdanannegamātana pārvantiyuṁ
pagalappāgaḷ kūḻaṁ koṇḍu bandu keyyoḷagalamaṟasi
kāṇade sūryapratimeninda bhaṭāraraṁ besagoṇḍaḷajjā
enna bhaṭṭanī keyyanuḻal bandātanetta vōdaṁ pēḻimendu
besagoṇḍoḍā bhaṭārar maunavrataṅgoṇḍu nuḍiyade
kemmagirdoḍe piriduṁ bēgamirdu bēsattu kūḻaṁ manege
koṇḍupōdaḷannegamitta haḷamukhanuṁ keyyaṁ piridu
bēgamuḻtu sēdegeṭṭu pasidu nīraḍisi basamaḻidu kūḻaṁ
tarpudaṁ piridu bēgaṁ pāruttirdu tāradirdoḍe bēsattu
muḷidu manege vōgi elege kūḻaṁ tandeyillendu
peṇḍatiyaṁ soppunārāgi baḍiye ākeyintendaḷēke baḍive
yāṁ kūḻaṁ koṇḍupōgi keyyoḷaṟasi piridubēgamirdu
pārdu nimmaṁ kāṇade manege kūḻaṁ tandenendoḍēkallirde
kṣapaṇakanaṁ besagoṇḍeyillātaṅgāṁ mūḍaṇa keyge
nīṁ bandoḍe paḍuvaṇa keyge kūḻaṁ koṇḍubarpantire
pēḻdu pōdenendoḍākeyintendaḷenitānuṁ sūḻāṁ
besagoṇḍoḍaṁ pēḻdanillendoḍantappoḍe ninagēnuṁ
dōṣamillennanātanuṇṇapaḍisi kondanendu

peṇḍatiya mēgaṇa muḷisanuḻidu r̥ṣiyara mēge munisāgi
bhavasambandhiyappa vairaṁ kāraṇamāgi krōdhāgni perciyennaṁ
pasiviniṁ suṭṭonaṁ kicciniṁ suṭṭalladuṇṇenendu pratijñegeydu
pullabeṇṭeyaṁ posedu kiccumeṇṇeya koḍanuṁ beṇṭeyumaṁ
koṇḍu pōgi bhaṭārara mundiṭṭelavo savaṇā nīnennaṁ
pasivinindaṁ suṭṭeyanteyānuṁ ninnaṁ kiccinindaṁ suṭṭappeṁ
kāvorārendu muṭṭi mūdalisidāgaḷ

bhaṭārarintendu bagedarītaṅgēnuṁ dōṣamillemma
munnina geyda karmadudayakālaṁ bandudakkumademmaṁ
suṭṭappudītanemmaṁ suṭṭapponallaṁ suḍuvoḍaṁ
kiḍuvoḍalane suḍugumemma darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ
suḍalneṟeyanītanemage kalyāṇamitranendu bagedintendu
bhāvisal taguḷdar

lg.l:
ṇindantaṁ siḷahantaṁ sattuṁ mittuṁ tahēva
suhadukkhaṁ

jō samabhāvai peccai sō samaṇō sōya
pavvayaō
dujjaṇavayaṇasaḍagaraṁ sahanti ucchōḍaṇaṁ ca paharaṁ ca

tiṇṇeva ciṇṇevakhkhayi idēva agidēva udayaggisi
duṇṇārōgā

bighāde imaṁ sarīra viṇappadi aṇiccaṁ tiṇṇañcō
susadabhāvēṇa jhāṇēṇauttā
khammāmi savva jīvāṇaṁ savvē jīvā khamantu mē
mettī mē savva bhūdēsu vēraṁ majja ṇa kēṇa ci

div.p:
endintu kṣameyaṁ bhāvisuttirpannegaṁ haḷamukhanuṁ
beṇṭeyaneṇṇeyoḷ toydu nakhāgradiṁ toṭṭu nettivaregaṁ
baḷasiyuṁ meyyaṁ sutti ellā eḍegaḷoḷaṁ kiccaṁ
taguḷciyeṇṇeyaṁ taḷiyuttiralurikoṇḍēkajvāleyāgi
suḍeyā kiccu meyyaṁ pordadannegaṁ
bhaṭārarājñāvicayamapāyavicaya vipākavicaya
saṁsthānavicayamembī nālku dharmadhyānaṅgaḷaṁ
dhyānisuttaṁ baḻikke pr̥thaktvavitarkavīcāramemba
prathamaśukladhyānamaṁ dhyānisi sūkṣmasāmparāyaguṇasthāna
doḷ mōhanīyadakāṇḍaka ghātaṁ tīrdu carama
kāṇḍakada carama pāḷibirda nantara samayaṁ
modalgoṇḍu jānisiyalliṁ baḻiyamēkatvavitarka
vīcāramemberaḍaneya śukladhyānamaṁ kṣīṇakaṣāyanāgi
jānisi baḻiyaṁ caramasamayadoḷ nālku karmamaṁ
kiḍisuva samayadoḷ rasa rudhira māṁsa mēdōsthi
majja śuklamemba saptadhātugaḷumavaṟoḍane keṭṭuvu
matte ghāti karmaṅgaḷavāvuvendoḍe aydu teṟada
jñānāvaraṇīyamombattu teṟada darśanāvaraṇīya
manteraḍuṁ karmaṅgaḷa kēḍinoḷ lōkālōkadoḷagaṇa
sūkṣmāntarita dūra padārtha vastugaḷellamaṁ krama
karaṇa vyavadhānarahitamāgi bageyade taḍeyade
suḻiyade mōhisade ellā vastugaḷanormodalaṟiva
kāṇbanantajñānamumanantadarśanamumanoḍeyarādar
mattirpatteṇṭu teṟada mōhanīyavemba karmada kēḍiniṁ
anantasukhigaḷādar mattamaydu teṟadantarāyamemba
karmada kēḍinindamanantavīryamanoḍeyarādar
antormodale ghātikarmaṅgaḷa nālkaṟa
kēḍinindamanantacatuṣṭayamanoḍeyar
muṇḍakēvaḷigaḷāgirdar

annegamindrana besadiṁ dhanadaṁ māḍida nelada mēgaisāsira
billutsēdhadoḷantarikṣadoḷondu yōjana vistīrṇamēka
śileyappindranīlamaṇikuṭṭima bhūmiyakkumadaṟa mēge
ēka yōjana vistīrṇa ratnamayamappa śrī maṇṭapamakkuṁ
mattaṁ nālkuṁ deseyoḷaṁ kanakamayamappa nālkuṁ sōpāna
paṅktigaḷanoḍeya bhūmiya mēge siṁhāsanamakkuṁ
adaṟa mēgalardda pondāmareyakkumadaṁ nālveralaṁ
muṭṭade adaṟa mēge palyaṅkadoḷirdondu beḷgoḍeya
noḍeyonāgi mūvatteraḍuṁ cāmaraṅgaḷiṁ dēvarkaḷ
bīsuttamintirpannegaṁ

lg.l: puṇṭiha kappavāsī sihaṇiṇā e i jō isiyā

div.p:
endī pēḻda cihnaṅgaḷindaṟidu caturvidha dēvanikāyaṁ
tantamma parivāraṁ berasu bandu divyamappa gandha puṣpa dhūpa
dīpākṣataṅgaḷindarcisi vandisi samavasaraṇa kōṣṭhaṅgaḷoḷ
tantammirpa sthānaṅgaḷoḷ dēvarkaḷuṁ dēviyarkaḷuṁ
cāturvarṇya saṅghamuṁ mr̥gaṅgaḷuṁ baḷasiyuṁ bandu
dharmamaṁ kēḷuttirdar

annegaṁ haḷamukhanuṁ dharmamaṁ kēḷdu nindirddintendu
binnapaṅgeydaṁ bhaṭārā nimagāṁ pollakeydenadanenage
kṣamiyisimendeṟagi poḍevaṭṭoḍe bhaṭārarendar ninagēnuṁ
dōṣamillendātana tamma bhavaṅgaḷaṁ pēḻdoḍe kēḷdīgeyda
pāpamintallade piṅgadenage dīkṣeyaṁ dayegeyyimendu bēḍi
tapambaṭṭu śiṣyanāgi āgamaṅgaḷanōduttirdan

itta gurudatta kēvaḷiyuṁ grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa
maḍamba paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ bhavyavara
puṇḍarīkarkaḷge dharmāmr̥tamaṁ kaṟeyuttaṁ palambarumaṁ
dharmaṅgoḷisuttaṁ mattamā pallikhēḍamembūrge
bandu yōga nirōdhaṁ geydu ayōgi bhaṭārarāgi
pañca hrasvākṣarōccāraṇa mātra kāladindāyurnāma
gōtra vēdanīyamemba nālkumaghāti karmaṅgaḷa
normodale kiḍisi ēkasamayadoḷage mōkṣasthānadoḷ
nelasi jāti jarāmaraṇaṅgaḷuṁ pasivuṁ nīraḻke
śītōṣṇavātaṁ modalāgoḍeya āva bādhegaḷillada
anantajñānamanantadarśanamanantasukhamanantavīryadoḷ
kūḍi ellā kālamuṁ sukhiyāgirdar

lg.l:
arujamamaraṇaṁ madhuraṁ akkhaya sokkhaṁ
aṇōvamaṁ pattā

div.p:
matte haḷamukha risiyarumāgamaṅgaḷellamaṁ kaltu
ēkavihāriyāgi grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba
paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ koṅkaṇa
viṣayamaneydiyānāḍoḷ pōguttaṁ ūraneydadeḍeyoḷ
poladoḷ nēsarppaṭṭoḍe yatrāstamitavāsiyelli
nēsarppaṭṭoḍalliye nilvarappudaṟiṁ kummariyaṁ
suḍalendu kaḍidoṭṭida maraṅgaḷa mēgiruḷ dēvaraṁ
bandisi niyamaṅgeydu jōga bhaktiyindirdarannegaṁ
kummariyaṁ suḍalendu tuṅgabhadranemba pōḍuṅgāṟaṁ
sorki tūṅkaḍindiruḷ kaḻdiṅgaḷ kaḍugattaleyoḷ bandu
kiccaṁ taguḷci pōdonā kiccinindaṁ haḷamukharisiyuṁ
bēyuttaṁ dharmadhyānaṅgaḷaṁ dhyānisi śubhapariṇāmadiṁ
muḍipi padināṟaneyacyutakalpadoḷ irpatteraḍu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyonaccutēndranāgi puṭṭidoṁ

mattitta tuṅgabhadranemboṁ pōḍuṅgāṟaṁ nēsarmmūḍe
kummariyaṁ nōḍalendu pōdanannegaṁ sattirda risiyaṁ
kaṇḍu pañca mahāpātakaneṁ niṣkāraṇamaṟiyade risiyaraṁ
kondenendu nindaṇegaruhaṇe geydu tānumalliye kiccaṁ
pokku sattu vyantaradēvanāgi puṭṭi āyuṣyāntadoḷ
bandilli vindhyāṭaviyoḷādamānuṁ raudramappa
biḷiya pērāneyāgi puṭṭi baṭṭeyoḷ pōpa barpa
janaṅgaḷaneḻbaṭṭi koluttamirpudaṁ haḷamukhacaranappa
acyutēndranavadhijñānadindaṟidu bandu dharmamaṁ
pēḻdu pratibōdhisi śrāvaka vrataṅgaḷa phalamaṁ pēḻdu
samyaktvapūrvakaṁ brataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoḷisi pōdanāneyuṁ
koleyanuḻidu madhumadyamāṁsaṅgaḷaṁ toṟedu
ṣaṣṭhāṣṭama daśama dvādaśādi nōmpigaḷaṁ nōnuttaṁ
pārisuva divasaṁ prāsukamāguttirda taṟagelegaḷaṁ mēdu
gajayūdhamuṇḍu pōda baḻikke kadaḍida nīrgaḷanuṇḍintu
palakālaṁ saṁyamamemba bratamaṁ salisuttamirpannegaṁ
mattondu divasamaḍaviyoḷ bēsageya dinaṁ
kāḻkiccu taguḷdoḍe kicciṅgañji piridondālada marada
keḻage gajayūdhadoḍane bandirdudā maradoṇagida
kombugaḷoḷ kiccu taguḷdu tannaṁ suḍuvannegamondu
molaṁ kiccinindaṁ benduriya baṇṇamāgi paritandu tanna
kāla keḻage pokkoḍadaṁ kaṇḍu dayeyindakkaṭa ayyō
endu kāruṇyamappa manadoḷ kūḍi sattu panneraḍaneya
sahasrāra kalpadoḷ padmagulmamemba vimānadoḷ padineṇṭu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyoṁ sāmānikadēvanāgi
puṭṭidoṁ

puṭṭi dēvalōkada sukhamaṁ
palakālamanubhavisiyāyuṣyāntadoḷ baḻci bandilli
jambūdvīpada bharata kṣētradoḷ magadheyembudu
nāḍalli rājagr̥hamembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
śrēṇika mahārājanembonarasaṁ mahāmaṇḍaḷika
neṇchāsira makuṭabaddharkaḷgameṇchāsirvar
arasiyarkaḷgameṟeyanapponātaṅge eṇbar
mahādēviyaravaroḷage dhanaśrīyemba mahādēviya
garbhadoḷ nelasidan
ākegamintappudondu bayakeyādapudu
maḻegāladoḷāneyanēṟiyellā paḍeyoḍaneyaḍavige
pōgiyālada marada paṇgaḷaṁ koyvantappa matte baygiruḷina
manōhariyemba jāvadāgaḷ biḷidappa kāḍāneyaṁ
kāṇbudumintī bayakeyuṁ kanasumanarasaṅge pēḻdoḍarasaṁ
kālamallada kāladoḷ maḻegālamanentu paḍeyalakkumī
bayakeyaṁ tīrcuvudaridendu cintākuḷitamanadanāgirdu
tanna maganappabhayakumāraṅge baḻiyaṭṭi barisiyarasiya
bayakeya pāṅgellamaṁ pēḻdidarkēgeyvamendarasaṁ
besagoṇḍoḍabhayakumāranupāyamaṁ bageyalakkuṁ
nīmēnuṁ cintisalvēḍa niścintarāgirimendarasanaṁ santavisi
pōdan

annegamitta vijayārdha parvatada dakṣiṇa śrēṇiyoḷ
gaganatilakamembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ manōgatiyemba
vidyādharanātana mahādēvi kanakamāḷe
yemboḷāyirvvarggaṁ magaḷ kanakacitreyemboḷ
kanneyākeyondu divasaṁ pēraḍavige vōgi vidyeyaṁ
sādhisuttirpannegaṁ cintāgatiyemba vidyādharanākeya
rūpa lāvaṇya saubhāgya kāntitvamaṁ kaṇḍāṭisi nīnenage
peṇḍatiyāgendu kaiyaṁ piḍidu kāḍuttirpannegamākeya
tande magaḷ piridu bēgaṁ taḍedaḷendavaḷōkinī vidyeyaṁ
nōḍalaṭṭidoḍadu nōḍi bandu kūsaṁ cintāgatiyemba
vidyādharaṁ kāḍidapponendu pēḻdoḍadaṁ kēḷdu manōgati
prabhr̥ti vidyādhararkaḷellaṁ kūḍi pōgiyātana vidyeyellamaṁ
koṟedikki panneraḍu varuṣambaraṁ bhūmigōcaranāgirendu
śāpaṅgoṭṭoḍātanumadaṁ nīgalvēḍi rājagr̥hakke vandu
peṇḍavāsadaggaḷada sūḷe kāmalateyemboḷākeyoḍane
bāḻuttamākeya maneyoḷ panneraḍu varuṣambaregamirdu
avadhiya varṣaṁ neṟedoḍe tanna vidyādharaśrēṇige
vōgal bagedondu divasaṁ śmaśānakke vōgi iruḷ
vidyegaḷellamaṁ sādhisuvalliyākāśakke negeyutuṁ
bīḻutumirpannegamabhayakumāraṁ tandeya besanaṁ
tīrcalendupāyamaṁ bageyalvēḍi kaḻdiṅgaḷoḷ
naṭṭanaḍuviruḷoḷ maṇikhēṭamanuradoḷ sārci kiḻta
bāḷverasu poṟamaṭṭu poḻaloḷellaṁ toḻaldu poṟa
voḻalaṁ toḻalvannegaṁ śmaśānadoḷ mēgaṇgogeyuttaṁ
bīḻuttamirda puruṣanaṁ kaṇḍu

nīnārgēnembeyellirpeyākāśakke negedu mattaṁ neladoḷēke
bīḻveyendu besagoṇḍoḍātanintendaṁ āṁ vidyādharanembeṁ
cintāgatināmadhēyanenendu tanna vr̥ttāntamellamaṁ pēḻdoḍe
mattīgaḷ nīnēgeydappeyendu besagoṇḍoḍātanintendaṁ
nāṁ vidyegaḷaṁ sādhisiyenna vidyādharalōkakke pōgal
bagedappeṁ vidyegaḷ sādhanege sallavāgappudaṟindākāśakkogedu
mattaṁ neladoḷ bīḻvenendoḍā vidyāmantraṅgaḷanenage
pēḻendabhayakumāraṁ besagoṇḍu mantra
vyākaraṇadoḷādamānuṁ kuśalanappudaṟiṁ prastārisi
nōḻpāgaḷ mantraṅgaḷ hīnādhikākṣara sahitaṅgaḷendaṟidu
hīnamappalliyakṣaraṅgaḷaniṭṭadhikamappalliyakṣaraṅgaḷaṁ kaḷedu
tirdī pāṅginoḷ mantraṅgaḷanōdendu pēḻdoḍātanumā
pāṅginoḷ mantraṅgaḷanōdidoḍe vidyegaḷ sādhanege
sanduvu sandoḍe vidyādharanendanenagupakāriyay
varamitranay ninagāṁ besakeyvenenagēnappoḍamondu
besanaṁ pēḻendoḍe abhayakumāranendaṁ emmabbeya
bayakeyaṁ tīrcendoḍātanuṁ bayakeyaṁ besagoṇḍu
nēsarmmūḍidoḍe vidyegaḷindame bēsageyane maḻegālaṁ
māḍi biḷiyāneyanarasiyanēṟisi parivāramuṁ
paḍeyuṁ berasu gandhapuṣpavr̥ṣṭiyaṁ kaṟeyuttaṁ paṭu
paṭaha paṇava tuṇava bhambhā mardaḷe jhallari mr̥daṅga
śaṅkha vaṁśa kahaḷādigaḷuṁ munde bājise poḻalaṁ
poṟamaṭṭu vindhyāṭavige vōgiyaḍaviyellamaṁ
toḻaldu nōḍiyālada paṇgaḷaṁ tāneyāydu sōṅkilaṁ
tīvikoṇḍāgaḷ bayake neṟedoḍe mattā poḻalgarasiyaṁ
tandu karumāḍamaṁ pugisida baḻikkabhayakumāraṅgintenda
nāniṁ pōpenendānuṁ ninage bāḻteyādandennaṁ
nenevudendabhayakumāranaṁ bīḻkoṇḍu kāmalategaṁ pēḻdu
tanna vidyādharalōkakke pōdaṁ

matte dhanaśrīmahādēviyuṁ navamāsaṁ neṟedu
besaleyāgi magaṁ puṭṭidoḍātaṅge tāyuṁ tandeyuṁ
gajakumāranendu pesaraniṭṭar intiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ palakālaṁ sale mattondu divasaṁ
rājagr̥hada nair̥tiya deseyoḷ vipuḷagiriyemba parvatada
mēge vardhamānabhaṭārara samavasaraṇaṁ bandirdoḍe
r̥ṣinivēdakaṁ kaṇḍu pōgi śrēṇika mahārājaṅge
bhaṭṭārara baravaṁ pēḻdoḍātanuṁ siṁhāsanadinderdā
deseyattēḻaḍiyaṁ naḍedu sāṣṭāṅgameṟagi poḍevaṭṭu
pēḻdātaṅge tuṣṭidānaṅgoṭṭu ānandabhēriyaṁ poysi
putra pautra kaḷatra mitra parivāra sahitaṁ vandanā bhaktige
pōgi sphaṭikamaṇimayamappa sōpānapaṅktigaḷindēṟi
samavasaraṇambokku gandhakuṭiprāsādamaṁ
triḥpradakṣiṇaṅgeydu munde nindu stutiśatasahasraṅgaḷiṁ
stutiyisi bandisi gandha puṣpa dīpa dhūpākṣataṅgaḷindarcisi
gaṇadhara dēvar modalāgoḍeya risiyarkaḷumaṁ
gurupariviḍiyindaṁ vandisi tammirppōvariyoḷirdu
piridu bēgaṁ dharmamaṁ kēḷdu tadanantarame gajakumāraṁ
tanna bhavāntaraṅgaḷaṁ besagoṇḍoḍe gaṇadhara dēvarintendu
pēḻdar

ī bhavadiṁ toṭṭu aydaneya bhavadandu nīṁ
koṅkaṇanāḍoḷ tuṅgabhadranemba pōḍuṅgāṟanay nīṁ
kummariyaṁ suṭṭu pōgi poḻtaḍe bandu nōḍuvannegamā
kircinoḷ satta r̥ṣi rūpaṁ kaṇḍu karuṇisiyalliye
kircaṁ pokku sattu vyantaradēvanāgiyāyuṣyāntadoḷ
vindhyāṭaviyoḷ biḷiyāneyāgi puṭṭiyacyutēndraṁ
pratibōdhise samyaktvapūrvakaṁ śrāvakavrataṅgaḷaṁ
kaikoṇḍu pratipāḷisiyāyuṣyāntadoḷ padineṇṭu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeya sahasrāra kalpadoḷ
dēvanāgi puṭṭi alliṁ bandīgaḷ gajakumārane ādeyendu
pēḻdoḍe tanna bhavaṅgaḷaṁ kēḷdu vairāgyamanoḍeyanāgi
erdu vardhamāna bhaṭārargidiraṁ nindu kaigaḷaṁ mugidu
dīkṣāprasādaṅgeyyimendu bēḍi tapambaṭṭāgamaṅgaḷellamaṁ
kaltēkavihāriyāgi grāmēkarātraṁ nagarē pañcarātraṁ
aṭavyāṁ daśarātramembīnyāyadiṁ grāma nagara khēḍa
kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ
kaḷiṅganāḍaneydiyalli dantapuramemba poḻala paḍuvaṇa
beṭṭada mēgēkasthirayōgaṅgoṇḍu kalnelenindarannegaṁ

ā poḻalanāḷvoṁ narasiṁhanembarasanātana mahādēvi
vasumatiyemboḷāyirvvarggaṁ magaṁ narapāḷanemboṁ
mantri buddhadāsanembonantavargaḷverasondu divasaṁ
karumāḍada mēgaṇa neleyoḷirdarasaṁ diśāvaḷōkanaṁ
geyyuttirdātaṁ beṭṭada mēgā tapamirda r̥ṣiyaraṁ kaṇḍī
tapasvi bēsageyoḷ beṭṭada mēgirddēke bisilgāydaponendu
mantriyappa buddhadāsanaṁ besagoṇḍoḍātaṁ
kauṭilyabhāvadindintendanī tapasvige mahāvātaṁ taguḷduda
daṟindaṁ nindirddonendoḍarasanidarke mardēnendu
besagoṇḍoḍātanintendanā tapasviyēṟirda śileyaṁ
kāsuvudendoḍantappoḍe nīṁ pakkadirdu kāsendu
besavēḻdoḍātanante geyvenendu pōgeyā r̥ṣiyar
carigevōdarannegaṁ yōgapīṭhada sileyaṁ kiccina baṇṇadantāgi
kāsi pōdan

annegaṁ carigevuguttirda risiyaraṁ dēvate kaṇḍintendaḷ
nimagāyuṣyamillēke carige māḍal pōpirendoḍe
carigevugadante maguḻdubarporannegaṁ kiccina baṇṇamāgi
kāydirda śileyaṁ kaṇḍemaginiteyāyuṣyamendu
paricchēdisi siddhabhakti jōgabhaktigeydu caturvidhamappāhārakkaṁ
śarīrakkaṁ yāvajjīvaṁ nivr̥ttigeydācārya bhaktigeydu
kāydirda yōgapīṭhamanēṟi bāhyābhyantara parigrahaṅgaḷaṁ
toṟedu samatvībhāvaneyaṁ bhāvisi kiccinupasargamaṁ
sairisi caturvidhamappa dharmadhyānamaṁ nālku teṟada
śukladhyānaṅgaḷumaṁ dhyānisi eṇṭu karmaṅgaḷanormodale
kiḍisi mōkṣakke vōdar

annegaṁ caturvidha dēvanikāyaṁ bandu divyamappa
gandha puṣpa dīpa dhūpākṣataṅgaḷiṁ śrīpādamanarcisi
poḍevaṭṭu matte buddhadāsanaṁ dēvarkaḷ jaḍidu
nuḍidoḍavanañjiyendanānaṟiyade pañcamahāpātakaneṁ
pollakeydenenagormiṅge kṣamiyisimendu nuḍidoḍe
dēvarkaḷ kṣamiyisi tantamma naṅgaḷge pōdar itta
buddhadāsanumā risiyara tapada mahātmyamumaṁ
dēvarkaḷ bandu pūjisidudumaṁ kaṇḍiduve dharmamiduve
tapamendu nambi samyaktvapūrvakaṁ śrāvakavrataṅgaḷaṁ
kaikoṇḍu negaḻdaṁ mattā narasiṁhanr̥patiyuṁ paścāttāpamāgi
r̥ṣivadhegeyda pāpamintallade nīgadendu narapāḷanemba
piriya magaṅge rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi palambararasumakkaḷverasu
sudharmaremba bhaṭārara pakkade tapambaṭṭu palakālamugrōgra
tapaścaraṇaṅgeydu samādhimaraṇadindaṁ mikka ratna
trayaṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi sarvārthasiddhiyoḷ mūvattu mūṟu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyonahamindradēvanādon

intī kathegaḷellaṁ gurudatta bhaṭārara kathege pratibaddhaṅgaḷ
mattaṁ peṟar saṁnyasanaṅgeyda bhavyarkaḷ gurudatta
bhaṭārarumaṁ haḷamukha r̥ṣiyarumaṁ gajakumāra
bhaṭārarumanintivargaḷaṁ manadoḷ bagedupasargaṅgaḷumaṁ
nīraḻke modalāgoḍeya irpatteraḍu parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ
sairisi samādhimaraṇadindaṁ paramaśuddha sahaja darśana jñāna
cāritraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi svargāpavarga sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: cilāta putrana kathe
div.p: cilāta putrana katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ

lg.l: tadaviya cilāta puttō paḍivaṇṇō uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ

div.ab:
gāḍhappahāra – ādamānuṁ sairisalkariyavappēṟugaḷindaṁ,
viddhō – urcepaṭṭonāgi, mūiṅgāḷīhi –
kaṭṭiṟumpegaḷindaṁ, cāḷiṇikadō vā – onaliyavol chidraṁ
māḍepaṭṭa meyyanoḍeyanāgi, tadaviya – antu, cilāta
puttō – cilātaputranemba risi, paḍivaṇṇō – pordidoṁ,
uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ – mikka darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷārādhaneyaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷ magadheyembudu
nāḍalli rājagr̥hamembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
upaśrēṇikanembonarasanātaṅge jayāvati mahādēvi
modalāgi mūsāsirarasiyarkaḷantavariṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ palakālaṁ sale mattondu
divasaṁ upaśrēṇikaṁ bēṇṭeyāḍalvōgiyaḍaviyoḷ
duṣṭāśvamanēṟi pandiya baḻiyaṁ taguḷdoḍadu gāḷi
goṇḍondu desegevaridu vindhyāṭaviya naṭṭanaḍuve
suramyamemba bēḍavaḷḷiya sāre toṟeya taḍiyoḷ
kudure tanniṁ tāne sēdegeṭṭu nindāgaḷ kudureyindiḻidu
pallaṇamaṁ cadurasigeyumaṁ kīḻumaṁ kaḷedu kudureyaṁ
nīrūḍi maidoḷedu kaṭṭi tānuṁ nīraṁ kuḍidondu marada
keḻage cadurasigeyaṁ pāsi paṭṭirdan

annegamā bēḍavaḷḷiyarasaṁ mahākāḷanembonātaṁ
kuladoḷarasukulaṁ dāyigarindamuccāṭisi
kaḷeyepaṭṭonāgi bandalli poḻalaṁ māḍi palakāla
mirdonātanarasi saundariyemboḷāyirvargaṁ magaḷ
guṇasaundariyemboḷatyanta rūpalāvaṇya saubhāgya
kānti hāva bhāva vilāsa vibhramaṅgaḷanoḍeyoḷāke
palaruṁ kanneyarkaḷuṁ kāpinavaruṁ berasudyānavanadoḷ
vanakrīḍeyanāḍi barpāke upaśrēṇikana rūpaṁ
kaṇḍāṭisi nōḍe ātanumākegāṭisi sōltu nōḍi
basamaḻidu nīḍumoldu nōḍe kāpinavar jaḍidu
koṇḍupōpāgaḷondōleyanintendu baredaḷ
nīnalladenaguḻida puruṣar moṟeyallarendu bagedu
baredu peṟagaṇindōleyanikki pōdāgaḷōleyaṁ bācisi
nōḍi santuṣṭacittanāgirdanannegaṁ peṟagaṇindaḍivajjeyaṁ
nōḍi tēnatēnadiṁ tantramellaṁ neredu bandu paṟeya
kahaḷeya śaṅkhadhvanigaḷormodale bājise bēḍarasaṁ
kēḷdu dāḻi bandudendañji trastābhibhūtanāgiyōḍal
taguḷdoḍupaśrēṇikaṁ tanna pergaḍegaḷanaṭṭiyōḍalīyade
santavisidoḍātanuṁ ānegaḷa dantaṅgaḷuṁ muttugaḷuṁ
puliya tovalgaḷumaṁ camarigaḷumaṁ koṇḍu bandu kaṇḍu
kṣēmakuśalaṅgaḷaṁ besagoṇḍa baḻikke nimma kulamēnendu
besagoṇḍoḍātanarasukulamendu pēḻdoḍe kēḷdu
santōṣambaṭṭirdoḍātanuṁ arasaṅge birddu māḍirda
baḻikke kūsaṁ bēḍiyaṭṭi pettu praśasta divasa vāra nakṣatra
muhūrtadoḷ maduvenindu kūsanoḍagoṇḍu tanna
poḻalge vōgi ciḷāta mahādēviyendu pesaraniṭṭu intiṣṭa
viṣaya kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ palakālaṁ sale

mattittā nāḍoḷ sārthādhipati
nandimitranemboṁ seṭṭi sārthaṁ berasu paradiṅge
pōguttirdātaneḍeyoḷondūroḷ biṭṭirdanannegaṁ
tapōvararemba risiyarēkavihārigaḷ grāma nagara khēḍa
kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ
barporā sārthādhipatiya biṭṭirdūrge bandu panthāticāra
niyamaṅgeydu pagal dēvaraṁ vandisiyūrge carigevōgi
yūrellamaṁ tiṟṟane tiridu toḻaldāruṁ niṟisadirdoḍe
ūriṁ poṟamaṭṭu pōpa risiyaraṁ nandimitraṁ kaṇḍu
kāruṇyadiṁ niṟisi eḷḷuṇḍeyanikkidoḍadaṁ carige māḍi
prāsukamappa nīraṁ kuḍidu parasipōdar

ā nandimitranuṁ palakālaṁ bardāyuṣyāntadoḷ
jambūdvīpada haimavatamemba jaghanya bhōga
bhūmiyoḷondu paḷitōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyoṁ
bhōgabhūmijanāgi puṭṭidoṁ puṭṭiyalli

antu pattuṁ teṟada vr̥kṣaṅgaḷ bhōgaṅgaḷaṁ kuḍe palakālaṁ
bhōgōpabhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisiyāyuṣyāntadoḷ
mandarada nandanamemba vanadoḷ vyantaradēvanāgi puṭṭi
alliṁ baḻci bandu rājagr̥hadoḷ upaśrēṇikaṅgaṁ cilāta
mahādēvigaṁ cilāta putranemboṁ piriya maganāgi
puṭṭidanalliṁ baḻiyaṁ jayāvatiyemba piriya mahādēvige
śrēṇikanemboṁ maganāgi puṭṭidanuḻidarasiyarkaḷgaṁ
makkaḷ puṭṭidarantellamupaśrēṇikaṅge makkaḷa
ynūrvarantupaśrēṇikanaynūrvar makkaḷverasu
bhōgōpabhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ naimittikananarasaṁ
besagoṇḍanenna makkaḷoḷage rājyārharārendu
besagoṇḍoḍātanintendanaynūrvar makkaḷgonde
pantiyoḷ tuyyalaṁ baḍḍisiyaynūṟu nāyanavara mēge
biṭṭoḍāvanorvanañjaduṇgumātanakkuṁ mattaramaneyoḷ
kircerdoḍāvanorvaṁ siṁhāsanamuṁ beḷgoḍeyuṁ
pāḷidhvajaṁ modalāgoḍeya rājyacihnaṅgaḷaṁ kaikoḷgumātaṁ
rājyakkarhanakkumendu pēḻdoḍadaṁ kēḷdondu
divasamarasanavargguṇalikkavēḻdu parīkṣisi nōḍidoḍe śrēṇikaṁ
nāygaḷge tuyyalanikki tānumuṇḍonuḻidarellarumōḍidar
mattondu divasamaramaneyoḷ kircerdoḍuḻida
makkaḷellaṁ bhaṇḍāraṅgaḷumānegaḷuṁ kuduregaḷuṁ
jayanaśāleyumaṁ kaikoṇḍar śrēṇikaṁ rājyacihnaṅgaḷaṁ
kaikoṇḍanadaṟindarasanītaṁ rājyakkarhanakkumillirdoḍe
palambaruṁ munivar pramādamakkumendu bagedu nīṁ
nāyoḍanuṇḍeyemma rājyacihnaṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍeyemma
bāḻuttireyarasiṅgāṭisideyendu nevamiṭṭaṭṭi kaḷedan

ātanuṁ dakṣiṇa madhurege vōgi indradattanemba seṭṭigaṁ
śrīkānteyemba paradigaṁ magaḷabhayamatiyemboḷākeyaṁ
maduvenindanākegabhayakumāranemboṁ magaṁ
puṭṭiyintiṣṭa viṣaya kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttire
mattittupaśrēṇikaṁ mārugamemba poḻalanāḷvoddāyananemba
mahāsāmantaṅgintendu pēḻdaṭṭidanujjēniyanāḷva
pradyōtanembarasanīgaḷemmanuṟadirponātanaṁ piḍidu
kaṭṭikoṇḍu barkendu besavēḻdaṭṭidoḍātanuṁ tannuḷḷa
cāturdanta balamellamaṁ kūḍikoṇḍu ātana mēgeḻdu
kādidoḍe pradyōtaṁ kāḷegamaṁ geldoddāyananaṁ piḍidu
kaṭṭi seṟeyiṭṭaṁ matte vijayanemba kumāranuṁ piridu
tantramberasu pōgi ēnānumondupāyadindoddāyanana
seṟeyaṁ barduṅkisi rājagr̥hakkoḍagoṇḍu pōdoḍe
pradyōtaṁ muḷidavara nāḍaṁ sūṟegoḷuttaṁ
suḍuttaṁ kiḍisuttaṁ upaśrēṇikana mēge pōgeyātana
baravanaṟidupaśrēṇikaṁ tanna poḻaloḷ ghōṣaṇeyanintendu
toḻalcidanāvanorvaṁ pradyōtanaṁ piḍidu kaṭṭikoṇḍu
barkumātaṅgātana bēḍidosageyaṁ kuḍuven

endu toḻalva gōsaneyaṁ cilātaputraṁ kēḷdu piḍidarasaṅge
pēḻdu piriduṁ tantraṁ berasupōgi carapuruṣanaṭṭi
bēgaṁ dāḻivōgi jalakrīḍeyāḍuvananiṟidu
piḍidu kaṭṭikoṇḍupaśrēṇikaṅgoppisidoḍātanu
mādamānuṁ mecciyosageyaṁ bēḍikoḷ ninna
bēḍidudellamanīvenendarasaṁ nuḍidoḍātanintendaṁ
nimma prasādadindenagellamuṇṭu oṁdaṁ bēḍuveṁ
nimmantaḥpuramuḻiye panneraḍuvarṣambaregaṁ
peṇḍirkaḷoḷellamenna meccidante saydaṁ bāḻvenidaṁ
bēḍidenidanenage dayageydu salisuvudendoḍe arasanumante
geyyendoḍosageyaṁ pettu prasādamendu poḍemaṭṭu
sāmanta mahāsāmanta parivāradeṟatanigara pārvara
paradaroḷveṇḍirkaḷellarumaneḻedu baggisiyumoṭṭayisiyuṁ
koṇḍavaroḷ bāḻuttumintu panneraḍu varuṣambaregaṁ
tanniccheyoḷ baḻdavadhiya divasaṁ neṟedoḍarasanintappa
goḍḍamaninnāḍal sallendu bārisidoḍaṁ uḻiyade
tanna meccidante bāḻe arasaṁ muḷidu nāḍindiradaṭṭi
kaḷedoḍātanumaḍaviyoḷ mahēndranemba tāpasana
pakkakkevōgiyalliya durgamamappeḍeyoḷ poḻalaṁ
māḍiyadarke baḷasiyuṁ kōṇṭeyuṁ gōpura
dvāramumaṁ māḍi keladūrgaḷanoṭṭayisiyu
mōḍisiyumeḻedu sūṟegoṇḍumintu palavukālaṁ
sukhadiṁ bāḻuttirpannegaṁ

ittalupaśrēṇikaṁ karmaṅgaḷupaśamaṁ kāraṇamāgi yamadhara
bhaṭṭārara pakkade dharmamaṁ kēḷdu śrāvaka vrataṅgaḷaṁ
kaikoṇḍu vairāgya parāyaṇanāgi śrēṇikaṅgaṁ baḻiyaṭṭi
barisi rājyapaṭṭaṅgaṭṭi yamadhara bhaṭārara pakkade tapambaṭṭu
palakālaṁ tapadoḷ negaḻdu samādhi maraṇadindaṁ
svargadoḷ puṭṭidoṁ

mattitta śrēṇika mahārājanarasugeyyuttirpannegaṁ
cilātaputranāḷ bhaṭṭimitranembonātana sōdaramāvaṁ
rudramitranemboṁ rājagr̥hadoḷirponātana magaḷ
subhadreyemboḷākeyaṁ bhaṭṭimitraṁ bēḍidoḍākeyanātaṅge
kuḍade peṟarge kuḍal taguḷdoḍātanuṁ tammarasaṅgintendu
pēḻdanenna sōdaramāvaṁ tanna magaḷanenage kiṟiyande
kuḍuvenendu nuḍidanīgaḷ peṟarge koṭṭapponindu
maduve nerevudendu pēḻdoḍātanumaynūrvar
subhaṭaranāydukoṇḍu poḻalgevandu mogavaḍaṅgavidirda
kūsaṁ bhaṭṭimitraṅge kuḍimendu kīṟi cilātaputraṁ
bēḍidoḍaṁ kuḍadirdoḍe muḷideḻedukoṇḍu pōdoḍe
śrēṇika mahārājaṅge puyyaliṭṭoḍātanumā puyyalaṁ
kēḷdu anyāyadoḷ negaḻdātanaṁ kondu kūsaṁ koṇḍu
bannimendu sāmanta mahāsāmanta makuṭabaddharkaḷge
besavēḻdoḍavaruṁ baḻiyane taguḷvarannegaṁ pōgal
pāṅgillade cilātaputraṁ kanneyaṁ kondanākeyuṁ sattā
poḻaloḷ vyantaradēvateyāgi puṭṭidaḷ

tānuṁ bēgaṁ pōgi vaibhāramemba parvatamanēṟidonā
parvatada mēge sarvaguptarembācāryaravadhijñānigaḷ
aynūrvar śiṣyarkaḷverasirdoraṁ kaṇḍu bēgamenage
saṅkṣēpadiṁ dharmamaṁ pēḻimendoḍe bhaṭārarintendu
pēḻdar

lg.l: jaṁ icchasi taṁ ṇantaṁ jampuṇa ṇēcchasi taṁ tumappaṁ
purisa sīha taṁ icchasu saṁsāra mahaṇṇavaṁ tariduṁ

div.p:
mattaṁ abhāvidaṁ bhāvēmi bhāvidaṁ bhāvēmi endintu
saṅkṣēpadindaṁ dharmamaṁ pēḻdu mattamintendar
ninagāyuṣyaṁ kiṟideyendu pēḻdoḍe

ātanumantappoḍenage dīkṣāprasādaṅgeyyimendu bēḍi
bāhyābhyantara parigrahaṅgaḷellamaṁ toṟedu tapambaṭṭu
savvaṁsāvajja jōgaṁ viradōmhiyendu bāḻvannegamāhāra
śarīrakke nivr̥ttigeydu cilātaputraṁ tapambaṭṭu kāyōtsargaṁ
geydirdor
annegaṁ peṟagaṇiṁ balaṁ kēḷdu bandu kāyōtsargaṁ
nindonaṁ kaṇḍēnuṅgeyyalaṟiyade śrēṇika mahārājaṅge
cilāta putraṁ tapambaṭṭu kāyōtsargaṁ geydirdoninnemage
besanēnendu binnapaṁ geydaṭṭidoḍātanintendaṁ tapambaṭṭa
nappoḍoḷḷikeydaṁ tanna muṅgeyda pāpamumayaśamuṁ
paḻiyuṁ pollameyumaṁ nīgidanendu nuḍidu pōda balakke
baḻiyaṭṭidoḍavaruṁ cilāta risiyaṁ balagoṇḍu bandarcisi
poḍevaṭṭu poḻalgevōdar

mattitta subhadreyappa vyantara dēvate vibhaṅga jñānadindaṟidu
cilāta risiyaraṁ kaṇḍu pageyaṁ nenedu pardina rūpaṁ
kaikoṇḍu bandu nettiya mēgirdu kaṇgaḷaṁ tōḍi tine
perdaleya kaṭṭiṟumpegaḷumāgi meyyellamanurciyuṁ
saṭṭugadante baḷasiyuṁ chidraṁ māḍi kāḍe eraḍu
divasamiruḷuṁ pagaluṁ nirantaraṁ dēvōpasargamaṁ sairisi
śubhapariṇāmadiṁ muḍipi sarvārtha siddhiyoḷ mūvattu
mūṟu sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyonahamindra
dēvanāgi puṭṭidaṁ

mattaṁ peṟar saṁnyasanaṁ geyda bhavyarkaḷ cilāta risiyaraṁ
manadoḷ bagedu caturvidhamappupasargamuṁ pasivu
nīraḻke modalāgoḍeya duḥkhaṅgaḷumaṁ sairisi parama śuddha
sahaja darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷumaṁ sādhisisvargāpavarga
sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: daṇḍakanemba risiya kathe
div.p: daṇḍakanemba risiya katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ

lg.l:
daṇḍō yamuṇā vaṅkēṇa tikkha kaṇḍēṇa
pūridaṅgō vi

div.ab:
daṇḍō – daṇḍakanemba risi, yamuṇāvaṅkēṇa
– yamunāvaṅkanembarasinindaṁ, tikkhakaṇḍēṇa –
kūridavappambugaḷindaṁ, pūridaṅgō vi – tīvepaṭṭa
meyyanoḍeyanāgiyuṁ, taṁ vēdaṇaṁ – ā vēdaneyaṁ,
agaṇittā – bageyade, paḍivaṇṇō – pordidoṁ, uttamaṁ
aṭṭhaṁ – mikka darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷārādhaneyaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷ amaḷakaṇṭhamembudu
poḻaladanāḷvoṁ aviṣṭasēnanembonarasanātana
mahādēvi nandiniyemboḷāyirvarge magaṁ
daṇḍakanemboṁ puṭṭidonātaṁ garbhadoḷirdandu
nandini mahādēvigintuṭondu bayakeyādudellā
janaṅgaḷumaṁ daṇḍisuvantireyadaṟindātaṅge tāyuṁ
tandeyuṁ daṇḍakanendu pesaraniṭṭorātaniṁ kiṟiyoḷ
nandavatiyemboḷ kūsākeyanardha cakravartiyappa
viṣṇuviṅge koṭṭu daṇḍakanuṁ viṣṇuviṅgādamānuṁ
priyanappa sēnāpatiyādanantanibarumiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ palakālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ viṣṇu ariṣṭanēmibhaṭāraraṁ
bandisalkendu baladēvaṁ berasu putra kaḷatra mitra
saparivāraṁ pōgi samavasaraṇamaneydi sphaṭikamayamappa
sōpānapaṅktigaḷindoppuvudanēṟi gandhakuṭi
prāsādamaṁ triḥpradakṣiṇaṁ geydu bandabhimukhanāgirdu
stuti śata sahasraṅgaḷiṁ stutiyisi gandha puṣpa dīpa
dhūpākṣataṅgaḷindarcisi gaṇadhara dēvar modalāgoḍeya
r̥ṣisamudāyamaṁ gurupariviḍiyindaṁ vandisi
tammirpōvariyoḷirdu dharmamaṁ kēḷdu tadanantaraṁ
viṣṇuvintendu besagoṇḍaṁ bhaṭārā ī ati raudranappa
daṇḍakaṁ narakambuguvantire piriduṁ pāpamaṁ nerapidanītana
pāpakarmadupaśamamenitu kāladindakkuṁ mattamītana
munnina bhavamēnendu besagoṇḍoḍe

sakala vimala kēvala jñāna virājitanappa ariṣṭanēmi
bhaṭārarintendu pēḻdar ī jambūdvīpada
pūrvavidēhadoḷ vītaśōkamembudu poḻaluṇṭu
adanāḷvon aśōkanembonarasanātana mahāsāmantaṁ
sudhāmakanemboṁ tīvralōbhadonati raudramappārambha
karmadoḷ kūḍidoṁ tannārambhada keygaḷanokkuveḻtugaḷa
bāyaṁ kaṭṭiyokkisuguṁ mattaḍuva baḍḍisuva besakeyva peṇḍira
molegaḷaṁ sīreyiṁ kaṭṭisi kūsugaḷaṁ moleyuṇalīyade
besakeysuguṁ mattaṁ koleyuṁ piridārambhamuṁ
pervaradumembivu kāraṇamāgi narakāyuṣyaṁ kaṭṭi

kālaṁ sale ātaṅge śirōrōgamuṁ mukharōgamumāgi
vēdanābhibhūtanāgirpannegaṁ vaidyaraṁ besagoṇḍoḍadarke
pratīkāramondu divasaṁ tanage marduverasiyaṭṭa
kūḻanuṇalendirpannegaṁ samādhiguptaremba bhaṭārar
carigevokkaravaranati bhaktiyindaṁ niṟisi tanaguḷḷa
vyādhiyavarguṇṭembudanaṟidu tanagendu māḍida mardina
kūḻanavarge baḍḍisidoḍavar carige māḍi parasi pōdar
panneraḍu varuṣada śirōrōgamuṁ mukharōgamumā
risiyarge keṭṭattā sudhāmakanuṁ dānada phaladindaṁ kiṟidu
puṇyamaṁ nerapikoṇḍaṁ mattaṁ baddhāyuṣyanappudaṟiṁ
mūṟaneya narakadoḷēḻu sāgarōpamāyuṣyama
noḍeyoṁ nārakanāgi puṭṭi

lg.l:
acchiṇimīḷaṇa mēttaṁ ṇatthi suhaṁ dukhkhamēva
aṇubaddhaṁ

div.p:
intu narakalōkadoḷ kaṇṇemeyikkuvanitu poḻtappoḍaṁ
sukhamillade palakālaṁ duḥkhamananubhavisi bandilli
daṇḍakanādaṁ munnina bhavadoḷ prāṇigaḷaṁ daṇḍisida tanna
pūrvadabhyāsamane nandini mahādēviya garbhadoḷirdu
tōṟidanappudaṟiṁ daṇḍakanemba pesarāytu

intappa svānubhūtamappa naraka lōkada mahāduḥkhamaṁ
sarvajñar pēḻe nambi narakada mahāduḥkhakkañji daṇḍakaṁ
tapambaṭṭōdugaḷellamaṁ kaltu risiyarkaḷoḍane grāma
nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ carigevokkoḍāruṁ niṟisuvorilla
mūṟittu niṟisidoḍaṁ chardiyakkuṁ risiyarkaḷoḍane
carigevokkoḍanibargamalābhamakkuṁ mattaṁ vāta pitta ślēṣma
khāsa śvāsa jvarāruci chardi atisārākṣi kukṣivēdanāsphōṭaka
piṭaka śūla bhagandara kuṣṭha kṣaya gaṇḍa śirōvēdanādi
vyādhigaḷāgi rūpaṟiyalāgadantire vyādhigaḷindamoṭṭayise
paṭṭanāgi maguḻdu vihārisuttaṁ risiyarkaḷoḍane dvārāvatige
bandirdor

annegamondu divasaṁ viṣṇu bandu risiyarkaḷaṁ
vandisiyavaroḷage daṇḍaka risiyārendoḍe kelada risiyar
tōṟidoḍavaraṁ vandisi nōḍi vyādhiya prabalatvamaṁ
kaṇḍu vaiyāpr̥tyaṁ geyvudarkādamānumaḻtiyoḍeya
nāgi poḍevaṭṭintendaṁ bhaṭārā nimmanondaṁ bēḍidappeṁ
daṇḍaka risiyī varṣākālamanenna dēhāradoḷirdantaḥpurada
manegaḷoḷ caryāmārgambuguvudanenage
dayageyyalvēḻkumendoḍavarumantegeyvemendu
viṣṇuva dēhāradoḷ jōgugoṇḍirdoḍe viṣṇu tanna
pradhānanappa jayanemba vaidyanaṁ karedintendaṁ namma daṇḍaka
risiya kuttamanentu balleyante tīrcendu pēḻdoḍā
tanumantegeyvenendu divyauṣadhigaḷindaṁ māḍiduṇḍegaḷaṁ
piṭṭinoḷ sāsirvararasiyarkaḷa manegaḷoḷ prayōgisiyā
ruṣiyaraṁ mardanūḍidaṁ mattaṁ poḻaloḷagellaṁ uṇḍeya
parvamaṁ māḍisidanintu varṣākālada nālku tiṅgaḷoḷaṁ
mardanūḍi kuttamanimbumāḍidoḍe vaiyāpr̥tyaṁ
geyvudaṟoḷādamānuṁ udyōgaparanappudaṟiṁ viṣṇuviṅge
tīrthakara nāmaṁ kaṭṭittu mattaṁ daṇḍaka risiyara meyya
togal pāvina pere sulivante sulidu pōgi nirvyādhita
dēharāgi meyya tējaṁ toḷaguttirdudaṁ viṣṇu kaṇḍu vyādhi
keṭṭudendaṟidu ādamānuṁ harṣacittanāgi ā ruṣiyara
pakkade vaidya jayanaṁ pogaḻdoḍavar kemmagirdoḍe
vaidyanivarennaṁ pogaḻdarillendu manadoḷā risiyaroḷappa
muḷisaṁ taḷedu ārtadhyānadiṁ kelakāladiṁ kālaṁ geydu
vindhyāṭavī madhyasthamappa narmadānadī tīradoḷ
kōḍagamāgi puṭṭidoṁ

mattitta daṇḍakarisiyar tamma pakkade viṣṇu jayanaṁ
pogaḻdudaṟindamarasana besadiṁ vaidyananavarataṁ
tammanōlagisuvudaṟiṁ tamagenduṁ māḍida
vaiyāpr̥tyamanaṟidu nindaṇagaruhaṇaṅgeydu adarke
takka prāyaścittamaṁ koṇḍu siṁhaniṣkrīḍitamemba
nōmpiyaṁ nōntu vihārisuttaṁ pōgi narmadeya
taḍiyoḷ māmarada keḻage svādhyāyaṅgeyyuttirdarannegaṁ
ā kōḍaganavaraṁ kaṇḍu jātismaranāgi pūrvabhava
vairasambandhamanaṟidu muḷisiniṁ śaktiyembā
yudhadoḷōrantāguttirda māvina kombaṁ munivarana
toḍeyanurcipōge nūṅkittāgaḷā muniyuṁ tyakta
śarīranāgi samatvībhāvaneyoḷ kūḍirdonaṁ kaṇḍu

tanna meyyumītaṅge bāḻteyaltennadēvenendu sale nambi
paścāttāpamāgi markaṭavr̥ndamaṁ nerapikoṇḍu bandadaṁ
kiḻtu mardaṁ tandu poydu yativarana kālgeṟagirdudumaṁ
kaṇḍu muniyumī prāṇi bhavyanendaṟidu dharmamaṁ pēḻdu
samyaktvapūrvakaṁ brataṅgaḷaṁ koṭṭar aduvuṁ kaikoṇḍu
dharmadoḷ kūḍi tannaṁ nindisuttaṁ bratōpavāsaṅgaḷiṁ
meyyaṁ daṇḍisuttaṁ salvudondu divasaṁ parvata śikharadiṁ
pāydubandu barduṅki munivarara pakkade birdattāgaḷavaruṁ
saṁnyasanapūrvakaṁ pañcanamaskāramaṁ koṭṭar
aduvuṁ sattupōgi sanatkumāramemba kalpadoḷ eraḍu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyoṁ sāmānikadēvanāgi
puṭṭidoṁ tannavadhi jñānadindamaṟidu mahāvibhūtiyindaṁ
bandu dhvaja makuṭa sitātapatrādigaḷoḷ maṇimayamappa
markaṭa cihnadoḷ munivaranaṁ pūjisi poḍevaṭṭintendanī
dēvatvamuṁ vibhūtiyumaṁ paśujātiyappenage nīmittir
bhaṭārā endu tanna pūrvabhavasambandhamellamaṁ
pēḻdu tannoḍalumaṁ pūjisi pōdanāyeḍe
lōkadoḷamarēśvaramemba tīrthamāytu

mattitta daṇḍaka risiyuṁ grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba
paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ kramadinduttara
madhureyaneydiyalli sūryapratime nindarannegaṁ ā
poḻalanāḷvoṁ yamunāvaṅkanembonarasanātaṁ
daṇḍakanindaṁ palavu sūḻ daṇḍaṇegaḷaneydidanappudaṟindaṁ
daṇḍakaṁ bandanemba vārteyaṁ kēḷaloḍaṁ jātyaśvamanēṟi
ōḍuvana baḻiyaṁ mantri taguḷdōḍalīyade
māṇisiyintendaṁ daṇḍakaṁ tapambaṭṭu bandanendaṟiye
pēḻdāgaḷ maguḻdu bandati krōdhadindaṁ
kāsida moneyambuḷḷavanavaṟiṁ meyyananēka
śarasaṅghātaṅgaḷindameccoḍavarumā vēdaneyaṁ sairisi
samatvī bhāvaneyaṁ bhāvisi caturvidhamappāhārakkaṁ śarīrakkaṁ
yāvajjīvaṁ nivr̥ttigeydu śukladhyānaṅgaḷaṁ dhyānisi karmakṣayaṁ
geydu mōkṣakke vōdar

annegaṁ itta caturvidha dēvanikāyaṁ tantamma
jñānaṅgaḷindaṟidu citrapaṭamaṁ kedaṟidanteyākāśamellamaṁ
vyāpisi nānā vidha vāhanārūḍharkaḷ jvalanmaṇimaya
makuṭāgravinyastahastarkaḷāgi indrādi dēvarkaḷuṁ jayajaya
śabdaṅgaḷindaṁ munivarēṇyana guṇaṅgaḷaṁ negaḻteyaṁ
pogaḻuttaṁ barporaṁ kaṇḍu bhayaṁ kāraṇamāgiyuṁ
karmaṅgaḷupaśamaṁ kāraṇamāgiyuṁ yamunāvaṅkaṁ
tapambaṭṭaṁ tapambaṭṭoḍamā risiyaṁ konda pāpada
phaladindanēka mahāvyādhigaḷumādavu mattamā pāpakke
takka prāyaścittamaṁ negaḻdu palakālamugrōgraghōravīra
tapaścaraṇaṁ geyyuttaṁ grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba
paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ barpor
sajjātagiriyaneydiyalliye rātri pratime nindorannegaṁ
kāḻkiccu mūvaḷasaṁ baḷasiyuṁ taguḷdu tammaṁ suḍe
caturvidhamappāhārakkaṁ jāvajjīvaṁ nivr̥ttigeydu śubhamappa
śukladhyānaṅgaḷaṁ jānisi ghātikarmaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisiyantargata
kēvaliyāgiyeṇṭu karmaṅgaḷaṁ kiḍisi tapōgniyiṁ suṭṭu
mōkṣakke pōdar

matte peṟaruṁ saṁnyasanaṁ geydirda kṣapaṇakaruṁ
daṇḍaka risiyaraṁ kāsida moneyambugaḷindeccu
māḍidupasargamumaṁ yamunāvaṅka risiyar kicciniṁ
bendupasargamumaṁ manadoḷ bagedu pasivuṁ nīraḻke
modalāgoḍeyavirpatteraḍu parīṣahaṅgaḷumaṁ
vyādhigaḷoḷappa vēdanegaḷumaṁ sairisi parama śuddha
sahaja darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi svargāpavarga
sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head:
mahēndradattācāryar
modalāda
aynūrvar risiyarkaḷa kathe
div.p:
mahēndradattācāryar modalāgoḍeya aynūrvar
risiyarkaḷa katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ
div.ab:
ṇagarē – poḻaloḷ , mahēndradattādīṇaṁ –
mahēndradattarembācāryar modalāgoḍeya
risiyarkaḷ , pañcasadā – aynūrvar , kumbhakāraghaḍē –
kumbhakāraghaṭamembudaṟoḷ , ārādhaṇaṁ – sahaja darśana
jñāna cāritraṅgaḷārādhaneyaṁ, pavaṇṇā – pordidor ,
pīḷijjantāvi – piḻiyepaṭṭarāgiyuṁ, jantēhiṁ
gāṇaṅgaḷindaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambū dvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷ vidēhamembudu
nāḍalli sāvastiyembudu poḻaluṇṭadanāḷvoṁ
jitaśatruvembonarasanātana mahādēvi dhāriṇi
yemboḷāyirvarggaṁ magaṁ skandakumāranembonātaniṁ
kiṟiyaḷ puṇḍrayaśeyemboḷākeyaṁ dakṣiṇāpathadoḷ
kumbhakāraghaṭamemba poḻaladanāḷvoṁ daṇḍakanembarasaṅge
koṭṭudantavarggaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ
kālaṁ sale

mattitta munisuvrata tīrthakara parama dēvara pakkade
mahēndradattanuṁ jitaśatruva maganappa skandakumāranuṁ
modalāgoḍeya aynūrvar rājaputrarkaḷ
tapambaṭṭōdugaḷellamaṁ kaltu abhinandanaremba
gaṇadhararoḍane grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba
paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ barpor
kaḷiṅga dēśadoḷ dantapuramemba poḻalaneydi alli
kelavu divasamirpannegaṁ ā poḻalanāḷvoṁ janārdana
mahārājanembonarasanātana purōhitaṁ vyāḷanembonātaṁ
skandakumāra r̥ṣiyaroḍane arasana munde paṇḍitarkaḷa
naḍuve vādugeydu sōltoḍarasanātananaṭṭi kaḷedoḍātanuṁ
pōgi daṇḍakanembarasaṅgāḷāgiyalli mantripadamaṁ
pettirpannegaṁ

mattitta r̥ṣiyarkaḷuṁ grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba
paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttaṁ barpor
kumbhakāraghaṭamemba poḻalgevandoḍā poḻalanāḷ
daṇḍakanr̥pati biccuvarge bhaktanappātaṁ risiyarkaḷa
baravaṁ kēḷdu bandu bandisiyabhinandana bhaṭārara pakkade
vicārisi dharmamaṁ kēḷdu mecci nambi śrāvakabrataṅgaḷaṁ
kaikoṇḍu śrāvakanāgi aynūrvar risiyarkaḷumaṁ
pratidivasakkaṁ atibhaktiyindaṁ niṟisi tāṁ pakkadirdu
divyāhāraṅgaḷanūḍutintu r̥ṣiyarkaḷge besakeyyuttamire
skandakumāra r̥ṣiyoḍane vādugeydu sōltoḍe tannanaṭṭi
kaḷedudu kāraṇamāgi vyāḷanembaṁ mantri r̥ṣiyarkaḷanaṭṭi
kaḷevupāyamane bageyuttirpon

ondu divasaṁ aḍavige pōgi risiyarkaḷ siddhāntamaṁ
pariviḍigeydudaṁ kēḷdu poḻalgevanda baḻikke avarōduva
kṣētrada sāreyondu giḍuvina keḻage kelavumāyudhaṅgaḷaṁ
pūḻdu bandarasaṅgintendanīyaynūrvaruṁ risiyarkaḷu
marasumakkaḷe mahābala parākramamanoḍeyarī
rūpaṁ tōṟi nambisi nimma prāṇakkapāyamaṁ
māḍal bagedu bandaradaṟiṁ biḍadavarallige pōgalvēḍa
avarumaṁ nambalvēḍendēkāntadoḷ pēḻdu
mattamintendanentaṟiyalakkumavarāyudhaṅgaḷaṁ
pūḻdirdarappudaṟiṁ kūrparanaṭṭi avarōduva kṣētrade
baḷasiyuṁ nōḍisuvudendu pēḻdoḍarasanumāḷgaḷaṁ
nōḍimendu besavēḻdoḍavaruṁ pōgiyavarōduva
kṣētradoḷ nōḍi giḍuvina keḻage pūḻdirdāyudhaṅgaḷaṁ
tandarasaṅge tōṟidoḍe arasanendaṁ risiyaroṁ
diṟupegappoḍaṁ polladaṁ bageyadavarenagahitamaṁ
bagevare polladorārānuṁ r̥ṣiyarge muḷivar
pūḻdiṭṭarakkumendarasanadaṁ kaḍegaṇisi kemmagirdaṁ

matte kelavu divasadiṁ bhaṇḍārada maneyoḷ kannamikkisi
bhaṇḍārada puḍukegaḷaṁ pōḻdu drammamuṁ ponnuṁ
tuḍugegaḷumaṁ sāliṭṭantireyuguttaṁ naḍuviruḷ koṇḍu
pōgiyavarirpa basadiyoḷagondu kōṇeyoḷoṭṭirisi
bandu poḻtaḍe arasaṅgintendu pēḻdaṁ dēvā bhaṇḍārada
maneyoḷ kannamanikki bhaṇḍāramellamaṁ kaḷdukoṇḍu
pōdarendu pēḻdoḍarasanār koṇḍarārayyendu taḷāṟaṅge
besavēḻdoḍātanumāraydu bandu dēvā risiyar kannamikki
tamma basadiyoḷ kasavaramanoṭṭiṭṭu sāliṭṭantire basadi
varegaṁ drammamuṁ ponnuṁ sārabīdiyāgiyumuguttaṁ
pōduvendu pēḻdoḍarasanendaṁ r̥ṣiyar śrāvakarge
kaḷḷadiriṁ peṟara vastuvaṁ koḷḷadirimendu brataṅgaḷaṁ kuḍuvar
tāme kaḷvare ārānumavarge muḷivaridaṁ māḍidarendaduvaṁ
kaḍegaṇisi kemmagirdaṁ

matte kelavu dinadiṁ mēle suvrateyemba mahādēviyoḍane
mantri kajjamaṁ samakaṭṭiyondu divasamorva būtiṅge
drammamaṁ koṭṭoḍambaḍisi taleyaṁ kirisi kariya
kōvaṇamanuḍisi palgaḷoḷ kavaḍikeyaṁ kaṭṭisi kuñcamaṁ
koṭṭintendaṁ nīṁ mahādēviya mañcamanañjadēṟi
ākeyoḍane naguttaṁ tegaḻuttamirendu kalpisidanannegamittarasaṁ
r̥ṣiyarkaḷellarumanūḍi kaḻipida baḻikke barponannegamā
būtumā prastāvadoḷ pōgi mahādēviya mañcama
nēṟirdāgaḷ arasi mañcadindiḻidu kaigaḷaṁ mugidu
namōstidēnendu nuḍidoḍātanintendaṁ ninagāṭisi
bēṇṭaṅgoṇḍu bandeṁ peṟatēnumaṁ nuḍiyadiritta bā
endu mañcadatta karevudanitellamaṁ nr̥patige mantri tōṟi
intendaṁ nōḍarasā nimma savaṇara goḍḍamaṁ ninnaṁ kolal
neṟedāyudhaṅgaḷaṁ pūḻdiṭṭorendoḍaṁ nambideyilla
bhaṇḍāramaṁ kaḷdarendoḍadaṁ nambideyillamīgaḷ pratyakṣaṁ
nōḍu ninna mahādēviyoḍane goḍḍamāḍuvudaṁ ninna
peṇḍirumaṁ barduṅkalittapporillendu tōṟi nuḍidoḍarasaṁ
munna kaḻida dōṣamellamanivare māḍidarembondu
nambuge manadoḷāgi r̥ṣiyarkaḷge kaḍumuḷidu
mantriyanintendanivargge takka nigrahamaṁ nīnaṟidumāḍendu
pēḻdoḍātanumante geyvenendeḷḷagāṇaṅgaḷoḷiṭṭaynūrvar
r̥ṣiyarkaḷaṁ piḻidu kondanavaruṁ śukladhyānaṅgaḷoḷ
kūḍi muḍipiyanibaruṁ svargaṅgaḷoḷ puṭṭidar

mattavaroḷage skandakumāranemba risi niraparādhigaḷaṁ
nirdōṣigaḷaṁ nirarthakamī pātakaṁ kondanendu
tannantaraṅgadalli sairisalāṟade tīvrakōpaṁ puṭṭi kaimige ā
prastāvadoḷ tējōr̥ddhi puṭṭe ghanaravadiṁ bandarasanumaṁ
vyāḷanemba mantri modalāgi poḻalellā prajeyumaṁ
mattamātana nāḍa samasta jīvarāśigaḷellamaneyde suṭṭu tanna
śarīramumaṁ bhasmaṁ māḍi suṭṭu sattēḻaneya narakambokkaṁ

mattitta daṇḍakanr̥patiyumēḻaneya narakadoḷ
mūvattumūṟu sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyoṁ
nārakanāgi puṭṭiyallindaṁ bandu svayambhūramaṇa
samudradoḷ mahāmatsyamāgi puṭṭi palavu jīvaṅgaḷaṁ
kondu tindu sattāṟaneya narakadoḷ irpatteraḍu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeyoṁ nārakanāgi puṭṭi sattu
bandilli siṁhamāgi puṭṭi sattaydaneya narakadoḷ padinaydu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeya nārakanāgi puṭṭi sattu
bandilli pervāvāgi puṭṭi sattu nālkaneya narakadoḷ pattu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeya nārakanāgi puṭṭi sattu
bandilli puliyāgi puṭṭi sattu mūṟaneya narakadoḷ ēḻu
sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeya nārakanāgi puṭṭi sattu
bandilli bhēruṇḍavakkiyāgi puṭṭi sattu eraḍaneya narakadoḷ
mūṟu sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeya nārakanāgi
puṭṭi sattu bandilli koṅkanāgi puṭṭi pāpaṅgeydu sattu
prathama narakadoḷondu sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeya
nārakanāgi puṭṭi sattu bandilli trasasthāvaraṅgaḷoḷ puṭṭi
palakālaṁ saṁsāra duḥkhamananubhavisi nīḍaṟindettānuṁ
bandilli jaṭāyuvemba pakkiyāgi puṭṭi rāmadēvana
saṁsargadiṁ jinadharmamaṁ pettu pañcanamaskāradoḷ kūḍi
sattu svargadoḷ puṭṭittu

matte peṟaruṁ saṁnyasanaṁ geydirda bhavyarkaḷ mahēndradattaṁ
modalāgoḍeya aynūrvar r̥ṣiyarkaḷ gāṇadoḷ
piḻisikoṇḍudaṁ manadoḷ bagedu pasivuṁ nīraḻke
modalāgoḍeya parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ sairisi svargāpavarga
sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: cāṇākyarisiya kathe
div.p: cāṇākyarisiya katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ
div.ab:
goṭṭhē – tuṟupaṭṭiyoḷ , pāōgadō – prāyōpagamanakke
sandonāgi, subandhuṇā – subandhuvemboṁ mantriyindaṁ,
gobbarē – gobbaradoḷ , paḷividahmi – uripepaṭṭudādoḍe,
dajjhantō – bēyuttirdanāgiyuṁ, cāṇakkō –
cāṇākyanemba risi, paḍivaṇṇō – pordidoṁ, uttamaṁ aṭṭhaṁ
– mikka darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷārādhaneyaṁ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷ magadheyembudu
nāḍalli pāṭaḷīputramembudu poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
nandavaṁśadoṁ padmanembonarasanātana mahādēvi
sundariyemboḷāyirvargaṁ magaṁ mahāpadmanemboṁ
mantri kāpiyembonātaṅgeraḍaneya pesar
viśvasēnanembudantavargaḷiṣṭa viṣaya kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananu
bhavisuttireyire

mattondu divasaṁ kāpiyemba mantri sundari mahādēvige
kaṇbēṭaṅgoṇḍu arasanaṁ kondarasiyoḷ bāḻvenemba
bageyindaṁ paracakradarasugaḷaṁ padmana mēgēḻvantire
māḍiyarasananintendaṁ dēvā nimma sāramappa dravyama
nārumaṟiyadalli maḍagi nāmuccavigrahadoḷ nindu
kāduvamendu pēḻdu dravyamaniḍuva pradēśamaṁ
tōrpa nevadindarasanaṁ baygiruḷina jāvadāgaḷ
udyānavanakkoḍagoṇḍu pōgi guṇḍitappudondu
nāḍe kesaṟanoḍeya paḻavāviya taḍiyoḷiṟidu kondu
bāviyoḷ nūṅki desegaḷaṁ nōḻpanannegaṁ marana mēgirdu
pūgoyva vasantakanemba mālegāṟanarasana sāvaṁ kaṇḍu
tanagañji pāydōḍuva bharadiṁ maradaluguva kombaṁ
kaṇḍādamānuṁ bhayasthanāgi viśvasēnanintendaṁ

lg.l: yēnēyaṁ kampitā śākhā vānarēṇa narēṇa vā

div.p:
endintu hr̥daya santāpa paranāgi tanna manege vōgi
nēsarmūḍidoḍe sāmanta mahāsāmantarkaḷoḍane
aramaneya ōlagakke pōgi ellā vōḷiyu
maṟasiyarasiyarasanaṁ kāṇade kr̥taka duḥkhamanādamānuṁ
geydu keladivasamantirdu matte praśasta dina vāra nakṣatra
muhūrtadoḷ mahāpadmaṅge rājyābhiṣēkaṁ geydu
paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi suvrateyembarasige mahādēvi paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi sundari
mahādēviyoḍane maṟevāḻuttirkumintu palakālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ mahāpadmanintendu bagedanenna
tandeya sāvaninitondu mahānagaradoḷ
āvanorvanaṟiyadirkume ātananārayvenenda
ramaneyiṁ poṟamaṭṭu pōgi naṭṭanaḍuviruḷ
maṇikhēṭamanuradoḷamarci kiḻta bāḷverasu mane maneya
janaṅgaḷa nuḍiyaṁ kēḷuttamante pōpannegaṁ vasantakanemba
mālegāṟana maneyaneydi nuḍiyaṁ kēḷalirdanannegaṁ
ātaṁ vanamāḷeyemba tanna peṇḍatiya viyōgadiṁ
kaḍuduḥkhadindaṁ pēḻdudaṁ sābhiprāya sambandhamappa
vacanamaṁ kēḷdanadentene

ī vākyārthamaṁ kēḷdarasanaramanege vōgi nēsarmūḍe
sabhāmaṇṭapadoḷ siṁhāsanāsīnanāgi sāmanta
mahāsāmantarkaḷiṁ parivēṣṭitanāgirdu mālegāṟaṅge
baḻiyaṭṭi barisi emmarasanaṁ kondavanaṁ nīnaṟiveyañjade
pēḻalladirdoḍe ninnaṁ kolisidappenendoḍe bhayadiṁ
piḍipettumātanintendu pēḻdaṁ dēvā baygiruḷina
jāvadāgaḷ viśvasēnanemba mantriyarasananudyāna
vanakkoḍagoṇḍu pōgi bāviya taḍiyoḷirdiṟidu kondu
bāviyoḷ nūṅkuvuduṁ marananēṟi pūgoyyutir
kaṇḍettānumennumaṁ kolgumendu bhayadiṁ pāydōḍi
keṭṭenidenna kaṇḍa vr̥ttāntamendāgaḷ

ātaṅge mecci biccaḷisi tannaṅgacittamumaṁ kelavu bāḻumaṁ
koṭṭātanaṁ santasaṁ baḍisi mantriya pollameya
nellargaṟiye pēḻdātana putra mitra kaḷatra svajana bāndhava
sahitaṁ kolisalbagedoḍe sāmantādigaḷ bārisidoḍa
nibarumaṁ nelamaneyoḷikki mallal puguvanitu bāgilaṁ
māḍi pratidinakkondu mallala kūḻumanondu
mogape nīrumaṁ nelamaneyoḷagaṇge nīḍidoḍanibaruṁ
paccugoṇḍuṇbarintu paladivasaṅgaḷ sale

mattondu divasaṁ kāpi tannavaranintendaṁ nāminibaruṁ
sāvarumalla bāḻvarumallemmoḷāvanorvaṁ namma
pageyaniṟiyaluṁ nandanavaṁśamaṁ nirmūlaṁ māḍi
kiḍisalumārkumātanī mallala kūḻanuṇgendoḍe kāpiya
magaṁ subandhuvembonātanintendaṁ namma pageyaniṟiyaluṁ
nandanavaṁśamaṁ nirmūḷisalānārpenendu
pūṇdoḍātananuṇalvēḻdu uḻidavarellamuṇṇapaṭṭu sattar
subandhuvorvanuṇḍu bardon

intu mūṟuvarṣaṁ pōdimbaḻikke mattitta
pratyantavāsigaḷapparasugaḷ masagidoḍe mantriya guṇamaṁ
nenedu besagoṇḍaṁ mallala kūḻanārānuminnumuṇbaroḷare
endu besagoṇḍoḍoḷarendu pēḻdoḍe subandhuvaṁ
nelamaneyiṁ tegeyisi sanmānadānaṅgaḷindātanaṁ satkarisi
kṣamegoḷisi mantripadamaṁ koṭṭanātanuṁ paracakramaṁ
masagalīyade tanna buddhi kramadiṁ pūrvakramadoḷ
niṟisidoḍarasanātaṅgādamānumosedu tandeya
bāḻindaggaḷa bāḻimeyaṁ māḍidaṁ matteraḍaneya mantri
śakaṭāḷanembonātana magaḷ nandavatiyemboḷākeyaṁ
subandhu maduvenindu pradhānamantriyāgi iṣṭa viṣaya
kāmabhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ palakālaṁ sale

mattitta magadheyemba nāḍoḷ śālmaliyembagrahāradoḷ
sōmaśarmanemba pārvaṅgaṁ kapiḷeyemba pārvantigaṁ
magaṁ nālkudāḍeverasu puṭṭidoḍātaṅge tāyuṁ tandeyuṁ
cāṇākyanemba pesaraniṭṭar matte dāḍeverasu puṭṭidanembudaṁ
naimittikaṁ śrāvakaṁ vasantakanemboṁ kēḷdintendādēśaṁ geydaṁ

endādēśaṅgeydudaṁ cāṇākyana tande kēḷdu kaisāṇegaḷindaṁ
nālkuṁ dāḍegaḷanurdisi kaḷedu maṭṭaṁ māḍidoṁ
mattaṁ cāṇākyanuṁ baḷedu nālku vēdamumāṟaṅgamuṁ
padineṇṭu dharmaśāstraṅgaḷuṁ mīmāṁsā vyākaraṇaṁ
pramāṇaṁ chandamalaṅkāraṁ nighaṇṭu kāvya nāṭakaṁ
śālihōtraṁ vaidya sāmudrikaṁ nītiśāstraṁ modalāgoḍeya
śāstraṅgaḷellamaṁ kaltu r̥ṣiyara pakkade dharmamaṁ kēḷdu
śrāvakavrataṅgaḷaṁ kaikoṇḍu samyag dr̥ṣṭiyāgi palakālaṁ
sale matte pāṭaḷīputra purakke pōdoḍātana pāṇḍitya
muṁ samyag dr̥ṣṭiyappudumaṁ bhavyākāramumaṁ śakaṭāḷaṁ
kaṇḍu tanna kiṟiya magaḷaṁ yaśōmatiyemboḷaṁ koṭṭa
nātanumākeyaṁ maduve nindu sukhadiṁ kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ śōṇeyemba toṟeya taḍiyoḷ tanna
kālaṁ darbhāṅkuraṁ nettarvare koṇḍoḍe muḷidadanaguḻdu
suḍuvonaṁ subandhu kaṇḍu tatsambandhamellamaṁ
besagoṇḍoḍe svavairi vidhvaṁsanaṅgeydappenendaṟiyepēḻdoḍe
subandhu munnādēśamaṁ kēḷdanappudaṟindintendaṁ

emba ślōkārthamaṁ manadoḷ bagedu sakhāyanaṁ
pettenendosedumātana buddhiyaṁ parīkṣisalvēḍi bhaṭṭi
maṇḍapadoḷī ślōkamaṁ baredu pōdaṁ

ī bareda ślōkamaṁ cāṇākyanondu divasaṁ kaṇḍidu
nītiśāstrada balmeyaltendadaṁ sīṇṭi tānintendu baredaṁ

adaṁ subandhu kaṇḍu idanārvaredarendu besagoṇḍoḍe
cāṇākyaṁ baredanendu pēḻdoḍeyadaṁ kēḷdidarkanusāriyappa
buddhiyuṇṭendu manadoḷ bagedondu divasaṁ
tanna magaḷā cōḷaṅgiyoḷ svajana bāndhavajana
parijanarkaḷellarumaṁ barisi divyāhāraṅgaḷanūḍi
vastrādyābharaṇaṅgaḷiṁ pūjisi cāṇākyaṅgaṁ
yaśōmatigendirvargaṁ niśrāvamaṁ tanna bhāryeyappa
nandavatiya keyyoḷaṭṭidoḍe ākeyuṁ koṇḍu pōgi
nimagirvargaṁ niśrāvamendu pēḻdu yaśōmatige koṭṭu
pōdoḍe cāṇākyaṁ manadoḷintendu bagedaṁ lōkadoḷ
dāridryadiṁ biṭṭu kaṣṭatikeyondumilla aduve lōkadoḷ
mahāpātakamentumintembudalte

lg.l: saṅgaṁ naivahi kaścidēva kurutē nābhāṣatē bāndhavāt
manyē nirdhanatā prakāśamaparaṁ kaṣṭaṁ mahā pātakaṁ

div.p:
adaṟiṁ dravyārjanegeyvenembabhiprāyadindirpātanaṁ
subandhu kēḷdaṟidondu divasaṁ cāṇākyanaṁ
kaṇḍintendaṁ nimage dāridryamōkṣamakkuṁ
ṣaṣṭigrāmasamanvitamappa agrāsanamanarasanaṁ bēḍikoṇḍoḍe
sukhadiṁ bāḻvirene ātanumantegeyvenendarasanaṁ
kaṇḍupaślōkisiyagrāsanamaṁ bēḍikoṇḍoḍarasanuṁ mecci
koṭṭanintagrāsanamanuṇuttamaṟuvattu bāḍamanāḷuttaṁ
sukhasaṅkathāvinōdadiṁ kālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ subandhu mahāpadmanaṁ kiḍisuva
bageyindaṁ nandanakramāgatarappa brāhmaṇarkaḷanintendaṁ
nimmī padamembudu nanda mahārājaṁ vijayao
nandanaṁ sunandanaṁ nandivardhanaṁ nandanaṁ śrīnandanaṁ
padmaṁ mahāpadmanendintu ombattu talevaregaṁ kramāgataṁ
nimage bandagrahāramaṁ peṟar koṇḍu bāḻuttire nimage
kemmane nōḍuttirpudēṁ kāraṇaṁ pāḻiyendoḍa
vargaḷintendar nimma baladindamāmemma padamaṁ
paḍevemendoḍe antegeyyimendoḍavarumarasaṅgintendu
binnapaṁ geydar mahārājā kulakramāgataremuṁ nimma
prasādadiṁ bāḻvemuṁ kramadiṁ bandudemma padamaṁ
nimage kiḍisalāgadendāgaḷ subandhuvintendaṁ kṣatriyarge
pūrvakramāgatamaṁ kiḍisade salisuvude dharmamendoḍe

arasanagrāsanadiṁ cāṇākyanaṁ piṅgisendoḍantegeyvenendu
pōgiyagrāsanadoḷuṇalendu bandu
maṇeyanēṟirdonanintendaṁ nimagādamānuṁ
muḷidarasanintendaṁ madavihvaḷeyarappa
vēśyāṅganāsakta viṭajananivāsi ennagrāsanamanuṇalke
yōgyanallanadaṟindātananaṭṭikaḷeyimendaṭṭidanendu
pēḻdu paḍiyaṟanindameḻeyisi peḍataleyaṁ piḍidu
nūṅkuttamaramaneyindaṁ poṟamaḍisiyaṭṭi
kaḷedoḍādamānuṁ muḷidintendaṁ nandananandanāge
māḍuveṁ subandhuvanabandhu māḍuvenendu pratijñegeydu
poḻaliṁ poṟamaṭṭu pōgi panneraḍu varuṣadoḷage
mahāpadmanaṁ kiḍisidallade kāsegaḷaṁ kaḷeyenendu jādina
sēlegaḷanuṭṭu bhagavanta vēṣamaṁ kaikoṇḍu mahōdakamemba
poḻalgevōgi allirdan

annegamā poḻalanāḷvoṁ mayūravaṁśadarasaṁ
kumudanembonātana mahādēvi mandeyemboḷākege
garbhamāgi candranaṁ nuṅguva bayakeyāgi
baḍavādoḍarasaṁ besagoṇḍākeya bayakeyaṁ tīrcalāṟade
cintākuḷitanāgirpinamadaṁ cāṇākyaṁ kēḷdu arasanaṁ
kaṇḍānarasiya bayakeyaṁ neṟapuvenāyarasige puṭṭida
kūsanenagīyalārpoḍendoḍarasanīvenendoḍarasiyumaṁ
nannigoṇḍārumaṟiyadantire nr̥patiya prāsādada śikharada
madhyapradēśamaṁ bādaṇadantire chidraṁ māḍi candraniruḷ
madhyāhnamappa poḻtaṟoḷā chidrakkabhimukhamāge
piridondu kājina baṭṭaloḷ kammitappa nīraṁ tīvi
candrabimbamaṁ nīroḷ kāṇbantire māḍiyarasiyaṁ
tr̥ṣṇābhivr̥ddhiyappāhāramanūḍi nīraḍasidoḍe
cāṇākyanintendaṁ mantradindāhvānaṅgeydu tande candranaṁ
nuṅgu bāyendarasiyaṁ kaṇṇaṁ kaṭṭiyoḍagoṇḍu pōgi kaṇṇa
kaṭṭaṁ biṭṭu candranaṁ nuṅgendu tōṟidoḍākeyuṁ kaṇḍu
rāgisiyānīraṁ kuḍidu bayake neṟedattu

mattaṁ kelavu divasadiṁ navamāsaṁ neṟedu besaleyādā
kūsaṁ dādiyaniṭṭu cāṇākyaṅge koṭṭarātanuṁ
candrabhuktanendu pesaraniṭṭu bāyveṇṇeyoḍane kiṟikiṟide
nañjanūḍi baḻike baḷedoḍāhāradoḷūḍal taguḷdoṁ
matte padināṟaneya barisamādandu sāmantarkaḷgamalliya
mantriyarkaḷgamarasu makkaḷgaṁ taḷavaṟarkaḷgamintendu
nuḍidoṁ candrabhuktaṅge pr̥thviyellamanāḷva lakṣaṇaṅgaḷoḷavu
ītaṅgarasu māḍidappeṁ nimagellamilliya bāḻin
padirmaḍi bāḻaṁ māḍuvenendu bōdhisiyoḍagoṇḍu
pōgi mattaṁ peṟarumaṁ nerapi piriduṁ tantramaṁ māḍi
śrīparvatada mēganibarumanirisi

tānorvane pōgi ponnaṁ māḻpa bageyindaṁ
mardugaḷanaṟasi suttaṁ toḻalvanannegaṁ parvatada
taḻpaloḷādamānuṁ guṇḍitappa rasada bāviyaṁ
moḍenārpudaṁ kaṇḍu muccida śileyaṁ kaḷedu
nōḻpanannegamadaṟoḷorvaṁ bāḻuttirda puruṣanaṁ kaṇḍu
nīnēkilli pokkirdeyendu besagoṇḍoḍātanendanorva
rasavādakanemba biccuvanī bāviyoḷagiḻidu nīnī rasamaṁ
mogedu koṭṭoḍadaṟoḷ māḍida ponnuṁ ninagamenagaṁ
samabhāgamakkumendoḍāṁ ponna lōbhadindaṁ
bāviyaṁ pokku rasamaṁ sōreyiṁ tīvi bēḻpanitumaṁ
mogedu koṭṭoḍātanennaṁ tegeyade pōdanante munnaṁ
palambarumanī mārgadiṁ bāviyoḷage pugisi rasamaṁ
koṇḍavaraṁ tegeyade kondanendu pēḻdoḍāṁ ninnaṁ tegedu
bāḻippenenage rasamaṁ mogedu kuḍendu niḍunēṇaṁ palavuṁ
sōregaḷumaṁ tandu tīvisikoṇḍātanumaṁ tegedu rasao
tinda meyge takka pratīkārada mardugaḷaṁ māḍiyātanaṁ
bāḻisi kaḻipidaṁ

mattā rasadindenitānuṁ ponnarāśiyaṁ māḍi
intendanārorvarondu pēṟu maṇṇaṁ śrīparvatada
mēgoṭṭuvaravargondu pēṟu ponnaṁ kuḍuve
nendā nāḍoḷ ghōṣaṇeyaṁ poysidoḍadaṁ
kēḷdorvanokkaliganondu pēṟu maṇṇaṁ tandu śrīparvatada
mēgoṭṭidoḍātaṅgondu pēṟu ponnaṁ koṭṭoḍadaṁ
kēḷdā nāḍokkaligarellaṁ maṇṇa pēṟaṁ tandu śrīparvatada
mēge baḷasiyuṁ piriduṁ rāśiyāgoṭṭi cāṇākyanaṁ ponnaṁ
bēḍidoḍintendaṁ nimmaṁ taravēḻdorāremagondu pēṟu
maṇṇu bāḻteyāge tarisikoṇḍevīyuḻida maṇṇemage
bāḻteyaltu nimma nimma tanda maṇṇaṁ koṇḍu pōgi
mendoḍavargaḷ nirāśeyāgi bisuṭṭu pōdar mattā
maṇṇindaṁ baḷasiyuṁ kōṇṭeyaṁ māḍi māṭakūṭa
prāsāda sahitaṁ poḻalaṁ māḍi ponnaṁ koṭṭu palavuṁ
kuduregaḷumaṁ kaṭṭiyāḷgaḷge koṭṭu

piriduṁ tantramaṁ māḍi candrabhuktananoḍagoṇḍu pōgi
mahāpadmana mēgerdātanoḷ kādi kāḷegamaṁ sōltōḍi
barduṅki mattaṁ tantramaṁ māḍi varuṣavaruṣakkaṁ pōgi kādi
sōltu barkuṁ mattorme mēleḻdu bavaramaṁ kādi sōlva
kāḷegamanaṟidu candrabhuktanaṁ pōgalvēḻdu tānuṁ nīḍuṁ
bēgaṁ kādi kāḷegamaṁ sōltu koḷguḷadoḷagirdāgaḷ
pōgal pāṅgillade sāreyondu tāmaregeṟeyuṇṭadaṁ
pokku neraviyellaṁ pōpannegamirdu iruḷ poṟamaṭṭu
pāṭaḷīputramaṁ pokku pasidu sāligara maneyaṁ
pokku sāligara birddiyanuṇalvēḍidoḍākeyuṁ kuḷḷiru
maganeyendēṟalikki kuḷḷirisi kañcaniṭṭu bisiyambaliyaṁ
baḍḍisidoḍātanuṁ pasidalampinindaṁ bisiyambaliyaṁ
bāyoḷiṭṭāgaḷ kayyuṁ bāyuṁ bendoḍe meyyanadirdu
kaiyaṁ bidirdavanaṁ birdi kaṇḍu nakkintendaḷ
ī lōkadoḷ mūvar mūrkharaṁ kaṇḍenendoḍe
cāṇākyanavarārabbāyendu besagoṇḍoḍākeyendaḷ
nīnuṁ nandanuṁ cāṇākyanumendu pēḻdoḍānentu
mūrkhanendu besagoṇḍoḍe magane buddhiyoḍeyon
bisiyambaliyaṁ kañcina kaḍekaḍeyoḷ kiṟikiṟidane
āṟisuttamuṇguṁ nīnantuṇalaṟiyadudaṟiṁ
mūrkhanene nandanēṁ mūrkhanendoḍe nandanendoḍaṁ
mahāpadmanendoḍamorvana pesare ātaṁ tanna koṭṭa
dānamaṁ kuḍadudaṟiṁ pagegoṇḍu pōpanaṁ tannārpande
kolladudaṟindaṁ nandaṁ mūrkhaṁ cāṇākyanentu
mūrkhanendoḍintendaḷ cāṇākyaṁ tanna muḷisane nōḻkuṁ
kajjamanaṟiyaṁ mūlatantramanoḍeyanuṁ kṣatriyanumallaṁ
pr̥thvīśvaranoḍane kādal barkumātaṅge buddhiyuḷḷoḍe tanna
pagevana nāḍaṁ kiḍisuvudu pratipakṣamaṁ tanage māḍuvudu
sāmanta mahāsāmantarkaḷaṁ dravyamaṁ koṭṭu bhēdisuvudu
tatsambandhigaḷaṁ pratipakṣadindaṁ kiḍisuvudumintu
māḍidoḍe nr̥patiyorvaneyuḻigumāgaḷ tanna bageda
kāryasiddhiyakkumendoḍe

abbā nimma pēḻdantuṭe kajjamenduṇḍu poṟamaṭṭu
śrīparvatakke pōgi piridu tantramaṁ māḍi sāligara
birddiya pēḻdante nandana nāḍaṁ kiḍisi sāmanta
mahāsāmantarkaḷaṁ dravyadiṁ bhēdisi tatpratipakṣamaṁ tannante
māḍi tatsambandhigaḷaṁ pratipakṣadindaṁ kiḍisi nandanorvane
uḻidāgaḷ candrabhuktaṁ berasu samasta balamellamaṁ
kūḍikoṇḍu mēlerdu kāduvāgaḷ mahāpadmana
sāmanta mahāsāmantaroḍḍaṇamanoḍḍirdoraṁ
kādavēḻdoḍaṁ kādalollade kemmagire mahāpadmaṁ bhēdakke
paḍe sandudembudanaṟidañjiyārumaṟiyadantire ōḍi
keṭṭaṁ mattitta subandhu piridu bēgaṁ kāḷegamaṁ kādi
sōltoḍātanaṁ piḍidu kaṭṭi saṅkaleyanikki seṟeyoḷiṭṭaṁ

matte cāṇākyaṁ kāḷegamaṁ geldu pāṭaḷīputramaṁ
pokku mahāpadmanarasiyarkaḷgaṁ bhaṇḍārakkaṁ kāpaniṭṭu
poḻala prajeyaṁ santaisi mattaṁ praśasta dina vāra nakṣatra
muhūrtadoḷ candrabhuktaṅge rājyābhiṣēkaṅgeydu
paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi mahāpadmanarasi candramati mahādēviyaṁ
candrabhuktaṅge mahādēvi māḍi matte nandana
bhaṇḍāradoḷaṁ tamma bhaṇḍāradoḷaṁ dravyamilladudanaṟidu
pāṭaḷīputrada prajegaḷaṁ nāḍa prajegaḷaṁ baḻiyaṭṭi
barisiyavargellamuṇisaṁ māḍi sorkappāhāramanūḍi nimma
nimma dravyaṅgaḷirdeḍeyaṁ tōṟimendu besagoṇḍoḍa
vargaḷ sorki meyyaṟiyadanibaruṁ tantamma dravyadeḍegaḷaṁ
tōṟi pēḻdu koṭṭarintanēka sahasrakōṭi dravyamaṁ
cāṇākyaṁ paḍedu candrabhuktaṅge tōṟi bhaṇḍāramaṁ
tīviyaramaneya mundaṇaṅgaṇadoḷ intendu pēḻdāḍidaṁ
panneraḍu varṣadindaṁ nandanavaṁśamaṁ nirmūlaṁ
māḍi kiḍisuvenendenna pūṇda pratijñe neṟedattu mattenage
jādinoḷūḍidaveraḍu vastramoḷavuṁ ponna guṇḍigeyu
muṇṭu mūṟudaṇḍamumoḷavu magadhenāḍa dravyamellamaṁ
tandu bhaṇḍāramaṁ tīvideṁ guṇaviśēṣamanaṟivarasanumenage
basamādaṁ poḍe paṟeyanendu paṟeyaṁ poysiyosedu
rāgisi tridaṇḍamanetti sorkida prajeverasu laṭaha
dindāḍidoṁ mattaṁ śrīparvatadoḷirda tanna
pārvanti yaśōmatige baḻiyaṭṭi barisiyākeyoḍane
bhōgōpabhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ sāmanta
mahāsāmantarkaḷgaṁ jīvitaṅgeydu taḷavargamumaṁ
santavisi magadhaviṣayamanāḷuttamiṣṭa viṣaya kāma
bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ palakālaṁ sale

mattaṁ candramati mahādēvige garbhamāgiyondu
divasaṁ rathamanēṟidoḍā rathada cakrada pattuṁ kadirgaḷ
neladoḷardudaṁ cāṇākyaṁ kaṇḍī candrabhuktaṁ modalāgi
pr̥thviyanēkacchatracchāyeyiṁ daśamayūrarkaḷāḷvarendā
dēśaṅgeydaṁ matte kelavu divasadiṁ candramati mahādēvige
navamāsaṁ neṟedondu divasamarasaṁ nañjinoḷ
berasidāhāramanuṇbāgaḷ pakkadirdarasige arasanoḍanuṇba
bayakeyādoḍe bāḷaṅkiḻtu nimirdu pakkadirda cāṇākyana
dr̥ṣṭiyaṁ bañcisi pracchannadindaṁ tanna keyya tuttanarasaṁ
viṣamiśramendaṟiyade koṭṭanadanāke bāyoḷiṭṭāgaḷe
cāṇākyaṁ kaṇḍu taleyaṁ pōgiṟidu basiṟaṁ pōḻdu kūsaṁ
poṟamaḍisuvudaṁ kaṇḍu hā ayyō enna candramati mahā
dēvi enna nallaḷeyendu praḷāpaṅgeydu duḥkhākrāntanāgi
tadviyōgadiṁ candrabhuktaṁ prāṇa parityāgaṅgeydaṁ mattā
kūsina taleyoḷinisānuṁ viṣa bindu panitudaṟindātaṅge
bindusāgaranendu pesaraniṭṭu paṭṭaṅgaṭṭi kūsaṁ tōṟi
yarasugeyyuttaṁ kālaṁ sale

matte bindusāgaraṁ navayauvananādandu cāṇākyaṅge
saṁsāra śarīra bhōgaṅgaḷoḷādaṁ vairāgyamāgi tapambaḍuva
bageyāgi subandhuvaṁ seṟeyiṁ biḍisi varisi kṣamegoḷisi
sanmānadānādigaḷindātanaṁ pūjisi bindusāgaraṅge
mantrimāḍiyarasanaṁ besaṅgoṇḍoḍambaḍisiyellarumaṁ
kṣamegoḷisi bāhyābhyantara parigrahaṅgaḷaṁ toṟedu
mativararembācāryara pakkade tapambaṭṭāgamamellamaṁ
kaltācāryarāgi palambar śiṣyarkaḷ māḍi grāma nagara
khēḍa kharvaḍa maḍamba paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ
vihārisuttaṁ palakālamugrōgra tapaścaraṇaṅgeydu matte
pāṭaḷīputrada sāre sōṇeyemba toṟeya taḍiya
tuṟupaṭṭiyoḷ vihārisuttaṁ bandirdar

ā baravaṁ subandhu kēḷdu mahāpadmana rājyamaṁ
koṇḍudumaṁ tannaṁ saṅkaleyoḷiṭṭu seṟegeydu
palakālaṁ nameyisida pageyumaṁ nenedu sañje
voḻtādāgaḷ bandisuva nevadindaṁ piridumarcaneyaṁ
koṇḍu pōgi cāṇākya r̥ṣiyar modalāgoḍeya
r̥ṣiyarkaḷanarcisi gurupariviḍiyindaṁ bandisi
piridubēgaṁ cāṇākyarisiyoḍane gōṣṭhiyirdu
pōpāgaḷ tannavarggendaṁ māgiya divasaṁ risiyarkaḷ
sītadoḷ seḍeguṁ sēdegeḍuvaradaṟiṁ baḷasiyuṁ piriduṁ
gobbaramanoṭṭimendu pakkadirdoṭṭisi baḷasiyuṁ kiccaṁ
taguḷcalvēḻdu poḻalge pōdaṁ

matte gobbarada kiccu baḷasiyuṁ tammaṁ suḍe cāṇākya
r̥ṣiyar modalāgoḍeya risiyarkaḷellaṁ

lg.l: chijjau bhijjau jāu khau jō iya ēhu sarīru
appā bhāvahi ṇimmalau jēṁ pāvahi bhava tīru
khammāmi savvajīvāṇaṁ savvē jīvā khamantu mē
mettī mē savvabhūdēsu vēraṁ majjhaṇa kēṇaci

div.p:
endintu kṣameyaṁ bhāvisi caturvidhamappāhāra
śarīramumaṁ toṟediṅgiṇī maraṇadiṁ śubhapariṇāmadoḷ
kūḍi mikka ratnatrayamanārādhisi sanatkumāra kalpadoḷ
sarvārthamemba vimānadoḷ cāṇākya risiyar puṭṭidar
mattuḻida r̥ṣiyarkaḷellaṁ saudharmakalpaṁ modalāgoḍeya
kalpaṅgaḷoḷ puṭṭidar

matte peṟaruṁ saṁnyasanaṁ geydirda kṣapaṇakaruṁ cāṇākya
risiyaraṁ manadoḷ bagedu caturvidhamappupasargamumaṁ
pasivuṁ nīraḻke modalāgoḍeya ippatteraḍu parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ
vyādhigaḷoḷappa vēdanegaḷumaṁ sairisi śubha pariṇāmadiṁ
mikka darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷanārādhisi svargāpavarga
sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

div.head: vr̥ṣabhasēnaremba risiyara kathe
div.p: vr̥ṣabhasēnaremba risiyara katheyaṁ pēḻveṁ
div.ab:
vasaīē – basadi, paḷidāē – uripepaṭṭudādoḍe,
viṭṭhāmacchēṇa – viṣṭamatsyanindaṁ, usahasēṇōvi –
vr̥ṣabhasēnācāryar , ārādhaṇaṁ – mikka darśana jñāna
cāritraṅgaḷārādhaneyaṁ, pavaṇṇō – pordidoṁ,
saṅghaparisāe – tamma risi samudāyamberasu, kuṇāḷahmi –
kuṇāḷamemba poḻaloḷ
div.p: adentendoḍe

ī jambūdvīpada bharatakṣētradoḷ dakṣiṇāpathadoḷ
karahaṭamembudu nāḍalli kuṇāḷamemba poḻaladanāḷvoṁ
dhanadanembonarasanātana mahādēvi padmaśrīyemboḷ
mantri viṣṭamatsyanemboṁ piriya paṇḍitanantavargaḷiṣṭa
viṣaya kāma bhōgaṅgaḷananubhavisuttaṁ palakālaṁ sale

mattondu divasaṁ vr̥ṣabhasēnarembācāryar piridu
risisamudāyaṁ berasu grāma nagara khēḍa kharvaḍa
maḍamba paṭṭaṇa drōṇāmukhaṅgaḷaṁ vihārisuttamā
poḻalge bandondu basadiyoḷirdaravara baravanarasanuṁ
poḻalavaruṁ kēḷdu piriduṁ pūjeyaṁ koṇḍu
pōgiyarcisi pūjisi poḍevaḍuvudaṁ viṣṭamatsyaṁ kaṇḍu
sairisalāṟade mātsaryadindaṁ tanna pāṇḍityada garvadindaṁ
vr̥ṣabhasēnācāryaroḍane vādugeydu neraviyoḷ sōltu
siggāgi pōgi naṭṭanaḍuviruḷ bandu kiccaṁ taguḷci pōdaṁ

mattaṁ vr̥ṣabhasēnācāryar modalāgoḍeya risiyarkaḷ
kṣameyaṁ bhāvisi caturvidhamappāhārakkaṁ śarīrakkaṁ
yāvajjīvaṁ nivr̥ttigeydu śubhapariṇāmadindaṁ mikka
ratnatrayaṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi muḍipiyalli vr̥ṣabhasēnācāryar
padinālkaneya prāṇatamemba kalpadoḷ puṣpakamemba
vimānadoḷirpattu sāgarōpamāyuṣyamanoḍeya
dēvanāgi puṭṭidar mattuḻida r̥ṣiyarkaḷuṁ tantamma
tapōnuṣṭhānakke takkantu saudharma kalpaṁ modalāgoḍeya
svargaṅgaḷoḷ puṭṭidar

mattaṁ peṟaruṁ saṁnyasanaṅgeydirda kṣapaṇakaruṁ
vr̥ṣabhasēnācāryar modalāgoḍeya risiyarkaḷaṁ
manade bagedu caturvidhamappusargamumaṁ pasivuṁ nīraḻke
modalāgoḍeya parīṣahaṅgaḷaṁ vyādhigaḷoḷappa vēdane
gaḷumaṁ sairisi kṣameyaṁ bhāvisi śubha pariṇāmadindaṁ parama
śuddha sahaja darśana jñāna cāritraṅgaḷaṁ sādhisi svargāpavarga
sukhaṅgaḷaneyduge

body.trailer:
ī pēḻda pattoṁbattu kathegaḷaṁ
śivakōṭyācāryar pēḻdār
vaḍḍārādhane sampūrṇaṁ
